title: 1  Annals of Emperor Wǔ
1  Annals of Emperor Wǔ
text:
Tàizǔ Wǔ Huángdì was a Pèi state Qiáo man, family name Cáo, forbidden name Cāo, appellation Mèngdé, Hàn Chancellor of State [Cáo] Cān’s posterity. [1] During Emperor Huán’s reign, Cáo Téng became Central Regular Attendant and Chief Prolonging Autumn, enfeoffed as Marquess of Fèi precinct. [2] His adopted son [Cáo] Sōng succeeded, office reached Grand Commandant, none can determine his birth origins. [3] [Cáo] Sōng begat Tàizǔ.



太祖武皇帝，沛國譙人也，姓曹，諱操，字孟德，漢相國參之後。〔一〕桓帝世，曹騰為中常侍大長秋，封費亭侯。〔二〕養子嵩嗣，官至太尉，莫能審其生出本末。〔三〕嵩生太祖。










[1] Cáo Mán zhuàn states: Tàizǔ had another name Jílì, childhood appellation Ā’mán. Wáng Chén’s Wèi shū states: His ancestry originated from Huáng-dì. During Gāoyáng’s era, Lùzhōng’s son called Ān was the Cáo family name. Zhōu King Wǔ conquered Yīn, and to preserve the previous era’s lineages, enfeoffed Cáo Xiá with Zhū. During the Spring and Autumn era, [Zhū state] participated in alliances, and reaching to the Warring States, it was destroyed by Chǔ. The descendants scattered, and some settled at Pèi. At the rise of Hàn Gāozǔ, Cáo Cān for his achievements was enfeoffed as Marquess of Píngyáng, for generations inheriting the noble rank and territory, the succession cut off but again restored, reaching the present the succession state was Róngchéng.



〔一〕　〔曹瞞傳曰〕：太祖一名吉利，小字阿瞞。王沈魏書曰：其先出於黃帝。當高陽世，陸終之子曰安，是為曹姓。周武王克殷，存先世之後，封曹俠於邾。春秋之世，與於盟會，逮至戰國，為楚所滅。子孫分流，或家於沛。漢高祖之起，曹參以功封平陽侯，世襲爵土，絕而復紹，至今適嗣國於容城。













[2] Sīmǎ Biāo’s Xù Hàn shū states: [Cáo] Téng’s father [Cáo] Jié appellation Yuánwěi was praised for his benevolent and generous nature. A neighbor had lost a pig, which resembled [Cáo] Jié’s pig, visited his door to request it, and [Cáo] Jié did not argue with him. Later the lost pig returned to its home on its own. The pig owner was greatly ashamed, sent back the pig he had requested, and apologized to [Cáo] Jié. [Cáo] Jié laughed and accepted it. Because of this the people of the village esteemed him and sighed in admiration. His eldest son was Bóxīng, the next son Zhòngxīng, the next son Shūxīng. [Cáo] Téng appellation Jìxīng when young became a Yellow Gate Following Official. Yǒngníng Inaugural Year [120], Dowager Empress Dèng gave Edict for the Yellow Gate Director to select from the Yellow Gate Following Officials someone young, friendly, and diligent, to accompany the Imperial Heir-Apparent in study, and [Cáo] Téng in answer was selected. The Heir-Apparent was especially close with and favored [Cáo] Téng, and the drink and food bestowed on him was different from all others. When Emperor Shùn succeeded the throne, [Cáo Téng] became Lesser Yellow Gate, and his advancement reached Central Regular Attendant and Chief Prolonging Autumn. He was in office for over thirty years, served four Emperors, and never once had a fault. He enjoyed advancing and conveying the worthy and capable, and to the end slandered or harmed no one. Those he praised and recommended such as Chénliú’s Yú Fàng and Biān Sháo, Nányáng’s Yán Gù and Zhāng Wēn, Hóngnóng’s Zhāng Huàn, Yǐngchuān’s Tángxī Diǎn, and others, all reached rank among the Excellencies and Ministers, but he did not boast of his contributions. The Shǔ Prefecture Administrator used his Calculations Clerk to send salutations to [Cáo] Téng, Yì Province Inspector Zhǒng Hào at Hángǔ Pass searched and discovered the letter, reported the Administrator, and also memorialized that [Cáo] Téng was an inner official communicating with the outside, that this was inappropriate, and requested that he be dismissed from office and punished. The Emperor said: “The letter came in from the outside, [Cáo] Téng did not send a letter out, so this is not his crime,” and therefore dismissed [Zhǒng] Hào’s memorial. [Cáo] Téng did not take offense for this, and always praised and admired [Zhǒng] Hào, believing that [Zhǒng] Hào had the highest integrity in handling affairs. [Zhǒng] Hào later became Excellency over the Masses, and said to someone: “Today I am an Excellency because of Regular Attendant Cáo’s kindness.” [Cáo] Téng’s behaviors in affairs were all of this sort. When Emperor Huán succeeded the throne, as [Cáo] Téng was the former Emperor’s long-serving official, his loyalty and filial nature manifest and outstanding, he was enfeoffed as Marquess of Fèi precinct, added rank as Specially Advanced. Tàihé Third Year [229], posthumously honored [Cáo] Téng as Gāo Huángdì.



〔二〕　司馬彪續漢書曰：騰父節，字元偉，素以仁厚稱。鄰人有亡豕者，與節豕相類，詣門認之，節不與爭；後所亡豕自還其家，豕主人大慚，送所認豕，并辭謝節，節笑而受之。由是鄉黨貴歎焉。長子伯興，次子仲興，次子叔興。騰字季興，少除黃門從官。永寧元年，鄧太后詔黃門令選中黃門從官年少溫謹者配皇太子書，騰應其選。太子特親愛騰，飲食賞賜與眾有異。順帝即位，為小黃門，遷至中常侍大長秋。在省闥三十餘年，歷事四帝，未嘗有過。好進達賢能，終無所毀傷。其所稱薦，若陳留虞放、邊韶、南陽延固、張溫、弘農張奐、潁川堂谿典等，皆致位公卿，而不伐其善。蜀郡太守因計吏修敬於騰，益州刺史种暠於函谷關搜得其牋，上太守，并奏騰內臣外交，所不當為，請免官治罪。帝曰：「牋自外來，騰書不出，非其罪也。」乃寢暠奏。騰不以介意，常稱歎暠，以為暠得事上之節。暠後為司徒，語人曰：「今日為公，乃曹常侍恩也。」騰之行事，皆此類也。桓帝即位，以騰先帝舊臣，忠孝彰著，封費亭侯，加位特進。太和三年，追尊騰曰高皇帝。













[3] Xù Hàn shū states: [Cáo] Sōng appellation Jùgāo. By nature he was kindhearted and careful, and wherever he was he was loyal and filial. He became Director of Retainers Colonel. Emperor Líng promoted him to Minister of Agriculture, Minister Herald, and he succeeded Cuī Liè as Grand Commandant. Huángchū Inaugural Year [220], posthumous title honored [Cáo] Sōng as Tài Huángdì.
A Wú man’s composed Cáo Mán zhuàn and Guō Bān’s Shìyǔ both say that [Cáo] Sōng was the Xiàhóu clan’s son, Xiàhóu Dūn’s father’s younger brother. Tàizǔ and [Xiàhóu] Dūn were paternal first cousins.



〔三〕　續漢書曰：嵩字巨高。質性敦慎，所在忠孝。為司隸校尉，靈帝擢拜大司農、大鴻臚，代崔烈為太尉。黃初元年，追尊嵩曰太皇帝。吳人作曹瞞傳及郭頒世語並云：嵩，夏侯氏之子，夏侯惇之叔父。太祖於惇為從父兄弟。







Tàizǔ was clever and perceptive as a youth, had ability to adapt, but he acted as a vigilante and was unrestrained, did not manage [moral] conduct and study, and therefore the people of the era did not consider him remarkable. [4] Only Liáng state’s Qiáo Xuán and Nányáng’s Hé Yóng were impressed with him. [Qiáo] Xuán said to Tàizǔ: “Heaven’s Under will fall into chaos, and if not for a destined talent, it cannot be saved. The one able to bring peace could be you!” [5] Aged twenty years, he was nominated as Filial-Incorruptible and became a cadet, was appointed Luòyáng North Division Commandant, transferred to Magistrate of Dùnqiū, [6] summoned back as a Consultant Cadet. [7]



太祖少機警，有權數，而任俠放蕩，不治行業，故世人未之奇也；〔一〕惟梁國橋玄、南陽何顒異焉。玄謂太祖曰：「天下將亂，非命世之才不能濟也，能安之者，其在君乎！」〔二〕年二十，舉孝廉為郎，除洛陽北部尉，遷頓丘令，〔三〕徵拜議郎。〔四〕










[4] Cáo Mán zhuàn says: Tàizǔ as a youth enjoyed flying hawks and hunting with dogs, roaming and playing without restraint, and his father’s younger brother repeatedly reported this to [Cáo] Sōng. Tàizǔ was worried about this, later encountered his uncle on the road, and then acted by withering his facing and twisting his mouth. His uncle was bewildered and asked of the cause. Tàizǔ said: “A sudden stroke.” His uncle reported this to [Cáo] Sōng. [Cáo] Sōng was alarmed, called Tàizǔ, but Tàizǔ’s mouth and appearance were as usual. [Cáo] Sōng said: “Your uncle said you were having a stroke. Are you already recovered?” Tàizǔ said: “From the beginning there was no stroke, but having lost the favor of my uncle, I therefore meet with false accusations.” [Cáo] Sōng thus became suspicious, and from then afterward when the uncle reported something, [Cáo] Sōng to the end did not again believe it, and Tàizǔ from this increased his recklessness.



〔一〕　曹瞞傳云：太祖少好飛鷹走狗，游蕩無度，其叔父數言之於嵩。太祖患之，後逢叔父於路，乃陽敗面喎口；叔父怪而問其故，太祖曰：「卒中惡風。」叔父以告嵩。嵩驚愕，呼太祖，太祖口貌如故。嵩問曰：「叔父言汝中風，已差乎？」太祖曰：「初不中風，但失愛於叔父，故見罔耳。」嵩乃疑焉。自後叔父有所告，嵩終不復信，太祖於是益得肆意矣。













[5] Wèi shū states: Grand Commandant Qiáo Xuán at the time was famed for understanding men, observed Tàizǔ and was impressed with him, saying: “I have met many famed servicemen Under Heaven, but have never met any like you! You must exert yourself. I am already old, and hope to entrust my wives and children [to your care].” Because of this, his reputation and fame became increasingly valued.
Xù Hàn shū states: [Qiáo] Xuán appellation Gōngzǔ, was strict and wise and had talent and strategy, and was strong in appraising men.
Zhāng Fán’s Hàn jì states: [Qiáo] Xuán successively held positions inside and outside [the capital], was praised for his firmness and decisiveness, was modest and respectful to subordinate servicemen, and did not use his noble rank for private or family gains. During Guānghé [178 – 185] he became Grand Commandant, due to chronic illness resigned, was appointed as Grand Central Grandee, died, his family was impoverished with no property, his coffin had no place for a funeral. At the time because of this he was praised as a famed official.
Shìyǔ states: [Qiáo] Xuán said to Tàizǔ: “You do not yet have fame, and can associate with Xǔ [Shào] Zǐjiāng.” Tàizǔ therefore visited [Xǔ] Zǐjiāng, [Xǔ] Zǐjiāng received him, and from this he became famed.
Sūn Shèng’s Yìtóng Záyǔ says: Tàizǔ once secretly entered Central Regular Attendant Zhāng Ràng’s estate [uninvited]. [Zhāng] Ràng discovered him, and [Cáo Cāo] thus brandished a hand halberd in the courtyard and leaped over the wall to escape. His talent and martial ability surpassed others, none could harm him. He widely read many books, especially enjoyed military strategy, copied and compiled the various schools of military strategy [into one book] named Jiēyào, and also annotated Sūn Wǔ’s thirteen chapters, and both were passed through the generations. Once he asked Xǔ Zǐjiāng: “What sort of man am I?” Xǔ Zǐjiāng did not answer. He stubbornly asked him, and Zǐjiāng said: “You are a governed era’s capable minister, a chaotic era’s treacherous opportunist.” Tàizǔ greatly laughed.



〔二〕　魏書曰：太尉橋玄，世名知人，睹太祖而異之，曰：「吾見天下名士多矣，未有若君者也！君善自持。吾老矣！願以妻子為託。」由是聲名益重。
續漢書曰：玄字公祖，嚴明有才略，長於人物。張璠漢紀曰：玄歷位中外，以剛斷稱，謙儉下士，不以王爵私親。光和中為太尉，以久病策罷，拜太中大夫，卒，家貧乏產業，柩無所殯。當世以此稱為名臣。世語曰：玄謂太祖曰：「君未有名，可交許子將。」太祖乃造子將，子將納焉，由是知名。孫盛異同雜語云：太祖嘗私入中常侍張讓室，讓覺之；乃舞手戟於庭，踰垣而出。才武絕人，莫之能害。博覽群書，特好兵法，抄集諸家兵法，名曰接要，又注孫武十三篇，皆傳於世。嘗問許子將：「我何如人？」子將不答。固問之，子將曰：「子治世之能臣，亂世之姦雄。」太祖大笑。













[6] Cáo Mán zhuàn states: When Tàizǔ first entered the Commandant Office, he repaired the Four Gates, made five colored staves, and hung to the left and right of the gates over ten staves. Any that violated the law, no matter how powerful and strong, were all beaten to death. After several moons, Emperor Líng’s favorite the Lesser Yellow Gate Jiǎn Shuò’s father’s younger brother was out at night, and immediately was killed. The capital hid its tracks, none daring to violate the law. The close and long-serving favored ministers all hated him, but could not harm him, and therefore together praised and recommended him, and therefore he was transferred to Dùnqiū Magistrate.



〔三〕　曹瞞傳曰：太祖初入尉廨，繕治四門。造五色棒，縣門左右各十餘枚，有犯禁，不避豪彊，皆棒殺之。後數月，靈帝愛幸小黃門蹇碩叔父夜行，即殺之。京師斂跡，莫敢犯者。近習寵臣咸疾之，然不能傷，於是共稱薦之，故遷為頓丘令。













[7] Wèi shū states: Tàizǔ’s younger female cousin’s husband the Marquess of Yīnqiáng, Sòng Qí, was executed, and in connection he was dismissed from office. Later, because he could understand ancient scholarship, he was again recruited and appointed a Consultant Cadet. Before this, General-in-Chief Dòu Wǔ and Grand Tutor Chén Fán had plotted to execute the eunuch officials but instead were destroyed by them. Tàizǔ sent up a letter explaining that [Dòu] Wǔ and the rest were upright and honest but had met with entrapment and murder, that treachery and corruption filled the Court, that good men were shut out. His words were extremely cutting, but Emperor Líng was not able to employ them. After this, Edict letter commanded the Three Offices to cite and report those who had been ineffective in governing the provinces and counties and so had the people create folk ballads about them, to be dismissed and expelled. The Three Excellencies tended to be corrupt, all pandered to situations to meet with Edict of employment, bribery occurred in all affairs, the powerful that were complained of were not cited and reported, and of the weak that held to principle many were entrapped and ruined. Tàizǔ resented this. That year, because of natural disasters and strange omens, there was widespread investigation of successes and failures, and because of this he again sent up letter with cutting remonstration, saying that the citations and reports by the Three Excellencies focused on avoiding conflicts with the powerful. The memorial was sent up, Heaven’s Son became aware, showed it to the Three Offices to reprimand them, and those who had been dismissed by folk ballads all became Consultant Cadets. After this governance and instruction daily became disordered, the powerful and crafty increased their intensity, with many ruined and destroyed. Tàizǔ knew correction was not possible, and therefore did not again proffer report.



〔四〕　魏書曰：太祖從妹夫濦彊侯宋奇被誅，從坐免官。後以能明古學，復徵拜議郎。先是大將軍竇武、太傅陳蕃謀誅閹官，反為所害。太祖上書陳武等正直而見陷害，姦邪盈朝，善人壅塞，其言甚切；靈帝不能用。是後詔書敕三府：舉奏州縣政理無效，民為作謠言者免罷之。三公傾邪，皆希世見詔用，貨賂並行，彊者為怨，不見舉奏，弱者守道，多被陷毀。太祖疾之。是歲以災異博問得失，因此復上書切諫，說三公所舉奏專回避貴戚之意。奏上，天子感悟，以示三府責讓之，諸以謠言徵者皆拜議郎。是後政教日亂，豪猾益熾，多所摧毀；太祖知不可匡正，遂不復獻言。







At the end of Guānghé [178 – 185], the Huángjīn rebelled. He was appointed Cavalry Commandant and suppressed Yǐngchuān rebels, promoted to Jǐnán Chancellor. The state had over ten counties, of the Chief Clerks many flattered and attached to the powerful families, the bribery and corruption like a wolf’s mat, and therefore he memorialized to dismiss eight [out of ten] of them. He prohibited and ended excessive sacrifices, the treacherous fled away, and the prefecture borders were calm and ordered. [8] Long after this he was summoned back to become Dōng Prefecture Administrator. He did not accept, and claimed illness to return to his hometown. [9]



光和末，黃巾起。拜騎都尉，討潁川賊。遷為濟南相，國有十餘縣，長吏多阿附貴戚，贓污狼藉，於是奏免其八；禁斷淫祀，姦宄逃竄，郡界肅然。〔一〕久之，徵還為東郡太守；不就，稱疾歸鄉里。〔二〕










[8] Wèi shū states: The Chief Clerks greedily accepted bribes and relied on the power of the nobility, and previous Chancellors did not report them. Hearing that Tàizǔ was arriving and would have them all reported and dismissed, small and large were shaken and afraid, the treacherous fled way, hiding in other prefectures. Governance and instruction were greatly enacted, the entire prefecture purified and pacified. Previously, King Jǐng of Chéngyáng, Liú Zhāng, for having achievements for Hàn, therefore had his state establish sacrificial shrines. Qīng Province’s various prefectures turned to imitate it, Jǐnán especially excessive, reaching to six hundred sacrificial shrines. Of the merchants some borrowed Two Thousand dàn carriages and uniforms, with guides and escorts of singers and performers, the extravagance daily increasing. The people in connection were impoverished, and the successive generations of Chief Clerks had none dare to prohibit and stop it. Tàizǔ arrived, demolished all the sacrificial shrine rooms, stopped and cut off the government officials and people to prevent them from offering sacrifices. Reaching to when he controlled the government, he therefore eliminated treacherous and evil supernatural practices, and the excessive sacrifices of the era from this were then ended.



〔一〕　魏書曰：長吏受取貪饕，依倚貴勢，歷前相不見舉；聞太祖至，咸皆舉免，小大震怖，姦宄遁逃，竄入他郡。政教大行，一郡清平。初，城陽景王劉章以有功於漢，故其國為立祠，青州諸郡轉相倣效，濟南尤盛，至六百餘祠。賈人或假二千石輿服導從作倡樂，奢侈日甚，民坐貧窮，歷世長吏無敢禁絕者。太祖到，皆毀壞祠屋，止絕官吏民不得祠祀。及至秉政，遂除姦邪鬼神之事，世之淫祀由此遂絕。













[9] Wèi shū states: At the time, the powerful ministers dominated the Court, the noble families were without restraint. Tàizǔ would not violate principles to seek acceptance. Repeatedly and repeatedly he offended and was disobedient, feared he would endanger his family, and therefore requested to remain in the Residential Guard. He was appointed a Consultant Cadet, always claimed illness, and then announced he was returning to his hometown. He built a house outside the city walls, in the spring and summer studying and reading books and classics, in the autumn and winter shooting and hunting, and by this amused himself.



〔二〕　魏書曰：於是權臣專朝，貴戚橫恣。太祖不能違道取容。數數干忤，恐為家禍，遂乞留宿衛。拜議郎，常託疾病，輒告歸鄉里；築室城外，春夏習讀書傳，秋冬弋獵，以自娛樂。







Shortly after this, Jì Province Inspector Wáng Fēn, Nányáng’s Xǔ Yōu, Pèi state’s Zhōu Jīng and others gathered together powerful figures, plotting to depose Emperor Líng and establish the Marquess of Héféi [as Emperor], and informed Tàizǔ about this. Tàizǔ refused them. [Wáng] Fēn and the rest therefore failed. [10]



頃之，冀州刺史王芬、南陽許攸、沛國周旌等連結豪傑，謀廢靈帝，立合肥侯，以告太祖，太祖拒之。芬等遂敗。〔一〕










[10] Sīmǎ Biāo’s Jiǔzhōu Chūnqiū states: At the time Chén Fán’s son [Chén] Yì with the Technician Píngyuán’s Xiāng Kǎi met together with [Wáng] Fēn’s group. [Xiāng] Kǎi said: “Heaven’s Signs are not in favor of the eunuchs. The Yellow Gate and Regular Attendants truly will be clan exterminated.” [Chén] Yì was pleased. [Wáng] Fēn said: “If so, then [I, Wáng] Fēn wish to act.” Therefore, he with [Xǔ] Yōu and others together plotted. Emperor Líng wished to tour the north at the Héjiān former residences. [Wáng] Fēn and the rest plotted to take advantage of this to cause trouble, and sent up letter saying that Hēishān bandits were attacking and plundering the prefectures and counties, requesting permission to raise troops. It happened that in the north there was a red mist, from the east to west crossing the sky. The Grand Scribe sent up word: “There will be a secret plot. It is unsuitable to travel north.” The Emperor therefore stopped. Orders were sent to [Wáng] Fēn to dismiss his troops, and very soon after he was summoned [to the capital]. [Wáng] Fēn was afraid and killed himself.
Wèi shū records Tàizǔ’s refusal of [Wáng] Fēn stating: “The matter of deposing and establishing is the most inauspicious event of Heaven’s Under. The men of antiquity who weighed success and failure, calculated light and heavy, and so enacted it: Yī Yǐn and Huò Guāng were this. Yī Yǐn harbored the sincerity of utmost loyalty, held authority as the chief minister, occupied rank above all other officials, and therefore in advancing and retreating and in deposing and installing, his plans were followed and affairs accomplished. Reaching to Huò Guāng accepting appointment to be entrusted with the state, relying on rank as the Imperial clan’s servant, inside he took advantage of the heaviness of the Dowager Empress’s control of governance, outside he had the momentum of all the other ministers’ shared desires. Chāngyì had ascended only a few days, did not yet have esteemed and favored [followers], the Court lacked honest ministers, discussions came [only] from the intimate and near, and therefore the plan was enacted [as smoothly] as turning a circle, the matter was completed [as easily] as breaking a rotten stick. Now you sirs only look to the ease of the past, and have not observed the difficulties of the present. You sirs judge yourselves: in gathering multitudes and joining associations, can you compare to the Seven States? Does the nobility of Héféi compare to Wú and Chǔ? But you think to accomplish the extraordinary, expecting to be certainly successful, is this not also dangerous!”



〔一〕　司馬彪九州春秋曰：於是陳蕃子逸與術士平原襄楷會于芬坐，楷曰：「天文不利宦者，黃門、常侍（貴）〔真〕族滅矣。」逸喜。芬曰：「若然者，芬願驅除。」於是與攸等結謀。靈帝欲北巡河間舊宅，芬等謀因此作難，上書言黑山賊攻劫郡縣，求得起兵。會北方有赤氣，東西竟天，太史上言「當有陰謀，不宜北行」，帝乃止。敕芬罷兵，俄而徵之。芬懼，自殺。魏書載太祖拒芬辭曰：「夫廢立之事，天下之至不祥也。古人有權成敗、計輕重而行之者，伊尹、霍光是也。伊尹懷至忠之誠，據宰臣之勢，處官司之上，故進退廢置，計從事立。及至霍光受託國之任，藉宗臣之位，內因太后秉政之重，外有群卿同欲之勢，昌邑即位日淺，未有貴寵，朝乏讜臣，議出密近，故計行如轉圜，事成如摧朽。今諸君徒見曩者之易，未睹當今之難。諸君自度，結眾連黨，何若七國？合肥之貴，孰若吳、楚？而造作非常，欲望必克，不亦危乎！」







Jīnchéng’s Biān Zhāng and Hán Suì killed the Inspector and the Prefecture Administrator to rebel, their multitudes over a hundred thousand, Heaven’s Under was disturbed. Tàizǔ was summoned to be Organizing Army Colonel. It happened that Emperor Líng passed away, the Heir-Apparent succeeded the throne, the Dowager Empress oversaw the Court. General-in-Chief Hé Jìn with Yuán Shào plotted to execute the eunuchs, the Dowager Empress would not listen. [Hé] Jìn thus summoned Dǒng Zhuó, wishing to pressure the Dowager Empress. [11] [Dǒng] Zhuó had not yet arrived when Hé Jìn was killed. [Dǒng] Zhuó arrived, deposed the Emperor to become King of Hóngnóng, and established Emperor Xiàn, the capital was in great chaos. [Dǒng] Zhuó memorialized Tàizǔ to be Valiant Cavalry Colonel, wishing to plan affairs with him. Tàizǔ thus falsified his family name and personal name and on side paths returned east. [12] He went out the passes, passed Zhōngmù, was by a precinct chief suspected, arrested and sent to the county. Someone in the city secretly recognized him, and on his behalf requested and obtained his release. [13] [Dǒng] Zhuó then killed the Dowager Empress and the King of Hóngnóng. Tàizǔ reached Chénliú, spent his family wealth, gathering Righteous Troops, in order to execute [Dǒng] Zhuó. Winter, Twelfth Moon [189 Dec 26 – 190 Jan 23], he first raised troops at Jǐwú. [14] That year was Zhōngpíng Sixth Year.



金城邊章、韓遂殺刺史郡守以叛，眾十餘萬，天下騷動。徵太祖為典軍校尉。會靈帝崩，太子即位，太后臨朝。大將軍何進與袁紹謀誅宦官，太后不聽。進乃召董卓，欲以脅太后，〔一〕卓未至而進見殺。卓到，廢帝為弘農王而立獻帝，京都大亂。卓表太祖為驍騎校尉，欲與計事。太祖乃變易姓名，間行東歸。〔二〕出關，過中牟，為亭長所疑，執詣縣，邑中或竊識之，為請得解。〔三〕卓遂殺太后及弘農王。太祖至陳留，散家財，合義兵，將以誅卓。冬十二月，始起兵於己吾，〔四〕是歲中平六年也。










[11] Wèi shū states: Tàizǔ heard and laughed at this saying: “Castrate officials have been needed from antiquity to the present, but the present ruler should not have lent them authority and favor, so that it came to this. To punish their crimes, simply execute the leading criminals, and a single prison official would be enough. What need is there to continuously and messily summon outside officers? If one wishes to completely execute them, the matter will certainly be discovered. I see this will be a failure.”



〔一〕　魏書曰：太祖聞而笑之曰：「閹豎之官，古今宜有，但世主不當假之權寵，使至于此。既治其罪，當誅元惡，一獄吏足矣，何必紛紛召外將乎？欲盡誅之，事必宣露，吾見其敗也。」













[12] Wèi shū states: Tàizǔ, because [Dǒng] Zhuó in the end would certainly be overthrown and defeated, therefore did not accept the appointment, and fled to return to his hometown. With several accompanying riders he passed by his old friend, Chénggāo’s Lǚ Bóshē. [Lǚ] Bóshē was not there, and his son with their guest retainers together robbed Tàizǔ, taking his horse and baggage. Tàizǔ personally wielded blade, striking and killing several men.
Shìyǔ states: Tàizǔ passed by [Lǚ] Bóshē. [Lǚ] Bóshē was out abroad, his five sons were all present, and prepared a welcome ceremony. Tàizǔ himself had defied [Dǒng] Zhuó’s orders, suspected that others were plotting against him, personally wielded sword in the night killing eight men and fleeing.
Sūn Shèng’s Zájì states: Tàizǔ heard the sound of their food utensils, believed they were plotting against him, and therefore in the night killed them. Then he was sorrowful and said: “Better I betray others than let others betray me.” Then he left.



〔二〕　魏曰：太祖以卓終必覆敗，遂不就拜，逃歸鄉里。從數騎過故人成皋呂伯奢；伯奢不在，其子與賓客共劫太祖，取馬及物，太祖手刃擊殺數人。世語曰：太祖過伯奢。伯奢出行，五子皆在，備賓主禮。太祖自以背卓命，疑其圖己，手劍夜殺八人而去。孫盛雜記曰：太祖聞其食器聲，以為圖己，遂夜殺之。既而悽愴曰：「寧我負人，毋人負我！」遂行。













[13] Shìyǔ states: Zhōngmù suspected that he was a fugitive, and he was detained in the county. At the time an Assistant also had already received [Dǒng] Zhuó’s letter. Only the Merit Officer in his heart knew it was Tàizǔ, and believed the world was about to be in chaos and it was not appropriate to detain a powerful figure of Heaven’s Under, and therefore spoke with the Magistrate to release him.



〔三〕　世語曰：中牟疑是亡人，見拘于縣。時掾亦已被卓書；唯功曹心知是太祖，以世方亂，不宜拘天下雄雋，因白令釋之。













[14] Shìyǔ states: Chénliú’s Filial-Incorruptible [candidate] Wèi Zī used his family wealth to invest in Tàizǔ, allowing him to raise troops, the multitudes were five thousand men.



〔四〕　世語曰：陳留孝廉衛茲以家財資太祖，使起兵，眾有五千人。

title: 1  Annals of Emperor Wǔ
text:
Chūpíng (190 - 193)


Chūpíng Inaugural Year, Spring, Standard Moon [190 Feb 23 – Mar 23], Rear General Yuán Shù, Jì Province Governor Hán Fù, [15] Yù Province Inspector Kǒng Zhòu, [16] Yǎn Province Inspector Liú Dài, [17] Hénèi Administrator Wáng Kuāng, [18] Bóhǎi Administrator Yuán Shào, Chénliú Administrator Zhāng Miǎo, Dōng Prefecture Administrator Qiáo Mào, [19] Shānyáng Administrator Yuán Yí, [20] Jǐběi Chancellor Bào Xìn [21] at the same time all raised troops, their multitudes each several tens of thousands, and they elected [Yuán] Shào as Alliance Leader. Tàizǔ Acted as Exerting Warfare General.



初平元年春正月，後將軍袁術、冀州牧韓馥、〔一〕豫州刺史孔伷、〔二〕兗州刺史劉岱、〔三〕河內太守王匡、〔四〕勃海太守袁紹、陳留太守張邈、東郡太守橋瑁、〔五〕山陽太守袁遺、〔六〕濟北相鮑信〔七〕同時俱起兵，眾各數萬，推紹為盟主。太祖行奮武將軍。










[15] Yīngxióng jì states: [Hán] Fù appellation Wénjié was a Yǐngchuān man. He became Censorate Central Deputy. Dǒng Zhuó nominated him as Jì Province Governor. At that time Jì Province’s population was abundant and prosperous, its troops and provisions ample and sufficient. Yuán Shào was at Bǒhái, [Hán] Fù feared he would raise troops, and sent several bureau following officials to watch him and not allow him to move. Dōng Prefecture Administrator Qiáo Mào falsely made a capital Three Excellencies’ dispatch letter to the provinces and prefectures explaining [Dǒng] Zhuó’s crimes and evils, saying: “Meeting with coercion, with no way to rescue ourselves, we hope for Righteous Troops, to resolve the state’s suffering and difficulties.” [Hán] Fù obtained the dispatch, and invited his various following officials and asked: “Now do we support Yuán-shì or support Dǒng Zhuó?” Managing Central Following Official Liú Zǐhuì said: “Now raising troops is for the state, why speak of Yuán or Dǒng?” [Hán] Fù himself knew his words had been improper and had a shamed expression. [Liú] Zǐhuì further said: “Warfare is an inauspicious affair; one should not be the first. Now it is appropriate to go observe the other provinces, and if there is a mobilization, only afterward join it. Jì Province compared to other provinces is not weak, and the achievements of other people will not be ahead of Jì Province.” [Hán] Fù agreed with this. [Hán] Fù thus wrote a letter to Yuán Shào, explaining [Dǒng] Zhuó’s evils, permitting him to raise troops.



〔一〕　英雄記曰：馥字文節，潁川人。為御史中丞。董卓舉為冀州牧。于時冀州民人殷盛，兵糧優足。袁紹之在勃海，馥恐其興兵，遣數部從事守之，不得動搖。東郡太守橋瑁詐作京師三公移書與州郡，陳卓罪惡，云「見逼迫，無以自救，企望義兵，解國患難。」馥得移，請諸從事問曰：「今當助袁氏邪，助董卓邪？」治中從事劉子惠曰：「今興兵為國，何謂袁、董！」馥自知言短而有慚色。子惠復言：「兵者凶事，不可為首；今宜往視他州，有發動者，然後和之。冀州於他州不為弱也，他人功未有在冀州之右者也。」馥然之。馥乃作書與紹，道卓之惡，聽其舉兵。













[16] Yīngxióng jì states: [Kǒng] Zhòu appellation Gōngxù was a Chénliú man.
Zhāng Fán’s Hàn jì records Zhèng Tài’s conversation with [Dǒng] Zhuó saying: “Kǒng Gōngxù has ability in pure conversation and high discussion, breathing the withered to life.”



〔二〕　英雄記曰：伷字公緒，陳留人。張璠漢紀，載鄭泰說卓云：「孔公緒能清談高論，噓枯吹生。」













[17] [Liú] Dài was Liú Yáo’s elder brother. For the matter see Wú zhì.



〔三〕　岱，劉繇之兄，事見吳志。













[18] Yīngxióng jì states: [Wáng] Kuāng appellation Gōngjié was a Tàishān man. He thought little of wealth and enjoyed giving it out, and for acting as a vigilante was famed. He was recruited by General-in-Chief Hé Jìn’s Office as [Hé] Jìn’s tally messenger. [Wáng] Kuāng in Xú Province mobilized strong crossbow men of five hundred to go west to the capital. It happened that [Hé] Jìn was destroyed, [Wáng] Kuāng returned to his hometown. He rose from his home to be appointed Hénèi Administrator.
Xiè Chéng’s Hòu Hàn shū states: [Wáng] Kuāng as a youth was friendly with Cài Yōng. That year he was defeated by [Dǒng] Zhuó’s army and fled back to Tàishān, recruiting and gathering the strong and brave, obtaining several thousand men, wishing to join with Zhāng Miǎo. [Wáng] Kuāng had previously killed Metal Mace Bearer Húmǔ Bān. [Húmǔ] Bān’s family and dependents could not contain their anger, joined forces with Tàizǔ, and together killed [Wáng] Kuāng.



〔四〕　英雄記曰：匡字公節，泰山人。輕財好施，以任俠聞。辟大將軍何進府進符使，匡於徐州發彊弩五百西詣京師。會進敗，匡還州里。起家，拜河內太守。謝承後漢書曰：匡少與蔡邕善。其年為卓軍所敗，走還泰山，收集勁勇得數千人，欲與張邈合。匡先殺執金吾胡母班。班親屬不勝憤怒，與太祖并勢，共殺匡。













[19] Yīngxióng jì states: [Qiáo] Mào appellation Yuánwěi was [Qiáo] Xuán’s distant cousin’s son. Formerly he had been Yǎn Province Inspector, deeply having authority and grace.



〔五〕　英雄記曰：瑁字元偉，玄族子。先為兗州刺史，甚有威惠。













[20] [Yuán] Yí appellation Bóyè was [Yuán] Shào’s elder cousin. He was Cháng’ān Magistrate. Héjiān’s Zhāng Chāo once recommended [Yuán] Yí to Grand Commandant Zhū Jùn, appraising [Yuán] Yí: “He has goodness crowning the world, magnanimity to tolerate the times. His loyalty and fairness and brilliance and honesty are assuredly naturally endowed. Furthermore he embraces the Classics, masters the Hundred Schools, on climbing high able to rhapsodize, on seeing a thing knowing its name. Searching in the present day, by far there are none comparable.” The matter is in [Zhāng] Cháo’s Collected Works.
Yīngxióng jì states: [Yuán] Shào later employed [Yuán] Yí as Yáng Province Inspector, and [Yuán Yí] was defeated by Yuán Shù.
Tàizǔ appraised: “Those grown up but able to be diligent in study are only me and Yuán Bóyè.” The statement is in Wén-dì Diǎnlùn.



〔六〕　遺字伯業，紹從兄。為長安令。河間張超嘗薦遺于太尉朱雋，稱遺「有冠世之懿，幹時之量。其忠允亮直，固天所縱；若乃包羅載籍，管綜百氏，登高能賦，睹物知名，求之今日，邈焉靡儔。」事在超集。英雄記曰：紹後用遺為揚州刺史，為袁術所敗。太祖稱「長大而能勤學者，惟吾與袁伯業耳。」語在文帝典論。













[21] For [Bào] Xìn’s matters see his son [Bào] Xūn’s biography.



〔七〕　信事見子勛傳。







Second Moon [190 Mar 24 – Apr 22], [Dǒng] Zhuó heard that troops had risen, and therefore moved Heaven’s Son to set the capital at Cháng’ān. [Dǒng] Zhuó remained garrisoned at Luòyáng, and therefore burned the Palace Residences. At the time [Yuán] Shào garrisoned Hénèi; [Zhāng] Miǎo, [Liú] Dài, [Qiáo] Mào, and [Yuán] Yí garrisoned Suānzǎo; [Yuán] Shù garrisoned Nányáng; [Kǒng Zhòu] garrisoned Yǐngchuān; [Hán] Fù was at Yè. [Dǒng] Zhuó’s troops were strong, of [Yuán] Shào and the rest none dared be the first to advance. Tàizǔ said: “Having raised righteous troops to put down rebellion, the great multitudes are already gathered, why do you sirs hesitate? Supposing if Dǒng Zhuó, on hearing that troops had risen east of the mountains, had relied on the authority of the Ruling House, occupied the rugged terrain of the two Zhōu, heading east to overlook Heaven’s Under, though he acts without principle, yet he would be enough to be a concern. Now he burns the Palace Residences, seizes and moves Heaven’s Son, Within the Seas is shaken and disturbed, not knowing where to turn; this is the time of Heaven destroying him. In one battle Heaven’s Under can be settled; [the opportunity] cannot be missed.” Therefore he led his troops west, about to occupy Chénggāo. [Zhāng] Miǎo sent his officer Wèi Zī with a division of troops to follow Tàizǔ. Arriving at Xíngyáng’s Biàn river, they encountered [Dǒng] Zhuó’s officer Xú Róng, engaged in battle and were not successful, the soldiers killed and wounded were very many. Tàizǔ was hit by a stray arrow, and the horse he was riding was wounded. His younger cousin [Cáo] Hóng gave his horse to Tàizǔ, and in the night they escaped. [Xú] Róng observed that the troops Tàizǔ commanded were few but had battled hard all day, said Suānzǎo would not be easy to attack, and also led his troops back.



二月，卓聞兵起，乃徙天子都長安。卓留屯洛陽，遂焚宮室。是時紹屯河內，邈、岱、瑁、遺屯酸棗，術屯南陽，伷屯潁川，馥在鄴。卓兵彊，紹等莫敢先進。太祖曰：「舉義兵以誅暴亂，大眾已合，諸君何疑？向使董卓聞山東兵起，倚王室之重，據二周之險，東向以臨天下；雖以無道行之，猶足為患。今焚燒宮室，劫遷天子，海內震動，不知所歸，此天亡之時也。一戰而天下定矣，不可失也。」遂引兵西，將據成皋。邈遣將衛茲分兵隨太祖。到滎陽汴水，遇卓將徐榮，與戰不利，士卒死傷甚多。太祖為流矢所中，所乘馬被創，從弟洪以馬與太祖，得夜遁去。榮見太祖所將兵少，力戰盡日，謂酸棗未易攻也，亦引兵還。




Tàizǔ arrived at Suānzǎo. The various army soldiers were over a hundred thousand, every day setting alcohol for great feasts, with no plans to advance. Tàizǔ reproached them, and therefore made a strategy stating: “You sirs, listen to my plan: send Bóhǎi [Yuán Shào] to lead the multitudes of Hénèi to overlook Mèngjīn, Suānzǎo’s various officers to defend Chénggāo, occupy Áo Granary, block Huànyuán and Tàigǔ, completing controlling the rugged terrain. Send General Yuán [Shù] to lead the army of Nányáng to militarize Dān and Xī, enter Wǔ Pass, to shake the Three Adjuncts. All heighten ramparts and thicken walls, do not battle with them. Increase the use of diversion troops, show the situation to Heaven’s Under, using obedience to put down rebellion, and it can be settled. Now the troops for righteousness have mobilized, but you hold to suspicion and do not advance, failing the expectations of Heaven’s Under, I humbly am ashamed for you sirs!” [Zhāng] Miǎo and the rest would not use it.



太祖到酸棗，諸軍兵十餘萬，日置酒高會，不圖進取。太祖責讓之，因為謀曰：「諸君聽吾計，使勃海引河內之眾臨孟津，酸棗諸將守成皋，據敖倉，塞轘轅、太谷，全制其險；使袁將軍率南陽之軍軍丹、析，入武關，以震三輔：皆高壘深壁，勿與戰，益為疑兵，示天下形勢，以順誅逆，可立定也。今兵以義動，持疑而不進，失天下之望，竊為諸君恥之！」邈等不能用。




Tàizǔ’s troops were few, and so he with Xiàhóu Dūn and the rest visited Yáng Province to recruit troops. The Inspector Chén Wēn and Dānyáng Administrator Zhōu Xīn gave him troops of over four thousand men. When they returned and arrived at Lóngkàng, many of the soldiers rebelled. [22] He reached Zhì and Jiànpíng, again collected troops obtaining over a thousand men, and advanced to garrison Hénèi.



太祖兵少，乃與夏侯惇等詣揚州募兵，刺史陳溫、丹楊太守周昕與兵四千餘人。還到龍亢，士卒多叛。〔一〕至銍、建平，復收兵得千餘人，進屯河內。










[22] Wèi shū states: The troops plotted rebellion, in the night burning Tàizǔ’s tent. Tàizǔ personally wielded sword and killed several tens of men, the rest were routed, and so he was able to escape the camp. Those that did not rebel were over five hundred men.



〔一〕　魏書曰：兵謀叛，夜燒太祖帳，太祖手劍殺數十人，餘皆披靡，乃得出營；其不叛者五百餘人。







Liú Dài and Qiáo Mào hated one another. [Liú] Dài killed [Qiáo] Mào and appointed Wáng Gōng as designate Dōng Prefecture Administrator.



劉岱與橋瑁相惡，岱殺瑁，以王肱領東郡太守。




Yuán Shào with Hán Fù plotted to enthrone Yōu Province Governor Liú Yú as Emperor. Tàizǔ opposed them. [23] [Yuán] Shào also once obtained one jade seal, and while seated with Tàizǔ, raised it toward his elbow. Tàizǔ because of this laughed but was resentful. [24]



袁紹與韓馥謀立幽州牧劉虞為帝，太祖拒之。〔一〕紹又嘗得一玉印，於太祖坐中舉向其肘，太祖由是笑而惡焉。〔二〕










[23] Wèi shū records Tàizǔ’s answer to [Yuán] Shào stating: “Dǒng Zhuó’s crimes are exposed to the Four Seas. We have gathered great multitudes, raised righteous troops, far and near none do not respond to us. This is because we mobilized out of righteousness. Now the young ruler is weak, controlled by a traitor minister, not the disaster of Chāngyì destroying the state. To yet in one morning change and replace him, how will Heaven’s Under be at ease at this? You sirs may face north, I personally will turn west.”



〔一〕　魏書載太祖答紹曰：「董卓之罪，暴于四海，吾等合大眾、興義兵而遠近莫不響應，此以義動故也。今幼主微弱，制于姦臣，未有昌邑亡國之釁，而一旦改易，天下其孰安之？諸君北面，我自西向。」













[24] Wèi shū states: Tàizǔ greatly laughed and said: “I do not listen to you.” [Yuán] Shào again sent someone to persuade Tàizǔ saying: “Now Excellency Yuán’s power is flourishing and troops strong, two of his sons already mature. Of those outstanding Under Heaven, who can surpass this?” Tàizǔ did not answer. Because of this he increasingly did not trust [Yuán] Shào, and plotted to exterminate him.



〔二〕　魏書曰：太祖大笑曰：「吾不聽汝也。」紹復使人說太祖曰：「今袁公勢盛兵彊，二子已長，天下群英，孰踰於此？」太祖不應。由是益不直紹，圖誅滅之。







Second Year, Spring [191 Feb 22 – May 11], [Yuán] Shào and [Hán] Fù therefore established [Liú] Yú as Emperor. [Liú] Yú to the end did not dare accept.



二年春，紹、馥遂立虞為帝，虞終不敢當。




Summer, Fourth Moon [May 12 – Jun 9], [Dǒng] Zhuó returned to Cháng’ān.



夏四月，卓還長安。




Autumn, Seventh Moon [Aug 8 – Sep 6], Yuán Shào coerced [Hán] Fù and seized Jì Province.



秋七月，袁紹脅韓馥，取冀州。




Hēishān bandits Yú Dú, Bái Rào, Suī Gù and others [25] with multitudes of over a hundred thousand plundered Wèi Prefecture and Dōng Prefecture. Wáng Gōng could not resist them. Tàizǔ led troops to enter Dōng Prefecture, struck Bái Rào at Púyáng, defeating him. Yuán Shào therefore memorialized Tàizǔ as Dōng Prefecture Administrator, headquarters at Dōngwǔyáng.



黑山賊于毒、白繞、眭固等〔一〕十餘萬眾略魏郡、東郡，王肱不能禦，太祖引兵入東郡，擊白繞于濮陽，破之。袁紹因表太祖為東郡太守，治東武陽。










[25] Suī [is pronounced] Shēn and Suí together.



〔一〕眭，申隨反。







Third Year, Spring [192 Feb 1 – Apr 29], Tàizǔ’s army at Dùnqiū, [Yú] Dú and the rest attacked Dōngwǔyáng. Tàizǔ thus led troops west to enter the mountains, attacking [Yú] Dú and the rest’s base camp. [26] [Yú] Dú heard of this, abandoned [Dōng] Wǔyáng and returned. Tàizǔ intercepted and struck Suī Gù, and also struck the Xiōngnú [leader] Yūfūluó at Nèihuáng, greatly defeating them all. [27]



三年春，太祖軍頓丘，毒等攻東武陽。太祖乃引兵西入山，攻毒等本屯。〔一〕毒聞之，棄武陽還。太祖要擊眭固，又擊匈奴於夫羅於內黃，皆大破之。〔二〕










[26] Wèi shū states: The various officers all believed they should return to personally rescue it. Tàizǔ said: “Sūn Bìn rescued Zhào by attacking Wèi, Gěng Yǎn wished to go to Xī’ān and so attacked Línzī. If the bandits hear we have gone west and return, [Dōng] Wǔyáng will on its own be relieved. If they do not return, we will be able to destroy their base camp, but that the caitiffs will not be able to capture Wǔyáng is certain.” Therefore he went.



〔一〕　魏書曰：諸將皆以為當還自救。太祖曰：「孫臏救趙而攻魏，耿弇欲走西安攻臨菑。使賊聞我西而還，武陽自解也；不還，我能敗其本屯，虜不能拔武陽必矣。」遂乃行。













[27] Wèi shū states: Yūfūluó was the Southern Chányú’s son. During Zhōngpíng [185 – 189], Xiōngnú troops were mobilized, and Yūfūluó led them to assist Hàn. It happened that his own state rebelled, killing the Southern Chányú, and Yūfūluó therefore led his multitudes to remain in the central states. Taking advantage of Heaven’s Under being in chaos, he joined with Xīhé’s Báibō bandits, breaking Tàiyuán and Hénèi, plundering the various prefectures as a brigand.



〔二〕　魏書曰：於夫羅者，南單于子也。中平中，發匈奴兵，於夫羅率以助漢。會本國反，殺南單于，於夫羅遂將其眾留中國。因天下撓亂，與西河白波賊合，破太原、河內，抄略諸郡為寇。







Summer, Fourth Moon [192 Apr 30 – May 28], Excellency over the Masses Wáng Yǔn with Lǚ Bù together killed [Dǒng] Zhuó. [Dǒng] Zhuó’s officers Lǐ Jué, Guō Sì, and others killed [Wáng] Yǔn and attacked [Lǚ] Bù. [Lǚ] Bù was defeated and escaped east through Wǔ Pass. [Lǐ] Jué and the rest seized control over the Court and the government.



夏四月，司徒王允與呂布共殺卓。卓將李傕、郭汜等殺允攻布，布敗，東出武關。傕等擅朝政。




Qīng Province Huángjīn multitudes of one million entered Yǎn Province, killing Rènchéng Chancellor Zhèng Suì, turning to enter Dōngpíng. Liú Dài wished to strike them. Bào Xìn remonstrated saying: “Now the bandit multitudes are a million, the Hundred Surnames all are shaken and afraid, the soldiers have no fighting spirit and cannot oppose them. Observing the bandit multitudes, they travel in groups following one another, their army has no supplies, and only obtain resources by plunder. Now it is better to nurture the strength of our soldier multitudes and at first firmly defend. They will wish to battle and not obtain it, to attack and also be unable, their momentum will certainly scatter apart. Afterward select the elite, occupy the critical positions, strike them, and they can be defeated.” [Liú] Dài did not follow this, therefore battled with them, and indeed was killed by them. [28] [Bào] Xìn thus with provincial official Wàn Qián and others arrived at Dōng Prefecture to invite Tàizǔ to be designate Yǎn Province Governor. Therefore they advanced troops to strike the Huángjīn at Shòuzhāng’s east. [Bào] Xìn fought hard to the death, only barely defeating them. [29] A reward was offered to search for [Bào] Xìn’s body, but it was not found, the multitudes thus carved wood in [Bào] Xìn’s likeness, offering sacrifices and weeping. Pursued the Huángjīn to Jǐběi, they requested to surrender. Winter [192 Nov 23 – 193 Feb 18], accepted the surrender of troops of over three hundred thousand, men and women of over a million. Collected their elite, titled as the Qīng Province Troops.



青州黃巾眾百萬入兗州，殺任城相鄭遂，轉入東平。劉岱欲擊之，鮑信諫曰：「今賊眾百萬，百姓皆震恐，士卒無鬥志，不可敵也。觀賊眾群輩相隨，軍無輜重，唯以鈔略為資，今不若畜士眾之力，先為固守。彼欲戰不得，攻又不能，其勢必離散，後選精銳，據其要害，擊之可破也。」岱不從，遂與戰，果為所殺。〔一〕信乃與州吏萬潛等至東郡迎太祖領兗州牧。遂進兵擊黃巾于壽張東。信力戰鬥死，僅而破之。〔二〕購求信喪不得，眾乃刻木如信形狀，祭而哭焉。追黃巾至濟北。乞降。冬，受降卒三十餘萬，男女百餘萬口，收其精銳者，號為青州兵。










[28] Shìyǔ states: [Liú] Dài had died. Chén Gōng said to Tàizǔ: “The province now is without a master, but the ruler’s mandates are cut off. [I, Chén] Gōng request to persuade those of the province for Your Excellency to go be the Governor of it. Using its resources to gather Heaven’s Under, this is the Hegemon’s enterprise.” [Chén] Gōng persuaded the Separate Carriage and Managing Central saying: “Now Heaven’s Under is split apart but the province is without a master; Cáo Dōngjùn is a talent to command the age. If he is invited to be Governor of the province, he will certainly calm and save the people.” Bào Xìn and the rest also spoke in agreement.



〔一〕　世語曰：岱既死，陳宮謂太祖曰：「州今無主，而王命斷絕，宮請說州中，明府尋往牧之，資之以收天下，此霸王之業也。」宮說別駕、治中曰：「今天下分裂而州無主；曹東郡，命世之才也，若迎以牧州，必寧生民。」鮑信等亦謂之然。













[29] Wèi shū states: Tàizǔ commanded infantry and cavalry of over one thousand men, going to observe the battlefield, suddenly stumbling upon the bandit camp, battled and was not successful, the dead were several hundred men, and he led them back. The bandits pursued and advanced. The Huángjīn had been bandits for a long time, repeatedly following up on victories, their troops all elite and fierce. Tàizǔ had few veteran troops, the new troops were not trained, and the entire army was all afraid. Tàizǔ donned armor and helmet, personally toured the officers and soldiers, clearly exhorted with rewards and punishments, and the multitudes thus returned to exerting themselves, took advantage of openings to suppress and strike, and the bandits were slightly beaten and retreated. The bandits thus sent a letter to Tàizǔ that said: “In the past at Jǐnán, you destroyed spirit altars, the Way thus the same with Zhōnghuáng Tàiyǐ, seeming as if you understand the Way, but now you have again become deluded. Hàn’s Transition is already exhausted, the Yellow House will be established. Heaven’s Great Transformation is not what your talent and strength can resist.” Tàizǔ saw the letter, shouted and cursed at it, repeatedly called on them to surrender, and therefore set ambushes, day and night meeting in battle, in every battle killing and capturing, and the bandits thus retreated and fled.



〔二〕　魏書曰：太祖將步騎千餘人，行視戰地，卒抵賊營，戰不利，死者數百人，引還。賊尋前進。黃巾為賊久，數乘勝，兵皆精悍。太祖舊兵少，新兵不習練，舉軍皆懼。太祖被甲嬰冑，親巡將士，明勸賞罰，眾乃復奮，承閒討擊，賊稍折退。賊乃移書太祖曰：「昔在濟南，毀壞神壇，其道乃與中黃太乙同，似若知道，今更迷惑。漢行已盡，黃家當立。天之大運，非君才力所能存也。」太祖見檄書，呵罵之，數開示降路；遂設奇伏，晝夜會戰，戰輒禽獲，賊乃退走。







Yuán Shù with [Yuán] Shào had conflict. [Yuán] Shù sought assistance from Gōngsūn Zàn. [Gōngsūn] Zàn sent Liú Bèi to garrison Gāotáng, Shàn Jīng to garrison Píngyuán, Táo Qiān to garrison Fā’gān, in order to pressure [Yuán] Shào. Tàizǔ joined with [Yuán] Shào and struck, defeating them all.



袁術與紹有隙，術求援於公孫瓚，瓚使劉備屯高唐，單經屯平原，陶謙屯發干，以逼紹。太祖與紹會擊，皆破之。




Fourth Year, Spring [193 Feb 19 – May 18], army at Juànchéng. Jīng Province Governor Liú Biǎo cut off [Yuán] Shù’s supply lines. [Yuán] Shù led his army to enter Chénliú and garrisoned Fēngqiū. Hēishān remnant bandits and Yūfūluó and others supported him. [Yuán] Shù sent his officer Liú Xiáng to garrison Kuāngtíng. Tàizǔ struck [Liú] Xiáng, [Yuán] Shù rescued him. Engaged in battle, [Tàizǔ] greatly defeated them. [Yuán] Shù retreated to protect Fēngqiū. [Tàizǔ] therefore besieged him. The encirclement was not yet complete when [Yuán] Shù fled to Xiāngyì, [Tàizǔ] pursued arriving at Tàishòu, breaching the dam to flood the city, [Yuán Shù] fled to Nínglíng, [Tàizǔ] again pursued him, [Yuán Shù] fled to Jiǔjiāng. Summer [193 May 19 – Aug 14], Tàizǔ returned the army to Dìngtáo.



四年春，軍鄄城。荊州牧劉表斷術糧道，術引軍入陳留，屯封丘，黑山餘賊及於夫羅等佐之。術使將劉詳屯匡亭。太祖擊詳，術救之，與戰，大破之。術退保封丘，遂圍之，未合，術走襄邑，追到太壽，決渠水灌城。走寧陵，又追之，走九江。夏，太祖還軍定陶。




Xiàpī’s Quē Xuān gathered multitudes of several thousand men, declaring himself Heaven’s Son. Xú Province Governor Táo Qiān raised troops together with him, capturing Tàishān’s Huá and Fèi, plundering Rènchéng. Autumn [193 Aug 15 – Nov 11], Tàizǔ campaigned against Táo Qiān, subduing over ten cities. [Táo] Qiān held to defending the city and did not dare come out.



下邳闕宣聚眾數千人，自稱天子；徐州牧陶謙與共舉兵，取泰山華、費，略任城。秋，太祖征陶謙，下十餘城，謙守城不敢出。




That year, Sūn Cè received Yuán Shù’s orders to cross the Jiāng, and within several years he therefore possessed Jiāngdōng.



是歲，孫策受袁術使渡江，數年閒遂有江東。

title: 1  Annals of Emperor Wǔ
text:
Xīngpíng (194 - 195)


Xīngpíng Inaugural Year, Spring [194 Feb 9 – May 7], Tàizǔ returned from Xú Province. Previously, Tàizǔ’s father [Cáo] Sōng after leaving office returned to Qiáo, and in the chaos of Dǒng Zhuó, he fled the troubles to Lángyé, was murdered by Táo Qiān, and therefore Tàizǔ’s intentions were to return on a revenge eastern campaign. [30] Summer [194 May 8 – Aug 4], sent Xún Yù and Chéng Yù to defend Juànchéng, and again campaigned against Táo Qiān, captured five cities, therefore plundered the land reaching to Dōnghǎi. Returning, passed Tán, [Táo] Qiān’s officer Cáo Bào with Liú Bèi garrisoned Tán’s east, intercepting Tàizǔ. Tàizǔ struck and defeated them, and therefore attacked and captured Xiāngbēn, wherever he passed there was much destruction and killing. [31]



興平元年春，太祖自徐州還，初，太祖父嵩，去官後還譙，董卓之亂，避難瑯邪，為陶謙所害，故太祖志在復讎東伐。〔一〕夏，使荀彧、程昱守鄄城，復征陶謙，拔五城，遂略地至東海。還過郯，謙將曹豹與劉備屯郯東，要太祖。太祖擊破之，遂攻拔襄賁，所過多所殘戮。〔二〕










[30] Shìyǔ states: [Cáo] Sōng was at Tàishān’s Huá county. Tàizǔ ordered Tàishān Administrator Yìng Shào to escort the family to Yǎn Province. [Yìng] Shào’s troops had not yet arrived when Táo Qiān secretly sent several thousand cavalry in a surprise attack. [Cáo] Sōng’s household believed that it was [Yìng] Shào welcoming them and did not make preparations. [Táo] Qiān’s troops arrived and killed Tàizǔ’s younger brother [Cáo] Dé at the gates. [Cáo] Sōng was afraid, broke through the rear wall, first sending out his concubine. The concubine was fat and could not timely get out. [Cáo] Sōng fled to the lavatory, and with his concubine both were murdered, and everyone within the gates all died. [Yìng] Shào was afraid, abandoned his office and fled to Yuán Shào. Later when Tàizǔ settled Jì Province, [Yìng] Shào at the time had already died.
Wéi Yào’s Wú shū states: Tàizǔ invited [Cáo] Sōng. The supply wagons were over a hundred. Táo Qiān sent Commandant Zhāng Kǎi to command cavalry of two hundred to guard and escort them. [Zhāng] Kǎi between Tàishān’s Huá and Fèi killed [Cáo] Sōng, seized his property, and therefore fled to Huáinán. Tàizǔ assigned the blame to Táo Qiān and therefore attacked him.



〔一〕　世語曰：嵩在泰山華縣。太祖令泰山太守應劭送家詣兗州，劭兵未至，陶謙密遣數千騎掩捕。嵩家以為劭迎，不設備。謙兵至，殺太祖弟德于門中。嵩懼，穿後垣，先出其妾，妾肥，不時得出；嵩逃于廁，與妾俱被害，闔門皆死。劭懼，棄官赴袁紹。後太祖定冀州，劭時已死。韋曜吳書曰：太祖迎嵩，輜重百餘兩。陶謙遣都尉張闓將騎二百衛送，闓於泰山華、費間殺嵩，取財物，因奔淮南。太祖歸咎於陶謙，故伐之。













[31] Sūn Shèng states: To attack a criminal for the sake of the people is the virtuous course of the ancients. To because of [Táo] Qiān’s crimes yet destroy his followers and retainers was mistaken.



〔二〕　孫盛曰：夫伐罪弔民，古之令軌；罪謙之由，而殘其屬部，過矣。







It happened that Zhāng Miǎo and Chén Gōng rebelled, invited Lǚ Bù, the prefectures and counties all complied. Xún Yù and Chéng Yù protected Juànchéng, Fàn and Dōng’ē two counties firmly defended. Tàizǔ thus led the army back. [Lǚ] Bù arrived, attacked Juànchéng but could not capture it, and to the west garrisoned Púyáng. Tàizǔ said: “[Lǚ] Bù in one morning obtained the entire province, did not occupy Dōngpíng, cut off the roads of Kàngfù and Tàishān, and take advantage of the rugged terrain to intercept us, but instead garrisoned Púyáng. I know he is without ability.” Therefore he advanced the army to attack them. [Lǚ] Bù sent out troops to battle, first sending cavalry to assault the Qīng Province Troops. The Qīng Province Troops fled, Tàizǔ’s formations were in chaos, he galloped through fire to charge out, fell from his horse, burning his left hand. His Major Lóu Yì helped up Tàizǔ onto a horse, and therefore he escaped. [32] He had not yet reached his camp, the various officers and Tàizǔ had not yet seen each other, all were afraid. Tàizǔ thus personally exerted himself to encourage the army, ordering those in the army to quickly prepare siege weapons, and advanced to again attack them, with [Lǚ] Bù resisting one another for over a hundred days. Locusts broke out, the Hundred Surnames were in great famine, [Lǚ] Bù’s food provisions were also exhausted, and each side drew back and left.



會張邈與陳宮叛迎呂布，郡縣皆應。荀彧、程昱保鄄城，范、東阿二縣固守，太祖乃引軍還。布到，攻鄄城不能下，西屯濮陽。太祖曰：「布一旦得一州，不能據東平，斷亢父、泰山之道乘險要我，而乃屯濮陽，吾知其無能為也。」遂進軍攻之。布出兵戰，先以騎犯青州兵。青州兵奔，太祖陳亂，馳突火出，墜馬，燒左手掌。司馬樓異扶太祖上馬，遂引去。〔一〕未至營止，諸將未與太祖相見，皆怖。太祖乃自力勞軍，令軍中促為攻具，進復攻之，與布相守百餘日。蝗蟲起，百姓大餓，布糧食亦盡，各引去。










[32] Yuán Wěi’s Xiàn-dì Chūnqiū states: Tàizǔ besieged Púyáng. Púyáng’s powerful Tián clan were defecting agents and Tàizǔ was able to enter the city. He burned the east gate, to show he had no intention to turn back. At the battle, the army was defeated. [Lǚ] Bù’s cavalry captured Tàizǔ but did not know it was him, and asked him: “Where is Cáo Cāo?” Tàizǔ said: “The one riding the yellow horse to flee is he.” [Lǚ] Bù’s cavalry thus released Tàizǔ and pursued the yellow horse. The gate fire was yet strong, Tàizǔ charged through the fire and escaped.



〔一〕　袁暐獻帝春秋曰：太祖圍濮陽，濮陽大姓田氏為反閒，太祖得入城。燒其東門，示無反意。及戰，軍敗。布騎得太祖而不知是，問曰：「曹操何在？」太祖曰：「乘黃馬走者是也。」布騎乃釋太祖而追黃馬者。門火猶盛，太祖突火而出。







Autumn, Ninth Moon [194 Oct 3 – Oct 31], Tàizǔ returned to Juànchéng. [Lǚ] Bù arrived at Chéngshì, was by that county’s man Lǐ Jìn defeated, and went east to garrison Shānyáng. At that time [Yuán] Shào sent someone to persuade Tàizǔ to make alliance. Tàizǔ had newly lost Yǎn Province, the army’s provisions were exhausted, and he was about to agree to it. Chéng Yù stopped Tàizǔ, and Tàizǔ listened to him. Winter, Tenth Moon [194 Nov 1 – Nov 30], Tàizǔ reached Dōng’ē.



秋九月，太祖還鄄城。布到乘氏，為其縣人李進所破，東屯山陽。於是紹使人說太祖，欲連和。太祖新失兗州，軍食盡，將許之。程昱止太祖，太祖從之。冬十月，太祖至東阿。




That year, grain of one hú cost over five hundred thousand in cash. People ate each other. Thus dismissed officials and troops that were newly recruited. Táo Qiān died, Liú Bèi succeeded him.



是歲穀一斛五十餘萬錢，人相食，乃罷吏兵新募者。陶謙死，劉備代之。




Second Year, Spring [195 Jan 29 – Apr 27], attacked Dìngtáo. Jǐyīn Administrator Wú Zī protected Nánchéng, it was not yet captured. It happened that Lǚ Bù arrived. Also struck and defeated him. Summer [195 Apr 28 – Aug 23], [Lǚ] Bù’s officers Xuē Lán and Lǐ Fēng garrisoned Jùyě. Tàizǔ attacked them. [Lǚ] Bù went to rescue [Xuē] Lán. [Xuē] Lán was defeated, [Lǚ] Bù fled. Therefore beheaded [Xuē] Lán and others. [Lǚ] Bù again from Dōngmín with Chén Gōng led over ten thousand men came to battle. At the time Tàizǔ’s troops were few. He prepared an ambush, unleashed surprise troops to strike, greatly defeating them. [33] [Lǚ] Bù in the night fled. Tàizǔ again attacked, captured Dìngtáo, and divided troops to pacify the various counties. [Lǚ] Bù fled east to Liú Bèi. Zhāng Miǎo followed [Lǚ] Bù and sent his younger brother [Zhāng] Chāo to lead the family retainers to protect Yōngqiū. Autumn, Eighth Moon [195 Sep 22 – Oct 21], besieged Yōngqiū. Winter, Tenth Moon [195 Nov 20 – Dec 19], Heaven’s Son appointed Tàizǔ as Yǎn Province Governor. Twelfth Moon [196 Jan 18 – Feb 16], Yōngqiū fell, [Zhāng] Chāo killed himself. Exterminated [Zhāng] Miǎo’s three clans. [Zhāng] Miǎo went to Yuán Shù to request help, but was killed by his own multitudes. Yǎn Province was pacified, therefore went east to plunder Chén territory.



二年春，襲定陶。濟陰太守吳資保南城，未拔。會呂布至，又擊破之。夏，布將薛蘭、李封屯鉅野，太祖攻之，布救蘭，蘭敗，布走，遂斬蘭等。布復從東緡與陳宮將萬餘人來戰，時太祖兵少，設伏，縱奇兵擊，大破之。〔一〕布夜走，太祖復攻，拔定陶，分兵平諸縣。布東奔劉備，張邈從布，使其弟超將家屬保雍丘。秋八月，圍雍丘。冬十月，天子拜太祖兗州牧。十二月，雍丘潰，超自殺。夷邈三族。邈詣袁術請救，為其眾所殺，兗州平，遂東略陳地。










[33] Wèi shū states: At the time the troops had all gone out to harvest grain, those present were not even a thousand men, the garrison camp not firm. Tàizǔ thus ordered the women to defend the ramparts, and all the troops to go resist them. West of the garrison was a large dam, and to the south the trees were dense and thick. [Lǚ] Bù suspected there was an ambush, and therefore said to the others: “Cáo Cāo has many tricks, do not enter into his ambush.” He led his army to garrison south by over ten lǐ. The next day he again came, Tàizǔ hid troops within the dam, and sent out half the troops outside the damn. [Lǚ] Bù increasingly advanced, thus ordered light troops to challenge battle. When they engaged, the ambush troops then all charged from the dam, infantry and cavalry together advanced, greatly defeated them, captured their drum carts, pursed them to their camp and then returned.



〔一〕　魏書曰：於是兵皆出取麥，在者不能千人，屯營不固。太祖乃令婦人守陴，悉兵拒之。屯西有大隄，其南樹木幽深。布疑有伏，乃相謂曰：「曹操多譎，勿入伏中。」引軍屯南十餘里。明日復來，太祖隱兵隄裏，出半兵隄外。布益進，乃令輕兵挑戰，既合，伏兵乃悉乘隄，步騎並進，大破之，獲其鼓車，追至其營而還。







That year, Cháng’ān was in chaos. Heaven’s Son moved east, was defeated at Cáoyáng, crossed the Hé to visit Ānyì.



是歲，長安亂，天子東遷，敗于曹陽，渡河幸安邑。

title: 1  Annals of Emperor Wǔ
text:
Jiàn’ān 1 - 4 (196 - 199)


Jiàn’ān Inaugural Year, Spring, Standard Moon [196 Feb 17 – Mar 16], Tàizǔ’s army approached Wǔpíng, Yuán Shù’s installed Chén Chancellor Yuán Sì surrendered.



建安元年春正月，太祖軍臨武平，袁術所置陳相袁嗣降。




Tàizǔ was about to invite Heaven’s Son, of the various officers some were doubtful. Xún Yù and Chéng Yù encouraged him, and so he sent Cáo Hóng to lead troops west as welcome. Guard General Dǒng Chéng with Yuán Shù’s officer Cháng Nú resisted on rugged terrain, and [Cáo] Hóng could not advance.



太祖將迎天子，諸將或疑，荀彧、程昱勸之，乃遣曹洪將兵西迎，衛將軍董承與袁術將萇奴拒險，洪不得進。




Rǔnán’s and Yǐngchuān’s Huángjīn Hé Yí, Liú Pì, Huáng Shào, Hé Màn and others each had multitudes of several tens of thousands, had previously answered to Yuán Shù and also attached to Sūn Jiān. Second Moon [196 Mar 17 – Apr 15], Tàizǔ advanced the army to suppress and defeated them, beheading [Liú] Pì and [Huáng] Shào and others. [Hé] Yí and his multitudes all surrendered. Heaven’s Son appointed Tàizǔ as Establishing Virtue General. Summer, Sixth Moon [196 Jul 14 – Aug 11], promoted to Defending East General, enfeoffed Marquess of Fèi precinct. Autumn, Seventh Moon [196 Aug 12 – Sep 10], Yáng Fèng and Hán Xiān with Heaven’s Son returned to Luòyáng. [34] [Yáng] Fèng separately garrisoned Liáng. Tàizǔ therefore reached Luòyáng, guarded the capital city, [Hán] Xiān fled. Heaven’s Son Lent Tàizǔ Stave and Battle-Ax, controlling Secretariat Writers affairs. [35] Luòyáng was devastated and ruined, Dǒng Zhāo and others advised Tàizǔ to move the capital to Xǔ. Ninth Moon [196 Oct 10 – Nov 8], the Chariot Carriage went out Huànyuán and went east, appointed Tàizǔ as General-in-Chief, enfeoffed Marquess of Wǔpíng. From since Heaven’s Son had moved west, the Court had daily been in chaos. Only at this time were the Ancestral Temples, State Altars, and Administration Systems again established. [36]



汝南、潁川黃巾何儀、劉辟、黃邵、何曼等，眾各數萬，初應袁術，又附孫堅。二月，太祖進軍討破之，斬辟、邵等，儀及其眾皆降。天子拜太祖建德將軍，夏六月，遷鎮東將軍，封費亭侯。秋七月，楊奉、韓暹以天子還洛陽，〔一〕奉別屯梁。太祖遂至洛陽，衛京都，暹遁走。天子假太祖節鉞，錄尚書事。〔二〕洛陽殘破，董昭等勸太祖都許。九月，車駕出轘轅而東，以太祖為大將軍，封武平侯。自天子西遷，朝廷日亂，至是宗廟社稷制度始立。〔三〕










[34] Xiàn-dì Chūnqiū states: When Heaven’s Son first reached Luòyáng, he resided to the city’s west in former Central Regular Attendant Zhào Zhōng’s residence. Sent Zhāng Yáng to repair the Palace Residences, naming the Hall as Yáng’ān Hall. Eighth Moon [Sep 11 – Oct 9], the Emperor then moved to reside there.



〔一〕　獻帝春秋曰：天子初至洛陽，幸城西故中常侍趙忠宅。使張楊繕治宮室，名殿曰揚安殿，八月，帝乃遷居。













[35] Xiàn-dì jì states: Also designated Director of Retainers Colonel.



〔二〕　獻帝紀曰：又領司隸校尉。













[36] Zhāng Fán’s Hàn jì states: Previously, Heaven’s Son was defeated at Cáoyáng, and wished to sail on the Hé east downstream. Attendant Central Grand Scribe Director Wáng Lì said: “Since last spring Tàibái crossed Zhènxīng at Niú-Dǒu, passing Tiānjīn. Yínghuò also reversed course to defend Běihé; it cannot be crossed.” Because of this Heaven’s Son therefore did not cross the Hé north, and instead from Zhǐ Pass went out east. [Wáng] Lì also said to Minister of the Imperial Clan Liú Ài: “Previously Tàibái defended Tiānguān and with Yínghuò met. Metal and Fire meeting each other is a sign of a change in Mandate. Hàn’s Blessings have ended. Jìn and Wèi certainly will have one rise.” [Wáng] Lì later repeatedly said to the Emperor: “Heaven’s Mandate has its leaving and arriving. The Five Transitions do not constantly flourish. The successor of Fire is Earth. The inheritor of Hàn is Wèi. The one able to secure Heaven’s Under is the Cáo surname. You need only appoint the Cáo clan and nothing more.” The Excellency [Cáo Cāo] heard this, and sent someone to say to [Wáng] Lì: “I know that your excellency is loyal to the Court; however Heaven’s Ways are deep and profound. May you not say more.”



〔三〕　張璠漢紀曰：初，天子敗於曹陽，欲浮河東下。侍中太史令王立曰：「自去春太白犯鎮星於牛斗，過天津，熒惑又逆行守北河，不可犯也。」由是天子遂不北渡河，將自軹關東出。立又謂宗正劉艾曰：「前太白守天關，與熒惑會；金火交會，革命之象也。漢祚終矣，晉、魏必有興者。」立後數言于帝曰：「天命有去就，五行不常盛，代火者土也，承漢者魏也，能安天下者，曹姓也，唯委任曹氏而已。」公聞之，使人語立曰：「知公忠于朝廷，然天道深遠，幸勿多言。」







When Heaven’s Son went east, [Yáng] Fèng from Liáng wished to intercept them, but did not reach them. Winter, Tenth Moon [196 Nov 9 – Dec 7], the Excellency campaigned against [Yáng] Fèng. [Yáng] Fèng fled south to Yuán Shù. Therefore attacked his Liáng garrison and captured it. At that time appointed Yuán Shào as Grand Commandant. [Yuán] Shào was shamed to be ranked below the Excellency, and would not agree to accept. The Excellency thus firmly resigned and ceded the General-in-Chief rank to [Yuán] Shào. Heaven’s Son appointed the Excellency as Excellency of Works, Acting Chariots and Cavalry General. That year, employed the suggestions of Zǎo Zhī, Hán Hào, and others, and first established Garrison Farms. [37]



天子之東也，奉自梁欲要之，不及。冬十月，公征奉，奉南奔袁術，遂攻其梁屯，拔之。於是以袁紹為太尉，紹恥班在公下，不肯受。公乃固辭，以大將軍讓紹。天子拜公司空，行車騎將軍。是歲用棗祗、韓浩等議，始興屯田。〔一〕










[37] Wèi shū states: From since the desolation and chaos, all were lacking in provisions and grain. The various armies all rose, none with a plan for the end of the year. When hungry they robbed and plundered, when full they discarded the remainder, collapsing apart and wandering. Those that destroyed themselves on their own without even an enemy could not be counted. Yuán Shào was at Héběi, his army men relied on eating mulberries. Yuán Shù was between the Jiāng and Huái, gathering and giving out cattails and conches. The civilians ate each other, the provinces and neighborhoods desolate. The Excellency said: “The method to settle the state is in strong troops and sufficient food. The Qín men by emphasizing agriculture conquered Heaven’s Under. Xiào-Wǔ used Garrison Farms to settle the Western Regions. These are the excellent examples of previous ages.” That year he thus recruited civilians in Garrison Farms around Xǔ, and obtained grain of a million hú. Therefore the provinces and prefectures followed the example and installed Farm Officials, wherever they were they accumulated grain. In campaigning across the Four Quarters, there was no labor of transporting provisions, and therefore he conquered and exterminated various bandits, subdued and pacified Heaven’s Under.



〔一〕　魏書曰：自遭荒亂，率乏糧穀。諸軍並起，無終歲之計，飢則寇略，飽則棄餘，瓦解流離，無敵自破者不可勝數。袁紹之在河北，軍人仰食桑椹。袁術在江、淮，取給蒲蠃。民人相食，州里蕭條。公曰：「夫定國之術，在于彊兵足食，秦人以急農兼天下，孝武以屯田定西域，此先代之良式也。」是歲乃募民屯田許下，得穀百萬斛。於是州郡例置田官，所在積穀。征伐四方，無運糧之勞，遂兼滅群賊，克平天下。







Lǚ Bù attacked Liú Bèi, taking Xiàpī. [Liú] Bèi came fleeing. Chéng Yù advised the Excellency saying: “Observing that Liú Bèi has heroic talent and has deeply obtained the hearts of the multitudes, in the end he will not be a subordinate to another. It is better to early plan against him.” The Excellency said: “Now is the time to collect outstanding heroes. To kill one man and so lose the hearts of Heaven’s Under, it cannot be.”



呂布襲劉備，取下邳。備來奔。程昱說公曰：「觀劉備有雄才而甚得眾心，終不為人下，不如早圖之。」公曰：「方今收英雄時也，殺一人而失天下之心，不可。」




Zhāng Jì from Guānzhōng fled to Nányáng, [Zhāng] Jì died, his cousin’s son [Zhāng] Xiù took command of his multitudes. Second Year, Spring, Standard Moon [197 Feb 5 – Mar 6], the Excellency arrived at Wǎn. Zhāng Xiù surrendered, but soon after regretted it, and again rebelled. The Excellency battled with him, the army was defeated, he was hit by a stray arrow, his eldest son [Cáo] Áng and younger brother’s son [Cáo] Ānmín came to harm. [38] The Excellency thus led the troops back to Wǔyín. [Zhāng] Xiù led cavalry to come to raid, the Excellency struck and defeated them. [Zhāng] Xiù fled to Ráng, and joined with Liú Biǎo. The Excellency said to the various officers: “I accepted the surrender of Zhāng Xiù and the rest, my mistake was to not quickly take his hostages, so that it came to this. I know the reason for the defeat. May you sirs observe this, from now afterward there will be no further defeats.” Therefore he returned to Xǔ. [39]



張濟自關中走南陽。濟死，從子繡領其眾。二年春正月，公到宛。張繡降，既而悔之，復反。公與戰，軍敗，為流矢所中，長子昂、弟子安民遇害。〔一〕公乃引兵還舞陰，繡將騎來鈔，公擊破之。繡奔穰，與劉表合。公謂諸將曰：「吾降張繡等，失不便取其質，以至於此。吾知所以敗。諸卿觀之，自今已後不復敗矣。」遂還許。〔二〕










[38] Wèi shū states: The horse the Excellency rode was named Juéyǐng, was hit by stray arrows, wounded in cheek and leg, and the Excellency was also hit in the right arm.
Shìyǔ states: [Cáo] Áng was unable to ride, and offered his horse to the Excellency. The Excellency therefore escaped, but [Cáo] Áng came to harm.



〔一〕　魏書曰：公所乘馬名絕影，為流矢所中，傷頰及足，并中公右臂。世語曰：昂不能騎，進馬于公，公故免，而昂遇害。













[39] Shìyǔ states: In the old regulations, when the Three Excellencies commanded troops and entered to meet, all had crossed halberds at their necks as they advanced. Previously, the Excellency was about to suppress Zhāng Xiù, and entered for an audience with Heaven’s Son. At the time they first restored this regulation. From this the Excellency did not again attend Court.



〔二〕　世語曰：舊制，三公領兵入見，皆交戟叉頸而前。初，公將討張繡，入覲天子，時始復此制。公自此不復朝見。







Yuán Shù wished to declare himself Emperor in Huáinán, and sent someone to inform Lǚ Bù. [Lǚ] Bù arrested his messenger and reported up his letter. [Yuán] Shù was angry, attacked [Lǚ] Bù, and was by [Lǚ] Bù defeated. Autumn, Ninth Moon [197 Sep 30 – Oct 28], Yuán Shù invaded Chén, the Excellency campaigned east against him. [Yuán] Shù heard the Excellency had personally come, abandoned his army and fled, leaving his officers Qiáo Ruí, Lǐ Fēng, Liáng Gāng, and Yuè Jiù. The Excellency arrived, struck and defeated [Qiáo] Ruí and the rest, and beheaded them all. [Yuán] Shù fled and crossed the Huái. The Excellency returned to Xǔ.



袁術欲稱帝於淮南，使人告呂布。布收其使，上其書。術怒，攻布，為布所破。秋九月，術侵陳，公東征之。術聞公自來，棄軍走，留其將橋蕤、李豊、梁綱、樂就；公到，擊破蕤等，皆斬之。術走渡淮。公還許。




When the Excellency had returned from Wǔyīn, Nányáng’s and Zhānglíng’s various counties again rebelled on behalf of [Zhāng] Xiù. The Excellency sent Cáo Hóng to strike them, he was unsuccessful, returned to garrison Shè, and was repeatedly invaded by [Zhāng] Xiù and [Liú] Biǎo. Winter, Eleventh Moon [197 Nov 28 – Dec 26], the Excellency personally campaigned south, reaching Wǎn. [40] [Liú] Biǎo’s officer Dèng Jì occupied Húyáng. Attacked and captured it, capturing [Dèng] Jì alive, Húyáng surrendered. Attacked Wǔyīn and captured it.



公之自舞陰還也，南陽、章陵諸縣復叛為繡，公遣曹洪擊之，不利，還屯葉，數為繡、表所侵。冬十一月，公自南征，至宛。〔一〕表將鄧濟據湖陽。攻拔之，生擒濟，湖陽降。攻舞陰，下之。










[40] Wèi shū states: He overlooked the Yù river, sacrificed to the dead officers and soldiers, sobbing and weeping, the multitudes were all emotionally moved and grieved.



〔一〕　魏書曰：臨淯水，祠亡將士，歔欷流涕，眾皆感慟。







Third Year, Spring, Standard Moon [198 Jan 26 – Feb 23], the Excellency returned to Xǔ. First established the Army Preceptor Libationer. Third Moon [198 Apr 24 – May 23], the Excellency besieged Zhāng Xiù at Ráng. Summer, Fifth Moon [198 Jun 22 – Jul 21], Liú Biǎo sent troops to rescue [Zhāng] Xiù to cut off the army’s rear. [41] The Excellency was about withdraw and return, [Zhāng] Xiù’s troops came in pursuit. The Excellency’s army could not advance, and linked regiments to gradually go forward. The Excellency’s letter to Xún Yù said: “The rebels come in pursuit of me. Though each day we travel [only] a few lǐ, I have a plan for them. Arriving at Ānzhòng, the defeat of [Zhāng] Xiù is certain.” Arriving at Ānzhòng, [Zhāng] Xiù with [Liú] Biǎo’s troops joined to defend the rugged terrain. The Excellency’s army to the front and the rear received enemies. The Excellency thus in the night dug through the terrain to make tunnels, moved through the supply wagons, and set hidden troops. At dawn, the rebels said the Excellency had escaped, and all the armies came in pursuit. Thus he unleashed the hidden troops, infantry and cavalry in a pincer attack, and greatly defeated them. Autumn, Seventh Moon [198 Aug 20 – Sep 18], the Excellency returned to Xǔ. Xún Yù asked the Excellency: “Formerly you planned that the rebels would certainly be defeated. Why?” The Excellency said: “The caitiffs cut off my returning brigades, and with me battled on death ground. I therefore knew I had won.”



三年春正月，公還許，初置軍師祭酒。三月，公圍張繡於穰。夏五月，劉表遣兵救繡，以絕軍後。〔一〕公將引還，繡兵來〔追〕，公軍不得進，連營稍前。公與荀彧書曰：「賊來追吾，雖日行數里，吾策之，到安眾，破繡必矣。」到安眾，繡與表兵合守險，公軍前後受敵。公乃夜鑿險為地道，悉過輜重，設奇兵。會明，賊謂公為遁也，悉軍來追。乃縱奇兵步騎夾攻，大破之。秋七月，公還許。荀彧問公：「前以策賊必破，何也？」公曰：「虜遏吾歸師，而與吾死地戰，吾是以知勝矣。」










[41] Xiàn-dì Chūnqiū states: Yuán Shào had a defected soldier go to the Excellency and say: “Tián Fēng told [Yuán] Shào to quickly attack Xǔ to seize Heaven’s Son to command the vassal lords, and the Four Seas could be directed and settled.” The Excellency thus ended the siege of [Zhāng] Xiù.



〔一〕　獻帝春秋曰：袁紹叛卒詣公云：「田豐使紹早襲許，若挾天子以令諸侯，四海可指麾而定。」公乃解繡圍。







Lǚ Bù again on behalf of Yuán Shù sent Gāo Shùn to attack Liú Bèi. The Excellency sent Xiàhóu Dūn to rescue him, unsuccessful, [Liú] Bèi was defeated by [Gāo] Shùn. Ninth Moon [198 Oct 18 – Nov 16], the Excellency campaigned against [Lǚ] Bù. Winter, Tenth Moon [198 Nov 17 – Dec 15], slaughtered Péngchéng, capturing its Chancellor Hóu Xié. Advanced to Xiàpī. [Lǚ] Bù personally commanded cavalry to oppose and strike. Greatly defeated him, capturing his elite officer Chéng Lián. Pursued to below the city walls. [Lǚ] Bù was afraid and wished to surrender. Chén Gōng and others blocked this plan, sought rescue from [Yuán] Shù, and encouraged [Lǚ] Bù to go out to battle, the battle was another defeat, and so he returned to firmly defend. Attacking him he could not be subdued. At the time the Excellency had repeatedly battled, the soldiers exhausted, and wished to return. Employed Xún Yōu’s and Guō Jiā’s plan and therefore breached the Sì and Yí rivers to flood the city. After over a moon, [Lǚ] Bù’s officers Sòng Xiàn, Wèi Xù, and others seized Chén Gōng and opened the city to surrender. Captured alive [Lǚ] Bù and [Chén] Gōng, killed them both. Tàishān’s Zāng Bà, Sūn Guàn, Wú Dūn, Yǐn Lǐ, Chāng Xī each had gathered multitudes. When [Lǚ] Bù had defeated Liú Bèi, [Zāng] Bà and the rest all followed [Lǚ] Bù. When [Lǚ] Bù was defeated, captured [Zāng] Bà and the rest. The Excellency generously accepted and treated them, and therefore divided from Qīng and Xú two provinces the area bordering the sea to entrust to them. Divided from Lángyé, Dōnghǎi, and Běihǎi to form Chéngyáng, Lìchéng, and Chānglǜ prefectures.



呂布復為袁術使高順攻劉備，公遣夏侯惇救之，不利。備為順所敗。九月，公東征布。冬十月，屠彭城，獲其相侯諧。進至下邳，布自將騎逆擊。大破之，獲其驍將成廉。追至城下，布恐，欲降。陳宮等沮其計，求救于術，勸布出戰，戰又敗，乃還固守，攻之不下。時公連戰，士卒罷，欲還，用荀攸、郭嘉計，遂決泗、沂水以灌城。月餘，布將宋憲、魏續等執陳宮，舉城降，生禽布、宮，皆殺之。太山臧霸、孫觀、吳敦、尹禮、昌豨各聚眾。布之破劉備也，霸等悉從布。布敗，獲霸等，公厚納待，遂割青、徐二州附於海以委焉，分瑯邪、東海、北海為城陽、利城、昌慮郡。




Previously, when the Excellency became Yǎn Province [Governor], he appointed Dōngpíng’s Bì Chén as his Separate Carriage. When Zhāng Miǎo rebelled, [Zhāng] Miǎo captured [Bì] Chén’s mother and younger brother, wives and children. The Excellency apologized and sent him away, saying: “Your elderly mother is with them. You can go.” [Bì] Chén bowed his head [to the ground] with no second thoughts. The Excellency commended him and shed tears for him. But when he went out, he then deserted and submitted [to Zhāng Miǎo]. When [Lǚ] Bù was defeated, [Bì] Chén was captured alive. Everyone was afraid for [Bì] Chén. The Excellency said: “Someone who is filial to their parents, how can they not also be loyal to their lord? It is what I seek.” Appointed him as Lǔ Chancellor. [42]



初，公為兗州，以東平畢諶為別駕。張邈之叛也，邈劫諶母弟妻子；公謝遣之，曰：「卿老母在彼，可去。」諶頓首無二心，公嘉之，為之流涕。既出，遂亡歸。及布破，諶生得，眾為諶懼，公曰：「夫人孝於其親者，豈不亦忠於君乎！吾所求也。」以為魯相。〔一〕










[42] Wèi shū states: Yuán Shào previously with former Grand Commandant Yáng Biāo, Chief Prolonging Autumn Liáng Shào, and Minister Treasurer Kǒng Róng had conflict, and wished to have the Excellency take advantage of some other fault to execute them. The Excellency said: “Right now Heaven’s Under has collapsed apart, powerful figures all rising up, supporting ministers and ruling lords harbor discontent, each having hearts to act for themselves. This is the time of superiors and subordinates suspecting one another. Even if they are treated without suspicion, yet they are afraid and do not trust. If there is a purge, then who would not be fearful for themselves? Moreover, for a commoner rising in plain clothes amid dust and dirt, to be oppressed and entrapped by mediocre men, could one contain the resentment? Gāozǔ pardoned his enmity of Yōng Chǐ and everyone’s feelings were calmed by this. How can one forget this?” [Yuán] Shào believed that the Excellency was outside using claims of public righteousness to inside in fact break away from him, and harbored deep resentment.
Your Servant Sōngzhī believes: Yáng Biāo also once was persecuted by Wèi Wǔ, almost to the point of death, and Kǒng Róng indeed did not escape from execution and extermination. How is this what is called “first enacting his words and afterward following them?” It is not the knowing that is difficult, it is the enacting of it. That can be believed.



〔一〕　魏書曰：袁紹宿與故太尉楊彪、大長秋梁紹、少府孔融有隙，欲使公以他過誅之。公曰：「當今天下土崩瓦解，雄豪並起，輔相君長，人懷怏怏，各有自為之心，此上下相疑之秋也，雖以無嫌待之，猶懼未信；如有所除，則誰不自危？且夫起布衣，在塵垢之間，為庸人之所陵陷，可勝怨乎！高祖赦雍齒之讎而群情以安，如何忘之？」紹以為公外託公義，內實離異，深懷怨望。臣松之以為楊彪亦曾為魏武所困，幾至于死，孔融竟不免于誅滅，豈所謂先行其言而後從之哉！非知之難，其在行之，信矣。







Fourth Year, Spring, Second Moon [199 Mar 15 – Apr 13], the Excellency returned and reached Chāngyì. Zhāng Yáng’s officer Yáng Chǒu killed [Zhāng] Yáng, Suī Gù also killed [Yáng] Chǒu, led the multitudes to join Yuán Shào, garrisoned Shèquǎn.
Summer, Fourth Moon [199 May 13 – Jun 11], advanced the army to overlook the Hé, sent Shǐ Huàn and Cáo Rén to cross the Hé and strike them. [Suī] Gù sent [Zhāng] Yáng’s former Chief Scribe Xuē Hóng and Hénèi Administrator Miào Shàng to remain to defend and personally commanded troops north to invite [Yuán] Shào to come rescue, with [Shǐ] Huàn and [Cáo] Rén encountered each other at Quǎnchéng. Engaged in battle, greatly defeated them, beheaded [Suī] Gù. The Excellency therefore crossed the Hé and besieged Shèquǎn. [Xuē] Hóng and [Miào] Shàng led the multitudes to surrender, enfeoffed as Ranked Marquesses. Returned the army to Áo Granary. Appointed Wèi Zhǒng as Hénèi Administrator, entrusted with affairs north of the Hé.



四年春二月，公還至昌邑。張楊將楊醜殺楊，眭固又殺醜，以其眾屬袁紹，屯射犬。夏四月，進軍臨河，使史渙、曹仁渡河擊之。固使楊故長史薛洪、河內太守繆尚留守，自將兵北迎紹求救，與渙、仁相遇犬城。交戰，大破之，斬固。公遂濟河，圍射犬。洪、尚率眾降，封為列侯，還軍敖倉。以魏种為河內太守，屬以河北事。




Previously, the Excellency had nominated [Wèi] Zhǒng as Filial-Incorruptible. When Yǎn Province rebelled, the Excellency said: “Only Wèi Zhǒng would never abandon me.” When he heard [Wèi] Zhǒng had fled, the Excellency angrily said: “[Wèi] Zhǒng if you do not flee south to the Yuè or north to the Hú I will never let you go!” When subduing Shèquǎn, captured [Wèi] Zhǒng alive. The Excellency said: “It is only his talent!” and released his bonds and employed him.



初，公舉种孝廉。兗州叛，公曰：「唯魏种且不棄孤也。」及聞种走，公怒曰：「种不南走越、北走胡，不置汝也！」既下射犬，生禽种，公曰：「唯其才也！」釋其縛而用之。




At the time Yuán Shào had already conquered Gōngsūn Zàn and united the lands of four provinces, his multitudes over a hundred thousand, and was about to advance his army to attack Xǔ. The various officers believed he could not be matched. The Excellency said: “I know what sort of man [Yuán] Shào is. His ambition is large but wisdom is small, appearance strict but guts weak, jealously fierce but little authority, troops many but deployments confused, officers arrogant and governance not united. Though his lands are broad, and though his provisions are abundance, that is just to be presented over to me.” Autumn, Eighth Moon [199 Sep 8 – Oct 7], the Excellency advanced the army to Líyáng, sent Zāng Bà and others to enter Qīng Province to ravage Qí, Běihǎi, and Dōng’ān, and left Yú Jīn to garrison the Hé’s upper bank. Ninth Moon [199 Oct 8 – Nov 5], the Excellency returned to Xǔ and divided troops to defend Guāndù. Winter, Eleventh Moon [199 Dec 6 – 200 Jan 3], Zhāng Xiù led his multitudes to surrender, enfeoffed as a Ranked Marquess. Twelfth Moon [200 Jan 4 – Feb 2], the Excellency stationed Guāndù.



是時袁紹既并公孫瓚，兼四州之地，眾十餘萬，將進軍攻許，諸將以為不可敵，公曰：「吾知紹之為人，志大而智小，色厲而膽薄，忌克而少威，兵多而分畫不明，將驕而政令不一，土地雖廣，糧食雖豐，適足以為吾奉也。」秋八月，公進軍黎陽，使臧霸等入青州破齊、北海、東安，留于禁屯河上。九月，公還許，分兵守官渡。冬十一月，張繡率眾降，封列侯。十二月，公軍官渡。




Yuán Shù from since his defeat at Chén gradually became destitute. Yuán Tán from Qīng Province was sent to invite him. [Yuán] Shù wished to pass by Xiàpī’s north. The Excellency sent Liú Bèi and Zhū Líng to intercept him. It happened that [Yuán] Shù died of illness. Chéng Yù and Guō Jiā heard that the Excellency had sent [Liú] Bèi, and said to the Excellency: “Liú Bèi cannot be released.” The Excellency was regretful, pursued him but was too late. Before [Liú] Bèi had gone east, he had secretly with Dǒng Chéng and others plotted rebellion. When he reached Xiàpī, he therefore killed Xú Province Inspector Chē Zhòu and mobilized troops to garrison Pèi. Sent Liú Dài and Wáng Zhōng to strike him, [they] could not overcome him. [43]



袁術自敗於陳，稍困，袁譚自青州遣迎之。術欲從下邳北過，公遣劉備、朱靈要之。會術病死。程昱、郭嘉聞公遣備，言於公曰：「劉備不可縱。」公悔，追之不及。備之未東也，陰與董承等謀反，至下邳，遂殺徐州刺史車冑，舉兵屯沛。遣劉岱、王忠擊之，不克〔一〕。










[43] Xiàn-dì Chūnqiū states: [Liú] Bèi said to [Liú] Dài and the rest: “Even if a hundred of you came, how would it match me? If Excellency Cáo personally came, only then would things be uncertain!”
Wèi Wǔ Gùshì states: [Liú] Dài appellation Gōngshān was a Pèi state man. As Excellency of Works’s Chief Scribe he followed on campaign and had achievements, enfeoffed a Ranked Marquess.
Wèi lüè states: Wáng Zhōng was a Fúfēng man. When young he became a precinct chief. When the Three Adjuncts were in chaos, [Wáng] Zhōng due to starvation ate human flesh, and followed those of his group south toward Wǔ Pass. It happened that Lóu Zǐbó was sent by Jīng Province to welcome refugees from the north. [Wáng] Zhōng did not wish to go, and therefore led the others to oppose and strike him, seizing his troops, gathering multitudes of over a thousand men to submit to the Excellency. Appointed [Wáng] Zhōng as a Central Cadet General, accompanying on suppression campaigns. The Five Office General [Cáo Pī] knew that [Wáng] Zhōng had once eaten human flesh, and therefore when he followed the chariot in going out, ordered performers to obtain skulls and bones from tombs and tie them to [Wáng] Zhōng’s horse’s saddle to make fun and laugh.



〔一〕　獻帝春秋曰：備謂岱等曰：「使汝百人來，其無如我何；曹公自來，未可知耳！」魏武故事曰：岱字公山，沛國人。以司空長史從征伐有功，封列侯。魏略曰：王忠，扶風人，少為亭長。三輔亂，忠飢乏噉人，隨輩南向武關。值婁子伯為荊州遣迎北方客人；忠不欲去，因率等仵逆擊之，奪其兵，聚眾千餘人以歸公。拜忠中郎將，從征討。五官將知忠嘗噉人，因從駕出行，令俳取冢間髑髏繫著忠馬鞍，以為歡笑。







Lújiāng Administrator Liú Xūn led his multitudes to surrender, enfeoffed as a Ranked Marquess.



廬江太守劉勳率眾降，封為列侯。

title: 1  Annals of Emperor Wǔ
text:
Jiàn’ān 5 - 12 (200 - 207)


Fifth Year, Spring, Standard Moon [200 Feb 3 – Mar 2], Dǒng Chéng and the rest’s plot leaked, all were submitted to execution. The Excellency was about to personally campaign east against [Liú] Bèi. The various officers all said: “The one competing with Your Excellency for Heaven’s Under is Yuán Shào. Now [Yuán] Shào is about to come but you ignore him to go east. [If Yuán] Shào takes advantage to our rear, what then?” The Excellency said: “Liú Bèi is a hero among men. Now if we do not strike, he will certainly become a later danger. [44] Though Yuán Shào has large ambitions, yet in perceiving situations he is slow, and certainly will not move.” Guō Jiā also encouraged the Excellency, therefore he went east and struck [Liú] Bèi, defeated him, captured alive his officer Xiàhóu Bó. [Liú] Bèi fled to [Yuán] Shào. Captured his wives and children. [Liú] Bèi’s officer Guān Yǔ garrisoned Xiàpī. Again advanced and attacked him. [Guān] Yǔ surrendered. Chāng Xī rebelled in support of [Liú] Bèi, also attacked and defeated him. The Excellency returned to Guāndù. [Yuán] Shào in the end did not set out.



五年春正月，董承等謀泄，皆伏誅。公將自東征備，諸將皆曰：「與公爭天下者，袁紹也。今紹方來而棄之東，紹乘人後，若何？」公曰：「夫劉備，人傑也，今不擊，必為後患。〔一〕袁紹雖有大志，而見事遲，必不動也。」郭嘉亦勸公，遂東擊備，破之，生禽其將夏侯博。備走奔紹，獲其妻子。備將關羽屯下邳，復進攻之，羽降。昌豨叛為備，又攻破之。公還官渡，紹卒不出。










[44] Sūn Shèng’s Wèishì Chūnqiū says: He answered the various officers saying: “Liú Bèi is a hero among men, and will create grief for me.”
Your Servant Sōngzhī believes: Historians in recording speech often made embellishments, therefore what is narrated in the earlier records have things that are not true, and later compilers also recklessly revised them, so the deviation from the truth, is it not all the more distant? Generally Sūn Shèng in compiling his books often used the Zuǒ-shì to change the older text, and this was not the only instance. Alas! What can later scholars trust? Moreover Wèi Wǔ was about to have Heaven’s Under as his driving ambition, and so using Fūchāi’s speech of facing death was incredibly wrong in its categorization.



〔一〕　孫盛魏氏春秋云：答諸將曰：「劉備，人傑也，將生憂寡人。」
臣松之以為史之記言，既多潤色，故前載所述有非實者矣，後之作者又生意改之，于失實也，不亦彌遠乎！凡孫盛製書，多用左氏以易舊文，如此者非一。嗟乎，後之學者將何取信哉？且魏武方以天下勵志，而用夫差分死之言，尤非其類。







Second Moon [200 Mar 3 – Apr 1], [Yuán] Shào sent Guō Tú, Chúnyú Qióng, and Yán Liáng to attack Dōng Prefecture Administrator Liú Yán at Báimǎ. [Yuán] Shào led troops to reach Líyáng, about to cross the Hé. Summer, Fourth Moon [200 May 2 – May 30], the Excellency went north to rescue [Liú] Yán. Xún Yōu advised the Excellency saying: “Now the troops are few and cannot match them, so dividing their momentum is thus appropriate. If Your Excellency arrives at Yánjīn, as if about to ferry troops across toward their rear, [Yuán] Shào will certainly go west in answer to this. Afterward use light troops to attack Báimǎ, surprising where they are unprepared, and Yán Liáng can be taken.” The Excellency followed this. [Yuán] Shào heard that troops were crossing, and at once divided troops to go west in answer to it. The Excellency then led the army on double march to Báimǎ, had not yet reached by over ten lǐ, when [Yán] Liáng was greatly alarmed, and came to oppose in battle. Sent Zhāng Liáo and Guān Yǔ at the front, struck and defeated and beheaded [Yán] Liáng. Therefore relieved Báimǎ’s siege, evacuated its civilians, and along the Hé went west. [Yuán] Shào thereupon crossed the Hé and pursued the Excellency’s army, reaching Yánjīn’s south. The Excellency reined in the troops to halt and camp below Nánbǎn, sending someone to climb up the ramparts to watch them, who said: “It could be five to six hundred cavalry.” Soon afterward again reported: “Cavalry is gradually increasing, infantry is uncountable.” The Excellency said: “Do not report again.” Thus he ordered the cavalry to unfasten the saddles and release the horses. At the time, Báimǎ’s supply wagons were on the road. The various officers believed that the enemy cavalry was many, and it was better to return to protect the camp. Xún Yōu said: “This is the way to trap the enemy, how can we leave them?” [Yuán] Shào’s cavalry officer Wén Chǒu with Liú Bèi commanding five to six thousand cavalry beginning to end arrived. The various officers again reported: “We should mount horses.” The Excellency said: “Not yet.” Shortly afterward, the cavalry arriving gradually increased, and some divided to capture the supply wagons. The Excellency said: “[Now we] can.” Thus they all mounted horses. At the time the cavalry was not even six hundred. Then unleashed the troops to strike, greatly defeating them, beheading [Wén] Chǒu. [Yán] Liáng and [Wén] Chǒu were both [Yuán] Shào’s famed officers. In two battles both were taken, and [Yuán] Shào’s army was greatly shaken. The Excellency returned the army to Guāndù. [Yuán] Shào advanced to protect Yángwǔ. Guān Yǔ deserted to return to Liú Bèi.



二月，紹遣郭圖、淳于瓊、顏良攻東郡太守劉延于白馬，紹引兵至黎陽，將渡河。夏四月，公北救延。荀攸說公曰：「今兵少不敵，分其勢乃可。公到延津，若將渡兵向其後者，紹必西應之，然後輕兵襲白馬，掩其不備，顏良可禽也。」公從之。紹聞兵渡，即分兵西應之。公乃引軍兼行趣白馬，未至十餘里，良大驚，來逆戰。使張遼、關羽前登，擊破，斬良。遂解白馬圍，徙其民，循河而西。紹於是渡河追公軍，至延津南。公勒兵駐營南阪下，使登壘望之，曰；「可五六百騎。」有頃，復白：「騎稍多，步兵不可勝數。」公曰：「勿復白。」乃令騎解鞍放馬。是時，白馬輜重就道。諸將以為敵騎多，不如還保營。荀攸曰：「此所以餌敵，如何去之！」紹騎將文醜與劉備將五六千騎前後至。諸將復白：「可上馬。」公曰：「未也。」有頃，騎至稍多，或分趣輜重。公曰：「可矣。」乃皆上馬。時騎不滿六百，遂縱兵擊，大破之，斬醜。良、醜皆紹名將也，再戰，悉禽，紹軍大震。公還軍官渡。紹進保陽武。關羽亡歸劉備。




Eighth Moon [200 Aug 28 – Sep 25], [Yuán] Shào linked regiments and gradually advanced, used sand piles to make encampments, east to west for several tens of lǐ.
