Summer, Fourth Moon [213 May 8 – Jun 6], reached Yè.



十八年春正月，進軍濡須口，攻破權江西營，獲權都督公孫陽，乃引軍還。詔書并十四州，復為九州。夏四月，至鄴。




Fifth Moon Bǐngshēn [213 Jun 16], Heaven’s Son sent Censorate Grandee Chī Lǜ Holding Stave with conferment mandate on the Excellency to become Duke of Wèi, [83] stating:



五月丙申，天子使御史大夫郗慮持節策命公為魏公〔一〕曰：




We, being not virtuous, from youth encountered suffering and viciousness, driven into western lands, moving through Táng and Wèi. At that time, [I was] like superfluous tassel, [84] the Ancestral Temple lacked sacrifices, the State Altars without a place. Crowds of the vicious watched greedily, dividing apart the various Xià, the peoples of all the lands, We could not catch, and so the Mandate of our Gāozǔ was about to collapse to the ground. We from morning’s rise to restless sleep were shaken and mournful in despairing heart, saying: “Oh grandfather oh father, [of your] legs and arms and former rectifiers, [85] who is able to give relief to Our person?” Thus it stirred Heaven’s mercy, bringing forth the Assistant Chancellor [Cáo Cāo], to protect and nurture our Imperial House, vast relief from the hardships and troubles, We truly depend on this. Now about to confer on you the canonical honors, thus vigilantly hear Our command:



朕以不德，少遭愍凶，越在西土，遷於唐、衛。當此之時，若綴旒然，〔二〕宗廟乏祀，社稷無位；群凶覬覦，分裂諸夏，率土之民，朕無獲焉，即我高祖之命將墜於地。朕用夙興假寐，震悼於厥心，曰「惟祖惟父，股肱先正，〔三〕其孰能恤朕躬」？乃誘天衷，誕育丞相，保乂我皇家，弘濟於艱難，朕實賴之。今將授君典禮，其敬聽朕命。




In the past Dǒng Zhuó first created the state’s troubles, the crowds of lords left their seats to plan for the Ruling House, [86] you then gathered forces and advanced, first to begin military actions, this was your loyalty to our Court. Later when the Huángjīn rebelled against natural order, invading our three provinces, reaching to the common people, you again cut them down to give peace to the eastern Xià, this also was your achievement. Hán Xiān and Yáng Fèng seized control over power and command, you then came to suppress, defeated and expelled their troubles, and therefore moved the capital to Xǔ, built our capital territory, established offices and restored sacrifices, not losing the old ways, Heaven and Earth and spirits thereupon obtained relief, this also was your achievement. Yuán Shù usurped and rebelled, unrestrained in Huáinán, fearing and dreading your ability and use of grand and profound strategies, in the Qíyáng campaign, Qiáo Ruí gave up his head, your power and prestige strode the south, [Yuán] Shù thus fell and collapsed, this also was your achievement. Turning spears on eastern campaign, Lǚ Bù at once was killed, riding carriage about to return, Zhāng Yáng perished, Suī Gù was submitted to execution, Zhāng Xiù bowed in submission, this also was your achievement. Yuán Shào opposed and disordered the natural order, plotting to endanger the State Altars, relying on his multitudes, raised troops to oppress the interior. At that time, the Ruler’s Brigades were few and weak, Heaven’s Under turned cold in heart, none having the will to resist. You held to great integrity, vitality surpassing the white sun, exerting your martial fury, conveying your divine strategies, delivering finality at Guāndù, greatly annihilated the villains, [87] allowing our country to be rescued from danger and collapse, this also was your achievement. Leading the brigades across the vast Hé, opening and settling four provinces, Yuán Tán and Gāo Gàn both lost their heads, the sea pirates fled and rushed away, the Hēishān submitted to course, this also was your achievement. Wūhuán of three tribes raised chaos for two generations, Yuán Shàng took advantage of this, terrorizing and occupying the north of the passes. Bundling horses and hanging carts, in one campaign then destroyed, this also was your achievement. Liú Biǎo was treacherous and unrestrained, not providing tribute or service, the Ruler’s Brigades started on the road, the powerful winds ahead spreading, a hundred cities and eight prefectures [of Jīng Province] joined arms and bent knees, this also was your achievement. Mǎ Chāo and Chéng Yí alike in evil supported one another, on the riverbanks occupied the Hé and Tóng, seeking to indulge their desires. Exterminated them at the Wèi’s south, presented kill count in the tens of thousands, therefore settling the frontier borders, succoring and harmonizing the Róng and Dí, this also was your achievement. Xiānbēi and Dīnglíng with relay translators arrived, Bìyú and Báiwū requested to submit and offered tribute, this also was your achievement. You have the achievement of settling Heaven’s Under, and add to it with brilliant virtue, spreading order Within the Seas, promoting good social customs, broadly applying diligent teachings, careful and cautious in punishments, officials without oppressive governance, civilians without evil thoughts. Reverently honoring the Emperor’s clan, restoring the lineages of cut off successions, old virtues and former achievements, none were not all organized. Though Yī Yǐn matched the August Heavens and Zhōu-gōng shined the Four Seas, they do not compare.



昔者董卓初興國難，群后釋位以謀王室，〔四〕君則攝進，首啟戎行，此君之忠於本朝也。後及黃巾反易天常，侵我三州，延及平民，君又翦之以寧東夏，此又君之功也。韓暹、楊奉專用威命，君則致討，克黜其難，遂遷許都，造我京畿，設官兆祀，不失舊物，天地鬼神於是獲乂，此又君之功也。袁術僭逆，肆於淮南，懾憚君靈，用丕顯謀，蘄陽之役，橋蕤授首，稜威南邁，術以隕潰，此又君之功也。迴戈東征，呂布就戮，乘轅將返，張楊殂斃，眭固伏罪，張繡稽服，此又君之功也。袁紹逆亂天常，謀危社稷，憑恃其眾，稱兵內侮，當此之時，王師寡弱，天下寒心，莫有固志，君執大節，精貫白日，奮其武怒，運其神策，致屆官渡，大殲醜類，〔五〕俾我國家拯于危墜，此又君之功也。濟師洪河，拓定四州，袁譚、高幹，咸梟其首，海盜奔迸，黑山順軌，此又君之功也。烏丸三種，崇亂二世，袁尚因之，逼據塞北，束馬縣車，一征而滅，此又君之功也。劉表背誕，不供貢職，王師首路，威風先逝，百城八郡，交臂屈膝，此又君之功也。馬超、成宜，同惡相濟，濱據河、潼，求逞所欲，殄之渭南，獻馘萬計，遂定邊境，撫和戎狄，此又君之功也。鮮卑、丁零，重譯而至，（單于）〔箄于〕、白屋，請吏率職，此又君之功也。君有定天下之功，重之以明德，班敘海內，宣美風俗，旁施勤教，恤慎刑獄，吏無苛政，民無懷慝；敦崇帝族，表繼絕世，舊德前功，罔不咸秩；雖伊尹格于皇天，周公光于四海，方之蔑如也。




We have heard that the Former Kings all established the enlightened and virtuous, granted them with land, shared with them people, honored with exalted regalia, equipped with ritual objects, in order to be vassal screen defenses for the Ruling House, Left and Right through the generations. Thus during Zhōu Chéng, Guǎn and Cài were not peaceful, in remembrance of the achievement of punishing the troubles, thus sent Shào Kāng-gōng to bestow on Qí Tài-gōng a range east reaching to the sea, west reaching to the Hé, south reaching to Mùlíng, north reaching to Wúdì, Five Lords Nine Governors, true authority to campaign against them, for generations blessed as Grand Preceptors, as the border to the eastern sea. Reaching to King Xiāng, also there was the Chǔ people not providing their obligations to the King, and also the command on Jìn Wén to ascend as hegemon over the lords, bestowed with Two Chariots, Tiger Elite, Ax and Battle-Ax, libation liquor, bows and arrows, greatly expanding to Nányáng, for generations being alliance leader. The reason the Zhōu House was not destroyed was because it had those two states [Qí and Jìn] to depend upon. Now you possess grand and illustrious virtue, clearly protected Our person, served and answered Heaven’s Mandate, guided and raised vast exploits, thus calming the Nine Regions, none are not led as followers, [88] achievements higher than Yī [Yǐn] and Zhōu [gōng], but your rewards are inferior to Qí and Jìn, and We are extremely ashamed of this. We are a lesser person entrusted to be above the millions of people, forever think of their hardships, like treading an abyss of ice; if not for you as the way to cross, We would not be able to bear it. Now use Jì Province’s Hédōng, Hénèi, Wèi prefecture, Zhào state, Zhōngshān, Chángshān, Jùlù, Ānpíng, Gānlíng, Píngyuán, altogether ten prefectures, to enfeoff you as Duke of Wèi. Bestow on you dark soil, wrapped in white reeds, thus consult your turtle shells, to establish Mound Altars. In the past during the Zhōu House, Bì-gōng and Máo-gōng entered as minister assistants, Zhōu [gōng] and Shào [gōng] as Preceptor and Protector went out as Two Governors. Appointments outside and inside, you are truly appropriate for, thus remain as Assistant Chancellor and designate Jì Province Governor as before. Also apply on you the Nine Bestowments, thus respectfully listen to Our command: As you warp and weft rituals and laws, for the people a model standard, having them secure in duties and work, with none changing intentions, therefore employ bestowment on you a Great Chariot and War Chariot, one of each, dark stallions of two teams of four. You encourage duty and attending to roots, the harvesters to dusk labor, [89] grain and silk amassed and accumulated, the great enterprise thus flourishing, therefore employ bestowment on you the dress of Robe and Cap, Red Shoes to match. You esteem modesty and deference, causing the people to improve their conduct, young and grown have courtesy, above and below all harmonized, therefore employ bestowment on you Balcony Hanging [musical instruments], Six Rows of Dancers. You assist and declare moral cultivation, thus spreading in the four directions, the distant peoples change face, Huáxià enriched and full, therefore employ bestowment on you Vermillion Doors for your residence. You study the enlightened sages, ponder what Emperors find difficult, employ the talented and appoint the worthy, all the good certain to be raised, therefore employ bestowment on you an Entrance Ramp to ascend. You maintain the state’s authority, with stern expression occupying the center, of the smallest and slightest of evils, none are not stamped out and removed, therefore employ bestowment on you Tiger Elite guards of three hundred men. You examine and respect Heaven’s punishments, exposing those with guilt, [90] of those that violate order, none are not executed and eradicated, therefore employ bestowment on you Ax and Battle-Ax, one of each. You soar like a dragon and glare like a tiger, watching the eight directions, suppressing the rebellious, charging through the Four Seas, therefore employ bestowment on you red bow of one, red arrows of one hundred, black bows of ten, black arrows of one thousand. You take warmth and humility as foundation, filial piety and fraternal friendship as virtue, intelligently faithful sincerely truthful, emotionally moving Our thoughts, therefore employ bestowment on you libation liquor of one bottle, with jade ladle to match. Wèi State is to install an Assistant Chancellor on down, various ministers and hundred offices, all by the regulations of the vassal Marquesses and Kings at the beginning of Hàn. Go forth in veneration! Respectfully obey Our command! 朕聞先王並建明德，胙之以土，分之以民，崇其寵章，備其禮物，所以藩衛王室，左右厥世也。其在周成，管、蔡不靜，懲難念功，乃使邵康公賜齊太公履，東至於海，西至於河，南至於穆陵，北至於無棣，五侯九伯，實得征之，世祚太師，以表東海；爰及襄王，亦有楚人不供王職，又命晉文登為侯伯，錫以二輅、虎賁、鈇鉞、秬鬯、弓矢，大啟南陽，世作盟主。故周室之不壞，繄二國是賴。今君稱丕顯德，明保朕躬，奉答天命，導揚弘烈，緩爰九域，莫不率俾，〔六〕功高於伊、周，而賞卑於齊、晉，朕甚恧焉。朕以眇眇之身，託於兆民之上，永思厥艱，若涉淵冰，非君攸濟，朕無任焉。今以冀州之河東、河內、魏郡、趙國、中山、常山、鉅鹿、安平、甘陵、平原凡十郡，封君為魏公。錫君玄土，苴以白茅；爰契爾龜，用建冢社。昔在周室，畢公、毛公入為卿佐，周、邵師保出為二伯，外內之任，君實宜之，其以丞相領冀州牧如故。又加君九錫，其敬聽朕命。以君經緯禮律，為民軌儀，使安職業，無或遷志，是用錫君大輅、戎輅各一，玄牡二駟。君勸分務本，穡人昏作，〔七〕粟帛滯積，大業惟興，是用錫君袞冕之服，赤舄副焉。君敦尚謙讓，俾民興行，少長有禮，上下咸和，是用錫君軒縣之樂，六佾之舞。君翼宣風化，爰發四方，遠人革面，華夏充實，是用錫君朱戶以居。君研其明哲，思帝所難，官才任賢，群善必舉，是用錫君納陛以登。君秉國之鈞，正色處中，纖毫之惡，靡不抑退，是用錫君虎賁之士三百人。君糾虔天刑，章厥有罪，〔八〕犯關干紀，莫不誅殛，是用錫君鈇鉞各一。君龍驤虎視，旁眺八維，掩討逆節，折衝四海，是用錫君彤弓一，彤矢百，玈弓十，玈矢千。君以溫恭為基，孝友為德，明允篤誠，感于朕思，是用錫君秬鬯一卣，珪瓚副焉。魏國置丞相已下群卿百寮，皆如漢初諸侯王之制。往欽哉，敬服朕命！簡恤爾眾，時亮庶功，用終爾顯德，對揚我高祖之休命！〔九〕

Thereupon Central Army Preceptor and Língshù precinct Marquess Xún Yōu, Front Army Preceptor and Dōngwǔ precinct Marquess Zhōng Yáo, Left Army Preceptor Liáng Mào, Right Army Preceptor Máo Jiè, Pacifying Caitiffs General and Huá village Marquess Liú Xūn, Establishing Warfare General and Qīngyuán precinct Marquess Liú Ruò, Subduing Waves General and Gāo’ān Marquess Xiàhóu Dūn, Raising Warfare General and city precinct Marquess Wáng Zhōng, Exerting Authority General and Yuè village Marquess Liú Zhǎn, Establishing Loyalty General and Chāngxiāng precinct Marquess Xiānyú Fǔ, Exerting Warfare General and Ānguó precinct Marquess Chéng Yù, Grand Central Grandee and city village Marquess Jiǎ Xǔ, Army Preceptor Libationer Qiānqiū precinct Marquess Dǒng Zhāo, city precinct Marquess Xuē Hóng, Nánxiāng precinct Marquess Dǒng Méng, Within the Passes Marquess Wáng Càn, Fù Xùn, Libationers Wáng Xuǎn, Yuán Huàn, Wáng Lǎng, Chāng Chéng, Rèn Fān, Dù Xí, Central Protector of the Army and Guómíng precinct Marquess Cáo Hóng, Central Manager of the Army and Wànsuì precinct Marquess Hán Hào, Acting Valiant Cavalry General and Ānpíng precinct Marquess Cáo Rén, designate Protector of the Army General Wáng Tú, Chief Scribes Wàn Qián, Xiè Huàn, Yuán Bà and others encouraged the advancement stating:
“From since the ancient Three Dynasties, granting ministers with land, receiving commands for internal restoration, enfeoffments and titles to supporting assistants, was all to commend achievement and reward virtue, to serve as vassal defenses for the state. Previously, Heaven’s Under collapsed into chaos, crowds of vicious and powerful rose, the danger of overstepping bounds and domineering insolence, one cannot bear to speak of it. Your Enlightened Excellency exerted your body and devoted your life to face these troubles, punished the rebellion of the two Yuán’s usurpation and thieving, exterminated the sorts of the Huángjīn’s banditry and chaos, destroyed and razed the leaders of rebels, cut down and weeded the wild filth, bathed in frost and dew for over twenty years. From since there has been writing, there has never been achievements like this. In the past, Zhōu-gōng continued the legacy of Wén and Wǔ, received an already completed enterprise, rested high on writing brush, saluted to greet the various lords, the labors of Shāng-Yǎn were no more than two years; Lǚ Wàng used the circumstances of having two out of three to hold power over eight hundred vassal lords, temporarily held banner and battle-ax, for a time directed signal flag; however both greatly founded lands, striding provinces and merging states. Zhōu-gōng’s eight sons all were marquesses and earls, white bulls and red oxen, Suburb Sacrifices to Heaven and Earth, ritual tallies and prepared objects in imitation of the Ruling House, their glorious esteem and flourishing favor was as vast as this. Reaching to Hàn’s rise, the ministers assisting the mandate were Zhāng Ěr and Wú Ruì, their achievements were extremely meager, but they also linked cities and opened territory, faced south and declared themselves sovereign. These were all enlightened lords and understanding rulers conveying it above, worth ministers and sagely governors receiving it below, the virtuous standards of the Three Dynasties, the enlightened regulations of the Hàn Emperors. Now in comparing labors then Zhōu [gōng] and Lǚ [Wàng] had it easy, in calculating achievements then Zhāng [Ěr] and Wú [Ruì] were small, in discussing regulation standards then Qí and Lǔ were weightier, in speaking of territory then Chángshā was more. That being the case, the fief of Wèi state and the honor of the Nine Bestowments, compared to the ancient rewards, is like hiding jade under coarse clothes. Moreover, the Ranked Marquesses and various officers who will by fortunate connection to a dragon stallion be able to steal small labors to girdle purple and hold gold are altogether in the hundreds, and also will because of this be able to transmit inheritances for myriad generations, but if Your Enlightened Excellency alone declines reward above, it will cause those below to feel ill at ease, above violate the joyous hearts of the Sagely Court, below fail the utmost hopes of the capped and girdled, forgetting the great enterprise of supporting assistance, trusting in the meager conduct of a common fellow, this is what we [Xún] Yōu and the rest greatly fear.” Therefore the Excellency ordered the exterior to make a Reply, but only to receive Wèi prefecture. [Xún] Yōu and the rest again said: “In prostration observing: In the original enfeoffment of Wèi state, the Sagely Court considered carefully, consulted and planned with the various bureaus, and only then afterward issued the mandate, but Your Enlightened Excellency for a long time opposed the Superior’s direction, not accepting the great gifts. Now to have already reverently accepted the Edict mandate, to complement and obey the expectations of the masses, but also to wish to decline much and accept little, yielding nine and accepting one, it is like the reward of the Hàn Court reward not being enacted, and so the request of [Xún] Yōu and the rest not being approved. In the past the enfeoffments of Qí and Lǔ covered all to the East Sea, the territory tax revenue was four million families, the foundations prosperous and industry expansive, easy to use to establish achievement, and therefore able to achieve the accomplishments of supporting and carrying, establish the merit of unified rectification. Now although Wèi state is ten prefectures in name, yet it is less than Qūfù, in calculating its household numbers, it cannot even be half. To be a vassal guard for the Ruling House, establishing walls and planting screens, it appears not yet sufficient. Moreover, the Sagely Superior has observed the disaster of Qín falling without support, has been warned by the hardships of the shaking disturbances of former days, entrusts and establishes the loyal and worthy, for [the prevention of] decline and fall, may Your Enlightened Excellency respectfully receive the Emperor’s mandate, and no longer refuse and disobey.” The Excellency thus accepted the mandate.
Wèi lüè records the Excellency’s sent up letter of thanks stating: “Your Servant was immersed in the Former Emperor’s generous favor, reaching rank in the cadet bureaus. By nature being languid and idle, my intentions and hopes were completely fulfilled, not daring to wish for high rank, hope for prestige and influence. It happened that Dǒng Zhuó made chaos, righteousness is to die for a cause, and therefore I dared exert body and devote life, breaking charges and leading multitudes, and therefore in happening to encounter an opportunity of a thousand years, I served in the labors before your eyes. At the interval when the two Yuán were domineering and oppressive, Your Majesty and Your Servant were cold in heart and alike in anxieties, looking back to gaze to the capital, advancing to receive a ferocious enemy, always afraid that we lord and servant would together fall into the tiger’s mouth, truly I had no expectation that I would be able to preserve my head and neck. Depending on the blessings of the Ancestral spirits, the villainous sorts were exterminated, allowing Your Meager Servant to steal some reputation in the meantime. Your Majesty applied favor, appointing me as the highest minister, fief and noble rank and favors and salary, abundant and great and vast and generous. Of my entire life’s wishes, I truly had not expected it. The calculations of my mouth and of heart is that it is good fortune to remain to await punishment, preserve and keep my Ranked Marquisate, bequeath it to my sons and grandsons, entrust myself to your sagely reign, and forever be without worry and blame. Unexpectedly Your Majesty then showed greater intentions, opening a state and preparing bestowments, to confer on Your Foolish Servant, the territory comparable to Qí and Lǔ, the rituals the same as to the vassal kings, not what Your Servant without achievements should receive and hold. Submitting my feelings above to be heard, it was not favored with acceptance and permission, stern Edict harshly arrived, truly causing Your Servant’s heart to rise and fall in the pressure. In prostration examining myself, ranked among the great ministers, fate controlled by the Ruling House, my body is not my own possession, how can I dare have selfishness, to follow these foolish thoughts, to be dismissed and wear my original [commoner] clothes? Now in accepting the territory, preparing to serve as vassal assistant, I do not dare think for the long term and worry of having later generations [of descendants]. As for me and my sons, we together swear oaths to the end of our lives, disintegrating bodies and exhausting fates, to repay the generous favor. With Heaven’s authority at front, in fear I accept the Edict.”



〔九〕　後漢尚書左丞潘勗之辭也。勗字元茂，陳留中牟人。魏書載公令曰：「夫受九錫，廣開土宇，周公其人也。漢之異姓八王者，與高祖俱起布衣，創定王業，其功至大，吾何可比之？」前後三讓。於是中軍師（王）陸樹亭侯荀攸、前軍師東武亭侯鍾繇、左軍師涼茂、右軍師毛玠、平虜將軍華鄉侯劉勳、建武將軍清苑亭侯劉若、伏波將軍高安侯夏侯惇、揚武將軍都亭侯王忠、奮威將軍樂鄉侯劉展、建忠將軍昌鄉亭侯鮮于輔、奮武將軍安國亭侯程昱、太中大夫都鄉侯賈詡、軍師祭酒千秋亭侯董昭、都亭侯薛洪、南鄉亭侯董蒙、關內侯王粲、傅巽、祭酒王選、袁渙、王朗、張承、任藩、杜襲、中護軍國明亭侯曹洪、中領軍萬歲亭侯韓浩、行驍騎將軍安平亭侯曹仁、領護軍將軍王圖、長史萬潛、謝奐、袁霸等勸進曰：「自古三代，胙臣以土，受命中興，封秩輔佐，皆所以褒功賞德，為國藩衛也。往者天下崩亂，群凶豪起，顛越跋扈之險，不可忍言。明公奮身出命以徇其難，誅二袁篡盜之逆，滅黃巾賊亂之類，殄夷首逆，芟撥荒穢，沐浴霜露二十餘年，書契已來，未有若此功者。昔周公承文、武之跡，受已成之業，高枕墨筆，拱揖群后，商、奄之勤，不過二年，呂望因三分有二之形，據八百諸侯之勢，暫把旄鉞，一時指麾，然皆大啟土宇，跨州兼國。周公八子，並為侯伯，白牡騂剛，郊祀天地，典策備物，擬則王室，榮章寵盛如此之弘也。逮至漢興，佐命之臣，張耳、吳芮，其功至薄，亦連城開地，南面稱孤。此皆明君達主行之於上，賢臣聖宰受之於下，三代令典，漢帝明制。今比勞則周、呂逸，計功則張、吳微，論制則齊、魯重，言地則長沙多；然則魏國之封，九錫之榮，況於舊賞，猶懷玉而被褐也。且列侯諸將，幸攀龍驥，得竊微勞，佩紫懷黃，蓋以百數，亦將因此傳之萬世，而明公獨辭賞於上，將使其下懷不自安，上違聖朝歡心，下失冠帶至望，忘輔弼之大業，信匹夫之細行，攸等所大懼也。」於是公敕外為章，但受魏郡。攸等復曰：「伏見魏國初封，聖朝發慮，稽謀群寮，然後策命；而明公久違上指，不即大禮。今既虔奉詔命，副順眾望，又欲辭多當少，讓九受一，是猶漢朝之賞不行，而攸等之請未許也。昔齊、魯之封，奄有東海，疆域井賦，四百萬家，基隆業廣，易以立功，故能成翼戴之勳，立一匡之績。今魏國雖有十郡之名，猶減于曲阜，計其戶數，不能參半，以藩衛王室，立垣樹屏，猶未足也。且聖上覽亡秦無輔之禍，懲曩日震蕩之艱，託建忠賢，廢墜是為，願明公恭承帝命，無或拒違。」公乃受命。魏略載公上書謝曰：「臣蒙先帝厚恩，致位郎署，受性疲怠，意望畢足，非敢希望高位，庶幾顯達。會董卓作亂，義當死難，故敢奮身出命，摧鋒率眾，遂值千載之運，奉役目下。當二袁炎沸侵侮之際，陛下與臣寒心同憂，顧瞻京師，進受猛敵，常恐君臣俱陷虎口，誠不自意能全首領。賴祖宗靈祐，醜類夷滅，得使微臣竊名其間。陛下加恩，授以上相，封爵寵祿，豐大弘厚，生平之願，實不望也。口與心計，幸且待罪，保持列侯，遺付子孫，自託聖世，永無憂責。不意陛下乃發盛意，開國備錫，以貺愚臣，地比齊、魯，禮同藩王，非臣無功所宜膺據。歸情上聞，不蒙聽許，嚴詔切至，誠使臣心俯仰逼迫。伏自惟省，列在大臣，命制王室，身非己有，豈敢自私，遂其愚意，亦將黜退，令就初服。今奉疆土，備數藩翰，非敢遠期，慮有後世；至於父子相誓終身，灰軀盡命，報塞厚恩。天威在顏，悚懼受詔。」

[93] Wèishì Chūnqiū states: Appointed Xún Yōu as Secretariat Writers Director, Liáng Mào as Deputy Director, Máo Jiè, Cuī Yǎn, Cháng Lín, Xú Yì, Hé Kuí as Secretariat Writers, Wáng Càn, Dù Xí, Wèi Jì, Hé Qià as Attendant Centrals.



〔二〕　魏氏春秋曰：以荀攸為尚書令，涼茂為僕射，毛玠、崔琰、常林、徐奕、何夔為尚書，王粲、杜襲、衛覬、和洽為侍中。







Mǎ Chāo was at Hànyáng, again took advantage of the Qiāng and Hú to do harm. Dī King Qiānwàn rebelled in support of [Mǎ] Chāo, garrisoned Xīngguó. Sent Xiàhóu Yuān to suppress them.



馬超在漢陽，復因羌、胡為害，氐王千萬叛應超，屯興國。使夏侯淵討之。

title: 1  Annals of Emperor Wǔ
text:
Jiàn’ān 19 - 20 (214 - 215)


Nineteenth Year, Spring, Standard Moon [214 Jan 29 – Feb 26], first plowed the Register Field. Nán’ān’s Zhào Qú, Hànyáng’s Yǐn Fèng and others suppressed [Mǎ] Chāo, exposed the heads of his wives and children. [Mǎ] Chāo fled to Hànzhōng. Hán Suì relocated to Jīnchéng, entered Dī King Qiānwàn’s division, led Qiāng and Hú of over ten thousand cavalry to battle with Xiàhóu Yuān. Struck, greatly defeated them. [Hán] Suì fled to Xīpíng. [Xiàhóu] Yuān with the various officers attacked Xīngguó, slaughtered it. Abolished Āndōng and Yǒngyáng prefectures.



十九年春正月，始耕籍田。南安趙衢、漢陽尹奉等討超，梟其妻子，超奔漢中。韓遂徙金城，入氐王千萬部，率羌、胡萬餘騎與夏侯淵戰，擊，大破之，遂走西平。淵與諸將攻興國，屠之。省安東、永陽郡。




When Āndìng Administrator Guànqiū Xīng was about to take office, the Duke warmed him saying: “The Qiāng and Hú wish to connect with the central states, and should send people to come [to us], be careful to not send people to go [to them]. Good men are difficult to find, [so anyone sent] will certainly teach the Qiāng and Hú to make absurd requests, because he wishes to profit himself. To not agree then will disappoint the expectations of the foreigners, to agree to it then will have no benefits.” [Guànqiū] Xīng arrived, sent Colonel Fàn Líng among the Qiāng, [Fàn] Líng indeed instructed the Qiāng to request him to be their Dependent State Commandant. The Duke said: “I foresaw it would be like this, not because I am a sage, only because my experiences are many.” [94]



安定太守毌丘興將之官，公戒之曰：「羌，胡欲與中國通，自當遣人來，慎勿遣人往。善人難得，必將教羌、胡妄有所請求，因欲以自利；不從便為失異俗意，從之則無益事。」興至，遣校尉范陵至羌中，陵果教羌，使自請為屬國都尉。公曰：「吾預知當爾，非聖也，但更事多耳。」〔一〕










[94] Xiàn-dì Qǐjū zhù states: Sent Enacting Minister of Ceremonies affairs the Minister of Agriculture Ānyáng precinct Marquess Wáng Yì with Minister of the Imperial Clan Liú Ài, both Holding Stave, armored escort of five men, to present bundles of silk and teams of four horses, with the Dispensing Affairs Yellow Gate Attendant Cadet, the Lateral Court Deputy, Central Regular Attendants of two men, to welcome the two Noble Ladies from Wèi Duchy State. Second Moon, Guǐhài [214 Mar 10], also at the Duke of Wèi’s Ancestral Temples conferred Seals and Ribbons on the two Noble Ladies. Jiǎzǐ [214 Mar 11], visited the Duke of Wèi’s Palace’s Yánqiū Gate, welcomed the Noble Ladies to board the carriages. Wèi sent its Minister of Cadets, Minister Treasurer, Academic Scholars, Imperial Storehouses and Chénghuáng Stable Director, Assistant Chancellor’s Assistants and Associates and Attendants to escort the Noble Ladies. Guǐyǒu [214 Mar 20], the two Noble Ladies reached Wěicāng’s interior. Sent [Hàn] Attendant Centrals, Dānjiāng Surplus Followers, Tiger Elite beginning to end continuously to welcome them. Yǐhài [214 Mar 22], the two Noble Ladies entered the Palace, the Censorate Grandee, Central Two Thousand dàn officers and grandees, Consultant Cadets gathered inside the Hall, Wèi State’s two Ministers with an Attendant Central and Central Cadet, two men, with Hàn’s Excellencies and Ministers together ascended the Hall and feasted.



〔一〕　獻帝起居注曰：使行太常事大司農安陽亭侯王邑與宗正劉艾，皆持節，介者五人，齎束帛駟馬，及給事黃門侍郎、掖庭丞、中常侍二人，迎二貴人于魏公國。二月癸亥，又於魏公宗廟授二貴人印綬。甲子，詣魏公宮延秋門，迎貴人升車。魏遣郎中令、少府、博士、御府乘黃廄令、丞相掾屬侍送貴人。癸酉，二貴人至洧倉中，遣侍中丹將冗從虎賁前後駱驛往迎之。乙亥，二貴人入宮，御史大夫、中二千石將大夫、議郎會殿中，魏國二卿及侍中、中郎二人，與漢公卿並升殿宴。







Third Moon [214 Mar 29 – Apr 26], Heaven’s Son had the Duke of Wèi ranked above the vassal Marquesses and Kings, changed the conferment to Gold Ruler’s Seal and Red Cord, Distant Travels Cap. [95]



三月，天子使魏公位在諸侯王上，改授金璽，赤紱、遠遊冠〔一〕。










[95] Xiān-dì Qǐjū zhù states: Sent Left Central Cadet General Yáng Xuān and precinct Marquess Péi Mào Holding Stave and Seal to confer them.



〔一〕　獻帝起居注曰：使左中郎將楊宣亭侯裴茂持節、印授之。







Autumn, Seventh Moon [214 Aug 23 – Sep 21], the Duke campaigned against Sūn Quán. [96]



秋七月，公征孫權。〔一〕










[96] Jiǔzhōu Chūnqiū states: Advisor to the Army Fù Gàn remonstrated saying: “The greatest tools for governing Heaven’s Under are two: the Civil and the Martial. In using the Martial then prioritize power, in using the Civil then prioritize virtue. When power and virtue are sufficient to support one another, only afterward is the Ruler’s Way fulfilled. Previously Heaven’s Under was in great chaos, above and below lost their order, Your Enlightened Excellency employed the Martial to suppress it, out of ten pacifying nine. Now those not yet serving the ruler’s commands are Wú and Shǔ. Wú has the barrier of the Cháng Jiāng, Shǔ has the obstructions of the lofty mountains, difficult to subdue with power, easy to embrace with virtue. I humbly believe it possible to temporarily shelve armor and store weapons, rest the army and nurture the servicemen, divide land and determine fiefs, discuss achievements and enact rewards. If this is done then the hearts inside and outside are stabilized, those with achievements are encouraged, and then Heaven’s Under will understand regulation. Then afterward gradually raise learning and schools, to guide their good natures and expand their righteous integrity. Your Excellency’s divine Martial ability shakes the Four Seas, if you cultivate the Civil to aid it, then of all that are Under the Heavens, none will think to not submit. Now you raise multitudes of a hundred thousand, arranging them on the shores of the Cháng Jiāng, if the rebels rely on terrain to hide in the depths, then the servicemen and horses will not be able to display their abilities, the special and adaptive [strategies] will have no way to employ their effects, and then great power would be weakened and the enemy hearts would be unable to be subdued. May Your Enlightened Excellency ponder the meaning of Yú Shùn’s dance with shield and ax, preserve power and nurture virtue, and by principle establish victory.” The Duke did not listen, the army therefore was without achievements. [Fù] Gān appellation Yàncái was a Běidì man, ended as Assistant Chancellor’s Granary Department Associate, had a son named [Fù] Xuán.



〔一〕　九州春秋曰：參軍傅幹諫曰：「治天下之大具有二，文與武也；用武則先威，用文則先德，威德足以相濟，而後王道備矣。往者天下大亂，上下失序，明公用武攘之，十平其九。今未承王命者，吳與蜀也，吳有長江之險，蜀有崇山之阻，難以威服，易以德懷。愚以為可且按甲寢兵，息軍養士，分土定封，論功行賞，若此則內外之心固，有功者勸，而天下知制矣。然後漸興學校，以導其善性而長其義節。公神武震於四海，若脩文以濟之，則普天之下，無思不服矣。今舉十萬之眾，頓之長江之濱，若賊負固深藏，則士馬不能逞其能，奇變無所用其權，則大威有屈而敵心未能服矣。唯明公思虞舜舞干戚之義，全威養德，以道制勝。」公不從，軍遂無功。幹字彥材，北地人，終於丞相倉曹屬。有子曰玄。







Previously, Lǒngxī’s Sòng Jiàn declared himself Héshǒu Píng-Hàn King, gathered multitudes at Fūhǎn, changed Inaugurals, installed a Hundred Officials, for over thirty years. Sent Xiàhóu Yuān from Xīngguó to suppress him. Winter, Tenth Moon [214 Nov 20 – Dec 19], slaughtered Fūhǎn, beheaded [Sòng] Jiàn, Liáng Province was pacified.



初，隴西宋建自稱河首平漢王，聚眾枹罕，改元，置百官，三十餘年。遣夏侯淵自興國討之。冬十月，屠枹罕，斬建，涼州平。




The Duke from Héféi returned.



公自合肥還。




Eleventh Moon [214 Dec 20 – 215 Jan 17], Hàn Imperial Empress Fú-shì was connected to previously sending a letter to her father, the former Garrison Cavalry Colonel [Fú] Wán, saying that the Emperor, because Dǒng Chéng had been executed, blamed and resented the Duke, the words extremely harsh and foul. Discovered, the Empress was deposed and died, her brothers all submitted to execution. [97]



十一月，漢皇后伏氏坐昔與父故屯騎校尉完書，云帝以董承被誅怨恨公，辭甚醜惡，發聞，后廢黜死，兄弟皆伏法。〔一〕










[97] Cáo Mán zhuàn states: The Duke sent Huà Xīn to lead soldiers to enter the Palace to arrest the Empress. The Empress obstructed the doors and hide in the walls. [Huà] Xīn broke down the doors and opened the walls and dragged the Empress out. The Emperor at the time was seated with Censorate Grandee Chī Lǜ. The Empress with disheveled hair and walking barefooted passed and grasped the Emperor’s hand saying: “Can you not again save my life?” The Emperor said: “I also do not know my own fate will be at what time.” The Emperor said to [Chī] Lǜ: “Excellency Chī, Under Heaven how can there be such a thing?” Therefore led away the Empress and killed her, of [Fú] Wán with his clansmen the dead were several hundred people.



〔一〕　曹瞞傳曰：公遣華歆勒兵入宮收后，后閉戶匿壁中。歆壞戶發壁，牽后出。帝時與御史大夫郗慮坐，后被髮徒跣過，執帝手曰：「不能復相活邪？」帝曰：「我亦不自知命在何時也。」帝謂慮曰：「郗公，天下寧有是邪！」遂將后殺之，完及宗族死者數百人。







Twelfth Moon [215 Jan 18 – Feb 16], the Duke reached Mèngjīn. Heaven’s Son mandated the Duke set Banner Heads, Palace Halls establish Bells and Stands. Yǐwèi [215 Feb 5], Order said: “Servicemen of good conduct are not necessarily able to advance and succeed, servicemen of advancement and success are not necessarily able to have good conduct. Did Chén Píng act with sincerity? Did Sū Qín keep faith? Yet Chén Píng settled Hàn’s enterprise, Sū Qín rescued a weak Yān. By this discussing it, [even if a] serviceman has particular shortcomings, how can he be discarded? If the relevant managers understand and ponder this principle, then servicemen will not be overlooked, and offices will have no unfulfilled duties.” It also said: “Punishment is about the lives of the Hundred Surnames, but if inside the army of those managing imprisonment some are not the right people, and yet are appointed in the matters of death or life for the Three Armies, I am extremely fearful of this. Thus select those of enlightened understanding in law and judgment, to employ them in managing punishments.” Therefore installed Judgment Department Assistant and Associate.



十二月，公至孟津。天子命公置旄頭，宮殿設鍾虡。乙未，令曰：「夫有行之士未必能進取，進取之士未必能有行也。陳平豈篤行，蘇秦豈守信邪？而陳平定漢業，蘇秦濟弱燕。由此言之，士有偏短，庸可廢乎！有司明思此義，則士無遺滯，官無廢業矣。」又曰：「夫刑，百姓之命也，而軍中典獄者或非其人，而任以三軍死生之事，吾甚懼之。其選明達法理者，使持典刑。」於是置理曹掾屬。




Twentieth Year, Spring, Standard Moon [215 Feb 17 – Mar 17], Heaven’s Son established the Duke’s middle daughter as Imperial Empress. Abolished Yúnzhōng, Dìngxiāng, Wǔyuán, Shuòfāng prefectures, for each prefecture installed one county to govern its people, united to form Xīnxīng prefecture.



二十年春正月，天子立公中女為皇后。省雲中、定襄、五原、朔方郡，郡置一縣領其民，合以為新興郡。




Third Moon [215 Apr 17 – May 15], the Duke campaigned west against Zhāng Lǔ, reached Chéncāng, about to from Wǔdū enter the Dī. The Dī peoples blocked the roads. First sent Zhāng Hé and Zhū Líng and others to attack and defeated them. Summer, Fourth Moon [215 May 16 – Jun 14], the Duke from Chéncāng set out Sǎn Pass, reached Héchí. Dī King Dòumào’s multitudes of over ten thousand people relied on the terrain to not submit. Fifth Moon [215 Jun 15 – Jul 13], the Duke attacked and slaughtered them. Xīpíng’s and Jīnchéng’s various officers Qū Yǎn, Jiǎng Shí, and others together cut off and sent Hán Suì’s head. [98] Autumn, Seventh Moon [215 Aug 13 – Sep 10], the Duke reached Yángpíng. Zhāng Lǔ sent his younger brother [Zhāng] Wèi with his officer Yáng Áng to occupy Yángpíng Pass, along the mountains building fortifications for over ten lǐ. Attacked them, could not capture them, and so led the army back. The rebels saw the main army had retreated, their defense preparations loosened and scattered. The Duke then secretly sent Xiè Biāo, Gāo Zuò, and others to climb over the terrain in a night attack, greatly defeated them, beheaded their officer Yáng Rèn, advanced to attack [Zhāng] Wèi, [Zhāng] Wèi and the rest in the night escaped, [Zhāng] Lǔ fled to Bāzhōng. The Duke’s army entered Nánzhèng, completely captured [Zhāng] Lǔ’s offices and storehouses and treasures. [99] Bā and Hàn[zhōng] all surrendered. Reverted Hànníng prefecture to Hànzhōng, divided Hànzhōng’s Ānyáng and Xīchéng to form Xīchéng prefecture, installing an Administrator. Divided out Xī and Shàngyōng prefectures, installing Commandants.



三月，公西征張魯，至陳倉，將自武都入氐；氐人塞道，先遣張郃、朱靈等攻破之。夏四月，公自陳倉以出散關，至河池。氐王竇茂眾萬餘人，恃險不服，五月，公攻屠之。西平、金城諸將麴演、蔣石等共斬送韓遂首。〔一〕秋七月，公至陽平。張魯使弟衛與將楊昂等據陽平關，橫山築城十餘里，攻之不能拔，乃引軍還。賊見大軍退，其守備解散。公乃密遣解〈忄剽〉、高祚等乘險夜襲，大破之，斬其將楊任，進攻衛，衛等夜遁，魯潰奔巴中。公軍入南鄭，盡得魯府庫珍寶。〔二〕巴、漢皆降。復漢寧郡為漢中；分漢中之安陽、西城為西城郡，置太守；分錫、上庸郡，置都尉。










[98] Diǎnlüè states: [Hán] Suì appellation Wényuē, originally with his same prefecture’s Biān Zhāng both were famed in the western provinces. [Biān] Zhāng became Commanding Army Following Official, [Hán] Suì presented accounts to visit the capital, Hé Jìn had formerly heard of his reputation, and specially met with him. [Hán] Suì advised [Hé] Jìn to execute all the castrates, [Hé] Jìn did not listen, and so [Hán Suì] requested to return home. It happened that Liáng Province’s Sòng Yáng and Běigōng Yù and others rebelled, elected [Biān] Zhāng and [Hán] Suì as their leaders. [Biān] Zhāng soon died of illness, [Hán] Suì was seized by [Sòng] Yáng and the rest, had no choice. [Hán] Suì relied on troops to make chaos, altogether for thirty-two years, reaching to this then he died, his years were over seventy.
Liú Ài’s Líng-dì jì states: [Biān] Zhāng had another name [Biān] Yǔn.



〔一〕　典略曰：遂字文約，始與同郡邊章俱著名西州。章為督軍從事。遂奉計詣京師，何進宿聞其名，特與相見，遂說進使誅諸閹人，進不從，乃求歸。會涼州宋揚、北宮玉等反，舉章、遂為主，章尋病卒，遂為揚等所劫，不得已，遂阻兵為亂，積三十二年，至是乃死，年七十餘矣。劉艾靈帝紀曰：章，一名（元）〔允〕。













[99] Wèi shū states: The army from Wǔdū crossed mountains for a thousand lǐ, climbing up and down difficult terrain, the army men fatigued and suffering. The Duke therefore held a great feast, none did not forget their fatigue.



〔二〕　魏書曰：軍自武都山行千里，升降險阻，軍人勞苦；公於是大饗，莫不忘其勞。







Eighth Moon [215 Sep 11 – Oct 10], Sūn Quán besieged Héféi. Zhāng Liáo and Lǐ Diǎn struck and defeated him.



八月，孫權圍合肥，張遼、李典擊破之。




Ninth Moon [215 Oct 11 – Nov 8], Bā’s Seven Surnames of Yí King Pǔ Hú and Cóngyì Marquess Dù Huò led Bā’s Yí and Cóng peoples to come submit, [100] therefore divided Bā prefecture, with [Pǔ] Hú as Bādōng Prefecture Administrator, [Dù] Huò as Bāxī Prefecture Administrator, both enfeoffed as Ranked Marquesses. Heaven’s Son mandated that the Duke undertake regulations to enfeoff and appoint various Marquesses and Administrators and Chancellors. [101]



九月，巴七姓夷王朴胡、賨邑侯杜濩舉巴夷、賨民來附，〔一〕於是分巴郡，以胡為巴東太守，濩為巴西太守，皆封列侯。天子命公承制封拜諸侯守相。〔二〕










[100] Sūn Shèng states: Pǔ pronounced Fú. Huò pronounced Hù.



〔一〕　孫盛曰：朴音浮。濩音戶。













[101] Kǒng Yǎn’s Hàn Wèi Chūnqiū states: Heaven’s Son, because the Duke managed appointments in the exterior, and in overseeing matters of rewards, sometimes it was appropriate to be quick, thus mandated that the Duke be able to undertake regulations to enfeoff and appoint various Marquesses and Administrators and Chancellors. The Edict said: “The greatest matters of the army are in rewards and punishments, to encourage good and discourage evil, it is appropriate to not waste time. Therefore, that the Sīmǎ Fǎ states: ‘Rewards are not to take more than a day,’ is to wish the people to quickly see the benefits of doing good. In the past at the Internal Restoration, Dèng Yǔ entered the Passes and undertook regulations to appoint Army Libationer Lǐ Wén as Hédōng Administrator, Lái Shè also undertook regulations to appoint Gāo Jùn as Connecting Roads General. Investigating their biographies, both did not first request permission; it is clear that while facing the affairs they carved the seals. This then was Shìzǔ’s divine brilliance, expediently implementing increases or decreases, overall employing fast demonstrations of power and acceptance, and so established his great achievement. Thus in the principles of the Chūnqiū, grandees sent out to the borders have situations of taking command, only to benefit the State Altars and secure the country and nothing more. Moreover, you maintain the appointment of the Two Governors, Preceptor and Intendant over the Nine Possessions, truly campaigning Yí and Xià, army traveling beyond the vassal outskirts, losses and gains are decided in instants. Halting rewards to wait for Edict is to hinder worldly affairs, assuredly not what We intend. From now afterward, in facing affairs of evaluation, for those that should be applied with favor and title, then at once carve seals and lend conferment, to enable all the loyal and righteous to obtain immediate rewards and to not have doubts.”



〔二〕　孔衍漢魏春秋曰：天子以公典任於外，臨事之賞，或宜速疾，乃命公得承制封拜諸侯守相，詔曰：「夫軍之大事，在茲賞罰，勸善懲惡，宜不旋時，故司馬法曰『賞不逾日』者，欲民速睹為善之利也。昔在中興，鄧禹入關，承制拜軍祭酒李文為河東太守，來歙又承制拜高峻為通路將軍，察其本傳，皆非先請，明臨事刻印也，斯則世祖神明，權達損益，蓋所用速示威懷而著鴻勳也。其春秋之義，大夫出疆，有專命之事，苟所以利社稷安國家而已。況君秉任二伯，師尹九有，實征夷夏，軍行藩甸之外，失得在於斯須之間，停賞俟詔以滯世務，固非朕之所圖也。自今已後，臨事所甄，當加寵號者，其便刻印章假授，咸使忠義得相獎勵，勿有疑焉。」







Winter, Tenth Moon [215 Nov 9 – Dec 8], first installed Nominal Marquess reaching to Fifth Grandee, with the old Ranked Marquess and Within the Passes Marquess altogether six ranks, to reward army achievements. [102]



冬十月，始置名號侯至五大夫，與舊列侯、關內侯凡六等，以賞軍功。〔一〕










[102] Wèi shū states: Installed Nominal Marquess title as the eighteenth level, Inside the Passes Marquess title as the seventeenth level, all gold seals and purple ribbons; also installed Within the Passes Outer Marquess as the sixteenth level, bronze seal with turtle fastening and black ribbon, Fifth Grandee as the fifteenth level, bronze seal with ring fastening, also black ribbon, all with no income, with the old Ranked Marquess and Within the Passes Marquess altogether six ranks.
Your Servant Sōngzhī believes: The ‘empty enfeoffments’ of the present probably began from this.



〔一〕　魏書曰：置名號侯爵十八級，關中侯爵十七級，皆金印紫綬；又置關內外侯十六級，銅印龜紐墨綬；五大夫十五級，銅印環紐，亦墨綬，皆不食租，與舊列侯關內侯凡六等。臣松之以為今之虛封蓋自此始。







Eleventh Moon [215 Dec 9 – 216 Jan 6], [Zhāng] Lǔ from Bāzhōng led his remnant multitudes to surrender. Enfeoffed [Zhāng] Lǔ and his five sons all as Ranked Marquesses. Liú Bèi had attacked [Liú] Zhāng and seized Yì Province, and therefore occupied Bāzhōng. Sent Zhāng Hé to strike him.



十一月，魯自巴中將其餘眾降。封魯及五子皆為列侯。劉備襲劉璋，取益州，遂據巴中；遣張郃擊之。




Twelfth Moon [216 Jan 7 – Feb 5], the Duke from Nánzhèng returned, leaving Xiàhóu Yuān to garrison Hànzhōng. [103]



十二月，公自南鄭還，留夏侯淵屯漢中。〔一〕










[103] During the journey, Attendant Central Wáng Càn composed a five-character ode to praise the services, stating: > Following the army has sufferings or joys > Merely ask who is being followed > If the followed is divine and martial > How can the brigades be toiled for long? > The Chancellor and Duke campaigned right of the Passes > Awe-inspiring fury shaking with Heavenly power > In one move exterminated the Xūn caitiffs, > A second move subdued the Qiāng and Yí > To the west captured the borderland bandits > As suddenly as stooping for a dropped item > Exhibiting rewards higher than mountain peaks > Liquor and meat surpassing rivers and islands > In the army many exuberant and full > Men and horses overflowingly muscular > Those that walked going out in carriages return > Those with nothing setting out have abundance of wealth > Expanding land three thousand lǐ > Going and returning as fast as flying > Singing and dancing entering Yè city > What was desired obtained without omission



〔一〕　是行也，侍中王粲作五言詩以美其事曰：「從軍有苦樂，但問所從誰。所從神且武，安得久勞師？相公征關右，赫怒振天威，一舉滅獯虜，再舉服羌夷，西收邊地賊，忽若俯拾遺。陳賞越山嶽，酒肉踰川坻，軍中多饒飫，人馬皆溢肥，徒行兼乘還，空出有餘資。拓土三千里，往反速如飛，歌舞入鄴城，所願獲無違。」

title: 1  Annals of Emperor Wǔ
text:
Jiàn’ān 21 - 24 (216 - 219)


Twenty-First Year, Spring, Second Moon [216 Mar 7 – Apr 4], the Duke returned to Yè. [104] Third Moon [216 Apr 5 – May 4], Rényín [216 Apr 7], the Duke personally plowed the Register Field. [105] Summer, Fifth Moon [216 Jun 3 – Jul 2], Heaven’s Son advanced the Duke’s noble rank to King of Wèi. [106] Dài Prefecture’s Wūhuán Acting Chányú Pǔfùlú with his marquesses and kings came to Court. Heaven’s Son mandated that the King’s daughters be princesses, income from Tāngmùyì. [107] Autumn, Seventh Moon [216 Aug 1 – Aug 30], the Xiōngnú Southern Chányú Hūchúquán led his named kings to come to Court, cared for with rituals for a guest, and therefore remained in Wèi, having the Right Worthy King Qùbēi supervise their state. Eighth Moon [216 Aug 31 – Sep 28], Minister Judge Zhōng Yáo became Chancellor of State.



二十一年春二月，公還鄴。〔一〕三月壬寅，公親耕籍田。〔二〕夏五月，天子進公爵為魏王。〔三〕代郡烏丸行單于普富盧與其侯王來朝。天子命王女為公主，食湯沐邑。秋七月，匈奴南單于呼廚泉將其名王來朝，待以客禮，遂留魏，使右賢王去卑監其國。八月，以大理鍾繇為相國。〔四〕










[104] Wèi shū states: Xīnwèi [216 Mar 7], relevant managers with Grand Offering reported the arrival, tallied the achievements at the Temple. Jiǎwǔ [216 Mar 30], first Spring Sacrifices, the Order said: “Commentators believe that at the Sacrificial Temple in ascending the Hall one should remove shoes. I accepted Bestowment mandate to wear sword and not remove shoes when ascending Halls. Now in services in the Temple removing shoes is to honor my ancestors but disregard the Ruler’s mandate, venerate father and grandfather but disparage lord and ruler, and therefore I do not dare remove shoes in ascending the Hall. Also, [they say] at the cleansing for the sacrifices, the hands touch the water but do not wash. Washing is to by cleanliness show veneration, and one has never heard of a ritual of touching but not washing. Moreover, ‘sacrifice to the spirits as if the spirits are present.’ Therefore I will personally accept the water and wash. Also, [they say] when the rituals of communing with the spirits finishes, descend the steps to the curtains and stand, waiting for the performance of the music to complete. This is to appear to not please the illustrious ancestors, laggard in sacrifices and rushing to finish. Therefore I will sit and wait for the music to complete, send off the spirit, and then rise. Accepting the sacrificial meat and storing it in sleeve, to give the Attendant Central, this is to not be thorough to the end in veneration and respect. The ancients personally handled the sacrificial matters; therefore I will personally store it in sleeve, carry it to the end, and return. Zhòngní said: ‘Though it opposes the majority, I continue below.’ How true those words!”



〔一〕　魏書曰：辛未，有司以太牢告至，策勳于廟，甲午始春祠，令曰：「議者以為祠廟上殿當解履。吾受錫命，帶劍不解履上殿。今有事於廟而解履，是尊先公而替王命，敬父祖而簡君主，故吾不敢解履上殿也。又臨祭就洗，以手擬水而不盥。夫盥以潔為敬，未聞擬（向）〔而〕不盥之禮，且『祭神如神在』，故吾親受水而盥也。又降神禮訖，下階就幕而立，須奏樂畢竟，似若不（愆）〔衎〕烈祖，遲祭（不）速訖也，故吾坐俟樂闋送神乃起也。受胙納（神）〔袖〕，以授侍中，此為敬恭不終實也，古者親執祭事，故吾親納于（神）〔袖〕，終抱而歸也。仲尼曰『雖違眾，吾從下』，誠哉斯言也。」













[105] Wèi shū states: Relevant managers memorialized: “In the four seasons there is instructing warfare during the breaks in agriculture. Hàn continued Qín’s systems, for three seasons not instructing, only in the Tenth Moon at the capital inspecting chariots and horses, visiting Cháng River South Gate, gathering the Five Regiments servicemen in the Eight Formations advancing and withdrawing, naming it as ‘Deploying Them.’ Now metal and leather have not yet been set down, servicemen and civilians are always training, from now on afterward we can do without four seasons of instructing warfare, only at the Start of Autumn select an auspicious day to greatly convene the chariots and cavalry, called as ‘Drilling Troops,’ above according with ritual names, below continuing Hàn’s systems.” Memorial approved.



〔二〕　魏書曰：有司奏：「四時講武於農隙。漢承秦制，三時不講，唯十月都試車馬，幸長水南門，會五營士為八陳進退，名曰乘之。今金革未偃，士民素習，自今已後，可無四時講武，但以立秋擇吉日大朝車騎，號曰治兵，上合禮名，下承漢制。」奏可。













[106] Xiàn-dì zhuàn records the Edict stating: “From antiquity, of the Emperors and Kings, although the titles changed from one another, the noble ranks not the same, as for commending and esteeming foundational merits, establishing achievements and virtues, glorifying clans and surnames, bequeathing to sons and grandsons, for the differently surnamed compared with for kin, how are there differences? In the past my sagely ancestor received the Mandate, started the enterprise and began the foundations, established our regions of Xià, reflected on ancient and modern systems, understood the differences in noble ranks, used all the mountains and rivers as enfeoffments to set vassal screens, and had the differently surnamed and close relatives both arrayed in lands, occupying states as kings, by this protected and governed Heaven’s Mandate, secured firmly for myriad successions, passing through generations in continued peace, servant and master without problems. In Shìzǔ’s Internal Restoration then at times there were difficulties and ease, and therefore after years of several hundreds, there were no differently surnamed vassal lords ranked as kings. As We are not virtuous but inherited a vast enterprise, encountered the lands divided and collapsed, crowds of the vicious unleashed cruelty, from the west reaching the east, suffering and impoverished. At this interval, I only feared drowning in the troubles and so shaming the sagely virtue of the former Emperors. Relying on the spirits of the August Heavens, they allowed you to maintain righteousness and exert yourself, shaking quickly your divine martial power, shielding Us from disaster and trouble, winning protection for the Ancestral Temples. Huáxià’s remnant peoples, all that draw breath, none are not immersed in it. Your diligence surpasses Jì and Yǔ, loyalty comparable to Yī [Yǐn] and Zhōu [gōng], but conceal it with modest deference, maintain it with all the more reverence, and therefore formerly in the first founding of Wèi State, bestowing you with land, I feared you would oppose the command, worried of your firm refusals, and therefore temporarily held back will and subdued intentions, enfeoffing you as Highest Duke, wishing to venerate and follow high righteousness, to wait for distinguished achievements. Hán Suì and Sòng Jiàn to the south joined with Bā-Shǔ, crowds of rebels joining and following, plotting to endanger the State Altars, you again commanded the officers, dragon rising and tiger pouncing, beheaded their leaders, slaughtered their caves and perches. Reaching to the western campaign, at the battle of Yángpíng, you personally wore armor and helmet, deeply penetrated difficult terrain, cut down and razed the vermin rebels, exterminated their vicious and evil, cleansed and settled the western frontier, hanging banners ten thousand lǐ, sounds of instructions distantly shaking, pacifying our regions of Xià. Overall in the flourishing of Táng and Yú, the three lords planted achievements, in the rise of Wén and Wǔ, Dàn and Shì were the supporters, in the Two Zǔ achieving the enterprise, the outstanding and heroic assisted the mandate. The sagely and wise lord takes on matters as his own responsibility, but yet bestows land and applies commendations to repay accomplished ministers. How can it be that We of scant virtues relied on you for relief and yet the reward standards are not abundant, how can it answer the divinities and deities and comfort the myriad quarters? Now advance your noble rank to King of Wèi, send Envoy Holding Stave Acting as Censorate Grandee the Minister of the Clan Liú Ài to present the conferment and Ruler’s Seal, dark earth for altar, bundled in white reeds, Metal Tiger Tallies rank one to rank five, Bamboo Envoy Tallies rank one to ten. You are thus a true King’s rank, as Assistant Chancellor and designate Jì Province Governor as before. Thus send up your Duke of Wèi’s Seal and Ribbon and tallies and documents. Respectfully obey Our command, select and give relief to your multitudes, achieve and pacify many accomplishments, to raise up our ancestor’s glorious Mandate.” The King of Wèi sent up letters thrice declining, Edict thrice replied denying permission. Also hand wrote Edict that said: “Great sages take achievements and virtue as high beauty, take loyalty and harmony as canon teachings, therefore in initiating the enterprise and bequeathing reputation they allowed a hundred generations able to imitate, in acting by principle and governing by righteousness they allowed diligent action able to be emulated, and so their achievements and exploits were without limits, their glorious radiance dense and outstanding. Jì and Xiè conveyed the acute brilliance of the leading head, Zhōu and Shào continued the wise employments of Wén and Wǔ. Although they managed the various offices, looking up to sigh and looking down to think, how can they compare to you? We ponder the achievements of the ancients, beautiful to that extent, think of your loyal and diligent accomplishments, flourishing to this extent, and so every time when about to engrave tallies and split tokens, lay out ritual mandate conferment, awake or asleep sighing thus, myself forgetting my lack of virtue to maintain culture. Now you again disobey Our command, firmly declining with sincerity, this is not how to serve Our heart and instruct later generations. Thus restrain your will and reduce your integrity, do not again firmly decline.”
Sìtǐ Shūshì xù states: Liáng Hú appointed the Excellency as North Division Commandant.
Cáo Mán zhuàn states: He was by Secretariat Writers Right Deputy Sīmǎ Jiàn’gōng nominated. When the Excellency became King, he summoned Jiàn’gōng to Yè, with him happily drank, and said to Jiàn’gōng: “Today could I still be a Commandant or not?” Jiàn’gōng said: “In the past at the time I nominated you Great King, you were only suitable to be a Commandant.” The King greatly laughed.
Jiàn’gōng was named Fáng, Sīmǎ Xuān-wáng’s father.
Your Servant Sōngzhī notes: According to Sīmǎ Biāo’s Xùzhuàn, [Sīmǎ Fáng] Jiàn’gōng was not Right Deputy, so one suspects this is not correct, but Wáng Yǐn’s Jìn shū says that when the King of Zhào [Sīmǎ Lún] usurped the throne, he wished to honor his grandfather [Sīmǎ Fáng] as Emperor, and Academic Scholar Mǎ Píng commented claiming that “the Jīngzhào Office Lord in the past nominated Wèi Wǔ-dì as North Division Commandant, bandits did not violate the borders,” so by this then there is some evidence.



〔三〕　獻帝傳載詔曰：「自古帝王，雖號稱相變，爵等不同，至乎褒崇元勳，建立功德，光啟氏姓，延於子孫，庶姓之與親，豈有殊焉。昔我聖祖受命，創業肇基，造我區夏，鑒古今之制，通爵等之差，盡封山川以立藩屏，使異姓親戚，並列土地，據國而王，所以保乂天命，安固萬嗣。歷世承平，臣主無事。世祖中興而時有難易，是以曠年數百，無異姓諸侯王之位。朕以不德，繼序弘業，遭率土分崩，群兇縱毒，自西徂東，辛苦卑約。當此之際，唯恐溺入于難，以羞先帝之聖德。賴皇天之靈，俾君秉義奮身，震迅神武，捍朕于艱難，獲保宗廟，華夏遺民，含氣之倫，莫不蒙焉。君勤過稷、禹，忠侔伊、周，而掩之以謙讓，守之以彌恭，是以往者初開魏國，錫君土宇，懼君之違命，慮君之固辭，故且懷志屈意，封君為上公，欲以欽順高義，須俟勳績。韓遂、宋建，南結巴、蜀，群逆合從，圖危社稷，君復命將，龍驤虎奮，梟其元首，屠其窟栖。暨至西征，陽平之役，親擐甲冑，深入險阻，芟夷蝥賊，殄其兇醜，盪定西陲，懸旌萬里，聲教遠振，寧我區夏。蓋唐、虞之盛，三后樹功，文、武之興，旦、奭作輔，二祖成業，英豪佐命；夫以聖哲之君，事為己任，猶錫土班瑞以報功臣，豈有如朕寡德，仗君以濟，而賞典不豐，將何以答神祇慰萬方哉？今進君爵為魏王，使使持節行御史大夫、宗正劉艾奉策璽玄土之社，苴以白茅，金虎符第一至第五，竹使符第一至十。君其正王位，以丞相領冀州牧如故。其上魏公璽綬符冊。敬服朕命，簡恤爾眾，克綏庶績，以揚我祖宗之休命。」魏王上書三辭，詔三報不許。又手詔曰：「大聖以功德為高美，以忠和為典訓，故創業垂名，使百世可希，行道制義，使力行可效，是以勳烈無窮，休光茂著。稷、契載元首之聰明，周、邵因文、武之智用，雖經營庶官，仰歎俯思，其對豈有若君者哉？朕惟古人之功，美之如彼，思君忠勤之績，茂之如此，是以每將鏤符析瑞，陳禮命冊，寤寐慨然，自忘守文之不德焉。今君重違朕命，固辭懇切，非所以稱朕心而訓後世也。其抑志撙節，勿復固辭。」四體書勢序曰：梁鵠以公為北部尉。曹瞞傳曰：為尚書右丞司馬建公所舉。及公為王，召建公到鄴，與歡飲，謂建公曰：「孤今日可復作尉否？」建公曰：「昔舉大王時，適可作尉耳。」王大笑。建公名防，司馬宣王之父。臣松之案司馬彪序傳，建公不為右丞，疑此不然，而王隱晉書云趙王篡位，欲尊祖為帝，博士馬平議稱京兆府君昔舉魏武帝為北部尉，賊不犯界，如此則為有徵。













[107] Wèi shū states: First installed Minister of Presentations and Minister of the Clan offices.



〔四〕　魏書曰：始置奉常宗正官。







Winter, Tenth Moon [216 Oct 29 – Nov 26], Drilled Troops, [108] therefore campaigned against Sūn Quán. Eleventh Moon [216 Nov 27 – Dec 26], reached Qiáo.



冬十月，治兵，〔一〕遂征孫權，十一月至譙。










[108] Wèi shū states: The King personally beat the metal and drums to order the advances and withdrawals.



〔一〕　魏書曰：王親執金鼓以令進退。







Twenty-Second Year, Spring, Standard Moon [217 Jan 25 – Feb 23], the King’s army at Jūcháo, Second Moon [217 Feb 24 – Mar 24], advanced the army to garrison the Jiāng’s west’s Hǎoxī. [Sūn] Quán at Rúxūkǒu built fortifications to resist and defend, therefore pressured and attacked him, [Sūn] Quán retreated and fled. Third Moon [217 Mar 25 – Apr 23], the King led the army to return, left Xiàhóu Dūn, Cáo Rén, Zhāng Liáo, and others to garrison Jūcháo.



二十二年春正月，王軍居巢，二月，進軍屯江西郝谿。權在濡須口築城拒守，遂逼攻之，權退走。三月，王引軍還，留夏侯惇、曹仁、張遼等屯居巢。




Summer, Fourth Moon [217 May 24 – Jun 21], Heaven’s Son mandated that the King set up the flags and banners of Heaven’s Son, in going out and in to order to clear the streets. Fifth Moon [217 Jun 21 – Jul 21], built Pàn’gōng. Sixth Moon [217 Jul 22 – Aug 19], appointed Army Preceptor Huà Xīn as Censorate Grandee. [109] Winter, Tenth Moon [217 Nov 17 – Dec 15], Heaven’s Son mandated that the King wear cap of ten and two tassels, ride Gold Root chariot drawn by Six Horses, set Five Seasons Escort Carriages. Appointed Five Office Central Cadet General [Cáo] Pī as Wèi Heir-Apparent.



夏四月，天子命王設天子旌旗，出入稱警蹕。五月，作泮宮。六月，以軍師華歆為御史大夫。〔一〕冬十月，天子命王冕十有二旒，乘金根車，駕六馬，設五時副車，以五官中郎將丕為魏太子。










[109] Wèi shū states: First installed the Minister of the Guard office. Autumn, Eighth Moon [217 Sep 19 – Oct 17], Order said: “In the past Yī Zhì, Fù Yuè came from among the poor people, Guǎn Zhòng was Duke Huán’s enemy, all were employed to bring prosperity. Xiāo Hé, Cáo Cān were county clerks, Hán [Xìn], Chén Píng carried dirtied and disgraced names, had the shame of being met with ridicule, but in the end were able to achieve the ruler’s enterprise, reputation known for a thousand years. Wú Qǐ was a rapacious officer, killed his wife to prove himself, spent gold to seek office, when his mother died he did not return home; however, when he was at Wèi, the Qín people did not dare head east, and when he was at Chǔ then the Three Jìn did not dare plot south. Now Under Heaven are there no people of utmost virtue stranded among the civilians, as well as the resolute and valorous who do not look back when facing the enemy and fiercely battling? Or common civil clerks, high in talent and strange in character, perhaps able to be officers and administrators? Carrying dirtied and disgraced names, meeting with ridicule for conduct, perhaps not benevolent or not filial but yet have the skills to govern state or employ soldiers? Thus each are to nominate those they know, and do not have omissions.”



〔一〕　魏書曰：初置衛尉官。秋八月，令曰：「昔伊摯、傅說出於賤人，管仲，桓公賊也，皆用之以興。蕭何、曹參，縣吏也，韓、陳平負汙辱之名，有見笑之恥，卒能成就王業，聲著千載。吳起貪將，殺妻自信，散金求官，母死不歸，然在魏，奏人不敢東向，在楚則三晉不敢南謀。今天下得無有至德之人放在民間，及果勇不顧，臨敵力戰；若文俗之吏，高才異質，或堪為將守；負汙辱之名，見笑之行，或不仁不孝而有治國用兵之術：其各舉所知，勿有所遺。」







Liú Bèi sent Zhāng Fēi, Mǎ Chāo, Wú Lán, and others to garrison Xiàbiàn. Sent Cáo Hóng to resist them.



劉備遣張飛、馬超、吳蘭等屯下辯；遣曹洪拒之。




Twenty-Third Year, Spring, Standard Moon [218 Feb 13 – Mar 14], Hàn Grand Physician Director Jí Běn with Minister Treasurer Gěng Jì and Manager of Standards Wéi Huǎng and others rebelled, attacked Xǔ, burned Assistant Chancellor’s Chief Scribe Wáng Bì’s barracks. [110] [Wáng] Bì with Yǐngchuān Managing Agriculture Central Cadet-General Yán Kuāng suppressed and beheaded them. [111]



二十三年春正月，漢太醫令吉本與少府耿紀、司直韋晃等反，攻許，燒丞相長史王必營，〔一〕必與潁川典農中郎將嚴匡討斬之〔二〕。










[110] Wèi Wǔ Gùshì records an Order stating: “Designate Chief Scribe Wáng Bì was my clerk from the time I was chopping thistles and thorns, loyal and capable and diligent in matters, heart like iron and stone, the state’s excellent clerk. The misstep of not recruiting him for a long time, was abandoning a fine stallion and not riding it; why hurriedly and anxiously again seek another? Therefore instruct to recruit him, having already arranged an appropriate position, and have him as Designate Chief Scribe manage matters as before.”



〔一〕　魏武故事載令曰：「領長史王必，是吾披荊棘時吏也。忠能勤事，心如鐵石，國之良吏也。蹉跌久未辟之，捨騏驥而弗乘，焉遑遑而更求哉？故教辟之，已署所宜，便以領長史統事如故。」













[111] Sānfǔ Juélù zhù states: At the time there was Jīngzhào’s Jīn Yī appellation Déyī, himself believed [his family] for generations had been Hàn ministers, from since [Jīn] Mìdī had suppressed Mǎng Héluó, loyalty and sincerity demonstrably shown, reputation and integrity for accumulated ages. Observing that Hàn’s blessings were about to be removed, he said there could be third rising, and thus sighed in indignation, and therefore with Gěng Jì, Wéi Huǎng, Jí Běn, [Jí] Běn’s son [Jí] Miǎo, [Jí] Miǎo’s younger brother [Jí] Mù and others joined and planned. [Gěng] Jì appellation Jìxíng, in youth had beautiful reputation, became an Assistant Chancellor’s Official, the King extremely respected and was impressed with him, promoted to Attendant Central, observing Minister Treasurer. [Jí] Miǎo appellation Wénrán, [Jí] Mù appellation Sīrán, as [Jīn] Yī was fervent and had resemblance to [Jīn] Mìdī, and also was friendly with Wáng Bì, took advantage to have him infiltrate them, to kill [Wáng] Bì, wishing to seize Heaven’s Son to attack Wèi and to the south assist Liú Bèi. At the time Guān Yǔ was strong and flourishing, while the King was at Yè, leaving [Wáng] Bì to manage troops and command matters in Xǔ. [Jí Miǎo] Wénrán and the rest led miscellaneous people and house servants of over a thousand men in the night to burn the gates and attack [Wáng] Bì, [Jīn] Yī sent men to answer from the inside, shooting [Wáng] Bì in the shoulder. [Wáng] Bì did not know who the attackers were, and as he was previously friendly with [Jīn] Yī, fled to take refuge with [Jīn] Yī, in the night shouting “Déyī.” [Jīn] Yī’s household did not know it was [Wáng] Bì, said it was Wénrán and the rest, and mistakenly answered saying: “Is Chief Scribe Wáng already dead? Your matter is achieved!” [Wáng] Bì thus again fled on another road. Another account states: [Wáng] Bì wished to take refuge with [Jīn] Yī, his bannermen commander said to [Wáng] Bì: “In today’s affairs do you really know whose gates you can flee into?” Supporting [Wáng] Bì they fled over the south city wall. It happened it was dawn, [Wáng] Bì was still alive, Wénrán and the rest’s multitudes scattered, and therefore were destroyed. After over ten days, [Wáng] Bì indeed died from his wounds.
Xiàn-dì Chūnqiū states: Arrested [Gěng] Jì and [Wéi] Huǎng and the rest, about to behead them, [Gěng] Jì shouted the King of Wèi’s personal name, saying: “I only regret that I did not have my own plan, and indeed was misled by a few boys!” [Wéi] Huǎng knocked his head [to the ground] and beat his mouth until he died.
Shānyáng-gōng Zàijì states: The King heard that Wáng Bì had died, was overwhelmingly furious, summoned Hàn’s Hundred Officials to visit Yè, ordered those that fought the fire to the left, those that did not fight the fire to the right. The multitudes all believed those that fought the fire certainly would be without punishment, and all went left. The King believed: “Those that did not fight the fire did not add to the chaos, those that fought the fire thus are the real rebels.” Killed them all.



〔二〕　三輔決錄注曰：時有京兆金禕字德禕，自以世為漢臣，自日磾討莽何羅，忠誠顯著，名節累葉。睹漢祚將移，謂可季興，乃喟然發憤，遂與耿紀、韋晃、吉本、本子邈、邈弟穆等結謀。紀字季行，少有美名，為丞相掾，王甚敬異之，遷侍中，守少府。邈字文然，穆字思然，以禕慷慨有日磾之風，又與王必善，因以閒之，若殺必，欲挾天子以攻魏，南援劉備。時關羽彊盛，而王在鄴，留必典兵督許中事。文然等率雜人及家僮千餘人夜燒門攻必，禕遣人為內應，射必中肩。必不知攻者為誰，以素與禕善，走投禕，夜喚德禕，禕家不知是必，謂為文然等，錯應曰：「王長史已死乎？卿曹事立矣！」必乃更他路奔。一曰：必欲投禕，其帳下督謂必曰：「今日事竟知誰門而投入乎？」扶必奔南城。會天明，必猶在，文然等眾散，故敗。後十餘日，必竟以創死。獻帝春秋曰：收紀、晃等，將斬之，紀呼魏王名曰：「恨吾不自生意，竟為群兒所誤耳！」晃頓首搏頰，以至於死。山陽公載記曰：王聞王必死，盛怒，召漢百官詣鄴，令救火者左，不救火者右。眾人以為救火者必無罪，皆附左；王以為「不救火者非助亂，救火乃實賊也」。皆殺之。







Cáo Hóng defeated Wú Lán, beheaded his officer Rèn Kuí and others. Third Moon [218 Apr 13 – May 12], Zhāng Fēi and Mǎ Chāo fled Hànzhōng, Yīnpíng’s Dī [man] Qiángduān beheaded Wú Lán and sent his head.



曹洪破吳蘭，斬其將任夔等。三月，張飛、馬超走漢中，陰平氐強端斬吳蘭，傳其首。




Summer, Fourth Moon [218 May 13 – Jun 10], Dài Prefecture and Shànggǔ’s Wūhuán Wúchéndī and others rebelled. Sent the Marquess of Yānlíng [Cáo] Zhāng to suppress, defeated them. [112]



夏四月，代郡、上谷烏丸無臣氐等叛，遣鄢陵侯彰討破之。〔一〕










[112] Wèi shū records the King’s Order stating: “Last winter, Heaven sent down plague, the people suffered injuries, the army was mobilized in the exterior, cultivated farmland was reduced, I am extremely anxious of this. Thus order officials and civilians, male and female: women aged seventy and above with no husband or sons, or aged twelve and below with no father or mother or brothers, or those with eyes that cannot see, hands that cannot work, legs that cannot walk, and with no wives or children or fathers or elder brothers or property, government granaries are to feed them to the end of their lives, the young reaching until twelve. The poor unable to provide for themselves by mouths [per household] are given loans. For the aged and senile that must have caretakers, aged ninety and above, give labor exemptions of one person per family.”



〔一〕　魏書載王令曰：「去冬天降疫癘，民有凋傷，軍興於外，墾田損少，吾甚憂之。其令吏民男女：女年七十已上無夫子，若年十二已下無父母兄弟，及目無所見，手不能作，足不能行，而無妻子父兄產業者，廩食終身。幼者至十二止，貧窮不能自贍者，隨口給貸。老耄須待養者，年九十已上，復不事，家一人。」







Sixth Moon [218 Jul 11 – Aug 8], Order said: “The ancients in burials were certain to occupy barren ground. Thus take Xīmén Bào’s shrine’s west highland for the funerary tomb, taking advantage of the heights for foundation, no mound no trees. By the Zhōu Lǐ: ‘the Grave Master handles public burial ground,’ overall the vassal lords occupy the left and right of the front, ministers and grandees occupy the rear, Hàn’s system also called these as Accompanying Tombs. Thus the Excellencies and Ministers and great officials and ranked officers with achievements, should accompany the funerary tomb. Thus expand the area, to allow sufficient space.”



六月，令曰：「古之葬者，必居瘠薄之地。其規西門豹祠西原上為壽陵，因高為基，不封不樹。周禮冢人掌公墓之地，凡諸侯居左右以前，卿大夫居後，漢制亦謂之陪陵。其公卿大臣列將有功者，宜陪壽陵，其廣為兆域，使足相容。」




Autumn, Seventh Moon [218 Aug 9 – Sep 7], Drilled Troops, therefore campaigned west against Liú Bèi. Ninth Moon [Oct 8 – Nov 5], reached Cháng’ān.



秋七月，治兵，遂西征劉備，九月，至長安。




Winter, Tenth Moon [218 Nov 6 – Dec 5], Wǎn’s defending officer Hóu Yīn and others rebelled, seized the Nányáng Administrator, robbed and plundered the officials and civilians, protected Wǎn. Previously, Cáo Rén suppressed Guān Yǔ and garrisoned Fánchéng. That moon sent [Cáo] Rén to besiege Wǎn.



冬十月，宛守將侯音等反，執南陽太守，劫略吏民，保宛。初，曹仁討關羽，屯樊城，是月使仁圍宛。




Twenty-Fourth Year, Spring, Standard Moon [219 Feb 3 – Mar 3], [Cáo] Rén slaughtered Wǎn, beheaded [Hóu] Yīn. [113]



二十四年春正月，仁屠宛，斬音。〔一〕










[113] Cáo Mán zhuàn states: At that time Nányáng was suffering from conscripted labor, [Hóu] Yīn therefore seized Administrator Dōnglǐ Gǔn, with officials and civilians together rebelling, with Guān Yǔ joining in alliance. Nányáng Merit Officer Zōng Zǐqīng went to persuade [Hóu] Yīn saying: “You sir follow the people’s hearts, raising a great affair, far and near none do not watch the winds. However, seizing the prefecture officer is adverse and without benefit. Why not send him away? I will join strength with you, and by the time Excellency Cáo’s army comes, Guān Yǔ’s troops also will have arrived.” [Hóu] Yīn followed this, at once releasing and sending the Administrator. Zǐqīng took advantage in the night to go over the city walls to flee out, and therefore with the Administrator collected the remaining people to besiege [Hóu] Yīn. It happened that Cáo Rén’s army arrived, and together they exterminated them.



〔一〕　曹瞞傳曰：是時南陽閒苦繇役，音於是執太守（東里裦）〔東里袞〕，與吏民共反，與關羽連和。南陽功曹宗子卿往說音曰：「足下順民心，舉大事，遠近莫不望風；然執郡將，逆而無益，何不遣之。吾與子共戮力，比曹公軍來，關羽兵亦至矣。」音從之，即釋遣太守。子卿因夜踰城亡出，遂與太守收餘民圍音，會曹仁軍至，共滅之。







Xiàhóu Yuān with Liú Bèi battled at Yángpíng and was by [Liú] Bèi killed. Third Moon [219 Apr 3 – May 1], the King from Cháng’ān set out Yégǔ, the army screened the critical points to overlook Hànzhōng, and therefore reached Yángpíng. [Liú] Bèi took advantage of the difficult terrain to resist and defend. [114]



夏侯淵與劉備戰於陽平，為備所殺。三月，王自長安出斜谷，軍遮要以臨漢中，遂至陽平。備因險拒守。〔一〕










[114] Jiǔzhōu Chūnqiū states: At the time the King wished to return, and sent out an Order that said: “Chicken Rib.” The office associates did not know what it was saying. Registrar Yáng Xiū then on his own packed. Someone was alarmed and asked [Yáng] Xiū: “How did you understand it?” [Yáng] Xiū said: “Chicken ribs, to discard them is a shame, to eat them has no gain. Comparing this to Hànzhōng, one knows the King wishes to return.”



〔一〕　九州春秋曰：時王欲還，出令曰「雞肋」，官屬不知所謂。主簿楊脩便自嚴裝，人驚問脩：「何以知之？」脩曰：「夫雞肋，棄之如可惜，食之無所得，以比漢中，知王欲還也。」







Summer, Fifth Moon [219 Jun 1 – Jun 29], led the army back to Cháng’ān.



夏五月，引軍還長安。




Autumn, Seventh Moon [219 Jul 30 – Aug 27], appointed the consort Biàn-shì as Royal Queen. Sent Yú Jīn to assist Cáo Rén in striking Guān Yǔ. Eighth Moon [219 Aug 28 – Sep 26], the Hàn river flooded, drowning [Yú] Jīn’s army. The army was destroyed, [Guān] Yǔ captured [Yú] Jīn and therefore besieged [Cáo] Rén. Sent Xú Huǎng to rescue him.



秋七月，以夫人卞氏為王后。遣于禁助曹仁擊關羽。八月，漢水溢，灌禁軍，軍沒，羽獲禁，遂圍仁。使徐晃救之。




Ninth Moon [219 Sep 27 – Oct 25], Chancellor of State Zhōng Yáo in connection to West Department Official Wèi Fěng’s rebellion was dismissed. [115]



九月，相國鍾繇坐西曹掾魏諷反免。〔一〕










[115] Shìyǔ states: [Wèi] Fěng appellation Zǐjīng was a Pèi man, had talent in captivating the masses, admired and active in Yè capital, Zhōng Yáo because of this recruited him. The main army had not yet returned, [Wèi] Fěng secretly joined with followers and faction, and also with Chánglè Minister of the Guard Chén Yī planned to attack Yè. Before the planned time, [Chén] Yī was afraid and reported it to the Heir-Apparent [Cáo Pī]. Executed [Wèi] Fěng, those connected that died were several tens of men.
Wáng Chǎng’s Jiājiè states: “Jǐyīn’s Wèi Fěng,” but this says “Pèi man.” It is uncertain.



〔一〕　世語曰：諷字子京，沛人，有惑眾才，傾動鄴都，鍾繇由是辟焉。大軍未反，諷潛結徒黨，又與長樂衛尉陳禕謀襲鄴。未及期，禕懼，告之太子，誅諷，坐死者數十人。王昶家誡曰「濟陰魏諷」，而此云沛人，未詳。







Winter, Tenth Moon [219 Oct 26 – Nov 24], the army returned to Luòyáng. [116] Sūn Quán sent envoy to send up letter to request to suppress Guān Yǔ to prove himself. The King from Luòyáng campaigned south against [Guān] Yǔ, had not yet arrived, [Xú] Huǎng attacked [Guān] Yǔ, defeated him, [Guān] Yǔ fled, [Cáo] Rén’s besiegement was resolved. The King’s army at Móbēi. [117]



冬十月，軍還洛陽。〔一〕孫權遣使上書，以討關羽自效。王自洛陽南征羽，未至，晃攻羽，破之，羽走，仁圍解。王軍摩陂。〔二〕










[116] Cáo Mán zhuàn states: The King rebuilt the North Division Commandant Office, ordering it surpass its former state.



〔一〕　曹瞞傳曰：王更脩治北部尉廨，令過于舊。













[117] Wèi lüè states: Sūn Quán sent up letter declaring himself subject, declaring and explaining Heaven’s Mandate. The King had [Sūn] Quán’s letter shown to the exterior, saying: “This boy wishes to put me above the stove fire!” Attendant Central Chén Qún and Secretariat Writer Huán Jiē memorialized stating: “Hàn from since Emperor Ān onward had governance leave the ruling house, the state’s succession was repeatedly severed. Reaching to the present, there is only the name and title. A chǐ of land or a single civilian, all are not Hàn’s possession. Its allotted fate for a long time has already been exhausted, the calendar calculations for a long time have already ended. It is not only on today. Therefore, during Huán and Líng, those that observed and understood the Tú and Wĕi all said: ‘Hàn’s transition aura is exhausted, the Yellow House shall rise.’ Your Highness answers this allotment, of the ten divisions of Heaven’s Under then possessing nine, to submit and serve Hàn, the crowds take note and watch, far and near complain and sigh, and therefore Sūn Quán from afar declares himself subject, this is the answering of Heaven and Man, different auras together in chorus. Your Servants humbly believe Yú and Xià did not modestly decline, Yīn and Zhōu did not begrudge executing and exiling. Fearing Heaven and understanding the Mandate, there is no reason to decline.”
Wèishì Chūnqiū states: Xiàhóu Dūn said to the King: “Heaven’s Under all knows Hàn’s blessings are already exhausted, a different dynasty is about to rise. Since antiquity onward, the one able to remove the people’s sufferings and to which the Hundred Surnames submit to, is exactly the ruler of the people. Now Your Highness has fought in war for over thirty years, achievements and virtues known to the numerous masses, the one Heaven’s Under depends on and submits to. In answering Heaven and obeying the people, what further is there to doubt?” The King said: “‘Displaying it in government, is also to be government.’ If Heaven’s Mandate is with me, I am Zhōu Wén-wáng.”
Cáo Mán zhuàn and Shìyǔ both say Huán Jiē urged the King to correct his rank, Xiàhóu Dūn believed: “It is appropriate to first exterminate Shǔ, if Shǔ is destroyed then Wú will submit, two regions then settled, and only afterward follow the path of Shùn and Yǔ.” The King followed this. When the King died, [Xiàhóu] Dūn regretted his previous words, fell ill and died.
Sūn Shèng’s Appraisal states: Xiàhóu Dūn was ashamed to be a Hàn official and requested to receive a Wèi seal. Huán Jiē was proper and honest, having righteous and upright integrity. Investigating their biography records, Shìyǔ is absurd.



〔二〕　魏略曰：孫權上書稱臣，稱說天命。王以權書示外曰：「是兒欲踞吾著爐火上邪！」侍中陳群、尚書桓階奏曰：「漢自安帝已來，政去公室，國統數絕，至於今者，唯有名號，尺土一民，皆非漢有，期運久已盡，曆數久已終，非適今日也。是以桓、靈之間，諸明圖緯者，皆言『漢行氣盡，黃家當興』。殿下應期，十分天下而有其九，以服事漢，群生注望，，遐邇怨歎，是故孫權在遠稱臣，此天人之應，異氣齊聲。臣愚以為虞、夏不以謙辭，殷、周不吝誅放，畏天知命，無所與讓也。」魏氏春秋曰：夏侯惇謂王曰：「天下咸知漢祚已盡，異代方起。自古已來，能除民害為百姓所歸者，即民主也。今殿下即戎三十餘年，功德著於黎庶，為天下所依歸，應天順民，復何疑哉！」王曰：「『施于有政，是亦為政』。若天命在吾，吾為周文王矣。」曹瞞傳及世語並云桓階勸王正位，夏侯惇以為宜先滅蜀，蜀亡則吳服，二方既定，然後遵舜、禹之軌，王從之。及至王薨，惇追恨前言，發病卒。孫盛評曰：夏侯惇恥為漢官，求受魏印，桓階方惇，有義直之節；考其傳記，世語為妄矣。

title: 1  Annals of Emperor Wǔ
text:
Jiàn’ān 25 (220)


Twenty-Fifth Year, Spring, Standard Moon [220 Feb 22 – Mar 21], reached Luòyáng. [Sūn] Quán struck and beheaded [Guān] Yǔ, sent his head.



二十五年春正月，至洛陽。權擊斬羽，傳其首。




Gēngzǐ [220 Mar 15], the King passed away at Luòyáng, his years sixty-six. [118] Legacy Order said: “Heaven’s Under is not yet secure and settled, and cannot follow the old ways. When the burial is complete, all are to remove mourning clothes. Those commanding troops in garrison camps are all to not leave their garrison departments. Relevant managers are to each continue in their offices. Dress in seasonal clothes, without storage of gold or jade treasures.” Posthumous name Wǔ-wáng. Second Moon [220 Mar 22 – Apr 20] Dīngmǎo [220 Apr 11], buried at Gāolíng. [119]



庚子，王崩于洛陽，年六十六。〔一〕遺令曰：「天下尚未安定，未得遵古也。葬畢，皆除服。其將兵屯戍者，皆不得離屯部。有司各率乃職。斂以時服，無藏金玉珍寶。」諡曰武王。二月丁卯，葬高陵。〔二〕










[118] Shìyǔ states: Tàizǔ from Hànzhōng reached Luòyáng, raised Jiànshǐ Hall, cut down Zhuólóng shrine, but from the trees blood came out.
Cáo Mán zhuàn states: The King sent laborer Sū Yuè to move a pear tree. Digging it, a root was damaged and out came blood. [Sū] Yuè reported the situation. The King personally went to see and hated it, believing it inauspicious, returned and therefore fell ill.



〔一〕　世語曰：太祖自漢中至洛陽，起建始殿，伐濯龍祠而樹血出。曹瞞傳曰：王使工蘇越徙美梨，掘之，根傷盡出血。越白狀，王躬自視而惡之，以為不祥，還遂寢疾。













[119] Wèi shū states: Tàizǔ personally took the reins of Within the Seas, weeded and razed the crowds of the evil, his deploying of armies and employing of brigades overall followed the methods of Sūn [Wǔ] and Wú [Qǐ], but in taking advantage of situations and setting surprises, outwitting the enemy to secure victory, the transformations were like a deity. He personally composed military books of over a hundred thousand words, the various officers on campaign all consulted his Xīn shū in managing affairs. Overseeing matters he also hand wrote dispatch directions, those that followed orders achieved victory, those that violated instructions suffered defeats. Facing the enemy lines, his thoughts were tranquil and at ease, as if not wishing to battle, however reaching the decisive opportunity to seize victory, his energy was overflowing, therefore every battle was certain to succeed, the army never only by fortune victorious. He understood men and excelled in observation, difficult to beguile with falseness, selected out Yú Jīn and Yuè Jìn from among the battle lines, obtained Zhāng Liáo and Xú Huǎng from within defeated enemies, all assisted the mandate and established achievements, ranked as famed officers. The rest that he selected out from the small and obscure, raised to be governors and administrators, cannot even be counted. Therefore he created a great enterprise, civil and martial together enacted, led the army for over thirty years, his hand did not set aside books, in daytime then discussing martial strategy, in the night then pondering the classics, when climbing up high certain to compose an ode, and when he made a new poem, he set it to pipes and strings, all becoming musical songs. His talent and strength surpassed men, hand shooting flying birds, personally capturing fierce beasts, once at Nánpí in one day shooting pheasants and obtaining sixty-three heads. Reaching to the building of Palace Residences, repairing of machines and weapons, none were not by his methods and models, all completely by his intentions. Elegant in nature and frugal, he did not enjoy flowery decoration, the Rear Palace clothes were not embroidered, his attendants’ shoes were not of two colors, his curtains and screens when damaged were patched, his bedding was for warmth, with no fringe decorations. In attacking cities and capturing towns, when obtaining beautiful things, then bestowed them all on those with achievements. For accomplished labors that should be rewarded, he did not begrudge a thousand gold. For those without achievements hoping for bestowment, the smallest fraction was not given. The Four Quarters sent tribute, he shared it together with his subordinates. He always believed the systems of ending arrangements and the numbers of burial shrouds were complicated and without benefit, vulgar and also excessive, and therefore in advance on his own regulated his final arrangements to clothes of four packages and nothing more.
Fù-zǐ states: Tàizǔ regretted that marriages had become extravagant and presumptuous. When his daughters were matched to someone, all had black curtains, the accompanying maid servants did not exceed ten people.
Zhāng Huá’s Bówùzhì states: In Hàn’s era, Ānpíng’s Cuī Yuàn, [Cuī] Yuàn’s son [Cuī] Shí, Hóngnóng’s Zhāng Zhī, [Zhāng] Zhī’s younger brother [Zhāng] Chǎng all excelled in cursive script, and Tàizǔ was second to them. Huán Tán and Cài Yōng excelled in music, Píngyì’s Shān Zǐdào, Wáng Jiǔzhēn, Guō Kǎi, and others excelled in wéiqí, Tàizǔ all matched them in ability. Also he enjoyed cultivation methods, also understood medicine and pharmacology, attracted and gathered masters of technical arts, Lújiāng’s Zuǒ Cí, Qiáo Prefecture’s Huà Tuó, Gānlíng’s Gān Shǐ, Yángchéng’s Xì Jiǎn, none did not all come. Also he regularly ate yěgé of one chǐ, and also sometimes drank poisoned alcohol.
Fù-zǐ states: At Hàn’s end of the kings and dukes many cast aside royal clothes, wore headscarves as fashion, and therefore the sorts as Yuán Shào and Cuī Jūn, although they were military commanders, all wore silk headscarves. Wèi Tàizǔ because Heaven’s Under was in desolation, resources and wealth lacking and exhausted, imitated ancient leather caps, cut silk to make the cap, in accordance with intentions for simplicity and ease and adapting to the times, using color to distinguish noble and lowly. To the present it is in use, and can be said to be a military appearance, not a stately appearance.
Cáo Mán zhuàn states: Tàizǔ as a man was frivolous and impulsive, without weighty prestige, enjoyed music, singers and performers at his side, always from day to night. He wore clothes of light raw silk, his body wearing girdle of small belt and purse, to hold hand scarf and small items, at times wearing cap to meet guests. Every time he conversed with someone, he would tease and joke, completely without holding back, and when pleased he would greatly laugh, to the extent that his head would be drenched in his cups on the table, dishes and food all dirtying his headscarf, his recklessness was like this. However in wielding law he was severe and oppressive, if among the various officers there was one with a strategy that surpassed his own, then he would use the law to execute them, reaching to past friends and old enemies, also all had none remaining. Those he condemned to death, then he would face them and shed tears and sigh in pain, but to the end none were spared. Previously, Yuán Zhōng was Pèi Chancellor, once wished to use the law to punish Tàizǔ, and Pèi State’s Huán Shào also disparaged him. Reaching to when he was at Yǎn Province, Chénliú’s Biān Ràng in speaking comments often offended Tàizǔ, Tàizǔ killed him and clan exterminated his family. [Yuán] Zhōng and [Huán] Shào both fled the troubles to Jiāo Province. Tàizǔ sent an envoy to meet Administrator Shì Xiè to completely clan exterminate them. Huán Shào was able to surrender himself, bowed and apologized in the courtyards, Tàizǔ said: “Can kneeling pardon death?” Therefore killed him. Once he set out the army, traveled through wheat, ordered: “Soldiers are not to damage wheat, violators die.” Cavalry servicemen all dismounted horse, parting the wheat to support one another. Then Tàizǔ’s horse galloped into the wheat. Ordered the Registrar to discuss punishment. The Registrar replied believing: “By the principles of the Chūnqiū, punishments are not applied on the honored.” Tàizǔ said: “To systemize a law but myself violate it, how can I command subordinates? However I am the army commander, and cannot kill myself, and request to punish myself.” Therefore he drew sword and cut his hair to set on the ground. Also he had a favored concubine that once accompanied when he napped during the day, pillowed on her lap, instructed her stating: “In a short while wake me.” The concubine saw Tàizǔ was resting peacefully, and did not at once wake him. When he woke up himself, had her beaten to death. Once while suppressing bandits, the government grain was not enough, and he privately said to the manager: “What can be done?” The manager said: “We can use smaller measuring cups to satisfy it.” Tàizǔ said: “Excellent.” Later those in the army said Tàizǔ was cheating the masses. Tàizǔ said to the manager: “I must specially rely on your death to appease the masses, if not the matter cannot be resolved.” Thus beheaded him, taking the head with an announcement sign stating: “For using smaller measuring cups, stealing government grain, beheaded him at the army gates.” His ruthless brutality and accommodating deceptions were all of this sort.
