辛酉，給事中博士蘇林、董巴上表曰：「天有十二次以為分野，王公之國，各有所屬，周在鶉火，魏在大梁。歲星行歷十二次國，天子受命，諸侯以封。周文王始受命，歲在鶉火，至武王伐紂十三年，歲星復在鶉火，故春秋傳曰：『武王伐紂，歲在鶉火；歲之所在，即我有周之分野也。』昔光和七年，歲在大梁，武王始受命，（為）〔於〕時將討黃巾。是歲改年為中平元年。建安元年，歲復在大梁，始拜大將軍。十三年復在大梁，始拜丞相。今二十五年，歲復在大梁，陛下受命。此魏得歲與周文王受命相應。今年青龍在庚子，詩推度災曰：『庚者更也，子者滋也，聖命天下治。』又曰：『王者布德於子，治成於丑。』此言今年天更命聖人制治天下，布德於民也。魏以改制天下，與（時）〔詩〕協矣。顓頊受命，歲在豕韋，衛居其地，亦在豕韋，故春秋傳曰：『衛，顓頊之墟也。』今十月斗之建，則顓頊受命之分也，始魏以十月受禪，此同符始祖受命之驗也。魏之氏族，出自顓頊，與舜同祖，見于春秋世家。舜以土德承堯之火，今魏亦以土德承漢之火，於行運，會于堯舜授受之次。臣聞天之去就，固有常分，聖人當之，昭然不疑，故堯捐骨肉而禪有虞，終無恡色，舜發隴畝而君天下，若固有之，其相受授，閒不替漏；天下已傳矣，所以急天命，天下不可一日無君也。今漢期運已終，妖異絕之已審，階下受天之命，符瑞告徵，丁寧詳悉，反覆備至，雖言語相喻，無以代此。今既發詔書，璽綬未御，固執謙讓，上逆天命，下違民望。臣謹案古之典籍，參以圖緯，魏之行運及天道所在，即尊之驗，在于今年此月，昭晰分明。唯階下遷思易慮，以時即位，顯告天帝而告天下，然後改正朔，易服色，正大號，天下幸甚。」令曰：「凡斯皆宜聖德，故曰：『苟非其人，道不虛行。』天瑞雖彰，須德而光；吾德薄之人，胡足以當之？今讓，冀見聽許，外內咸使聞知。」




Rénxū [220 Dec 2], conferment Edict said: “The Imperial Emperor inquires of the King of Wèi saying: The dispatched [Máo] Zōng presenting your Gēngshēn [220 Nov 30] letter arrived, and what it states and explains, I have heard it. We consider that the Hàn House’s reigns have exceeded twenty, its years surpassed four hundred, the fate cycle calculations completed, the transition of blessings already finished, Heaven’s heart already shifted, the millions of people’s expectations severed, what Heaven has discarded is of its own accord. Now the Great Mandate has where it settles and rests, the Divine Vessels should go to sagely virtue, disobeying the masses is not favorable, opposing Heaven is not auspicious. You the King thus embody Yǒu Yú’s flourishing virtue, answer the auspicious conjunction of the calendar calculations, and therefore auspicious signs report the correspondences, the charts and prophecies present the records, Divinity and Humanity the same in answer, accepting the Mandate is completely appropriate. We are in awe of Highest God and convey the throne to you King. Heaven cannot be disobeyed; the masses cannot be discarded. Moreover Chónghuá did not oppose Yáo’s mandate, Dà Yǔ did not decline Shùn’s throne, as for ordinary fellows as [Xǔ] Yóu and [Shàn] Juān, they are not recorded in registers of sages, assuredly not what Imperial material or a vessel to be Emperor should praise and admire. Now send [Zhāng] Yīn to present the Imperial Emperor’s Ruler’s Seal and Ribbon, the King is to ascend the Emperor’s throne, not oppose Our mandate, to respectfully serve Heaven’s intentions thus.”



壬戌，冊詔曰：「皇帝問魏王言：遣宗奉庚申書到，所稱引，聞之。朕惟漢家世踰二十，年過四百，運周數終，行祚已訖，天心已移，兆民望絕，天之所廢，有自來矣。今大命有所厎止，神器當歸聖德，違眾不順，逆天不祥。王其體有虞之盛德，應曆數之嘉會，是以禎祥告符，圖讖表錄，神人同應，受命咸宜。朕畏上帝，致位于王；天不可違，眾不可拂。且重華不逆堯命，大禹不辭舜位，若夫由、卷匹夫，不載聖籍，固非皇材帝器所當稱慕。今使音奉皇帝璽綬，王其陟帝位，無逆朕命，以祗奉天心焉。」




Thereupon Secretariat Writers Director Huán Jiē and others memorialized saying: “Now Hàn’s envoy [Zhāng] Yīn presenting Ruler’s Seal marked letter arrives, We Your Servants believe that Heaven’s Mandate cannot be delayed, the Divine Vessels cannot be disrespected. Zhōu Wǔ in midstream had the verification of the white fish, did not wait for the appointment of the brigades and his great title was already established. Shùn received the great forest, the shade of the mulberry tree had not yet shifted and he had already ascended the Emperor’s throne. All, in order to respectfully serve Heaven’s Mandate, were as quick as this. Therefore there is no righteousness in stubbornly declining, no taking of maintaining limitation as nobility, one must place faith in the divinities, in accordance with Heaven and Earth and nothing more. The Yì states: ‘The receiving of mandate is like an echo, whether far or near or secluded or deep, all know what will come. If it is not the utmost profoundness of Heaven’s Under, how would it be able to be like this?’ Now Your Majesty answers the calculations of allotted fate, taken by August Heaven as son, but yet again delay and obstruct with declining, drawing back from the great title, it is not the way to model after the way of Heaven and Earth and fulfill the hopes of the myriad states. We Your Servants dare to risk death to plead, to at once order relevant mangers to build the platform stage, select an auspicious day, receive the abdication mandate, and open the Ruler’s Seal and Ribbon.”
The Order said: “I hoped to thrice decline but was not listened to. Why the rush in this?”



於是尚書令桓階等奉曰：「今漢使音奉璽書到，臣等以為天命不可稽，神器不可瀆。周武中流有白魚之應，不待師期而大號已建，舜受大麓，桑蔭未移而已陟帝位，皆所以祗承天命，若此之速也。故無固讓之義，不以守節為貴，必道信於神靈，符合於天地而已。易曰：『其受命如響，無有遠近幽深，遂知來物，非天下之至賾，其孰能與於此？』今陛下應期運之數，為皇天所子，而復稽滯於辭讓，低回於大號，非所以則天地之道，副萬國之望。臣等敢以死請，輒敕有司修治壇場，擇吉日，受禪命，發璽綬。」令曰：「冀三讓而不見聽，何汲汲于斯乎？」




Jiǎzǐ [220 Dec 4], the King of Wèi sent up letter stating: “Receiving this moon’s Rénxū [220 Dec 2] Ruler’s Seal marked letter, again bearing your sagely command, in prostration listening to the conferment announcement, my liver and guts trembled in fear, not knowing what to do. Heaven’s Under’s Divine Vessels and abdication successions are heavy affairs, and therefore when Yáo was about to abdicate to Shùn, ‘he appointed him to the great forest,’ and at Shùn’s mandate on Yǔ, dark jade tablet reported his achievements. Fierce winds did not confuse them, the Nine Provinces were tranquil and pacified, ‘inquired on affairs and investigated statements,’ and only afterward then mandated, and yet they still held to modestly declining that their virtue was not enough to be a successor. All the more for Your Servant of stubbornness, my character not of those two sages, to then answer Heaven’s governance and receive in the end your enlightened Edict, I dare maintain my trifling integrity, submit my ambitions to Jī mountain, unable to bear your great wish. I solemnly bow and present explanation of my feelings, and send also to present up the Ruler’s Seal and Ribbon.



甲子，魏王上書曰：「奉今月壬戌璽書，重被聖命，伏聽冊告，肝膽戰悸，不知所措。天下神器，禪代重事，故堯將禪舜，納于大麓，舜之命禹，玄圭告功；烈風不迷，九州攸平，詢事考言，然後乃命，而猶執謙讓于德不嗣。況臣頑固，質非二聖，乃應天統，受終明詔；敢守微節，歸志箕山，不勝大願。謹拜表陳情，使并奉上璽綬。」




Attendant Central Liú Yì and others memorialized stating: “We Your Servants have heard that a sagely emperor does not oppose the times, an enlightened ruler does not defy the people, and therefore the Yì says to ‘connect the will of Heaven’s Under,’ ‘break the doubts of Heaven’s Under.’ In prostration we consider that Your Majesty embodies the upper sagacity of Yǒu Yú, bears the transitioning fate of Earth’s Virtue, meets the conjunction of Kàngyáng and Míngyí, answers the calculation of the completion of the blessings of the Hàn clan, accords with the Imperial standard, corresponds to the Two Polarities. Therefore sagely auspicious signs present portents, Heaven’s Under together answers, the calendar fates leave and arrive, deeply and sharply proven and clear. In debating Heaven’s Mandate, there is nothing to discuss. In comparing the suitability of timing, there is nothing to argue. Therefore for the period for receiving the mandate, the season is pure and sun is clear, shining vitality spreading radiance, glorious aura of clouds drifting. This then is Heaven’s Way pleased and rejoicing, the people’s hearts rejoicing and supportive, and yet again they meet with obstruction and refusal, by ritual this is what conduct? Moreover the crowds of the living cannot for one day be without a ruler, the Divine Vessels cannot for an instant be without governance, and therefore servants have disobedience to lords to achieve enterprises, subordinates have rectifying of superiors to establish affairs, We Your Servants dare to not begrudge death to plead.”
The King’s Order said: “Heaven’s Under is a precious vessel, the ruler’s legitimacy; by sagely virtue assume them, yet still have fearful heart. I am what sort of man? Moreover the Excellencies and Ministers have not yet reached to lacking a ruler; this is such a small matter, for the time being it is appropriate to wait to after my firmly declining, and only then again discuss the possibilities.”



侍中劉廙等奏曰：「臣等聞聖帝不違時，明主不逆人，故易稱通天下之志，斷天下之疑。伏惟陛下體有虞之上聖，承土德之行運，當亢陽明夷之會，應漢氏祚終之數，合契皇極，同符兩儀。是以聖瑞表徵，天下同應，曆運去就，深切著明；論之天命，無所與議，比之時宜，無所與爭。故受命之期，時清日晏，曜靈施光，休氣雲蒸。是乃天道悅懌，民心欣戴，而仍見閉拒，于禮何居？且群生不可一日無主，神器不可以斯須無統，故臣有違君以成業，下有矯上以立事，臣等敢不重以死請。」王令曰：「天下重器，王者正統，以聖德當之，猶有懼心，吾何人哉？且公卿未至乏主，斯豈小事，且宜以待固讓之後，乃當更議其可耳。」




Dīngmǎo [220 Dec 7], conferment Edict on the King of Wèi said: “Heaven has concluded Hàn’s blessings, the star signs are shown clear, We respect Heaven’s Mandate, convey the Throne to you King, and yet again explain the calendar calculations in Edict of conferment, describe the corresponding fates with brush and ink. The Divine Vessels cannot be dismissed and refused, the Imperial throne cannot be modestly declined. The delays of Heaven’s Mandate have reached to the second and third. Moreover the Four Seas cannot for one day be without a ruler, the myriad affairs cannot for an instant be without governance, and therefore one who establishes a great enterprise is not restrained by minor limits, one who understands Heaven’s Mandate is not bound by trifling things. Therefore Shùn accepted the mandate of the great enterprise and was without humble yielding refusals. The sagely man in transcending limits, is it not far? Now send [Zhāng] Yīn to present the Imperial Emperor’s Ruler’s Seal and Ribbon, the King is to respectfully accept, to reply to Heaven’s Under’s expectations of answer.”



丁卯，冊詔魏王曰：「天訖漢祚，辰象著明，朕祗天命，致位於王，仍陳曆數於詔冊，喻符運於翰墨；神器不可以辭拒，皇位不可以謙讓，稽於天命，至於再三。且四海不可以一日曠主，萬機不可以斯須無統，故建大業者不拘小節，知天命者不繫細物，是以舜受大業之命而無遜讓之辭，聖人達節，不亦遠乎！今使音奉皇帝璽綬，王其欽承，以答天下嚮應之望焉。」




Chancellor of State Huà Xīn, Grand Commandant Jiǎ Xǔ, Censorate Grandee Wáng Lǎng with the Nine Ministers sent up word stating: “We Your Servants have been summoned and arrived, in prostration observed Grand Scribe Deputy Xǔ Zhī and Left Central Cadet General Lǐ Fú’s sent up charts and prophecies and signs of the mandate, Attendant Central Liú Yì and other’s announced explanations of the hearts of the masses; humanity and spirits together planned. Also the Hàn Court knows Your Majesty’s sagely influence connects with the divine intelligence, sagely virtue matches with Yú and Xià, because signs and verifications completely arrive, it heeds where the calendar calculations are located, and therefore proffers Ruler’s Seal and Ribbon, firmly yielding the Honored Title. Of those able to speak, none do not applaud and dance. The Hé Tú and Luò Shū give the signs and verifications of Heaven’s Mandate, human affairs harmonize with Heaven’s timing, the people’s speech harmonize with Heaven’s narratives. But Your Majesty by nature maintains diligence and modesty, in conduct esteems restraint and refusal, the enlightened edict earnest and sincere, not yet willing to listen and agree. Of the ministers and servants and lesser men, none are not melancholy and anxious. We Your Servants have heard that from antiquity to the present, those that possessed Heaven’s Under were not always of one surname. Examining virtue and power, then flourishing and decline are by strength and weakness. Discussing the ends and beginnings, then downfall and rising are by allotted fates. Táng’s and Yú’s calendar calculations were not with their sons, but with Shùn and Yǔ. Although Shùn and Yǔ had thoughts of declining, they were compelled by the crowds of lords grasping silk and jade to hold Court for them, the millions of people joyously supportive and submitting to them, all the lands raising songs and ballads to eulogize them. Therefore the restraints of maintaining limits cannot be obtained and always held, the expedience of transcending limits cannot be obtained and long avoided, and therefore some resign the throne and are not stingy, some receive the abdication and do not decline. The one not stingy does not necessarily loathe Imperial favor, the one not declining does not necessarily thirst for the Emperor’s blessings. Each was compelled by Heaven’s Mandate and could not do as they wished. After the abdication, then the sons of the Táng clan were the guests of Yǒu Yú, the descendants of the Yú clan were the guests of the Xià dynasty. That being the case, the meaning of abdication succession is not only the receivers truly answering Heaven’s fortunes, the givers also enjoy hereditary celebrations. Hàn from Zhāng and Hé onward, the generations had many changes and misfortunes, gradually declining. Reaching to Xiào-Líng, he was not constant in heart, oppressed the worthy and harmed the benevolent, hoarded wealth without limit, governance was with his favorite castrates, saw the people as enemies, therefore causing Heaven Above to shake in anger, the Hundred Surnames shifted allegiance like following the winds. At that time then the Four Seas were a boiling cauldron, and at his passing then disaster issued from the Palace courts, favor and power both exhausted, the Emperor’s House therefore brought low. Like how at the final end of the Emperor Shùn he yet selected a sagely successor and conferred on him, how the Jīng man carried uncut jade and yet yearned for a skilled craftsman to carve it, all the more for the Hàn state already gone, none able to rectify it; transferring the vessels and shifting lords, entrusting to the sagely and wise, assuredly is appropriate. The Hàn Court entrusts its pledge, and already wishes for the ritual of abdication to be quickly settled. Heaven blesses all the lands, certainly there must be a ruler. A ruler of all the lands, if not Your Majesty then who can be appointed for it? It is what is called: in discussing virtue there are none who can compare, in examining achievements there can be no refusal and decline. Heaven’s Mandate cannot be long delayed, the people’s hopes cannot be long disobeyed. Your Servants are anxious and cannot bear our great hopes. In prostration we request Your Majesty cut off from your ambitions of modesty, prepare the rituals for accepting the abdication, to accord with the intentions of Humanity and Divinity, and comfort the hopes of the exterior and the interior.”
The Order said: “In virtue then I am insufficient, in timing then the warfare and rebels are not yet extinguished. If by the spirits of the various worthies I am able to protect my head and neck, ending as lord over Wèi state, to me it would be sufficient. One like me, how am I worth disgracing the Four Seas? As for Heaven’s signs and human affairs, all are the remnant celebrations of the Former King’s sagely virtue, what do I have to do with it? Therefore I do not dare hear of the Mandate.”



相國華歆、太尉賈詡、御史大夫王朗及九卿上言曰：「臣等被召到，伏見太史丞許芝、左中郎將李伏所上圖讖、符命，侍中劉廙等宣敘眾心，人靈同謀。又漢朝知陛下聖化通于神明，聖德參于虞、夏，因瑞應之備至，聽曆數之所在，遂獻璽綬，固讓尊號。能言之倫，莫不抃舞，河圖、洛書，天命瑞應，人事協于天時，民言協于天敘。而陛下性秉勞謙，體尚克讓，明詔懇切，未肯聽許，臣妾小人，莫不伊邑。臣等聞自古及今，有天下者不常在乎一姓；考以德勢，則盛衰在乎彊弱，論以終始，則廢興在乎期運。唐、虞曆數，不在厥子而在舜、禹。舜、禹雖懷克讓之意迫，群后執玉帛而朝之，兆民懷欣戴而歸之，率土揚歌謠而詠之，故其守節之拘，不可得而常處，達節之權，不可得而久避；是以或遜位而不恡，或受禪而不辭，不恡者未必厭皇寵，不辭者未必渴帝祚，各迫天命而不得以已。既禪之後，則唐氏之子為賓于有虞，虞氏之冑為客于夏代，然則禪代之義，非獨受之者實應天福，授之者亦與有餘慶焉。漢自章、和之後，世多變故，稍以陵遲，洎乎孝靈，不恆其心，虐賢害仁，聚斂無度，政在嬖豎，視民如讎，遂令上天震怒，百姓從風如歸；當時則四海鼎沸，既沒則禍發宮庭，寵勢並竭，帝室遂卑，若在帝舜之末節，猶擇聖代而授之，荊人抱玉璞，猶思良工而刊之，況漢國既往，莫之能匡，推器移君，委之聖哲，固其宜也。漢朝委質，既願禮禪之速定也，天祚率土，必將有主；主率土者，非陛下其孰能任之？所謂論德無與為比，考功無推讓矣。天命不可久稽，民望不不可久違，臣等慺慺，不勝大願。伏請陛下割撝謙之志，脩受禪之禮，副人神之意，慰外內之願。」令曰：「以德則孤不足，以時則戎虜未滅。若以群賢之靈，得保首領，終君魏國，於孤足矣。若孤者，胡足以辱四海？至乎天瑞人事，皆先王聖德遺慶，孤何有焉？是以未敢聞命。」




Jǐsì [220 Dec 9], the King of Wèi sent up letter stating: “Your Servant has heard that Shùn had the accomplishment of the guests at the four gates and thus received the abdication from Táo Táng, that Yǔ had the achievement of preserving states of seven hundred and thus inherited fortunes from Yǒu Yú. Your Servant is sheltered and ignorant, my virtue not of those two sages, shamefully meet Heaven’s governance, and do not dare hear your mandate. I dare repeatedly resist and petition, roughly explaining my private wishes, hoping my Response reaches the purple courts, to be able to preserve my meager integrity, my feelings communicated to the palace summit, forever maintain my original ambition. But [Zhāng] Yīn once again carries mandate, extending Regulation Edict on Your Servant, Your Servant truly trembles in fear, and will not open the Ruler’s Seal marked letter, but [Zhāng] Yīn is constrained by a strict Edict, and does not dare return from his mandate. May Your Majesty urgently send galloping relays, to summon [Zhāng] Yīn back to the terraces. I cannot bear my utmost sincerity, and solemnly send [Máo] Zōng to present letter.”



己巳，魏王上書曰：「臣聞舜有賓于四門之勳，乃受禪於陶唐，禹有存國七百之功，乃承祿於有虞。臣以蒙蔽，德非二聖，猥當天統，不敢聞命。敢屢抗疏，略陳私願，庶章通紫庭，得全微節，情達宸極，永守本志。而音重復銜命，申制詔臣，臣實戰惕，不發璽書，而音迫于嚴詔，不敢復命。願陛下馳傳騁驛，召音還臺。不勝至誠，謹使宗奉書。」




Chancellor of State [Huà] Xīn, Grand Commandant [Jiǎ] Xǔ, Censorate Grandee [Wáng] Lǎng with the Nine Ministers memorialized stating: “We Your Servants in prostration read the Edict letter, our anxiety increasingly extreme. We Your Servants have heard that the Yì states that the sagely man serves Heaven’s timing, the Lúnyǔ says that the noble man is awed by Heaven’s Mandate, Heaven’s Mandate has its leaving and arriving, and only afterward do Emperors have abdication successions. Therefore Táng abdicated to Yú because the mandate was on his body, Yú obeyed Táng calling it acceptance of completion. Yáo understood that Heaven’s Mandate had left him and therefore was not able to not abdicate to Shùn, Shùn understood that the calendar calculations were upon himself and therefore did not dare not accept. Not able to not abdicate is serving Heaven’s timing. Not daring to not accept is fearing Heaven’s Mandate. Although the Hàn Court continues as the remnant of a final end of decline, yet it attends to serving Heaven’s Mandate to model after Yáo’s way, and therefore hopes to abdicate the Emperor’s throne and marry off two daughters. But Your Majesty right at the beginning of Great Wèi receiving the Mandate opposes the transcending integrity of Yú and Xià and esteems the declining and refusal of Yánlíng, and so what is twisted is the large, what is straightened is the small, what is detailed is the light, what is rough is the heavy, even mediocre men and ordinary servicemen yet for Your Majesty disparage it. If the gone have awareness, then Chónghuá is certainly indignant and resentful in Cāngwú’s Shénmù, Dà Yǔ is certainly melancholy and anxious in Kuàijī’s Shānyīn, Wǔ-wáng is certainly displeased in Gāolíng’s Xuángōng. Therefore We Your Servants dare to risk death to plead. Moreover Hàn’s governance was with the castrate eunuchs, fortunes had left the Emperor’s household for seven reigns, and therefore there was the accumulation of arrows and stones in the Palace Halls, and so the two capitals became graves and ruins. At that time, the Four Seas were swept away and overturned, Heaven’s Under divided and collapsed, Wǔ-wáng personally wore armor and donned helmet, bathed in rain and combed by wind, pleaded for the lives of the people, then saved the myriad states, for the world subdued the chaos, then delivering the rise of peace, assembled the people and established leaders, built offices and installed officials, person by person without faults who lost their previous enterprise yet began to have contributions to the Huáxià. Your Majesty succeeded the throne, radiantly shining culture and virtue, to complement the martial achievements, diligently giving relief to the people’s sufferings, treating them like the injured, the afraid you calmed, the labored you rested, the cold you warmed, the hungry you fed, the estranged by your virtue submitted, the enemies by your grace surrendered, spreading grace and planting virtue, radiance covering the four borders. In studying antiquity and sincere amiability, your abundance exceeds Fàngxūn; as a net releasing a boat swallower, your generosity surpasses Zhōu Wén. Therefore when your spreading of governance has not yet been a year, humanity and divinity are both harmonized, August Heaven then sent down sweet dew and delivered the four spirituals, Lordly Earth then grew up zhīcǎo and spurted out sweet springs. Tigers and leopards and deer and hares, all white in color, pheasants and turtledoves and swallows and sparrows, also white in feathers, trees growing joined as one, melons sharing a core, fish of five colors, rare auspicious signs and objects, mixed together in between, none are not completely prepared. The ancients had a saying: ‘Without Yǔ I would be a fish!’ Without Great Wèi, then We Your Servants would be white bones scattered across the wilderness. In prostration examining the exterior and interior various ministers’ beginning to end replies and memorials, the explanations and narrations of Your Majesty’s correspondence to the mandate, none are not of the Hé’s and Luò’s chart and document, according with the signs and verifications of Heaven and Earth, enabled by the Hàn Court’s authentic sincerity, announcing the myriad quarters’ admiring adherence, it can be said to be believable and proven. The Three Kings have nothing to compare, the Five Emperors have nothing to add. The lives of the people have hung on Wèi’s country, the hearts of the people have been bound with Wèi’s government, for over thirty years. This then is the conjunction of a thousand ages of time arriving, the autumn of one encounter in ten thousand years. Transcending limits and broadening tolerance are appropriate to shine at this interval; restraint by small details should not be applied at this time. In the long delay of Heaven’s Mandate, the crime is on Us Your Servants. At once we build the platform stage, prepare the ritual ceremonies, select an auspicious day, clearly announce to the Vast Heavens Highest God, order the rituals of the various divinities, wait for the sacrifices to complete, gather the various bureaus at the Court Hall, discuss a Year Name, Standard Calendar, and uniform colors to put into effect, and send it up.”
Response Order said: “In the past Dà Shùn ate dried grains and wild grasses, about to do so to the end of his life ; this then was my former ambition. When he received Yáo’s abdication, he was covered in robes of furs, married [Yáo’s] two daughters, as if he intrinsically had them; this then was obeying Heaven’s Mandate. The various Excellencies and Ministers and servicemen sincerely believe Heaven’s Mandate cannot be refused, the people’s hopes cannot be disobeyed, how can I yet decline?”



相國歆、太尉詡、御史大夫朗及九卿奏曰：「臣等伏讀詔書，於邑益甚。臣等聞易稱聖人奉天時，論語云君子畏天命，天命有去就，然後帝者有禪代。是以唐之禪虞，命在爾躬，虞之順唐，謂之受終；堯知天命去己，故不得不禪舜，舜知曆數在躬，故不敢不受；不得不禪，奉天時也，不敢不受，畏天命也。漢朝雖承季末陵遲之餘，猶務奉天命以則堯之道，是以願禪帝位而歸二女。而陛下正於大魏受命之初，抑虞、夏之達節，尚延陵之讓退，而所枉者大，所直者小，所詳者輕，所略者重，中人凡士猶為陛下陋之。沒者有靈，則重華必忿憤于蒼梧之神墓，大禹必鬱悒于會稽之山陰，武王必不悅于（商）〔高〕陵之玄宮矣。是以臣等敢以死請。且漢政在閹宦，祿去帝室七世矣，遂集矢石於其宮殿，而二京為之丘墟。當是之時，四海蕩覆，天下分崩，武王親衣甲而冠冑，沐雨而櫛風，為民請命，則活萬國，為世撥亂，則致升平，鳩民而立長，築宮而置吏，元元無過，罔于前業，而始有造于華夏。陛下即位，光昭文德，以翊武功，勤恤民隱，視之如傷，懼者寧之，勞者息之，寒者以煖，飢者以充，遠人以（恩復）〔德服〕，寇敵以恩降，邁恩種德，光被四表；稽古篤睦，茂于放勛，網漏吞舟，弘乎周文。是以布政未期，人神並和，皇天則降甘露而臻四靈，后土則挺芝草而吐醴泉，虎豹鹿兔，皆素其色，雉鳩燕雀，亦白其羽，連理之木，同心之瓜，五采之魚，珍祥瑞物，雜遝於其間者，無不畢備。古人有言：『微禹，吾其魚乎！』微大魏，則臣等之白骨交橫于曠野矣。伏省群臣外內前後章奏，所以陳敘陛下之符命者，莫不條河洛之圖書，據天地之瑞應，因漢朝之款誠，宣萬方之景附，可謂信矣（省）〔著〕矣；三王無以及，五帝無以加。民命之懸於魏〔邦，民心之繫於魏〕政，三十有餘年矣，此乃千世時至之會，萬載一遇之秋；達節廣度，宜昭於斯際，拘牽小節，不施於此時。久稽天命，罪在臣等。輒營壇場，具禮儀，擇吉日，昭告昊天上帝，秩群神之禮，須禋祭畢，會群寮於朝堂，議年號、正朔、服色當施行，上。」復令曰：「昔者大舜飯糗茹草，將終身焉，斯則孤之前志也。及至承堯禪，被（珍）〔袗〕裘，妻二女，若固有之，斯則順天命也。群公卿士誠以天命不可拒，民望不可違，孤亦曷以辭焉？」




Gēngwǔ [220 Dec 10], conferment Edict on the King of Wèi said: “In the past Yáo matched Heaven in virtue, maintained the heaviness of the Six Directions, but yet observed the calculations of the calendar fates had shifted to Yǒu Yú, entrusted and yielded the Emperor’s throne as suddenly as leaving a footprint. Now Heaven has already completed our Hàn’s mandate and thus turns to look north, the enterprise of Emperors and Imperials truly on Great Wèi. We maintain an empty title to seek ancient meanings, look toward past affairs, yet have shamed virtue, and so the King has modestly declined reaching to the third and fourth, and We are afraid. One who does not decline the throne of ten thousand chariots is one who understands the Mandate and calculations of transcending limits. The lords of Yú and Xià occupied it without doubt, and therefore their accomplishments and exploits were bequeathed for ten thousand years, their beautiful reputation transmitted without end. Now send Observing Secretariat Writers Director Attendant Central [Wèi] Jì to explain, that the King is to quickly ascend the Emperor’s throne, to follow the hearts of Heaven and Humanity, and complete Our great wish.”



庚午，冊詔魏王曰：「昔堯以配天之德，秉六合之重，猶睹曆運之數，移於有虞，委讓帝位，忽如遺跡。今天既訖我漢命，乃眷北顧，帝皇之業，實在大魏。朕守空名以竊古義，顧視前事，猶有慚德，而王遜讓至于三四，朕用懼焉。夫不辭萬乘之位者，知命達節之數也，虞、夏之君，處之不疑，故勳烈垂于萬載，美名傳于無窮。今遣守尚書令侍中（顗）〔覬〕喻，王其速陟帝位，以順天人之心，副朕之大願。」




Thereupon Secretariat Writers Director Huán Jiē and others memorialized stating: “Now the Hàn clan’s mandate has already four times arrived, yet Your Majesty beginning to end firmly declined. We Your Servants in prostration believe Highest God’s bequeathing on your sagely virtue, the prosperity of the allotted fate of Great Wèi, how has it only been for a few years? The Zhuàn says that Zhōu’s possession of Heaven’s Under was not on the morning of Jiǎzǐ and Yīn’s leaving of the Emperor’s throne was not on the day of Mùyě; therefore the Shī in introducing Shāng Tāng traces his roots up to Xuán-wáng and in narrating Jī Zhōu goes up to record the birth of Hòu Jì, and so their receiving of the mandate was already assured, their virtue did not waver. The Hàn clan has declined and fallen, their transition ended and already severed, the Three Celestials bequeath their portents, the scribal offices have written the verifications, the aged elders recorded the divinations of former antiquity, the Hundred Surnames harmonize with the sound of songs and ballads. Your Majesty answers Heaven and receives the abdication, should quickly ascend the platform stage, burn sacrifices to Highest God, sincerely should not long delay the Divine Vessels and resist the wishes of the numerous millions. Your Servants at once send down to the Grand Scribe Director to select the inaugural time, that this moon’s twenty-ninth day [220 Dec 11] can be for ascending the platform to receive the mandate, and request an Edict on the kings and dukes and various ministers, and prepare articles on the ritual ceremonies in a separate memorial.”
Order said: “Permitted.”



於是尚書令桓階等奏曰：「今漢氏之命已四至，而陛下前後固辭，臣等伏以為上帝之臨聖德，期運之隆大魏，斯豈數載？傳稱周之有天下，非甲子之朝，殷之去帝位，非牧野之日也，故詩序商湯，追本玄王之至，述姬周，上錄后稷之生，是以受命既固，厥德不回。漢氏衰廢，行次已絕，三辰垂其徵，史官著其驗，耆老記先古之占，百姓協歌謠之聲。陛下應天受禪，當速即壇場，柴燎上帝，誠不宜久停神器，拒億兆之願。臣輒下太史令擇元辰，今月二十九日，可登壇受命，請詔王公群卿，具條禮儀別奏。」令曰：「可。」













[21] Xiàn-dì zhuàn states: Xīnwèi [220 Dec 11], the King of Wèi ascended the platform and received the abdication, the Excellencies and Ministers, Ranked Marquesses, various Generals, Xiōngnú Chányú, Four Yí attenders of Court, several tens of thousands of people in accompanying seats, burned sacrifices to Heaven and Earth, the Five Peaks, the Four Streams, stating: “Imperial Emperor Your Servant [Cáo] Pī dares employ Dark Bull to announce to Huáng Huáng Hòu Dì: Hàn has passed through reigns of twenty and four, tread through years of four hundred twenty and six, the Four Seas are destitute and impoverished, the Three Networks not established, the Five Latitudes interlocked in transition, ominous and auspicious signs together seen. Those employing methods of calculation, considering the ancient ways, all believe the calendar calculations of Heaven have completed phase at this generation, all the various auspicious signs and intentions of the people and divinities show clearly the end of Yǒu Hàn’s calculations completion and the signs of the Wèi House receiving the Mandate. The Hàn ruler believes the Divine Vessels should be conferred on Your Servant, following the example of Yǒu Yú, and conveys the throne to [me, Cáo] Pī. [I, Cáo] Pī tremble in fear of Heaven’s Mandate, though praised not praised. The various Excellencies and many intendants and people of the Six Affairs, outside with the officers and servicemen, reaching to the Mán-Yí chieftains, all state: ‘Heaven’s Mandate cannot be declined and refused, the Divine Vessels cannot be long neglected, the various ministers cannot be without master, the myriad tasks cannot be without governance.’ [I, Cáo] Pī respectfully serve the Imperial images, dare I not respectfully serve? Divining by tortoise shell, the omen was Dà Héng. Stalk divining by the Three Yì, the omen was the Gé omen. Solemnly selecting an Inaugural Day, with the various bureaus ascending the platform to accept the Emperor’s Ruler’s Seal and Ribbon, announcing declaration to you Great Divinity: May you of divinity accept the sacrifices and forever bless the hopes of the millions of people, blessings on Yǒu Wèi for generations to enjoy.” Therefore Regulation Edict on the Three Excellencies: “From when high antiquity first had lords, they certainly esteemed generous influence, to beautify social customs, so that the Hundred Surnames would obey teachings and that punishments and executions be set away. Now We continue the thread of Emperors and Kings, thus have Yánkāng Inaugural Year become Huángchū Inaugural Year, discuss revising the Standard Calendar, change uniform colors, distinguish insignia and titles, unify standards and measures, undertake the Earth Transition, Great Amnesty on Heaven’s Under. From the death penalty on down, all that are unsuitable to obtain pardon, all pardon and spare them.”



〔三〕　獻帝傳曰：辛未，魏王登壇受禪，公卿、列侯、諸將、匈奴單于、四夷朝者數萬人陪位，燎祭天地、五嶽、四瀆，曰：「皇帝臣丕敢用玄牡昭告于皇皇后帝：漢歷世二十有四，踐年四百二十有六，四海困窮，三綱不立，五緯錯行，靈祥並見，推術數者，慮之古道，咸以為天之曆數，運終茲世，凡諸嘉祥民神之意，比昭有漢數終之極，魏家受命之符。漢主以神器宜授於臣，憲章有虞，致位于丕。丕震畏天命，雖休勿休。群公庶尹六事之人，外及將士，洎于蠻夷君長，僉曰：『天命不可以辭拒，神器不可以久曠，群臣不可以無主，萬幾不可以無統。』丕祗承皇象，敢不欽承。卜之守龜，兆有大橫，筮之三易，兆有革兆，謹擇元日，與群寮登壇受帝璽綬，告類于爾大神；唯爾有神，尚饗永吉，兆民之望，祚于有魏世享。」遂制詔三公：「上古之始有君也，必崇恩化以美風俗，然百姓順教而刑辟厝焉。今朕承帝王之緒，其以延康元年為黃初元年，議改正朔，易服色，殊徽號，同律度量，承土行，大赦天下；自殊死以下，諸不當得赦，皆赦除之。」




Wèishì Chūnqiū states: The Emperor ascended the platform and the ritual completed, looking back he said to the various ministers: “The affairs of Shùn and Yǔ, I have experienced them.”



魏氏春秋曰：帝升壇禮畢，顧謂群臣曰：「舜、禹之事，吾知之矣。」




Gān Bǎo’s Sōushénjì states: “Sòng Grandee Xíngshǐ Zǐchén understood Heaven’s Way. Zhōu King Jìng’s Thirty-Seventh Year [483 BC], Duke Jǐng inquired stating: “Heaven’s Way has what omens?” Replied stating: “Afterward in the Fifth Year Fifth Moon Dīnghài, I Your Servant will die. After I die in the Fifth Year Fifth Moon Dīngmǎo, Wú will be destroyed. After it is destroyed in the Fifth Year, you my lord will end. After you end in four hundred years, Zhū will rule Heaven’s Under.” Eventually it was all as he said. What it says of Zhū ruling Heaven’s Under was speaking of the rise of Wèi. Zhū was of the Cáo surname, Wèi also was of the Cáo surname, both were Zhū’s posterity. The year calculation then is mistaken; it is unknown if Xíngshǐ erred in his calculation, or if the years and generations so far away that the copyists while transmitting had an error.



干竇搜神記曰：宋大夫邢史子臣明於天道，周敬王之三十七年，景公問曰：「天道其何祥？」對曰：「後五（十）年五月丁亥，臣將死；死後五年五月丁卯，吳將亡；亡後五年，君將終；終後四百年，邾王天下。」俄而皆如其言。所云邾王天下者，謂魏之興也。邾，曹姓，魏亦曹姓，皆邾之後。其年數則錯，未知邢史失其數邪，將年代久遠，注記者傳而有謬也？

title: 2  Annals of Emperor Wén
text:
Huángchū 1 - 3 (220 - 222)


Huángchū Inaugural Year, Eleventh Moon, Guǐyǒu [220 Dec 13], used ten thousand households from Hénèi’s Shānyáng city to serve the Hàn Emperor as Duke of Shānyáng, to enact Hàn’s Standard Calendar, to use the Rituals of Heaven’s Son in Suburb Sacrifices, in sending up letter to not call himself a Servant, and when the capital had affairs in Tài Temple to be delivered sacrificial meat. Enfeoffed four sons of the Duke as Ranked Marquesses. Posthumously honored the late Imperial grandfather Tài-wáng as Tài Huángdì, late father Wǔ-wáng as Wǔ Huángdì, honored the Royal Dowager Queen as Imperial Dowager Empress. Bestowed on adult males noble rank of level one, and those serving as their father’s posterity and those that were Filial-Fraternal and Diligent-Farmers level two. Appointed Hàn’s vassal kings as Esteemed Virtue Marquesses, Ranked Marquesses as Inside the Passes Marquesses. Converted Yǐngyīn’s Fányáng precinct to Fánchāng county. Enfeoffed nobles and increased ranks each on distinct basis. Changed Chancellor of State to Excellency over the Masses, Censorate Grandee to Excellency of Works, Minister of Presentations to Minister of Ceremonies, Minister of Cadets to Minister of Staff, Minister Judge to Minister of Justice, Minister Agriculturalist to Minister of Agriculture. Of the prefectures and states and counties and cities many were changed. Again conferred on the Xiōngnú Southern Chányú Hūchúquán a Wèi Ruler’s Seal and Ribbon, bestowed an Azure Canopy Chariot, carriage sedan, treasure sword, jade annulus. Twelfth Moon [221 Jan 11 – Feb 9], began construction of Luòyáng Palace, Wùwǔ [221 Jan 27], visited Luòyáng. [22]



黃初元年十一月癸酉，以河內之山陽邑萬戶奉漢帝為山陽公，行漢正朔，以天子之禮郊祭，上書不稱臣，京都有事于太廟，致胙；封公之四子為列侯。追尊皇祖太王曰太皇帝，考武王曰武皇帝，尊王太后曰皇太后。賜男子爵人一級，為父後及孝悌力田人二級。以漢諸侯王為崇德侯，列侯為關中侯。以潁陰之繁陽亭為繁昌縣。封爵增位各有差。改相國為司徒，御史大夫為司空，奉常為太常，郎中令為光祿勳，大理為廷尉，大農為大司農。郡國縣邑，多所改易。更授匈奴南單于呼廚泉魏璽綬，賜青蓋車、乘輿、寶劍、玉玦。十二月，初營洛陽宮，戊午幸洛陽。〔一〕










[22] Your Servant Sōngzhī notes: Various books record that at the time the Emperor resided in the North Palace, in Jiànshǐ Hall held Court with the various ministers, the gates called Chéngmíng. Chén King Sī [Cáo] Zhí’s poem stating “Visiting the Emperor in Chéngmíng house” was this. Reaching the time of Emperor Míng, they first at Hàn’s South Palace’s Chóngdé Hall’s location raised Tàijí and Zhāoyáng various Halls. Wèi shū states: As Xià’s calculations followed Heaven, therefore continued to use the Xià Standard, but uniform colors esteemed Yellow. Wèi lüè states: Edict believed: Hàn was the Fire Transition, Fire dreads Water, and therefore “Luò” removed “water” and added “auspicious.” Wèi in the Transition Sequence is Earth. Earth is Water’s restraint, Water on obtaining Earth thus flows, Earth obtaining Water is then movable, and therefore remove “auspicious” and add “water,” change “Luò” to “Luò.”



〔一〕　臣松之案：諸書記是時帝居北宮，以建始殿朝群臣，門曰承明，陳思王植詩曰「謁帝承明廬」是也。至明帝時，始於漢南宮崇德殿處起太極、昭陽諸殿。魏書曰：以夏數為得天，故即用夏正，而服色尚黃。魏略曰：詔以漢火行也，火忌水，故「洛」去「水」而加「佳」。魏於行次為土，土，水之牡也，水得土而乃流，土得水而柔，故除「佳」加「水」，變「雒」為「洛」。







That year, Cháng River Colonel Dài Líng remonstrated that it was not appropriate to repeatedly go shooting and hunting, the Emperor was greatly furious. [Dài] Líng was spared the death penalty by one degree.



是歲，長水校尉戴陵諫不宜數行弋獵，帝大怒；陵減死罪一等。




Second Year, Spring, Standard Moon [221 Feb 10 – Mar 10], Suburb Sacrifices to Heaven and Earth and at Míngtáng. Jiǎxū [221 Feb 12], hunted reaching to Yuánlíng, sent envoy to offer Grand Offering to sacrifice to Hàn Shìzǔ. Yǐhài [221 Feb 13], Morning Sun in the East Suburbs. [23] First ordered prefectures and states with population of at least ten thousand to each year nominate a Filial-Incorruptible [candidate] of one man; if there were any especially unusual, no restrictions based on population. Xīnsì [221 Feb 19], divided the Three Excellencies’ fiefs to enfeoff a junior relative, each one man, as a Ranked Marquess. Rénwǔ [221 Feb 20], exempted Yǐngchuān prefecture one year’s field taxes. [24] Changed Xǔ county to Xǔchāng county. Converted Wèi prefecture’s east part to Yángpíng prefecture, west part to Guǎngpíng prefecture. [25]



二年春正月，郊祀天地、明堂。甲戌，校獵至原陵，遣使者以太牢祠漢世祖。乙亥，朝日于東郊。〔一〕初令郡國口滿十萬者，歲察孝廉一人；其有秀異，無拘戶口。辛巳，分三公戶邑，封子弟各一人為列侯。壬午，復潁川郡一年田租。〔二〕改許縣為許昌縣。以魏郡東部為陽平郡，西部為廣平郡。〔三〕










[23] Your Servant Sōngzhī believes: Heaven’s Son in the Spring Equinox has the Morning Sun, in the Autumn Equinox the Evening Moon. Observing that this year’s Standard Moon Suburb Sacrifices has a moon but no date and the Yǐhài Morning Sun then a date but no moon, probably there are missing characters. Note that Emperor Míng’s Morning Sun and Evening Moon were all as in Ritual writings, and therefore one knows that these Annals are in error.



〔一〕　臣松之以為禮天子以春分朝日，秋分夕月；尋此年正月郊祀，有月無日，乙亥朝日，則有日無月，蓋文之脫也。案明帝朝日夕月，皆如禮文，故知此紀為誤者也。













[24] Wèi shū records the Edict stating: “Yǐngchuān was where the Former Emperor raised troops on campaign. In the Guāndù campaign, the Four Quarters were collapsing apart, far and near waiting and watching, but this prefecture held to righteousness, the young and strong carrying spears, the old and weak carrying grain. In the past Hàn Zǔ used Qín’s center as his state’s root, Guāng-Wǔ relied on Hénèi as his ruling foundation, now We also here ascended the platform to receive the abdication, Heaven by this prefecture assisted the completion of Great Wèi.”



〔二〕　魏書載詔曰：「潁川，先帝所由起兵征伐也。官渡之役，四方瓦解，遠近顧望，而此郡守義，丁壯荷戈，老弱負糧。昔漢祖以秦中為國本，光武恃河內為王基，今朕復於此登壇受禪，天以此郡翼成大魏。」













[25] Wèi lüè states: Changed Cháng’ān, Qiáo, Xǔchāng, Yè, Luòyáng to be the Five Capitals. Set a stone boundary, the west bordering Yíyáng, the north following the Tàiháng [mountain range], the northeast bordering Yángpíng, the south following Lǔyáng, the east bordering Tán, to define the central capital region. Ordered that those in Heaven’s Under that moved within be exempted five years [taxation and conscription], later also increased this exemption.



〔三〕　魏略曰：改長安、譙、許昌、鄴、洛陽為五都；立石表，西界宜陽，北循太行，東北界陽平，南循魯陽，東界郯，為中都之地。令天下聽內徙，復五年，後又增其復。







Edict said: “In the past Zhòngní possessed the talent of a great sage, held the capacity of Emperors and Kings, right at the end of declining Zhōu, without the fate of receiving the Mandate, was at the Courts of Lǔ and Wèi, spreading teachings above the Zhū and Sì, miserably and mournfully, hurriedly and anxiously, wishing to subdue himself to preserve the way, diminish his body to save the world. At the time of the Kings and Dukes in the end none were able to employ him, thus he withdrew and studied the rituals of five dynasties, cultivated the works of an unrecognized king, used the Lǔ shǐ to compile the Chūnqiū, met the Grand Preceptor and corrected the Yǎ and Sòng, so that after a thousand years, none do not model after his writings in narration and composition, look up to his sagacity to achieve plans. Alas! He can be called a destined great sage, a teacher and model for a hundred million years. Encountering Heaven’s Under in Great Chaos, a hundred sacrifices were abandoned and destroyed, the temple of his old residence is damaged and not repaired, the posterity of Bāochéng is cut off and not inherited. Quēlǐ does not hear the sounds of lectures and eulogies, the four seasons do not see the seats of the Zhēng and Cháng. How can this be called esteeming virtue and repaying achievement, raising the virtue that for a hundred generations must receive sacrifices? Thus appoint Consultant Cadet Kǒng Xiàn as Zōngshèng Marquess, fief of a hundred households, to provide for Kǒng-zǐ’s sacrifices.” Ordered Lǔ prefecture to repair and rebuild the old temple, install a hundred households of clerks and soldiers to maintain and guard it, and also outside expanded and built residences to house scholars.



詔曰：「昔仲尼資大聖之才，懷帝王之器，當衰周之末，無受命之運，在魯、衛之朝，教化乎洙、泗之上，悽悽焉，遑遑焉，欲屈己以存道，貶身以救世。于時王公終莫能用之，乃退考五代之禮，脩素王之事，因魯史而制春秋，就太師而正雅頌，俾千載之後，莫不宗其文以述作，仰其聖以成謀，咨！可謂命世之大聖，億載之師表者也。遭天下大亂，百祀墮壞，舊居之廟，毀而不脩，褒成之後，絕而莫繼，闕里不聞講頌之聲，四時不睹蒸嘗之位，斯豈所謂崇禮報功，盛德百世必祀者哉！其以議郎孔羨為宗聖侯，邑百戶，奉孔子祀。」令魯郡脩起舊廟，置百戶吏卒以守衛之，又於其外廣為室屋以居學者。




Third Moon [221 Apr 10 – May 9], added office to Liáodōng Administrator Gōngsūn Gōng as Chariots and Cavalry General. First restored the wǔzhū coinage. Summer, Fourth Moon [221 May 10 – Jun 7], appointed Chariots and Cavalry General Cáo Rén as General-in-Chief. Fifth Moon [221 Jun 8 – Jul 7], Zhèng Gān again rebelled, sent Cáo Rén to suppress and beheaded him. Sixth Moon [221 Jul 8 – Aug 5], Gēngzǐ [221 Jul 8], first sacrificed to the Five Peaks and Four Streams, ranked all the various sacrifices. [26] Dīngmǎo [221 Aug 4], the consort Zhēn-shì died. Wùchén [221 Aug 5], last day of the moon, the sun was eclipsed, relevant managers memorialized to dismiss the Grand Commandant. Edict said: “The appearance of disastrous and strange omens is to reprimand the leading head. To instead assign the fault to the legs and arms, how is it the righteousness of Yǔ and Tāng punishing themselves? Thus Order the hundred offices to each be reverent in their duties, and afterward if there are faults in Heaven and Earth, do not again impeach the Three Excellencies.”



（春）三月，加遼東太守公孫恭為車騎將軍。初復五銖錢。夏四月，以車騎將軍曹仁為大將軍。五月，鄭甘復叛，遣曹仁討斬之。六月庚子，初祀五嶽四瀆，咸秩群祀。〔一〕丁卯，夫人甄氏卒。戊辰晦，日有食之，有司奏免太尉，詔曰：「災異之作，以譴元首，而歸過股肱，豈禹、湯罪己之義乎？其令百官各虔厥職，後有天地之眚，勿復劾三公。」










[26] Wèi shū states: Jiǎchén [221 Jul 7], as the capital’s Ancestral Temples were not yet complete, the Emperor personally sacrificed to Wǔ Huángdì [Cáo Cāo] in Jiànshǐ Hall, personally bowing and carrying the food and libations, as in the Rituals to a family member.



〔一〕　魏書：甲辰，以京師宗廟未成，帝親祠武皇帝于建始殿，躬執饋奠，如家人之禮。







Autumn, Eighth Moon [221 Sep 5 – Oct 3], Sūn Quán sent envoy to present Response, and also sent Yú Jīn and others to return. Dīngsì [221 Sep 23], sent Minister of Ceremonies Xíng Zhēn Holding Stave to appoint [Sūn] Quán as General-in-Chief, enfeoffed as King of Wú, applied the Nine Bestowments. Winter, Tenth Moon [221 Nov 3 – Dec 1], honored Yáng Biāo as Radiant Grandee. [27] As Grain was expensive, abolished the wǔzhū coinage. [28] Jǐmǎo [221 Dec 14], General-in-Chief Cáo Rén became Marshal-in-Chief. Twelfth Moon [222 Jan 1 – Jan 29], traveled on eastern tour. That year built Língyún Terrace.



秋八月，孫權遣使奉章，并遣于禁等還。丁巳，使太常邢貞持節拜權為大將軍，封吳王，加九錫。冬十月，授楊彪光祿大夫。〔一〕以穀貴，罷五銖錢。〔二〕己卯，以大將軍曹仁為大司馬。十二月，行東巡。是歲築陵雲臺。










[27] Wèi shū states: Jǐhài [221 Nov 4], the Excellencies and Ministers held Court on the morning of the first day of the moon, together welcoming former Hàn Grand Commandant Yáng Biāo, treated with the Rituals for a guest. Edict said: “The Former Kings instituted the bestowments of table and cane, in order to use the Rituals for a guest for the yellowed and wrinkled, to honor and esteem foremost elders. In the past Kǒng Guāng and Zhuó Mào both for their admirable virtue and high years received these commendations and bestowments. Your Excellency was formerly Hàn’s foremost minister, from your ancestors onward for generations famed in reputation and integrity, your years have passed seventy and your conduct without transgressions, and can be said to be an aged and accomplished man, and should be distinctly favored to make clear your old virtues. Thus bestow on Your Excellency a Longevity Cane and Supporting Table. On days of visiting and requesting, then use the cane to enter, and you also can use deer skin headdress.” [Yáng] Biāo declined and would not listen, and indeed wore plain unlined robe and plain skin cap for meetings.
Xù Hànshū states: [Yáng] Biāo observed Hàn’s blessings were about to end, himself believed as [his family] for generations had been Three Excellencies, it would be disgraceful to be a Wèi minister, and therefore claimed leg cramps and no longer walked. After over ten years, the Emperor [Cáo Pī] ascended the King’s throne, wished to appoint him Grand Commandant, and ordered his close ministers to announce the intention. [Yáng] Biāo declined stating: “Having served the Hàn Court in the Three Excellencies, I encountered a world of decline and chaos and was not able to establish a chǐ or cùn of benefit. If I were to again be made a Wèi minister, for the selections of the state, it also would not be an honor.” The Emperor did not force his intentions. Huángchū Fourth Year [223], Edict appointed him Radiant Grandee, salaried Central Two Thousand dàn, in Court meetings seated second to the Three Excellencies, as by the precedent of Kǒng Guāng. [Yáng] Biāo sent up Response firmly declining, the Emperor did not listen, and also for his gates granted sawhorses, conveyed clerks and soldiers, to especially honor him. At eighty-four years, in the Sixth Year [225] he died.
For his son [Yáng] Xiū see Chén Sī-wáng zhuàn.



〔一〕　魏書曰：己亥，公卿朝朔旦，并引故漢太尉楊彪，待以客禮，詔曰：「夫先王制几杖之賜，所以賓禮黃耇褒崇元老也。昔孔光、卓茂皆以淑德高年，受茲嘉錫。公故漢宰臣，乃祖已來，世著名節，年過七十，行不踰矩，可謂老成人矣，所宜寵異以章舊德。其賜公延年杖及馮几；謁請之日，便使杖入，又可使著鹿皮冠。」彪辭讓不聽，竟著布單衣、皮弁以見。續漢書曰：彪見漢祚將終，自以累世為三公，恥為魏臣，遂稱足攣，不復行。積十餘年，帝即王位，欲以為太尉，令近臣宣旨。彪辭曰：「嘗以漢朝為三公，值世衰亂，不能立尺寸之益，若復為魏臣，於國之選，亦不為榮也。」帝不奪其意。黃初四年，詔拜光祿大夫，秩中二千石，朝見位次三公，如孔光故事。彪上章固讓，帝不聽，又為門施行馬，致吏卒，以優崇之。年八十四，以六年薨。子脩，事見陳思王傳。













[28] Wèi shū states: Eleventh Moon [221 Dec 2 – Dec 31], Xīnwèi [221 Dec 6], Defending West General Cáo Zhēn ordered his multitudes and officers with the provincial and prefecture soldiers to suppress and defeated the Hú [leaders] Zhìyuánduō, Lúshuǐ, Fēngshǎng and others, cutting off the heads of over fifty thousand, capturing alive a hundred thousand, sheep of one million one hundred ten thousand, cattle of eighty thousand, the Hé’s west was therefore pacified. The Emperor had previously heard that the Hú had breached the river to flood Xiǎnměi, and said to his Left and Right and various officers saying: “In the past Wěi Áo flooded Lüèyáng and so Guāng-Wǔ took advantage of his weariness and advanced soldiers to exterminate him. Now the Hú breach the river to flood Xiǎnměi, this situation is exactly in resemblance, report of defeating the Hú will now arrive before long.” In ten days, dispatch reporting the defeat of the Hú arrived, the Superior greatly laughed and said: “I strategized it within the curtains, the various officers exerted and struck across ten thousand lǐ, the mutual correspondence like fitting a tally and stave. Beginning to end in battle successes and capturing of caitiffs, there has never been any like this.”



〔二〕　魏書曰：十一月辛未，鎮西將軍曹真命眾將及州郡兵討破叛胡治元多、盧水、封賞等，斬首五萬餘級，獲生口十萬，羊一百一十一萬口，牛八萬，河西遂平。帝初聞胡決水灌顯美，謂左右諸將曰：「昔隗囂灌略陽，而光武因其疲弊，進兵滅之。今胡決水灌顯美，其事正相似，破胡事今至不久。」旬日，破胡告檄到，上大笑曰：「吾策之於帷幕之內，諸將奮擊於萬里之外，其相應若合符節。前後戰克獲虜，未有如此也。」







Third Year, Spring, Standard Moon [222 Jan 30 – Feb 28], Bǐngyín [222 Jan 30], first day of the moon, the sun was eclipsed. Gēngwǔ [221 Feb 3], traveled to visit Xǔchāng Palace. Edict said: “The calculations and filial of the present are the tribute of servicemen of antiquity. ‘In a town of ten households, certainly there are those of loyalty and faith.’ If there is a limitation by age and only afterward a seeking of servicemen, then Lǚ Shàng and Zhōu Jìn would not have been famed in previous generations. Thus Order that the prefectures and states in their selections are not to be constrained by old age or youth. Classicists who understand the classics and arts, clerks who comprehend literature and law, on arriving are all to be tested in employment. Relevant managers are to investigate and cite those not genuine.” [29]



三年春正月丙寅朔，日有蝕之。庚午，行幸許昌宮。詔曰：「今之計、（考）〔孝〕，古之貢士也；十室之邑，必有忠信，若限年然後取士，是呂尚、周晉不顯於前世也。其令郡國所選，勿拘老幼；儒通經術，吏達文法，到皆試用。有司糾故不以實者。」〔一〕










[29] Wèi shū states: Guǐhài, Sūn Quán sent up letter to explain: “Liú Bèi’s branch faction of forty thousand men, horses of two to three thousand, have set out Zǐguī. I request to go sweep them away, to use victory as my contribution.” The Emperor’s reply said: “In the past in Wěi Áo’s destruction, the disaster came from Xúnyì, in [Gōngsūn Shù] Zǐyáng’s capture, the change rose at Hàn’guān. General, you will exert yourself to raise military power, strive to enact exceptional achievements, to accord with my intentions.”



〔一〕　魏書曰：癸亥，孫權上書，說：「劉備支黨四萬人，馬二三千匹，出秭歸，請往掃撲，以克捷為效。」帝報曰：「昔隗囂之弊，禍發栒邑，子陽之禽，變起扞關，將軍其亢厲威武，勉蹈奇功，以稱吾意。」







Second Moon [222 Mar 1 – Mar 29], the Shànshàn, Qiūcí, and Yútián Kings each sent envoys to present tribute. Edict said: “The Western Róng submitting to obedience, the Dī and Qiāng coming to the King, the Shī and Shū eulogized these. Recently the Western Regions outer Yí together thumped at the passes to inwardly submit, [30] thus send envoys to show appreciation for their labors.” From this afterward the Western Regions were therefore connected, installed a Wùjǐ Colonel.



二月，鄯善、龜茲、于闐王各遣使奉獻，詔曰：「西戎即敘，氐、羌來王，詩、書美之。頃者西域外夷並款塞內附，〔一〕其遣使者撫勞之。」是後西域遂通，置戊己校尉。










[30] Yīng Shào’s Hàn shū zhù states: Thumped is knocked. All knocked at the pass gates to come submit to obedience.



〔一〕　應劭漢書注曰：款，叩也；皆叩塞門來服從。







Third Moon [222 Mar 30 – Apr 28], Yǐchǒu [222 Mar 30], enthroned the Duke of Qí [Cáo] Ruì as King of Píngyuán, and the Emperor’s younger brothers the Duke of Yānlíng [Cáo] Zhāng and others of eleven men all as Kings. First set the system of enfeoffing the King’s non-successor sons as Dukes of villages, successor King’s non-successor sons as Marquesses of precincts, Duke’s non-successor sons as Earls of precincts. Jiǎxū [222 Apr 8], enthroned Imperial son [Cáo] Lín as King of Hédōng. Jiǎwǔ [222 Apr 28], traveled to visit Xiāngyì.
Summer, Fourth Moon [222 Apr 29 – May 27], Wùshēn [222 May 12], enthroned the Marquess of Juànchéng [Cáo] Zhí as King of Juànchéng. Guǐhài [222 May 27], traveled to return to Xǔchāng Palace.
Fifth Moon [222 May 28 – June 26], used Jīng’s and Yáng’s eight prefectures beyond the Jiāng to form Jīng Province, in order to designate Sūn Quán as its Governor; Jīng Province’s various prefectures north of the Jiāng became Yǐng Province.



三月乙丑，立齊公叡為平原王，帝弟鄢陵公彰等十一人皆為王。初制封王之庶子為鄉公，嗣王之庶子為亭侯，公之庶子為亭伯。甲戌，立皇子霖為河東王。甲午，行幸襄邑。夏四月戊申，立鄄城侯植為鄄城王。癸亥，行還許昌宮。五月，以荊、揚、江表八郡為荊州，孫權領牧故也；荊州江北諸郡為郢州。




Intercalary Moon [222 July 26 – Aug 24], Sūn Quán defeated Liú Bèi at Yílíng. Previously, the Emperor had heard that [Liú] Bèi’s troops had gone east downstream, with [Sūn] Quán engaging in battle, planting fences to link camps over seven hundred lǐ, and said to the various ministers: “[Liú] Bèi does not understand warfare. How can camps spread seven hundred lǐ be able to repel an enemy? Those who position their armies in vegetation and marshes and difficult terrain will be taken by the enemy. This is what warfare dreads. Sūn Quán sending up report will now arrive.” Seven days later, letter of defeating [Liú] Bèi arrived.



閏月，孫權破劉備于夷陵。初，帝聞備兵東下，與權交戰，樹柵連營七百餘里，謂群臣曰：「備不曉兵，豈有七百里營可以拒敵者乎！『苞原隰險阻而為軍者為敵所禽』，此兵忌也。孫權上事今至矣。」後七日，破備書到。




Autumn, Seventh Moon [222 Aug 25 – Sep 23], Jì Province great locusts outbreak, the people starved, sent Secretariat Writer Dù Jī Holding Stave to open the granaries to relieve them.
Eighth Moon [222 Sep 24 – Oct 22], Shǔ chief officer Huáng Quán led his multitudes to surrender. [31]



秋七月，冀州大蝗，民饑，使尚書杜畿持節開倉廩以振之。八月，蜀大將黃權率眾降。〔一〕










[31] Wèi shū states: [Huáng] Quán with designate Nán prefecture Administrator Shǐ Hé and others of three hundred eighteen people went to the Jīng Province Inspector to present up their false seals and ribbons, tallies and halberds, banners and flags, ivory gates, and drum chariots. [Huáng] Quán and the rest went to visit where [Cáo Pī] was traveling, the Emperor set alcohol and posted musicians, summoning them to meet at Chéngguāng Hall. [Huáng] Quán, [Shǐ] Hé and the rest person by person advanced to introduce themselves, the Emperor with them discussed and conversed on the determination of army success or failure and leaving or arriving, of the various officers none were not pleased. Bestowed on [Huáng] Quán gold and silk, chariots and horses, robes and furs, curtains and tents, wives and concubines, down reaching to the Auxiliary and Supplemental [Generals], all on distinct basis. Appointed [Huáng] Quán as Attendant Central, Defending South General, enfeoffed a Ranked Marquess, and that day summoned and sent him a carriage of four horses; also enfeoffed Shǐ Hé and others of forty-two men all as Ranked Marquesses, those that became Generals or Cadet Generals were over a hundred men.



〔一〕　魏書曰：權及領南郡太守史郃等三百一十八人，詣荊州刺史奉上所假印綬、棨戟、幢麾、牙門、鼓車。權等詣行在所，帝置酒設樂，引見于承光殿。權、郃等人人前自陳，帝為論說軍旅成敗去就之分，諸將無不喜悅。賜權金帛、車馬、衣裘、帷帳、妻妾，下及偏裨皆有差。拜權為侍中鎮南將軍，封列侯，即日召使驂乘；及封史郃等四十二人皆為列侯，為將軍郎將百餘人。







Ninth Moon [222 Oct 23 – Nov 21], Jiǎwǔ [222 Oct 25], Edict said: “Women participating in government is the root of chaos. From now on afterward, the various ministers are not to memorialize affairs to the Dowager Empress, the families of the empress’s clan are not to hold appointments of assisting in governing, and also are not to unreasonably receive noble ranks of reeds and soil. Have this Edict passed to later generations. If there are violations, Heaven’s Under is to together punish it.” [32] Gēngzǐ [222 Oct 31], enthroned as Imperial Empress Guō-shì. Bestowed on Heaven’s Under’s adult males noble ranks at level two, on widowers and widowed and the seriously incapacitated and the poor and unable to support themselves bestowed grain.



九月甲午，詔曰：「夫婦人與政，亂之本也。自今以後，群臣不得奏事太后，后族之家不得當輔政之任，又不得橫受茅土之爵；以此詔傳後世，若有背違，天下共誅之。」〔一〕庚子，立皇后郭氏。賜天下男子爵人二級；鰥寡篤癃及貧不能自存者賜穀。










[32] Sūn Shèng states: The administering of states and managing of governance certainly relies on the support of the eminent and wise, worthy transcendence and good virtue must reside in appointments of participating in governance. Therefore, even in the flourishing of the Zhōu House, there were women participating. In that case, the Earthly way supports Heaven, those facing south are not two, the courtesy of the Three Followings is called as utmost compliance. As for commanding orders through Heaven’s Son, controlling the enactment of memorialized affairs, these are not of the ancient principles. In the past Shēn and Lǚ truly rectified Yǒu Zhōu. If one takes Heaven’s Under as heart and only virtue is used, then in the conferment of the close or the distant, utmost impartiality is universal, and why must one reach to the Empress’s clan and necessarily expel and distance them? In the final reigns of the Two Hàn, the king’s way had declined, and therefore caused the in-law relations to rely on favor to hold office and disorder rankings. At these times of confusing ways and decline, the fated blessings about to shift, even if there are no troubles of Wáng or Lǚ, how is there a lack of disasters of Tián and Zhào? But if later generations observe things like this, they will deeply consider the warnings of toxic poisons. As for Wèi Wén [Cáo Pī], he then issued an Edict without exceptions, it can be said to be the blunt words of one having knowledge, not the profound considerations of an Emperor.”



〔一〕　孫盛曰：夫經國營治，必憑俊哲之輔，賢達令德，必居參亂之任，故雖周室之盛，有婦人與焉。然則坤道承天，南面罔二，三從之禮，謂之至順，至於號令自天子出，奏事專行，非古義也。昔在申、呂，實匡有周。苟以天下為心，惟德是杖，則親疏之授，至公一也，何至后族而必斥遠之哉？二漢之季世，王道陵遲，故令外戚憑寵，職為亂階。（於）此自時昏道喪，運祚將移，縱無王、呂之難，豈乏田、趙之禍乎？而後世觀其若此，深懷酖毒之戒也。至于魏文，遂發一概之詔，可謂有識之爽言，非帝者之宏議。







Winter, Tenth Moon [222 Nov 22 – Dec 20] Jiǎzǐ [222 Nov 24], specified Shǒuyáng mountain’s east as his funerary tomb, composed the Final Regulations stating: “By Ritual, when the state’s lord ascends the throne he makes his ellipse [33] to while living not forget death. [34] In the past Yáo was buried at Gǔlín, completely covered by the trees; Yǔ was buried at Kuàijī, the farmers did not change fields. [35] Therefore burial in mountains and woods then is to merge with the mountains and woods. The systems of mounds and trees is not of high antiquity, I will not have it. The funerary tomb will use the mountain as body, without mound or trees, without establishment of a Resting Hall, building of Park Village, or connecting of a Spirit Road. To bury is to hide, to wish people be unable to see. Bones are without awareness of pain or itch; burial mounds are not the residence of an inhabiting spirit. Ritual is to not offer sacrifices at the grave, wishing for the surviving and the perished to not be desecrated. Make the coffin and casing sufficient to decay the bones, the burial clothes sufficient to decay the flesh and nothing more. Therefore I build at this land of desolate hills without food, wishing that after a change in dynasties that none know its location. Do not apply reeds and ash, do not store gold or silver or copper or iron, entirely use pottery, in accordance with the meaning of the clay chariots and straw effigies of antiquity. The coffin is only to lacquer the juncture meetings in three passes, the mouth is not to contain pearls or jade, do not apply pearl jacket or jade casing; these all are the doings of foolish and crude customs . When the Jìsūn used jade gems in burial, Kǒng-zǐ went up the steps and rescued the situation, describing it as exposing the body in the central plains. When the Duke of Sòng was lavishly buried, noble men said Huà Yuán and Yuè Jǔ were not proper servants, believing it abandoning their lord to evil. That Hàn Emperor Wén was not excavated was because Bàlíng had nothing to seek. That Guāng-Wǔ was dug up was because Yuánlíng had mound and trees. In the preservation of Bàlíng, the achievement was on [Zhāng] Shìzhī. In the digging up of Yuánlíng, the crime was on [Hàn] Emperor Míng. It was [Zhāng] Shìzhī’s loyalty that benefited his lord, Emperor Míng’s love that harmed his parent. A loyal servant and filial son should think of the words of Zhòngní, [Zuǒ] Qiūmíng, [Zhāng] Shìzhī, and reflect on the warnings of Huà Yuán, Yuè Jǔ, Emperor Míng. Preservation is how to secure lord and settle parent, to enable the soul for ten thousand years to be without danger; this then is the loyalty and filial piety of worthies and sages. From antiquity to the present, there has never been a state that did not perish, and also no grave that was not dug up. From since the death and chaos onward, of the Hàn clan’s various tombs none were not excavated and dug up, going as far as to burn to extract the jade cases and gold threads, the skeletal bones completely destroyed. This punishment of burning, how is it not a heavy sorrow? The disaster comes from lavish burial and mounds and trees. ‘Sāng and Huò are my warnings,’ is it not also clear? As for the Imperial Empress and Noble Ladies on down, for those that accompany a king to their state, on death all are to be buried to the mountain stream’s west, previously also having specified the location. Probably when Shùn was buried at Cāngwú, his two consorts did not accompany him. Yánlíng buried his son far away at Yíng and Bó. If the soul has awareness, nowhere it cannot reach. The separation of one mountain stream is not enough to be considered far away. If there is violation of the present Edict, rashly making any changes or revisions in the construction or implementation, I will be killed and desecrated below the ground, killed and yet again killed, dead and yet again dead. A servant or son who disregards their dead lord or father is not loyal and not filial. If the dead have awareness they will not bless you. Thus have this Edict stored in the Ancestral Temple, copies in the Secretariat Writers, Confidential Writers, and Three Offices.”



冬十月甲子，表首陽山東為壽陵，作終制曰：「禮，國君即位為椑，〔一〕存不忘亡也。〔二〕昔堯葬穀林，通樹之，禹葬會稽，農不易畝，〔三〕故葬於山林，則合乎山林。封樹之制，非上古也，吾無取焉。壽陵因山為體，無為封樹，無立寢殿，造園邑，通神道。夫葬也者，藏也，欲人之不得見也。骨無痛痒之知，冢非棲神之宅，禮不墓祭，欲存亡之不黷也，為棺槨足以朽骨，衣衾足以朽肉而已。故吾營此丘墟不食之地，欲使易代之後不知其處。無施葦炭，無藏金銀銅鐵，一以瓦器，合古塗車、芻靈之義。棺但漆際會三過，飯含無以珠玉，無施珠襦玉匣，諸愚俗所為也。季孫以璵璠斂，孔子歷級而救之，譬之暴骸中原。宋公厚葬，君子謂華元、樂莒不臣，以為棄君於惡。漢文帝之不發，霸陵無求也；光武之掘，原陵封樹也。霸陵之完，功在釋之；原陵之掘，罪在明帝。是釋之忠以利君，明帝愛以害親也。忠臣孝子，宜思仲尼、丘明、釋之之言，鑒華元、樂莒、明帝之戒，存於所以安君定親，使魂靈萬載無危，斯則賢聖之忠孝矣。自古及今，未有不亡之國，亦無不掘之墓也。喪亂以來，漢氏諸陵無不發掘，至乃燒取玉匣金縷，骸骨并盡，是焚如之刑，豈不重痛哉！禍由乎厚葬封樹。『桑、霍為我戒』，不亦明乎？其皇后及貴人以下，不隨王之國者，有終沒皆葬澗西，前又以表其處矣。蓋舜葬蒼梧，二妃不從，延陵葬子，遠在嬴、博，魂而有靈，無不之也，一澗之閒，不足為遠。若違今詔，妄有所變改造施，吾為戮尸地下，戮而重戮，死而重死。臣子為蔑死君父，不忠不孝，使死者有知，將不福汝。其以此詔藏之宗廟，副在尚書、祕書、三府。」










[33] Ellipse [bì] is pronounced Fú and Lì together.



〔一〕椑音扶歷反。













[34] Your Servant Sōngzhī notes: By Ritual, the coffins of Heaven’s Son and vassal lords each have multiple layers. The coffin closest to the body is called the ellipse.



〔二〕　臣松之按：禮，天子諸侯之棺，各有重數；棺之親身者曰椑。













[35] Lǚshì Chūnqiū: Yáo was buried at Gǔlín, completely covered by the trees; Shùn was buried at Jì, the market places did not change their shops; Yǔ was buried at Kuàijī, not changing the people’s walking.



〔三〕　呂氏春秋：堯葬于穀林，通樹之；舜葬于紀，市廛不變其肆；禹葬會稽，不變人徒。







That Moon, Sūn Quán again rebelled. Reverted Yǐng Province to Jīng Province. The Emperor from Xǔchāng campaigned south, the various armies and soldiers together advanced, [Sūn] Quán overlooked the Jiāng to resist and defend.
Eleventh Moon [222 Dec 21 – 223 Jan 19], Xīnchŏu [222 Dec 31], traveled to visit Wǎn. Gēngshēn [223 Jan 19], the last day of the moon, the sun was eclipsed.
That year, dug Língzhī pond.



是月，孫權復叛。復郢州為荊州。帝自許昌南征，諸軍兵並進，權臨江拒守。十一月辛丑，行幸宛。庚申晦，日有食之。是歲，穿靈芝池。

title: 2  Annals of Emperor Wén
text:
Huángchū 4 - 6 (223 - 225)


Fourth Year, Spring, Standard Moon [223 Feb 18 – Mar 19], Edict said: “Since the death and chaos onward, weapons and armor are not yet put away, the people of Heaven’s Under killing one another. Now Within the Seas is beginning to be settled, anyone that dares take private revenge will all be clan exterminated.” Built Nánxún Terrace at Wǎn. Third Moon [223 Apr 18 – May 17], Bǐngshēn [223 Apr 25], traveled from Wǎn back to Luòyáng Palace. Guǐmǎo [223 May 2], the moon crossed Xīn’s center large star. [36] Dīngwèi [223 May 6], Marshal-in-Chief Cáo Rén died. That moon, great plague.



四年春正月，詔曰：「喪亂以來，兵革未戢，天下之人，互相殘殺。今海內初定，敢有私復讎者皆族之。」築南巡臺于宛。三月丙申，行自宛還洛陽宮。癸卯，月犯心中央大星。〔一〕丁未，大司馬曹仁薨。是月大疫。










[36] Wèi shū records the Bǐngwǔ [223 May 5] Edict stating: “Sūn Quán oppresses and harms the people, We believe banditry cannot [be allowed to] spread, and therefore separately mandated fierce officers on three roads to together campaign. Now the Campaigning East various armies with [Sūn] Quán’s faction’s Lǚ Fàn and others battled on the rivers, then cutting off heads of forty thousand, capturing boats of ten thousand. The Marshal-in-Chief occupies and defends Rúxū, those killed and captured also in the tens of thousands. The Central Army and Campaigning South attack and besiege Jiānglíng, Left General Zhāng Hé and others on sterns and bows directly cross, striking their southern islets, the rebels that fled into the rivers and drowned to death were several thousand men. Also making tunnels to attack the city, inside and outside the city sparrows and mice are not able to exit or enter, this is only served up meat on a table! But among the rebels there is plague and disease, spreading on both sides of the Jiāng and smearing the ground, and one fears cross-contamination. In the past Zhōu Wǔ attacked Yīn and turned back the brigades at Mèngjīn, Hàn Zǔ campaigned against Wěi Áo and returned the army to Gāopíng, both understanding Heaven’s timing and measuring the enemy’s condition. Moreover Chéng Tāng opened three sides of a net and Heaven’s Under submitted to the benevolence. Now lift the siege of Jiānglíng, to delay the taking of the already dead. For the time being rest the labor campaigns, cease and reduce conscription and garrisons, nurture and raise the servicemen and civilians, have all securely rest.”



〔一〕　魏書載丙午詔曰：「孫權殘害民物，朕以寇不可長，故分命猛將三道並征。今征東諸軍與權黨呂範等水戰，則斬首四萬，獲船萬艘。大司馬據守濡須，其所禽獲亦以萬數。中軍、征南，攻圍江陵，左將軍張郃等舳艫直渡，擊其南渚，賊赴水溺死者數千人，又為地道攻城，城中外雀鼠不得出入，此几上肉耳！而賊中癘氣疾病，夾江塗地，恐相染污。昔周武伐殷，旋師孟津，漢祖征隗囂，還軍高平，皆知天時而度賊情也。且成湯解三面之網，天下歸仁。今開江陵之圍，以緩成死之禽。且休力役，罷省繇戍，畜養士民，咸使安息。」







Summer, Fifth Moon [223 June 16 – July 15], there were pelican birds gathering at Língzhī pond. Edict said: “This is what the poets called ‘dirtied marsh,’ the Cáo ode’s criticizing Duke Gōng as distancing from noble men and drawing close to petty men. Now are there worthy and wise servicemen occupying low positions? If not, then why did the birds arrive? Thus broadly nominate Heaven’s Under’s eminent and virtuous abundant talents and solitary noble men, to answer the Cáo men’s criticism.” [37]



夏五月，有鵜鶘鳥集靈芝池，詔曰：「此詩人所謂污澤也。曹詩『刺恭公遠君子而近小人』，今豈有賢智之士處於下位乎？否則斯鳥何為而至？其博舉天下雋德茂才、獨行君子，以答曹人之刺。」〔一〕










[37] Wèi shū states: Xīnyǒu [223 Jul 19], relevant managers memorialized to construct two temples, to establish Tài Huángdì [Cáo Sōng] Temple, with the Chief Prolonging Autumn Specially Advanced Marquess [Cáo Téng] and the great-great-grandfather [Cáo Mēng] in combined sacrifices, and when degree of relation was exhausted to demolish in order, and to specially establish Wǔ Huángdì Temple, in the four seasons enjoying sacrifices, as Wèi Tàizǔ, for ten thousand years to not be demolished.



〔一〕　魏書曰：辛酉，有司奏造二廟，立太皇帝廟，大長秋特進侯與高祖合祭，親盡以次毀；特立武皇帝廟，四時享祀，為魏太祖，萬載不毀也。







Sixth Moon [223 July 16 – Aug 13], Jiǎxū [223 Aug 1], the King of Rènchéng [Cáo] Zhāng died in the capital. Jiǎshēn [223 Aug 11], Grand Commandant Jiǎ Xǔ died. Tàibái during daytime was seen. That moon heavy rain, the Yī and Luò overflowed, killing people and destroying houses. [38] Autumn, Eighth Moon [223 Sep 13 – Oct 11], Dīngmǎo [223 Sep 23], appointed Minister of Justice Zhōng Yáo as Grand Commandant. [39] Xīnwèi [223 Sep 27], inspection hunt at Xíngyáng, then toured the east. Discussed the achievements of the campaign against Sūn Quán, the various officers on down were advanced in noble rank and increased in fief revenue each on distinct basis. Ninth Moon [223 Oct 12 – Nov 10], Jiǎchén [223 Oct 30], traveled to visit Xǔchāng Palace. [40]



六月甲戌，任城王彰薨於京都。甲申，太尉賈詡薨。太白晝見。是月大雨，伊、洛溢流，殺人民，壞廬宅。〔一〕秋八月丁卯，以廷尉鍾繇為太尉。〔二〕辛未，校獵于滎陽，遂東巡。論征孫權功，諸將已下進爵增戶各有差。九月甲辰，行幸許昌宮。〔三〕










[38] Wèi shū states: Seventh Moon [223 Aug 14 – Sep 12], Yǐwèi [223 Aug 22], the main army was about to set out, sent the Minister of Ceremonies with bull ox of one to report and sacrifice in the suburbs.
Your Servant Sōngzhī notes: Within a memorial on Wèi’s Suburb Sacrifices, Secretariat Writer Lú Yù commented on sacrifices for matters of danger and calamity saying: “Furnish sacrificial animal and sacrificial vessels, like in the ritual of the beginning to end brigades setting out being reported in the suburbs.” According to this, then when the Wèi dynasty sent out the brigades all were reported in the suburbs.



〔一〕　魏書曰：七月乙未，大軍當出，使太常以特牛一告祠于郊。臣松之按：魏郊祀奏中，尚書盧毓議祀厲殃事云：「具犧牲祭器，如前後師出告郊之禮。」如此，則魏氏出師，皆告郊也。













[39] Wèi shū states: Relevant managers memorialized to revise the Hàn dynasty’s Ancestral Temple’s Ānshì Music to Zhèngshì Music, Jiāzhì Music to Yínglíng Music, Wǔdé Music to Wǔsòng Music, Zhāoróng Music to Zhāoyè Music, Yúnqiáo Dance to Fèngxiáng Dance, Yùmìng Dance to Língyīng Dance, Wǔdé Dance to Wǔsòng Dance, Wénshǐ Dance to Dàsháo Dance, Wǔxíng Dance to Dàwǔ Dance.



〔二〕　魏書曰：有司奏改漢氏宗廟安世樂曰正世樂，嘉至樂曰迎靈樂，武德樂曰武頌樂，昭容樂曰昭業樂，雲（翻）〔翹〕舞曰鳳翔舞，育命舞曰靈應舞，武德舞曰武頌舞，文（昭）〔始〕舞曰大（昭）〔韶〕舞，五行舞曰大武舞。













[40] Wèi shū states: Twelfth Moon [224 Jan 9 – 224 Feb 7], Bǐngyín [224 Jan 20], bestowed on the Duke of Shānyáng’s consort [Cáo Jié] Tāngmùyì and the Duke’s daughter [Liú] Màn as Chánglè prefecture Princess, fief of each five hundred households. That winter, Sweet Dew fell in Fānglín Garden.
Your Servant Sōngzhī notes: Fānglín Garden is the present Huálín Garden. When the King of Qí [Cáo] Fāng succeeded the throne, it was changed to Huálín.



〔三〕　魏書曰：十二月丙寅，賜山陽公夫人湯沐邑，公女曼為長樂郡公主，食邑各五百戶。是冬，甘露降芳林園。臣松之按：芳林園即今華林園，齊王芳即位，改為華林。







Fifth Year, Spring, Standard Moon [224 Feb 8 – Mar 7], first ordered that only for cases of plotting treason and great rebellion would there be permission to report on one another, all other cases would not be heard and judged; any that dared falsely report on another would be punished by the accused crime. Third Moon [224 Apr 7 – May 5], traveled from Xǔchāng back to Luòyáng Palace. Summer, Fourth Moon [224 May 6 – Jun 4], established the Grand Academy, set the methods for the courses and examinations on the Five Classics, installed Chūnqiū Gǔliáng Academic Scholars. Fifth Moon [224 June 5 – Jul 3], relevant managers believed as the Excellencies and Ministers held Court on the first days of the new moons they should take advantage to memorialize on doubtful affairs, listen and judge on great governance, discuss and distinguish gains and losses. Autumn, Seventh Moon [224 Aug 3 – Aug 31], traveled on eastern tour, visited Xǔchāng Palace. Eighth Moon [224 Sep 1 – Sep 30], made a navy, personally rode dragon boat, followed the Cài and Yǐng, sailed the Huái, visited Shòuchūn. Yáng Province’s border officers and clerks and servicemen and civilians that had violations of five years punishment on down were all pardoned and released. Ninth Moon [224 Oct 1 – Oct 29], therefore reached Guǎnglíng, amnesty on Qīng and Xú two provinces, changed and replaced the various officers and administrators. Winter, Tenth Moon [224 Oct 30 – Nov 28], Yǐmǎo [224 Nov 4], Tàibái during daytime seen. Traveled back to Xǔchāng Palace. [41] Eleventh Moon [224 Nov 29 – Dec 27], Gēngyín [224 Dec 9], because Jì Province was in famine, sent envoys to open the granaries to relieve them. Wùshēn [224 Dec 27], last day of the moon, the sun was eclipsed.



五年春正月，初令謀反大逆乃得相告，其餘皆勿聽治；敢妄相告，以其罪罪之。三月，行自許昌還洛陽宮。夏四月，立太學，制五經課試之法，置春秋穀梁博士。五月，有司以公卿朝朔望日，因奏疑事，聽斷大政，論辨得失。秋七月，行東巡，幸許昌宮。八月，為水軍，親御龍舟，循蔡、潁，浮淮，幸壽春。揚州界將吏士民，犯五歲刑已下，皆原除之。九月，遂至廣陵，赦青、徐二州，改易諸將守。冬十月乙卯，太白晝見。行還許昌宮。〔一〕十一月庚寅，以冀州饑，遣使者開倉廩振之。戊申晦，日有食之。










[41] Wèi shū records the Guǐyǒu [224 Nov 22] Edict stating: “If the near are not soothed, how can the far be embraced? Now tasks are many but the people are few, above and below use written law to damage one another, the Hundred Surnames have no way to use their hands and feet. In the past the weeper at Tàishān believed that an oppressive government was more ferocious than tigers. I am equipped with the airs of the classicists, submit to the remnant teachings of the sages, how can I amuse my eyes with their words but yet in conduct violate their prohibitions? Widely discuss lightening punishments, to give kindness to the Hundred Surnames.”



〔一〕　魏書載癸酉詔曰：「近之不綏，何遠之懷？今事多而民少，上下相弊以文法，百姓無所措其手足。昔太山之哭者，以為苛政甚于猛虎，吾備儒者之風，服聖人之遺教，豈可以目翫其辭，行違其誡者哉？廣議輕刑，以惠百姓。」







Twelfth Moon [224 Dec 28 – 225 Jan 26], Edict said: “The Former Kings regulated Ritual, in order to manifest filial piety and serve the ancestors, the largest then were the Suburb and Altars, the next the Ancestral Temples, the Three Celestials and Five Transitions, the famed mountains and great rivers. Those not of this kind are not in the sacrificial canon. In the final eras of decline and chaos, there is veneration and faith in witchcraft and seers, reaching into the Palace Halls and among the doors and windows, none are not flooded in libations, so extreme is the confusion. From now on, those that dare set offerings for improper sacrifices or speak of witchcraft prayers, all are to be arrested for deviant ways and theories. Make this known in orders and law.” That year dug Tiānyuān pond.



十二月，詔曰：「先王制禮，所以昭孝事祖，大則郊社，其次宗廟，三辰五行，名山大川，非此族也，不在祀典。叔世衰亂，崇信巫史，至乃宮殿之內，戶牖之閒，無不沃酹，甚矣其惑也。自今，其敢設非祀之祭，巫祝之言，皆以執左道論，著于令典。」是歲穿天淵池。




Sixth Year, Spring, Second Moon [225 Feb 25 – Mar 26], sent envoys to travel from Xǔchāng on east thoroughly to Pèi prefecture, to inquire the people of their pains and sufferings, and give support and loans to the poor. [42] Third Moon [225 Mar 27 – Apr 25], traveled to visit Shàolíng, connected Tǎolǔ Canal. Yǐsì [Apr 23], returned to Xǔchāng Palace. Bìng Province Inspector Liáng Xí suppressed the Xiānbēi [chieftain] Kē Bĭnéng, greatly defeated him. Xīnwèi, the Emperor made navy on eastern campaign. Fifth Moon [225 Jun 24 – Jul 22], Wùshēn [225 Jun 25], visited Qiáo. Rénxū [225 Jul 9], Yínghuò entered Tàiwēi.



六年春二月，遣使者循行許昌以東盡沛郡，問民所疾苦，貧者振貸之。〔一〕三月，行幸召陵，通討虜渠。乙巳，還許昌宮。并州刺史梁習討鮮卑軻比能，大破之。辛未，帝為舟師東征。五月戊申，幸譙。壬戌，熒惑入太微。










[42] Wèi lüè records the Edict stating: “In the past Xuānyuán established titles on four sides, Zhōu Wǔ said: ‘I have governing officials of ten men.’ These probably were how the former sages systemized the state and ruled the people, brightened and achieved Heaven’s labors, treated having many worthies as nobility. Now the interior has the Excellencies and Ministers to defend the capital, the exterior establishes Governors and Earls to supervise the Four Quarters. As for the primary army going out on campaign, then the army’s center should also have the stone pillar of a worthy commander, and where the heavy supplies are located also should have an important minister to defend and maintain, and only then afterward the Chariot Carriage can travel around Heaven’s Under without worrying of the interior or exterior. I now will campaign against rebels, and wish to maintain this for accumulated years. Thus appoint the Secretariat Writers Director and Marquess of Yǐng village Chén Qún as Defending Army General-in-Chief and the Secretariat Writers Deputy-Director and Marquess of Xī village Sīmǎ Yì as Succoring Army General-in-Chief. If I overlook the Jiāng to confer on the various officers policies and strategies, then the Succoring Army will remain at Xǔchāng to command the rear’s various armies and manage the rear Terrace’s written document affairs, and the Defending Army will accompany the Chariot Carriage to direct and command the multitudes and armies and manage the traveling Secretariat Writers affairs. Both are Lent Staves and drums and horns, given Central Army soldiers and cavalry of six hundred men. I wish to build Palace Residences several lǐ from the Jiāng, go back and forth from it, and on seeing an appearance of when the rebels can be struck, to then send out surprise troops to strike them, and if perhaps they cannot [be struck], then I will deploy the Six Armies with hunting expeditions, feast and bestow on the army servicemen.”



〔一〕　魏略載詔曰：「昔軒轅建四面之號，周武稱『予有亂臣十人』，斯蓋先聖所以體國君民，亮成天工，多賢為貴也。今內有公卿以鎮京師，外設牧伯以監四方，至於元戎出征，則軍中宜有柱石之賢帥，輜重所在，又宜有鎮守之重臣，然後車駕可以周行天下，無內外之慮。吾今當征賊，欲守之積年。其以尚書令潁鄉侯陳群為鎮軍大將軍，尚書僕射西鄉侯司馬懿為撫軍大將軍。若吾臨江授諸將方略，則撫軍當留許昌，督後諸軍，錄後臺文書事；鎮軍隨車駕，當董督眾軍，錄行尚書事；皆假節鼓吹，給中軍兵騎六百人。吾欲去江數里，築宮室，往來其中，見賊可擊之形，便出奇兵擊之；若或未可，則當舒六軍以遊獵，饗賜軍士。」







Sixth Moon [225 Jul 23 – Aug 21], Lìchéng prefecture soldier Cài Fāng and others with the prefecture rebelled, killing Administrator Xú Zhì. Sent Garrison Cavalry Colonel Rén Fú and Infantry Colonel Duàn Zhāo with the Qīng Province Inspector to suppress and pacified them. Those that had met with coercion and those that had deserted were all pardoned for their crimes.



六月，利成郡兵蔡方等以郡反，殺太守徐質。遣屯騎校尉任福、步兵校尉段昭與青州刺史討平之；其見脅略及亡命者，皆赦其罪。




Autumn, Seventh Moon [225 Aug 22 – Sep 19], enthroned the Imperial son [Cáo] Jiàn as King of Dōngwǔyáng. Eighth Moon [225 Sep 20 – Oct 19], the Emperor therefore with the navy from Qiáo followed the Guō to enter the Huái, followed land roads to visit Xú [Province]. Ninth Moon [225 Oct 20 – Nov 17], built Dōngxún Terrace. Winter, Tenth Moon [225 Nov 18 – Dec 17] traveled to visit Guǎnglíng former city, overlooked the Jiāng to observe the soldiers, the military troops over a hundred thousand, banners and flags across several hundred lǐ. [43] That year, great cold, the waterways froze, the boats could not enter the Jiāng, thus drew back and returned. Eleventh Moon [225 Dec 18 – 226 Jan 15], the King of Dōngwǔyáng [Cáo] Jiàn died. Twelfth Moon [226 Jan 16 – Feb 14], traveled from Qiáo, passed Liáng, sent envoy with Grand Offering to sacrifice to former Hàn’s Grand Commandant Qiáo Xuán.



秋七月，立皇子鑒為東武陽王。八月，帝遂以舟師自譙循渦入淮，從陸道幸徐。九月，築東巡臺。冬十月，行幸廣陵故城，臨江觀兵，戎卒十餘萬，旌旗數百里。〔一〕是歲大寒，水道冰，舟不得入江，乃引還。十一月，東武陽王鑒薨。十二月，行自譙過梁，遣使以太牢祀故漢太尉橋玄。










[43] Wèi shū records the Emperor’s on horseback composed poem stating: > Observing troops overlooking the Jiāng’s waters > The water’s flow how it rushes and rushes! > Spears and pikes create a mountain forest > Dark armor gleams in the sun’s light > Fierce officers harbor violent rage > Courageous spirit right about to be unleashed > Who says the Jiāng’s waters are wide? > One reed could be a boat > Without battle subduing enemy caitiffs > Restraining weapons is praised as worthy and good > Gǔ-gōng residing at Qíyì > Truly was the beginning of cutting down Yīn-Shāng > Mèng Xiàn camped at Hǔláo > The Zhèng man were afraid and bowed head > Chōngguó attended to plowing and planting > The Xiānlíng on their own were broken and destroyed > Raising farms between the Huái and Sì > Building house and capital in Xú region > Measuring appropriate fortune and expedient strategy > The Six Armies all pleased and quiet > How can it be like Dōngshān’s ode? > Many, many, its numerous sorrows and wounds.



〔一〕　魏書載帝於馬上為詩曰：「觀兵臨江水，水流何湯湯！戈矛成山林，玄甲耀日光。猛將懷暴怒，膽氣正從橫。誰云江水廣，一葦可以航，不戰屈敵虜，戢兵稱賢良。古公宅岐邑，實始翦殷商。孟獻營虎牢，鄭人懼稽顙。充國務耕植，先零自破亡。興農淮、泗間，築室都徐方。量宜運權略，六軍咸悅康；豈如東山詩，悠悠多憂傷。」

title: 2  Annals of Emperor Wén
text:
Huángchū 7 (226)


Seventh Year, Spring, Standard Moon [226 Feb 15 – Mar 15], about to visit Xǔchāng, Xǔchāng city’s south gate without reason on its own collapsed. The Emperor in his heart hated this, and therefore did not enter. Rénzǐ [226 Feb 24], traveled back to Luòyáng Palace. Third Moon [226 Apr 15 – May 13], built Jiǔhuá Terrace. Summer, Fifth Moon [226 Jun 13 – Jul 11], Bǐngchén [226 Jun 28], the Emperor was critically ill, summoned Central Army General-in-Chief Cáo Zhēn, Defending Army General-in-Chief Chén Qún, Campaigning East General-in-Chief Cáo Xiū, Succoring Army General-in-Chief Sīmǎ [Yì] Xuān-wáng, to together receive Legacy Edict to assist the successor ruler. Dismissed the Rear Palace’s Shūyuán and Zhāoyí on down to return to their families. Dīngsì [226 Jun 29], the Emperor passed away in Jiāfú Hall, at the time his years forty. [44] Sixth Moon [226 Jul 12 – Aug 10], Wùyín [226 Jul 20], buried at Shǒuyánglíng. From the encoffining to the burial, all followed the specifications in his Final Regulations. [45]



七年春正月，將幸許昌，許昌城南門無故自崩，帝心惡之，遂不入。壬子，行還洛陽宮。三月，築九華臺。夏五月丙辰，帝疾篤，召中軍大將軍曹真、鎮軍大將軍陳群、征東大將軍曹休、撫軍大將軍司馬宣王，並受遺詔輔嗣主。遣後宮淑媛、昭儀已下歸其家。丁巳，帝崩于嘉福殿，時年四十。〔一〕六月戊寅，葬首陽陵。自殯及葬，皆以終制從事。〔二〕










[44] Wèi shū states: Encoffined in Chónghuá Front Hall.



〔一〕　魏書曰：殯於崇華前殿。













[45] Wèishì Chūnqiū states: Emperor Míng was about to escort the burial, Cáo Zhēn, Chén Qún, Wáng Lǎng and others due to the [dangerous] summer heat firmly remonstrated, so he stopped.
Sūn Shèng states: The task of burying the grave is the filial son’s utmost pain. Of the ways of human affairs, in this none are heavier. Therefore, ‘Heaven’s Son in the Seventh Moon is buried, those of the same course completely arrive.’ Even for the emotions of righteous feeling, yet one would be thorough in the grieving at facing the burial tunnel, so all the more for natural feelings coming from within, the respect of Ritual would value it! The virtue of the Wèi dynasty was not a foundation for many generations. In the past Huà Yuán lavishly buried and noble men believed it abandoning his lord to evil. The remonstrations of [Chén] Qún and the rest, the abandonment was how much more extreme!
The Marquess of Juànchéng [Cáo] Zhí made an elegy that said:
“On Huángchū Seventh Year Fifth Moon Seventeenth Day, the Greatly Departed Imperial Emperor Passed Away. Alas the Sorrow! At the time Heaven thundered and Earth quaked, collapsing mountains and falling frost, the sun’s essence dimmed in light, the Five Latitudes traveled wrong, the Hundred Surnames cried aloud, Myriad States sorrowful and pained, like mourning for deceased father and deceased mother, melancholy and longing surpassing Táng [Yáo], beating chest and stomping in the suburbs and wilderness, looking up to ponder the vast blue [sky], all saying: ‘What crime [was there], to early perish and fall? Alas the Sorrow!’ Grieving for the Greatly Departed, suddenly how light is extinguished, forever abandoning the Myriad States, clouds departing and rain dried away. Continuing to ask into the desolation, confused and dumb choking with sobs, from the sleeve drawing the blade, sighing to seek my own death, to chase after the Three Good Men, willing in heart to share a grave, in emotion pondering the South Wind, thoughts melancholy and slow, to in the end accompany in destruction, pointing to the sun as oath. Investigating the various former records, searching for wise words: life is like a floating passing, only virtue can be discussed; in morning heard and at evening dying, what Kǒng’s records preserved. Though the Imperial is gone, Heaven’s blessings forever extend. How to narrate virtue? Memorialize it on white silks. How to sing of achievements? Declare it in pipes and strings. Thus I made an elegy saying:
‘Bright bright the Grand Essence, the Two Polarities first separated, the center harmonizing to create matter, originating human order, thus reaching the Three Augusts, they filled and maintained the true way, passing down to the Five Emperors, they continued it with exemplary purity, the Three Dynasties made systems, followed the footsteps to establish achievement. The last successors did not maintain, the [social] fabric slackened to Qín, collapsing music and extinguishing scholarship, classicists buried and ritual [books] burned, two generations and then destroyed.
