Summer, Fourth Moon [236 May 23 – Jun 21], installed Chóngwén Watchtower, recruiting those who excelled in writing prose to fill it. Fifth Moon [236 Jun 22 – Jul 20], Yǐmǎo [236 Jul 4], Excellency over the Masses Dǒng Zhāo died. Dīngsì [236 Jul 6], Sùshèn-shì proffered wooden arrows.



四年春二月，太白復晝見，月犯太白，又犯軒轅一星，入太微而出。夏四月，置崇文觀，徵善屬文者以充之。五月乙卯，司徒董昭薨。丁巳，肅慎氏獻楛矢。




Sixth Moon [236 Jul 21 – Aug 19], Rénshēn [236 Jul 21], Edict said: “Yǒu Yú shì drew images and the people did not violate law, the Zhōu men had punishments set aside and not used. We follow at the end of a hundred kings, reminisce and look toward the customs of high antiquity, how remote is the distance from there. Laws grow in severity, the violations all the more many, the punishments increasingly numerous, but treachery cannot be stopped. Formerly I reviewed the articles on capital punishment, many were abolished, thinking of rescuing the lives of the living people, this is Our utmost intention. But in the prefectures and states the deaths in prison within one year still exceed several hundred. Is it that Our instruction and guidance is not pure, enabling the people to think little of punishments, with severe laws still remaining, becoming an entrapment? Relevant managers thus when discussing punishments are to delay deaths, attend to lenience and simplicity. Of those begging for mercy, some have not yet made statements and already have executions reported; this is not how to investigate legal principles and be exhaustive in understanding. Thus order the Minister of Justice and the prison officials of Heaven’s Under, that all who have death sentence cases that already settled and that are not for plotting rebellion or personally killing someone, are to urgently speak with their kin, and if there are any begging for mercy, have them with the memorialized written documents all together be sent up, and We will consider how to preserve them. Thus announce to Heaven’s Under, to allow them to understand Our intentions.”



六月壬申，詔曰：「有虞氏畫象而民弗犯，周人刑錯而不用。朕從百王之末，追望上世之風，邈乎何相去之遠？法令滋章，犯者彌多，刑罰愈眾，而姦不可止。往者按大辟之條，多所蠲除，思濟生民之命，此朕之至意也。而郡國斃獄，一歲之中尚過數百，豈朕訓導不醇，俾民輕罪，將苛法猶存，為之陷阱乎？有司其議獄緩死，務從寬簡，及乞恩者，或辭未出而獄以報斷，非所以究理盡情也。其令廷尉及天下獄官，諸有死罪具獄以定，非謀反及手殺人，亟語其親治，有乞恩者，使與奏當文書俱上，朕將思所以全之。其布告天下，使明朕意。」




Autumn, Seventh Moon [236 Aug 20 – Sep 17], Gāogōulí King Gōng beheaded and sent the heads of Sūn Quán’s envoys Hú Wèi and others to Yōu Province. Jiǎyín [236 Sep 1], Tàibái crossed Xuānyuán large star. Winter, Tenth Moon [236 Nov 16 – Dec 15], Jǐmǎo [236 Nov 25], went back to Luòyáng Palace. Jiǎshēn [236 Nov 30], there was a comet in Dàchén. Yǐyǒu [236 Dec 1], another comet in Dōngfāng. Eleventh Moon [236 Dec 16 – 237 Jan 14], comet sighted, crossing Huànzhě Tiānjì stars. Twelfth Moon [237 Jan 15 – Feb 12], Guǐsì [237 Feb 7], Excellency of Works Chén Qún died. Yǐwèi [237 Feb 9], went to visit Xǔchāng Palace.



秋七月，高句驪王宮斬送孫權使胡衛等首，詣幽州。甲寅，太白犯軒轅大星。冬十月己卯，行還洛陽宮。甲申，有星孛于大辰，乙酉，又孛于東方。十一月己亥，彗星見，犯宦者天紀星。十二月癸巳，司空陳群薨。乙未，行幸許昌宮。

title: 3  Annals of Emperor Míng
text:
Jǐngchū (237 - 239)


Jǐngchū Inaugural Year, Spring, Standard Moon [237 Feb 13 – Mar 14], Rénchén, Shānchí county reported a Yellow Dragon sighting. [21]Thereupon relevant managers memorialized believing that as Wèi used the Earth Lineage, it was appropriate to use the Jiàn Chǒu moon as Standard. Third Moon, settled the calendar change of the year to Mèng Summer Fourth Moon [237 Apr 13 – May 12]. [22] Uniform colors esteemed yellow, sacrificial animals used white, military affairs rode black headed white horses, established great red flags, Court meetings established great white banners. [23] Changed the Tàihé calendar to the Jǐngchū calendar. Thus although the Spring’s, Summer’s, Autumn’s, and Winter’s Mèng, Zhòng, and Jì moons were not the same as the Standard year, as for the Suburb Sacrifices, welcoming of the seasons, Yuè and Cí, Zhēng and Cháng, touring hunts, hunting in the fields, equinoxes and solstices and opening and closing, announcements of seasonal orders, weather being early and late, instructions on agricultural affairs, all followed the Standard year’s dipper Dǒu Jiàn and calendar calculation sequences.



景初元年春正月壬辰，山茌縣言黃龍見。〔一〕於是有司奏，以為魏得地統，宜以建丑之月為正。三月，定曆改年為孟夏四月。〔二〕服色尚黃，犧牲用白，戎事乘黑首白馬，建大赤之旂，朝會建大白之旗。〔三〕改太和曆曰景初曆。其春夏秋冬孟仲季月雖與正歲不同，至於郊祀、迎氣、礿祠、蒸嘗、巡狩、蒐田、分至啟閉、班宣時令、中氣早晚、敬授民事，皆以正歲斗建為曆數之序。










[21] Chí pronounced Shì and Lí together.



〔一〕茌音仕狸反。













[22] Wèi shū states: Previously, Wén Huángdì [Cáo Pī] succeeded the throne, and due to receiving the abdication from Hàn, adhered to the Hàn Standard Calendar and did not revise it. The Emperor [Cáo Ruì] in the East Palace wrote a discourse, believing: “Although the Five Emperors and Three Kings were of the same vitality and common ancestor, their rituals did not continue from one another. The Standard Calendar naturally should be changed to make clear the cycle of receiving the Mandate.” When he succeeded the throne, the indecision had been for a long time, the scribal offices again wrote report that it was appropriate to change, thus Edict on the Three Excellencies, Specially Advanced, Nine Ministers, Central Cadet Generals, Grandees, Academic Scholars, Consultant Cadets, thousand dàn, and six hundred dàn to extensively discuss, of the discussions some did not agree. The Emperor accorded to the ancient canons, Jiǎzǐ [237 May 9] Edict said: “The Grand Axis revolves the Three Celestials and Five Planets above, the Primordial Vitality turns the Three Lineages and Five Transitions below, ascending and descending in cycles, ending and then again beginning. Therefore when Zhòngní composed the Chūnqiū, in the moons of the Three Subtleties, every moon was called the King’s, to make clear the Three Standards in alternation being the head. Now in advancing the sequence of the Three Lineages, Wèi obtains the Earth Lineage, and should use the Jiàn Chǒu moon as the Standard Moon. Examining the various standards, the principles are clear. Thus change Qīnglóng Fifth Year Third Moon to be Jǐngchū Inaugural Year Fourth Moon.”



〔二〕　魏書曰：初，文皇帝即位，以受禪于漢，因循漢正朔弗改。帝在東宮著論，以為五帝三王雖同氣共祖，禮不相襲，正朔自宜改變，以明受命之運。及即位，優游者久之，史官復著言宜改，乃詔三公、特進、九卿、中郎將、大夫、博士、議郎、千石、六百石博議，議者或不同。帝據古典，甲子詔曰：「夫太極運三辰五星於上，元氣轉三統五行於下，登降周旋，終則又始。故仲尼作春秋，於三微之月，每月稱王，以明三正迭相為首。今推三統之次，魏得地統，當以建丑之月為正月。考之群藝，厥義章矣。其改青龍五年三月為景初元年四月。」













[23] Your Servant Sōngzhī notes: Wèi used the Earth Transition, therefore uniform color esteemed yellow. Enacting Yīn’s seasons, using Jiàn Chǒu as the Standard, therefore sacrificial animals and banners and flags entirely used Yīn ritual. The Lǐjì says: “Xià Hòu shì esteemed black, therefore military affairs rode black horses, sacrificial animals used dark; the Yīn men esteemed white, military affairs rode quills, sacrificial animals used white; the Zhōu men esteemed red, military affairs rode chestnut horses, sacrificial animals used bay.” Zhèng Xuán says: “Xià Hòu shì used the Jiàn Yín as Standard, things are born colored black; Yīn used the Jiàn Chǒu as Standard, things teething are colored white; Zhōu used the Jiàn Zǐ as Standard, things sprouting are colored red. ‘Quill’ is a white colored horse. The Yì states: ‘White horses like quills.’” Zhōu Lǐ’s Jīn Chē records: “Establish Great Red for Court.” “Great White for the military.” This then is Zhōu using flags of the Standard color for Court, the flags of the previous dynasty for the military. Now Wèi employed Yīn ritual, changing the Zhōu system, therefore establishing Great White for Court, Great Red for the military.



〔三〕　臣松之按：魏為土行，故服色尚黃。行殷之時，以建丑為正，故犧牲旂旗一用殷禮。禮記云：「夏后氏尚黑，故戎事乘驪，牲用玄；殷人尚白，戎事乘翰，牲用白；周人尚赤，戎事乘騵，牲用騂。」鄭玄云：「夏后氏以建寅為正，物生色黑；殷以建丑為正，物牙色白；周以建子為正，物萌色赤。翰，白色馬也，易曰『白馬翰如』。」周禮巾車職「建大赤以朝」，大白以即戎，此則周以正色之旗以朝，先代之旗即戎。今魏用殷禮，變周之制，故建大白以朝，大赤即戎。







Fifth Moon [237 May 13 – Jun 10], Jǐsì [237 May 14], went back to Luòyáng Palace. Jǐchǒu [237 Jun 3], Great Amnesty. Sixth Moon [237 Jun 11 – Jul 9], Wùshēn [237 Jun 22], capital city earthquake. Jǐhài, appointed Secretariat Writers Director Chén Jiǎo as Excellency over the Masses, Secretariat Writers Right Deputy Director Wèi Zhēn as Excellency of Works. Dīngwèi, divided Wèixīng’s Wèiyáng and Xī prefecture’s Ānfù and Shàngyōng to form Shàngyōng prefecture. Abolished Xī prefecture, having Xī county subordinate to Wèixīng prefecture.



五月己巳，行還洛陽宮。己丑，大赦。六月戊申，京都地震。己亥，以尚書令陳矯為司徒，尚書（左）〔右〕僕射衛臻為司空。丁未，分魏興之魏陽、錫郡之安富、上庸為上庸郡。省錫郡，以錫縣屬魏興郡。




Relevant managers memorialized: “Wǔ Huángdì [Cáo Cāo] subdued chaos into order, to be Wèi Tàizǔ, music using Wǔshǐ zhī Wǔ. Wén Huángdì [Cáo Pī] answered Heaven to receive the Mandate, to be Wèi Gāozǔ, music using Xiánxī zhī Wǔ. The Emperor [Cáo Ruì] creates flourishing governance, to be Wèi Lièzǔ, music using Zhāngbīn zhī Wǔ. The Temples of the Three Zǔ for myriad ages will not to be demolished. The remaining four temples when degree of relation is exhausted will to be in order demolished, like the system of Zhōu’s Hòujì, Wén, Wǔ Temple Halls.” [24]



有司奏：武皇帝撥亂反正，為魏太祖，樂用武始之舞。文皇帝應天受命，為魏高祖，樂用咸熙之舞。帝制作興治，為魏烈祖，樂用章（武）〔斌〕之舞。三祖之廟，萬世不毀。其餘四廟，親盡迭毀，如周后稷、文、武廟祧之制。〔一〕










[24] Sūn Shèng states: The posthumous name is to present conduct, the temple name to preserve appearance, both are for the already dead and only afterward written, in order to from the beginning reach the end, to show to a hundred generations. There has never been in one’s prime years yet in advance a systemization as Zǔ or Zōng, not yet ended and yet in anticipation honoring oneself prominently. In the past Huà [Yuán] and Yuè [Jǔ] for lavish burials attracted ridicule, Zhōu men believed anticipating the inauspicious to be violation of ritual. Wèi’s various managers in this failed the correct.



〔一〕　孫盛曰：夫諡以表行，廟以存容，皆於既沒然後著焉，所以原始要終，以示百世也。未有當年而逆制祖宗，未終而豫自尊顯。昔華樂以厚斂致譏，周人以豫凶違禮，魏之群司，於是乎失正。







Autumn, Seventh Moon [237 Jul 10 – Aug 8], Dīngmǎo [237 Jul 11], Excellency over the Masses Chén Jiǎo died. Sūn Quán sent his officer Zhū Rán and others with twenty thousand men to besiege Jiāngxià prefecture, Jīng Province Inspector Hú Zhì and others struck them, [Zhū] Rán retreated and fled. Previously, [Sūn] Quán sent envoys to sail the sea to communicate with Gāogōulí, wishing to attack Liáodōng. Sent Yōu Province Inspector Guànqiū Jiǎn to lead the various armies with the Xiānbēi and Wūhuán to garrison Liáodōng’s south border, with Ruler’s Seal marked letter to summon Gōngsūn Yuān. [Gōngsūn] Yuān mobilized soldiers to rebel, [Guànqiū] Jiǎn advanced the army to suppress him, it happened it continuously rained for ten days, the Liáo river greatly flooded, Edict on [Guànqiū] Jiǎn to withdraw the army and return. Yòuběipíng Wūhuán Chányú Kòulóudūn and Liáoxī Wūhuán Overall Commander Wánghùliú and others residing in Liáodōng led their division multitudes to accompany [Guànqiū] Jiǎn to inwardly submit. Jǐmǎo [237 Jul 23], Edict that Liáodōng’s officers and officials and servicemen and civilians that were forcefully coerced by [Gōngsūn] Yuān and unable to surrender were to be entirely pardoned. Xīnmǎo [237 Aug 4], Tàibái during daytime seen. [Gōngsūn] Yuān, as [Guànqiū] Jiǎn had returned, therefore established himself as King of Yān, installing a Hundred Officials, declaring Shàohàn Inaugural Year.



秋七月丁卯，司徒陳矯薨。孫權遣將朱然等二萬人圍江夏郡，荊州刺史胡質等擊之，然退走。初，權遣使浮海與高句驪通，欲襲遼東。遣幽州刺史毌丘儉率諸軍及鮮卑、烏丸屯遼東南界，璽書徵公孫淵。淵發兵反，儉進軍討之，會連雨十日，遼水大漲，詔儉引軍還。右北平烏丸單于寇婁敦、遼西烏丸都督王護留等居遼東，率部眾隨儉內附。己卯，詔遼東將吏士民為淵所脅略不得降者，一切赦之。辛卯，太白晝見。淵自儉還，遂自立為燕王，置百官，稱紹漢元年。




Edict on Qīng, Yǎn, Yōu, Jì four provinces to greatly build sea-going ships.
Ninth Moon [237 Sep 7 – Oct 6], Jì, Yǎn, Xú, Yù four provinces’ civilians suffered floods, sent the Attendant Censor to go to where there were drownings and loss of property to open granaries to relieve them. Gēngchén [237 Sep 22], the Imperial Empress Máo-shì died. Winter, Tenth Moon [237 Oct 7 – Nov 4], Dīngwèi [237 Oct 19], the Moon crossed Yínghuò. Guǐchǒu [237 Oct 25], buried Empress Dào Máo-shì at Mǐnlíng. Yǐmǎo [237 Oct 27], built Luòyáng’s south Wěisù mountain into Yuánqiū. [25] Twelfth Moon [237 Dec 5 – 238 Jan 2], Rénzǐ [237 Dec 23], Winter Solstice, began sacrifices. Dīngsì [237 Dec 28], divided Xiāngyáng’s Línjǔ, Yíchéng, Jīngyáng, Qǐ [26] , four counties to install a Xiāngyáng South Division Commandant. Jǐwèi [237 Dec 30], relevant managers memorialized to establish a Temple for Wén-Zhāo Huánghòu in the capital city. Divided Xiāngyáng prefecture’s Ruòyè county to be subordinate to Yìyáng prefecture. [27]



詔青、兗、幽、冀四州大作海船。九月，冀、兗、徐、豫四州民遇水，遣侍御史循行沒溺死亡及失財產者，在所開倉振救之。庚辰，皇后毛氏卒。冬十月丁未，月犯熒惑。癸丑，葬悼毛后于愍陵。乙卯，營洛陽南委粟山為圜丘。〔一〕十二月壬子冬至，始祀。丁巳，分襄陽臨沮、宜城、旍陽、邔〔二〕四縣，置襄陽南部都尉。己未，有司奏文昭皇后立廟京都。分襄陽郡之鄀葉縣屬義陽郡。〔三〕










[25] Wèi shū records the Edict stating: “Probably of the Emperors and Kings that received the Mandate, none did not respectfully serve Heaven and Earth to manifest the divine intelligence, honor and sacrifice to the generational lineages to exhibit achievement and virtue. Therefore the canons of former dynasties were written, and so the systems of the Examining, Suburb, and Ancestral [sacrifices] were prepared. In the past the beginning of the Hàn clan continued after Qín destroyed scholarship, selected from the badly damaged, to prepare the Suburb Sacrifices. From the Gānquán, Hòutǔ, Yōnggōng Five Altars, the manifestation seats of the divinities and deities, many are not seen in the classics, and therefore the systems were not constant, sometimes that sometimes this, for over four hundred years there were no Examining Sacrifices. The ways of how the ancient dynasties altered establishments [of sacrifices] therefore have deficiencies. The Cáo clan’s hereditary lineage comes from Yú shì, now sacrifice to Yuánqiū with Shǐzǔ Emperor Shùn paired, titling Yuánqiū called August Imperial Emperor Heaven; the sacrifices at Fāngqiū called August Imperial Empress Earth, with Shùn’s consort Yī-shì paired; the sacrifices to Heaven in the Suburbs called Divinity of August Heaven, with Tàizǔ Wǔ Huángdì paired; Sacrifices to Earth in the Suburbs called Deity of August Earth, with Wǔ-Xuān Hòu paired; Ancestral Sacrifices to Imperial father Gāozǔ Wén Huángdì in Míngtáng, to pair with Highest God.” Reaching to Jìn’s Tàishǐ Second Year [266], combined the sacrifices of the two solstices at Yuánqiū and Fāngqiū with the South and North Suburbs.



〔一〕　魏書載詔曰：「蓋帝王受命，莫不恭承天地以章神明，尊祀世統以昭功德，故先代之典既著，則禘郊祖宗之制備也。昔漢氏之初，承秦滅學之後，采摭殘缺，以備郊祀，自甘泉后土、雍宮五畤，神祇兆位，多不見經，是以制度無常，一彼一此，四百餘年，廢無禘祀。古代之所更立者，遂有闕焉。曹氏系世，出自有虞氏，今祀圜丘，以始祖帝舜配，號圜丘曰皇皇帝天；方丘所祭曰皇皇后地，以舜妃伊氏配；天郊所祭曰皇天之神，以太祖武皇帝配；地郊所祭曰皇地之祇，以武宣后配；宗祀皇考高祖文皇帝於明堂，以配上帝。」至晉泰始二年，并圜丘、方丘二至之祀於南北郊。













[26] Qǐ pronounced Qí and Jǐ together.



〔二〕邔音其己反。













[27] Wèi lüè states: That year, relocated from Cháng’ān the various bell stands, camels, copper men, and dew collecting pans. The pans broke, the copper men were heavy and could not be delivered, left at Bàchéng. Greatly mined copper to cast and build copper men of two, titled Wēngzhòng, lined in position outside the Major’s Gates. Also cast a yellow dragon and fènghuáng, one of each, the dragon height four zhàng, the fèng height over three zhàng, installed in front of the Inner Hall. Raised a soil mountain in Fānglín Garden’s northwest corner, having the Excellencies and Ministers and various bureaucrats all carry soil to complete the mountain, planted pines and bamboos and various trees and fine grasses on top of it, capturing mountain birds and various beasts to place in it.
Hàn Jìn Chūnqiū states: The Emperor relocated the pans, the pans broke, the sound was heard for several tens of lǐ, of the metal Dí some wept, and therefore were left at Bàchéng.
Wèi lüè records Excellency over the Masses’s Army Consultant Assistant Hédōng’s Dǒng Xún’s sent up letter of remonstration stating: “Your Servant has heard that the upright servicemen of antiquity exhaustively spoke out for the state without fear of death. Therefore Zhōu Chāng compared Gāozǔ to Jié and Zhòu, Liú Fǔ likened Empress Zhào to a slave girl. That Heaven births the loyal and upright that even when faced with bare blade and boiling broth will go without looking back, is truly for the time’s ruler to love and cherish Heaven’s Under. From since Jiàn’ān onward there has been death in battles in the wilderness, some families completely wiped out, and even if there are survivors, they are remnant orphans and the old and weak. If now the Palace Residences are narrow and small and are to be expanded and enlarged, yet it should follow the right timing, to not hinder farming affairs, all the more then for building things without benefits. Yellow dragons, fènghuáng, nine dragons, dew collecting pans, soil mountains, pool reservoirs, these all are what the sagely and enlightened do not build, their labors three times that of Hall residences. The Three Excellencies and Nine Ministers and Attendant Centrals and Secretariat Writers are Heaven’s Under’s utmost virtues, that they all know that these are against morality but do not dare speak, is because Your Majesty’s springs and autumns [years of age] are just in your prime, and in heart they fear your thunder. Now Your Majesty honors the various ministers, making them prominent with ceremonial caps, covering them in patterned embroidery, conveying them in flowery carriages, in order to distinguish them from petty men, but to have them dig up and carry soil, faces dirtied and blackened, staining body and muddying feet, robes and caps disheveled, destroys the state’s glory in order to esteem the not beneficial; this is extremely not sensible. Kǒng-zǐ said: ‘The lord employs the minister by courtesy, the minister serves the ruler by loyalty.’ Without loyalty and without courtesy, how is the state to stand? Therefore if a ruler is not ruling and servants not serving, above and below are not connected, hearts in frustrated knots, it causes yīn and yáng to not be in harmony, calamities and harms to repeatedly be sent down, the vicious and evil sorts take advantage of openings to rise. Who will for Your Majesty exhaustively speak of these issues? And who will obstruct Ten Thousand Chariots and treat death as a trifle? Your Servant knows to speak out is certain death, but Your Servant compares himself to a single hair on an ox: living it is of no benefit, and death is also what loss? Holding brush and shedding tears, in heart already taking leave of the world. Your Servant has eight children, after Your Servant’s death, to burden Your Majesty.” When about to memorialize, washed and bathed. When it was delivered, the Emperor said: “Does Dǒng Xún not fear death?” The manager memorialized to arrest [Dǒng] Xún, there was Edict to not investigate. Later he became Bèiqiū Magistrate, for purity and simplicity won the people’s hearts.



〔三〕　魏略曰：是歲，徙長安諸鐘簴、駱駝、銅人、承露盤。盤折，銅人重不可致，留于霸城。大發銅鑄作銅人二，號曰翁仲，列坐于司馬門外。又鑄黃龍、鳳皇各一，龍高四丈，鳳高三丈餘，置內殿前。起土山于芳林園西北陬，使公卿群僚皆負土成山，樹松竹雜木善草於其上，捕山禽雜獸置其中。漢晉春秋曰：帝徙盤，盤折，聲聞數十里，金狄或泣，因留霸城。魏略載司徒軍議掾河東董尋上書諫曰：「臣聞古之直士，盡言于國，不避死亡。故周昌比高祖於桀、紂，劉輔譬趙后於人婢。天生忠直，雖白刃沸湯，往而不顧者，誠為時主愛惜天下也。建安以來，野戰死亡，或門殫戶盡，雖有存者，遺孤老弱。若今宮室狹小，當廣大之，猶宜隨時，不妨農務，況乃作無益之物，黃龍、鳳皇，九龍、承露盤，土山、淵池，此皆聖明之所不興也，其功參倍于殿舍。三公九卿侍中尚書，天下至德，皆知非道而不敢言者，以陛下春秋方剛，心畏雷霆。今陛下既尊群臣，顯以冠冕，被以文繡，載以華輿，所以異于小人；而使穿方舉土，面目垢黑，沾體塗足，衣冠了鳥，毀國之光以崇無益，甚非謂也。孔子曰：『君使臣以禮，臣事君以忠。』無忠無禮，國何以立！故有君不君，臣不臣，上下不通，心懷鬱結，使陰陽不和，災害屢降，凶惡之徒，因間而起，誰當為陛下盡言事者乎？又誰當干萬乘以死為戲乎？臣知言出必死，而臣自比於牛之一毛，生既無益，死亦何損？秉筆流涕，心與世辭。臣有八子，臣死之後，累陛下矣！」將奏，沐浴。既通，帝曰：「董尋不畏死邪！」主者奏收尋，有詔勿問。後為貝丘令，清省得民心。







Second Year, Spring, Standard Moon [238 Jan 3 – Feb 1], Edict on Grand Commandant Sīmǎ [Yì] Xuān-wáng to lead multitudes to suppress Liáodōng. [28]



二年春正月，詔太尉司馬宣王帥眾討遼東。〔一〕










[28] Gān Bǎo’s Jìn jì states: The Emperor asked [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng: “By your estimation Gōngsūn Yuān will use what plan to wait for you?” Xuān-wáng replied saying: “[Gōngsūn] Yuān abandoning the city and in advance fleeing is the best plan. Occupying the Liáo river to resist the main army is the next. Sitting and defending Xiāngpíng, this would only guarantee his capture.” The Emperor said: “That being the case, of the three which will he use?” Replied saying: “Only by enlightened wisdom investigating and estimating the self and the opposition is there any abandoning in advance. This is not what [Gōngsūn] Yuān is capable of. Also he will say that now we have gone across a long distance, unable to last for a long time, and certainly will first occupy the Liáo river, and afterward defend [Xiāngpíng].” The Emperor said: “Going and returning will be how many days?” Replied saying: “Going a hundred days, attacking a hundred days, returning a hundred days, with sixty days for rest. In this way, one year is enough.”
Wèi Míng Chén Zòu records Cavalier Regular Attendant Hé Zēng’s memorial stating: “Your Servant has heard that the former kings in regulations and laws certainly were completely cautious, therefore in establishing offices and conferring appointments then they installed temporary assistants, in exhibiting brigades and mandating officers then they established supervising seconds, in declaring commands and sending envoys then they set herald deputies, in facing enemies and engaging blades then they added a driver’s right, overall to be exhaustive in the achievements of planning consideration and to guard against changes in security or danger. Therefore when in danger and facing troubles, then the authority needs to be enough to rescue one another, in unanticipated deaths and deficiencies, then the talent needs to be enough to substitute for one another, in order to be a solid safeguard, utmostly deep and utmostly far. Reaching to the Hàn clan, they also adhered to the old standards. When Hán Xìn attacked Zhào, Zhāng Ěr was his second; when Mǎ Yuán suppressed the Yuè, Liú Lóng was the deputy army. The legacies of previous generations are written in the chapters and records. Now [Sīmǎ] Yì serves the command to execute the criminal, infantry and cavalry of several tens of thousands, the roads twisting and obstructed, over four thousand lǐ. Even if supposing by Heavenly power there is a campaign without battles, the enemy might hide and flee, dissipating and scattering for days and moons, the assignment without a certain length of time. Men are not metal and stone. For long term consideration and detailed preparations, it is truly appropriate to have a deputy. Now the northern border’s various officers and those [Sīmǎ] Yì commands all are his subordinate staff, reputation and rank not differentiated, constituents without settled distinctions, if suddenly there is an urgent change, they cannot subdue and take over for one another. ‘While surviving not forgetting destruction’ is what sagely comprehension warns. It is appropriate to select a chief minister and famed officer of heavy authority and long-term prominence, make flourishing his ceremony rank, send him to visit [Sīmǎ] Yì’s army, advancing to join in planning strategies, withdrawing to be secondary assistant. Even if ten thousand to one there is an unexpected calamity, the leader of the army has a reserve, and then there are no worries.” Guànqiū Jiǎn’s records say at the time [Guànqiū] Jiǎn was [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng’s second-in-command.



〔一〕　干竇晉紀曰：帝問宣王：「度公孫淵將何計以待君？」宣王對曰：「淵棄城預走，上計也；據遼水拒大軍，其次也；坐守襄平，此為成禽耳。」帝曰：「然則三者何出？」對曰：「唯明智審量彼我，乃預有所割棄，此既非淵所及，又謂今往縣遠，不能持久，必先拒遼水，後守也。」帝曰：「住還幾日？」對曰：「往百日，攻百日；還百日，以六十日為休息，如此，一年足矣。」魏名臣奏載散騎常侍何曾表曰：「臣聞先王制法，必於全慎，故建官授任，則置假輔，陳師命將，則立監貳，宣命遣使，則設介副，臨敵交刃，則參御右，蓋以盡謀思之功，防安危之變也。是以在險當難，則權足相濟，隕缺不預，則才足相代，其為固防，至深至遠。及至漢氏，亦循舊章。韓信伐趙，張耳為貳；馬援討越，劉隆副軍。前世之跡，著在篇志。今懿奉辭誅罪，步騎數萬，道路迴阻，四千餘里，雖假天威，有征無戰，寇或潛遁，消散日月，命無常期。人非金石，遠慮詳備，誠宜有副。今北邊諸將及懿所督，皆為僚屬，名位不殊，素無定分，卒有變急，不相鎮攝。存不忘亡，聖達所戒，宜選大臣名將威重宿著者，盛其禮秩，遣詣懿軍，進同謀略，退為副佐。雖有萬一不虞之災，軍主有儲，則無患矣。」毌丘儉志記云，時以儉為宣王副也。







Second Moon [238 Feb 2 – Mar 2], Guǐmǎo [238 Feb 12], appointed Grand Central Grandee Hán Jì as Excellency over the Masses. Guǐchǒu [238 Feb 22], the Moon crossed Xīn’s distance star, also crossed Xīn’s center large star. Summer, Fourth Moon [238 Apr 2 – Apr 30], Gēngzǐ [238 Apr 10], Excellency over the Masses Hán Jì died. Rényìn [238 Apr 12], divided Pèi state’s Xiāo, Xiāng, Zhúyì, Fúlí, Qí, Zhì, Lóngkàng, Shānsāng, Xiáo, Jiàng [29] ten counties to form Rǔyīn prefecture, Sòng county and Chén prefecture’s Kǔ county both subordinated to Qiáo prefecture. Used Pèi, Zhùqiū, Gōngqiū, Péngchéng’s Fēng state, Guǎngqī, altogether five counties to form the King of Pèi’s state. Gēngxū [238 Apr 20], Great Amnesty. Fifth Moon [238 May 1 – May 30], Yǐhài [238 May 15], the Moon crossed Xīn’s distance star, also crossed the center large star. [30] Sixth Moon [238 May 31 – Jun 28], abolished Yúyáng prefecture’s Húnú county, restored the installation of Ānlè county.



二月癸卯，以大中大夫韓暨為司徒。癸丑，月犯心距星，又犯心中央大星。夏四月庚子，司徒韓暨薨。壬寅，分沛國蕭、相、竹邑、符離、蘄、銍、龍亢、山桑、洨、虹〔一〕十縣為汝陰郡。宋縣、陳郡苦縣皆屬譙郡。以沛、杼秋、公丘、彭城豐國、廣戚，并五縣為沛王國。庚戌，大赦。五月乙亥，月犯心距星，又犯中央大星。〔二〕六月，省漁陽郡之狐奴縣，復置安樂縣。










[29] Xiāo pronounced Hú and Jiāo together. Jiàng pronounced Jiàng.



〔一〕洨音胡交反。虹音絳。













[30] Wèi shū records the Wùzǐ [238 May 28] Edict stating: “In the past Hàn Gāozǔ began the enterprise, Guāng-Wǔ led the restoration, their plans eliminating the oppressive and brutal, their achievements shining the Four Seas, but their tombs have fallen into ruin, children and herders treading and trampling on top; this is not the intention of Great Wèi to honor and esteem the dynasty it succeeds. Thus around the tombs of Gāozǔ and Guāng-Wǔ on the four sides for a hundred bù, do not allow people to plow or herd or collect firewood or forage.”



〔二〕　魏書載戊子詔曰：「昔漢高祖創業，光武中興，謀除殘暴，功昭四海，而墳陵崩頹，童兒牧豎踐蹈其上，非大魏尊崇所承代之意也。其表高祖、光武陵四面百步，不得使民耕牧樵採。」







Autumn, Eighth Moon [238 July 28 – Aug 27], Shāodāng Qiāng kings Mángzhōng and Zhùyì and others rebelled, the Liáng Province Inspector led the various prefectures to attack and suppress, cut off Zhùyì’s head. Guǐchǒu [238 Aug 21], there was a comet sighted in Zhāngxiù. [31]



秋八月，燒當羌王芒中、注詣等叛，涼州刺史率諸郡攻討，斬注詣首。癸丑，有彗星見張宿。〔一〕










[31] Hàn Jìn Chūnqiū states: The scribal offices spoke to the Emperor saying: “This is the Field Allocation of Zhōu, Luò city suffers from it.” Thereupon greatly prepared methods of supplication prayers to suppress it. Wèi shū states: Ninth Moon [238 Aug 28 – Sep 25], Shǔ’s Yīnpíng Administrator Liào Dūn returned to attack Maintaining Excellence Qiāng Marquess Dàngxùn’s camp. Yōng Province Inspector Guō Huái sent Guǎngwèi Administrator Wáng Yūn and Nán’ān Administrator Yóu Yì to lead soldiers to suppress Liào Dūn. [Guō] Huái sent up letter: “[Wáng] Yūn and [Yóu] Yì and the rest divide the soldiers to pincer the mountain’s east and west, besieging and trapping the rebel’s exterior, their defeat by dawn or dusk.” The Emperor said: “Soldier momentum fears separation.” Urgently sent Edict on [Guō] Huái to order [Yóu] Yì’s various separate camps not in critical positions to return to occupy convenient ground. The Edict orders had not yet arrived, [Yóu] Yí’s army was defeated by [Liào] Dūn, [Wáng] Yūn was hit by a stray arrow and died.



〔一〕　漢晉春秋曰：史官言於帝曰：「此周之分野也，洛邑惡之。」於是大脩禳禱之術以厭焉。魏書曰：九月，蜀陰平太守廖惇反，攻守善羌侯宕蕈營。雍州刺史郭淮遣廣魏太守王贇、南安太守游奕將兵討惇。淮上書：「贇、奕等分兵夾山東西，圍落賊表，破在旦夕。」帝曰：「兵勢惡離。」促詔淮敕奕諸別營非要處者，還令據便地。詔敕未到，奕軍為惇所破；贇為流矢所中死。







Bǐngyín [238 Sep 3], Sīmǎ [Yì] Xuān-wáng besieged Gōngsūn Yuān at Xiāngpíng, greatly defeated him, sending [Gōngsūn] Yuān’s head to the capital city, the various prefectures east of the sea were pacified. Winter, Eleventh Moon [238 Oct 26 – Nov 23], reviewed the achievements of suppressing [Gōngsūn] Yuān, Grand Commandant [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng on down were increased in fief and enfeoffed noble titles each on distinct basis. Previously, the Emperor had discussed sending [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng to suppress [Gōngsūn] Yuān, mobilizing troops of forty thousand men. The discussing ministers all believed forty thousand soldiers was too many, the campaign costs difficult to supply. The Emperor said: “Campaigning across four thousand lǐ, thought it be said to be using surprise, it also must use strength, and should not be stingy in calculating campaign costs.” Therefore had forty thousand men go. When [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng reached Liáodōng, it continuously rained with no time to attack, of the various ministers some believed that [Gōngsūn] Yuān could not yet be quickly defeated, and there should be Edict on [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng to return. The Emperor said: “Sīmǎ Yì in facing dangers controls for changes, the capture of [Gōngsūn] Yuān can be calculated in days and waited for.” In the end it was all as he had planned.



丙寅，司馬宣王圍公孫淵於襄平，大破之，傳淵首于京都，海東諸郡平。冬十一月，錄討淵功，太尉宣王以下增邑封爵各有差。初，帝議遣宣王討淵，發卒四萬人。議臣皆以為四萬兵多，役費難供。帝曰：「四千里征伐，雖云用奇，亦當任力，不當稍計役費。」遂以四萬人行。及宣王至遼東，霖雨不得時攻，群臣或以為淵未可卒破，宜詔宣王還。帝曰：「司馬懿臨危制變，擒淵可計日待也。」卒皆如所策。




Rénwǔ [238 Nov 18], appointed Excellency of Works Wèi Zhēn as Excellency over the Masses, Director of Retainers Colonel Cuī Lín as Excellency of Works. Intercalary Moon [238 Nov 24 – Dec 23], the Moon crossed Xīn’s center large star. Twelfth Moon [238 Dec 24 – 239 Jan 21], Yǐchǒu [238 Dec 31], the Emperor was lying ill and unwell. Xīnsì [239 Jan 16], established an Imperial Empress. Bestowed on Heaven’s Under adult males noble rank at level two, grain on the widowers and widows and orphans and childless. Appointed the King of Yān [Cáo] Yǔ as General-in-Chief, Jiǎshēn [239 Jan 19] dismissed, appointing Martial Guard General Cáo Shuǎng to replace him. [32]



壬午，以司空衛臻為司徒，司隸校尉崔林為司空。閏月，月犯心中央大星。十二月乙丑，帝寢疾不豫。辛巳，立皇后。賜天下男子爵人二級，鰥寡孤獨穀。以燕王宇為大將軍，甲申免，以武衛將軍曹爽代之。〔一〕










[32] Hàn Jìn Chūnqiū states: The Emperor appointed the King of Yān [Cáo] Yǔ as General-in-Chief, employed with Manager of the Army General Xiàhóu Xiàn, Martial Guard General Cáo Shuǎng, Garrison Cavalry Colonel Cáo Zhào, Valiant Cavalry General Qín Lǎng and others to together assist in governing. Central Writers Supervisor Liú Fàng and Director Sūn Zī for a long time had concentrated power and favor, with [Qín] Lǎng and the rest formerly had not been friendly, feared there would later be harm, secretly plotted to estrange them, but [Cáo] Yǔ always was at the Emperor’s side, and therefore they were not yet able to speak. Jiǎshēn [239 Jan 19], the Emperor’s vitality was weak, [Cáo] Yǔ went down from the Hall to call Cáo Zhào to discuss something and had not yet returned, but then the Emperor slightly improved, only Cáo Shuǎng alone was present. [Liú] Fàng became aware of this and called [Sūn] Zī to plan. [Sūn] Zī said: “We cannot move.” [Liú] Fàng said: “We have both entered the cauldron, what ‘cannot’ is there?” Thus they rushed ahead to see the Emperor, shedding tears and saying: “Your Majesty’s vitality is weak, if there is the unspeakable, Heaven’s Under will be entrusted to who?” The Emperor said: “You have not heard I have employed the King of Yān?” [Liú] Fàng said: “Your Majesty has forgotten the Former Emperor’s Edict orders that the vassal kings are not to assist in governing. Moreover Your Majesty is now ill, but Cáo Zhào and Qín Lǎng and the rest casually speak and flirt with the Talent Ladies and women attending your illness. The King of Yān gathers soldiers and faces south, not allowing Us Your Servants to enter, this is exactly a Shù Diāo and Zhào Gāo. Now the Imperial Heir-Apparent is young and weak, not yet able to unite the government, the exterior has strong and cruel bandits, the interior has exhausted and resentful civilians, Your Majesty does not take distantly consider survival or destruction, but instead nearby connects to old affections. Entrusting the enterprise of your ancestors to be handed over to two to three mediocre servicemen, lying ill for several days, exterior and interior are obstructed and separated, the State Altars in danger of collapse, but you alone are unaware, this is why We Your Servants are pained in heart.” The Emperor accepted [Liú] Fàng’s words, was greatly furious and said: “Who can be appointed?” [Liú] Fàng and [Sūn] Zī then nominated [Cáo] Shuǎng to replace [Cáo] Yǔ, and also reported there should be Edict on Sīmǎ [Yì] Xuān-wáng to take part with him. The Emperor followed this. [Liú] Fàng and [Sūn] Zī exited, Cáo Zhào, wept tears and firmly remonstrated, and the Emperor sent [Cáo] Zhào to order to stop it. [Cáo] Zhào went out the doors, [Liú] Fàng and [Sūn] Zī hurried to go, again persuading and stopping the Emperor, and the Emperor again followed their words. [Liú] Fàng said: “There should be a hand-written Edict.” The Emperor said: “I am critically ill and cannot.” [Liú] Fàng approached and went up the bed, grabbed the Emperor’s hand and forcefully made it, and therefore carrying it went out, greatly shouting saying: “There is Edict dismissing the King of Yān [Cáo] Yǔ and the rest from office, not permitted to remain in the ministries.” Thereupon [Cáo] Yǔ, [Cáo] Zhào, [Xiàhóu] Xiàn, [Qín] Lǎng faced each other and sobbed and returned to their mansions.



〔一〕　漢晉春秋曰：帝以燕王宇為大將軍，使與領軍將軍夏侯獻、武衛將軍曹爽、屯騎校尉曹肇、驍騎將軍秦朗等對輔政。中書監劉放、令孫資久專權寵，為朗等素所不善，懼有後害，陰圖間之，而宇常在帝側，故未得有言。甲申，帝氣微，宇下殿呼曹肇有所議，未還，而帝少閒，惟曹爽獨在。放知之，呼資與謀。資曰：「不可動也。」放曰：「俱入鼎鑊，何不可之有？」乃突前見帝，垂泣曰：「陛下氣微，若有不諱，將以天下付誰？」帝曰：「卿不聞用燕王耶？」放曰：「陛下忘先帝詔敕，藩王不得輔政。且陛下方病，而曹肇、秦朗等便與才人侍疾者言戲。燕王擁兵南面，不聽臣等入，此即豎刁、趙高也。今皇太子幼弱，未能統政，外有彊暴之寇，內有勞怨之民，陛下不遠慮存亡，而近係恩舊。委祖宗之業，付二三凡士，寢疾數日，外內壅隔，社稷危殆，而己不知，此臣等所以痛心也。」帝得放言，大怒曰：「誰可任者？」放、資乃舉爽代宇，又白「宜詔司馬宣王使相參」，帝從之。放、資出，曹肇入，泣涕固諫，帝使肇敕停。肇出戶，放、資趨而往，復說止帝，帝又從其言。放曰：「宜為手詔。」帝曰：「我困篤，不能。」放即上床，執帝手強作之，遂齎出，大言曰：「有詔免燕王宇等官，不得停省中。」於是宇、肇、獻、朗相與泣而歸第。







Previously, during Qīnglóng Third Year [235], a Shòuchūn farmer’s wife herself said that she had been sent down by Heaven’s divinities, mandated to be an ascended woman, to guard and protect the Emperor’s household, to ward off the nefarious and to attract fortune. She gave water to people to drink as well as to wash wounds, and many recovered. Thereupon she was installed in the offices of the Rear Palace, sent down Edicts praised her, and she extremely met with exceptional favor. Reaching to when the Emperor was ill, he drank the water to no effect, and therefore she was killed.



初，青龍三年中，壽春農民妻自言為天神所下，命為登女，當營衛帝室，蠲邪納福。飲人以水，及以洗瘡，或多愈者。於是立館後宮，下詔稱揚，甚見優寵。及帝疾，飲水無驗，於是殺焉。




Third Year, Spring, Standard Moon [239 Jan 22 – Feb 20] Dīnghài [239 Jan 22], Grand Commandant [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng returned and reached Hénèi, the Emperor with relay horses summoned him to arrive, brought to enter the inner bedroom, grasped his hand and said: “My illness is extreme, later affairs will be entrusted to you, you will with [Cáo] Shuǎng support my young son. I in being able to see you have no regrets!” [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng bowed head [to the ground] with flowing tears. [33] That day, the Emperor passed away in Jiāfú Hall, [34] at the time his years thirty-six. [35] Guǐchǒu [239 Feb 17], buried at Gāopínglíng. [36]



三年春正月丁亥，太尉宣王還至河內，帝驛馬召到，引入臥內，執其手謂曰：「吾疾甚，以後事屬君，君其與爽輔少子。吾得見君，無所恨！」宣王頓首流涕。〔一〕即日，帝崩于嘉福殿，〔二〕時年三十六。〔三〕癸丑，葬高平陵。〔四〕










[33] Wèi lüè states: The Emperor followed Liú Fàng’s plan, summoning Sīmǎ [Yì] Xuān-wáng, by his own strength made an Edict, it was sealed, and looked back to call the Palace Central Regular for sending envoys saying: “Warden, come! You support me in having this Edict conferred on the Grand Commandant.” The warden galloped to leave. Before this, the King of Yān on behalf of the Emperor drew up a plan, that as Guānzhōng’s affairs were important, it was appropriate to use the shortcut side roads to send [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng from Hénèi to return west, and the matter was put into effect. [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng obtained the previous Edict, and shortly after this again obtained the later hand-written one, suspected the capital had a rebellion, and thus galloped to arrive, entering to meet the Emperor. The inquiries of his labors finished, then summoned the two Kings of Qí and Qín to show to [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng, separately pointing at the King of Qí to say to [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng stating: “This is the one. You carefully look at him, and make no mistake.” Also instructed the King of Qí to go forward and hug [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng’s neck.
Wèishì Chūnqiū states: At the time the Heir-Apparent [Cáo] Fāng’s age was eight years, the King of Qín nine years, at the bedside. The Emperor grasped [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng’s hand and staring at the Heir-Apparent said: “Death then also can be endured. We endured death to wait for you. You will with [Cáo] Shuǎng support him.” [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng said: “Does Your Majesty not remember the Former Emperor entrusted Your Servant with Your Majesty?



〔一〕　魏略曰：帝既從劉放計，召司馬宣王，自力為詔，既封，顧呼宮中常所給使者曰：「辟邪來！汝持我此詔授太尉也。」辟邪馳去。先是，燕王為帝畫計，以為關中事重，宜便道遣宣王從河內西還，事以施行。宣王得前詔，斯須復得後手筆，疑京師有變，乃馳到，入見帝。勞問訖，乃召齊、秦二王以示宣王，別指齊王謂宣王曰：「此是也，君諦視之，勿誤也！」又教齊王令前抱宣王頸。魏氏春秋曰：時太子芳年八歲，秦王九歲，在于御側。帝執宣王手，目太子曰：「死乃復可忍，朕忍死待君，君其與爽輔此。」宣王曰：「陛下不見先帝屬臣以陛下乎？」













[34] Wèi shū states: Encoffined in Jiǔlóng Front Hall.



〔二〕　魏書曰：殯于九龍前殿。













[35] Your Servant Sōngzhī notes: Wèi Wǔ in Jiàn’ān Ninth Year Eighth Moon settled Yè, Emperor Wén only then accepted Empress Zhēn, Emperor Míng should have been born in the Tenth Year. Calculating to reach this year’s Standard Moon, altogether it is only thirty-four years. At the time there was a change of the Standard Calendar, having the former year’s Twelfth Moon be this year’s Standard Moon, which can force the count to thirty-five years, not thirty-six years.



〔三〕　臣松之按：魏武以建安九年八月定鄴，文帝始納甄后，明帝應以十年生，計至此年正月，整三十四年耳。時改正朔，以故年十二月為今年正月，可彊名三十五年，不得三十六也。













[36] Wèi shū states: The Emperor’s appearance and demeanor were impressive, displaying solemn dignity. From when he was in the East Palace, he did not engage with the Court ministers and did not ask after government affairs, only immersing his thoughts in books and nothing more. After he ascended the throne, he commended and respected the chief ministers, surmised and selected by achievement and ability, the true and the false unable to be passed off for one another, attended to cutting off the origins of the pretentious and flowery and of slander and defamation. In deploying the brigades and mobilizing the multitudes, discussing and deciding great affairs, the strategy ministers and officers and officials all submitted to the Emperor’s grand strategy. By nature he had especially strong memory, for even the Left and Right minor ministers, the career histories, personalities and conduct, names and reputations that he encountered, reaching to their fathers and elder brothers and sons and younger brothers, once they entered his ears or eyes, to the end he did not forget them. He swallowed insults and concealed displeasures, tolerantly accepted direct speech, listened to and accepted the sent-up letters from the officials and civilians and servicemen and commoners, within one moon several tens to hundreds of letters arriving, and even if the language was shallow and coarse, yet he read and reviewed to the end, his thoughts never tiring.
Sūn Shèng states: Hearing from elder generations, Wèi Emperor Míng had natural beauty refined and exceptional, on standing his hair hung to the ground, he stuttered and seldom spoke, but was steady and firm and very decisive. Previously, the various Excellencies received legacy orders to support and guide him, but the Emperor placed them all in regional appointments and governance came from himself. But he was exceptionally courteous to the chief ministers, open and tolerant and enjoying directness, and even when offended to the face with extreme remonstration, none were repressed or killed, his capacity as a lord of men was as great as this. However he did not consider establishing virtue to bequeath influence, did not solidify the foundation of maintaining walls, so that it caused great power to be unbalanced, the State Altars without protection, a sorrow!



〔四〕　魏書曰：帝容止可觀，望之儼然。自在東宮，不交朝臣，不問政事，唯潛思書籍而已。即位之後，褒禮大臣，料簡功能，真偽不得相貿，務絕浮華譖毀之端，行師動眾，論決大事，謀臣將相，咸服帝之大略。性特彊識，雖左右小臣官簿性行，名跡所履，及其父兄子弟，一經耳目，終不遺忘。含垢藏疾，容受直言，聽受吏民士庶上書，一月之中至數十百封，雖文辭鄙陋，猶覽省究竟，意無厭倦。孫監曰：聞之長老，魏明帝天姿秀出，立髮垂地，口吃少言，而沉毅好斷。初，諸公受遺輔導，帝皆以方任處之，政自己出。而優禮大臣，開容善直，雖犯顏極諫，無所摧戮，其君人之量如此之偉也。然不思建德垂風，不固維城之基，至使大權偏據，社稷無衛，悲夫！







Appraisal States: Emperor Míng was steady and firm, decisive and knowledgeable, followed his will and enacted it, overall having the utmost bearing of a lord of men. At the time when the Hundred Surnames were exhausted and worn, the Four Seas divided and collapsed, he did not first cultivate the legacy of his ancestors to open and expand vast foundations, but instead hurriedly imitated Qín Huáng and Hàn Wǔ, building Palaces and buildings, shelving the long-term plans, was it dangerous haste!



評曰：明帝沉毅斷識，任心而行，蓋有君人之至概焉。于時百姓彫弊，四海分崩，不先聿脩顯祖，闡拓洪基，而遽追秦皇、漢武，宮館是營，格之遠猷，其殆疾乎！

title: 4  Annals of Three Young Emperors
crumbs: 4  Annals of Three Young Emperors

title: 4  Annals of Three Young Emperors
text:
The King of Qí forbidden name Fāng, appellation Lánqīng. Emperor Míng was without sons, and adopted the King and the King of Qín [Cáo] Xún. The Palace affairs were confidential, none had knowledge of where they came from. [1] Qīnglóng Third Year [235], established as King of Qí. Jǐngchū Third Year, Standard Moon [239 Jan 22 – Feb 20], Dīnghài [239 Jan 22], first day of the moon, the Emperor was extremely ill, and so established him as Imperial Heir-Apparent. That day, he assumed the Imperial Emperor’s throne, Great Amnesty. Honored the Imperial Empress as Imperial Dowager Empress. General-in-Chief Cáo Shuǎng and Grand Commandant Sīmǎ [Yì] Xuān-wáng assisted in governing. Edict said: “We with meager body continue and inherit a vast enterprise, utterly alone in grief, with no way to express it. The General-in-Chief and Grand Commandant respectively received the final command, to on each side assist Our person, the Excellency over the Masses, Excellency of Works, the senior ministers and foremost assistants together lead the hundred offices, to secure the State Altars. Thus with the various ministers and grandees exhort yourselves in heart, to accord with Our intentions. All the conscriptions for raising and building Palaces Residences are all by legacy Edict dismissed. Government slaves sixty and above are dismissed to be free persons.” Second Moon [239 Feb 21 – Mar 21], the Western Regions with relay translators proffered fire-laundered cloth, Edict on the General-in-Chief and Grand Commandant to oversee its testing to show to the hundred offices. [2]



齊王諱芳，字蘭卿。明帝無子，養王及秦王詢；宮省事祕，莫有知其所由來者。〔一〕青龍三年，立為齊王。景初三年正月丁亥朔，帝甚病，乃立為皇太子。是日，即皇帝位，大赦。尊皇后曰皇太后。大將軍曹爽、太尉司馬宣王輔政。詔曰：「朕以眇身，繼承鴻業，煢煢在疚，靡所控告。大將軍、太尉奉受末命，夾輔朕躬，司徒、司空、冢宰、元輔總率百寮，以寧社稷，其與群卿大夫勉勗乃心，稱朕意焉。諸所興作宮室之役，皆以遺詔罷之。官奴婢六十已上，免為良人。」二月，西域重譯獻火浣布，詔大將軍、太尉臨試以示百寮。〔二〕










[1] Wèishì Chūnqiū states: Some say they were the King of Rènchéng [Cáo] Kǎi’s sons.



〔一〕　魏氏春秋曰：或云任城王楷子。













[2] Yìwù zhì states: Sītiáo state has a fire island, in the middle of the south sea. On its top there are wild fires, in spring and summer on their own appearing, in autumn and winter on their own dying. There are trees growing in the middle that are not consumed, the branches and bark all the more thrive, in autumn and winter the fires die and then they all wither and decay. Their local custom is to collect their bark in winter to make cloth, the color a slightly green black; if dust or dirt stains it, then it is thrown into fire, and then it is all the more clean and bright.
Fù-zǐ states: In Hàn Emperor Huán’s time, General-in-Chief Liáng Jì used fire-laundered cloth to make a single robe, once at a great gathering of guest retainers, [Liáng] Jì acted as if fighting over liquor, spilled the cup and stained it, feigned anger, took off the robe and said: “Burn it.” The cloth caught fire, glowing bright, like burning ordinary cloth, the stain was consumed and fire extinguished, it was clear bright clean white, as if washed with lye water.
Sōushénjì states: In the wilderness of Kūnlún, there is a mountain of flaming fire, atop the mountain are birds and beasts and grasses and trees, all living in the middle of the flames, therefore if there is fire-laundered cloth, if it is not the bark or nettles of the grasses and trees, then it is the feathers or furs of the birds and beasts. In Hàn’s time the Western Regions used to proffer this cloth, in the interim they were for a long time cut off, so reaching to Wèi’s beginning, at the time people doubted if it existed or not. Emperor Wén believed that fire’s nature was too fierce, without an essence to tolerate life, and wrote this in the Diǎnlùn, to make clear that it was not true and end any belief by the intelligent. Reaching to Emperor Míng’s establishment, Edict on the Three Excellencies said: “The Former Emperor in the past wrote the Diǎnlùn, proper words that do not decay, thus carve on stone outside the gates of the Temple and the Grand Academy, with the Stone Classics together, to forever show to coming generations.” Reaching to when the Western Regions envoys arrived and proffered fire-laundered cloth, thereupon they were chiseled to remove this discussion, and Heaven’s Under laughed at it.
Your Servant Sōngzhī in the past accompanied the western campaign to reach Luòyáng, successively observed old artifacts, saw the Diǎnlùn stone at the Grand Academy was still preserved, but the outside of the Temple gates was without it. Asking the various elders, they said that when Jìn first received the abdication, they at once used the Wèi Temple, and moved this stone to the Grand Academy, and there were not two locations of establishment. I humbly say this report is not correct.
Also Dōngfāng Shuò’s Shényìjīng states: Beyond the southern wilderness there is a fire mountain, length thirty lǐ, width fifty lǐ, in the middle all are living trees that do not become ash, day and night burning in fire, in heavy winds it does not grow fiercer, in fierce rain it is not extinguished. In the fire there are rats, weight a hundred jīn, hair length over two chǐ, slender as silk, and can be made into cloth. Commonly they reside in fire, color a thorough red, and at times when they go out then their color becomes white. With water pursuing and dousing them they at once die, collecting their hairs, weaving into cloth.



〔二〕　異物志曰：斯調國有火州，在南海中。其上有野火，春夏自生，秋冬自死。有木生于其中而不消也，枝皮更活，秋冬火死則皆枯瘁。其俗常冬采其皮以為布，色小青黑；若塵垢汙之，便投火中，則更鮮明也。傅子曰：漢桓帝時，大將軍梁冀以火浣布為單衣，常大會賓客，冀陽爭酒，失杯而汙之，偽怒，解衣曰：「燒之。」布得火，煒曄赫然，如燒凡布，垢盡火滅，粲然絜白，若用灰水焉。搜神記曰：崑崙之墟，有炎火之山，山上有鳥獸草木，皆生於炎火之中，故有火浣布，非此山草木之皮枲，則其鳥獸之毛也。漢世西域舊獻此布，中間久絕；至魏初，時人疑其無有。文帝以為火性酷烈，無含生之氣，著之典論，明其不然之事，絕智者之聽。及明帝立，詔三公曰：「先帝昔著典論，不朽之格言，其刊石於廟門之外及太學，與石經並，以永示來世。」至是西域使至而獻火浣布焉，於是刊滅此論，而天下笑之。臣松之昔從征西至洛陽，歷觀舊物，見典論石在太學者尚存，而廟門外無之，問諸長老，云晉初受禪，即用魏廟，移此石于太學，非兩處立也。竊謂此言為不然。又東方朔神異經曰：南荒之外有火山，長三十里，廣五十里，其中皆生不燼之木，晝夜火燒，得暴風不猛，猛雨不滅。火中有鼠，重百斤，毛長二尺餘，細如絲，可以作布。常居火中，色洞赤，時時出外而色白，以水逐而沃之即死，續其毛，織以為布。







Dīngchǒu [239 Mar 13], Edict said: “The Grand Commandant embodies principles correct and upright, exhaustively loyal for three reigns, to the south captured Mèng Dá, to the west defeated the Shǔ caitiffs, to the east exterminated Gōngsūn Yuān, achievements crowning Within the Seas. In the past Zhōu Chéng established the offices of Protector and Tutor, more recently Hàn Xiǎnzōng esteemed and favored Dèng Yǔ, in order to specially glorify the outstanding and exceptional who must have honors. Thus appoint the Grand Commandant as Grand Tutor, Holding Stave to preside over troops as Overall Commander of various army affairs as before.” Third Moon [239 Mar 22 – Apr 20], appointed Campaigning East General Mǎn Chǒng as Grand Commandant. Summer, Sixth Moon [239 Jun 19 – Jul 17], as Liáodōng’s Tà county’s officials and people crossed the sea to reside at Qí prefecture’s border, used former Zòngchéng to form Xīntà county to house the relocated people. Autumn, Seventh Moon [239 Jul 18 – Aug 16], the Superior first personally oversaw Court, hearing the Excellencies and Ministers memorialize affairs. Eighth Moon [239 Aug 17 – Sep 14], Great Amnesty. Winter, Tenth Moon [239 Oct 15 – Nov 12], Defending South General Huáng Quán became Chariots and Cavalry General.



丁丑詔曰：「太尉體道正直，盡忠三世，南擒孟達，西破蜀虜，東滅公孫淵，功蓋海內。昔周成建保傅之官，近漢顯宗崇寵鄧禹，所以優隆雋乂，必有尊也。其以太尉為太傅，持節統兵都督諸軍事如故。」三月，以征東將軍滿寵為太尉。夏六月，以遼東東沓縣吏民渡海居齊郡界，以故縱城為新沓縣以居徙民。秋七月，上始親臨朝，聽公卿奏事。八月，大赦。冬十月，鎮南將軍黃權為車騎將軍。




Twelfth Moon [240 Dec 13 – 240 Jan 11], Edict said: “Lièzǔ Míng Huángdì in the Standard Moon relinquished and departed Heaven’s Under, the ministers and subjects will forever remember the sorrows of the tragic day, thus return to using the Xià Standard. Although it violates the Former Emperor’s principles of continuing the Three Lineages, this also is a reason for Ritual standards to be changed and reformed. Also the Xià Standard in calculations is for obtaining Heaven’s Standard, thus use the Jiàn Yín Moon to be Zhèngshǐ Inaugural Year Standard Moon, use the Jiàn Chǒu Moon as the next Twelfth Moon.



十二月，詔曰：「烈祖明皇帝以正月棄背天下，臣子永惟忌日之哀，其復用夏正；雖違先帝通三統之義，斯亦禮制所由變改也。又夏正於數為得天正，其以建寅之月為正始元年正月，以建丑月為後十二月。」




Zhèngshǐ Inaugural Year, Spring, Second Moon [240 Mar 11 – Apr 8], Yǐchǒu, added titles on Attendant Central Central Writers Supervisor Liú Fàng and Attendant Central Central Writers Director Sūn Zī as Left and Right Radiant Grandees. Bǐngxū [240 Mar 16], as Liáodōng’s Wèn and Běifēng counties’ people were relocating across the sea, divided along Qí prefecture’s Xī’ān, Línzī, Chāngguó counties’ borders to form Xīnwèn and Nánfēng counties to house the refugees.



正始元年春二月乙丑，加侍中中書監劉放、侍中中書令孫資為左右光祿大夫。丙戌，以遼東汶、北豐縣民流徙渡海，規齊郡之西安、臨菑、昌國縣界為新汶、南豐縣，以居流民。




From the previous winter Twelfth Moon reaching to this moon there was no rain. Bǐngyín [240 Apr 25], Edict ordered prison offices to urgently redress injustices, investigate and release the light and trivial, and the various Excellencies and Ministers and servicemen of honest speech and commendable plans were each to thoroughly explain their hearts. Summer, Fourth Moon [240 May 9 – Jun 6], Chariots and Cavalry General Huáng Quán died. Autumn, Seventh Moon [240 Aug 5 – Sep 3], Edict said: “The Yì says ‘decrease above increase below,’ ‘limit by systems, do not injure wealth, do not harm people.’ Right now the Hundred Surnames do not have enough and yet the Attendant Offices create many gold and silver trifling objects; what is it for? Now send out yellow gold and silver objects of one hundred fifty varieties, over one thousand eight hundred jīn, to melt down to provide for military expenditures.” Eighth Moon [240 Sep 4 – Oct 2], the Chariot Carriage toured and inspected Luòyáng’s borders’ autumn harvest, bestowed on the highly aged and diligent-farmers each on distinct basis.



自去冬十二月至此月不雨。丙寅，詔令獄官亟平冤枉，理出輕微；群公卿士讜言嘉謀，各悉乃心。夏四月，車騎將軍黃權薨。秋七月，詔曰：「易稱損上益下，節以制度，不傷財，不害民。方今百姓不足而御府多作金銀雜物，將奚以為？今出黃金銀物百五十種，千八百餘斤，銷冶以供軍用」八月，車駕巡省洛陽界秋稼，賜高年力田各有差。




Second Year, Spring, Second Moon [241 Feb 28 – Mar 28], the Emperor first completed the Lúnyǔ, sent the Minister of Ceremonies with Grand Offering to sacrifice to Kǒng-zǐ at Bìyōng, with Yán Yuān accompanying.



二年春二月，帝初通論語，使太常以太牢祭孔子於辟雍，以顏淵配。




Summer, Fifth Moon [241 May 28 – Jun 25], Wú officer Zhū Rán and others besieged Xiāngyáng’s Fánchéng, Grand Tutor Sīmǎ [Yì] Xuān-wáng led the multitudes to resist them. [3] Sixth Moon [241 Jun 26 – Jul 25], Xīnchǒu [241 Jul 24], [Zhū Rán] retreated. Jǐmǎo [241 Jul 2], appointed Campaigning East General Wáng Líng as Chariots and Cavalry General. Winter, Twelfth Moon [242 Jan 19 – Feb 16], Nán’ān prefecture earthquake.



夏五月，吳將朱然等圍襄陽之樊城，太傅司馬宣王率眾拒之〔一〕。六月辛丑，退。己卯，以征東將軍王淩為車騎將軍。冬十二月，南安郡地震。










[3] Gān Bǎo’s Jìn jì states: Wú officers Quán Cóng invaded Quèbēi, Zhū Rán and Sūn Lún with fifty thousand men besieged Fánchéng, Zhūgě Jǐn and Bù Zhì invaded Zhāzhōng. [Quán] Cóng had already been defeated and fled but Fán’s siege was critical. [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng said: “Zhāzhōng’s civilians and Yí are a hundred thousand, separated to the river’s south, wandering apart without a master, Fánchéng has been attacked for successive moons without resolution; this is a dangerous situation. I request to personally suppress them.” The commentators all said: “The rebels from afar besiege Fánchéng and cannot take it, repressed below firm city walls, having a momentum to be defeated on their own. It is appropriate to use a long-term strategy to deal with them.” [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng said: “Military treatises have this: ‘[if] the officer is capable and yet to restrain him, this is a shackled army; [if] incapable and yet to appoint him, this is an overturned army.’ Now the borders are disturbed, the people’s hearts in doubt and confusion, this is a great concern for the State Altars.” Sixth Moon [241 Jun 26 – Jul 25], commanded the various armies on southern campaign, the Chariot Carriage escorting him to outside Jīnyáng city gates. [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng believed the south was hot and humid, not appropriate to hold for a long time, and sent light cavalry to provoke them, [Zhū] Rán did not dare move. Thereupon then ordered the various armies to rest and wash, selected the elite, recruited a first to ascend, extended orders, showing a momentum of being certain to attack. [Zhū] Rán and the rest heard this, and so in the night escaped. Pursued reaching to Sānzhōukǒu, greatly killed and captured.



〔一〕　干寶晉紀曰：吳將全琮寇芍陂，朱然、孫倫五萬人圍樊城，諸葛瑾、步騭寇柤中；琮已破走而樊圍急。宣王曰：「柤中民夷十萬，隔在水南，流離無主，樊城被攻，歷月不解，此危事也，請自討之。」議者咸言：「賊遠圍樊城不可拔，挫于堅城之下，有自破之勢，宜長策以御之。」宣王曰：「軍志有之：將能而御之，此為縻軍；不能而任之，此為覆軍。今疆埸騷動，民心疑惑，是社稷之大憂也。」六月，督諸軍南征，車駕送津陽城門外。宣王以南方暑溼，不宜持久，使輕騎挑之，然不敢動。於是乃令諸軍休息洗沐，簡精銳，募先登，申號令，示必攻之勢。然等聞之，乃夜遁。追至三州口，大殺獲。







Third Year, Spring, Standard Moon [242 Feb 17 – Mar 18], the King of Dōngpíng [Cáo] Huī died. Third Moon [242 Apr 17 – May 16], Grand Commandant Mǎn Chǒng died. Autumn, Seventh Moon [242 Aug 14 – Sep 11], Jiǎshēn [242 Aug 31], Nán’ān prefecture earthquake. Yǐyǒu [242 Sep 1], appointed Manager of the Army General Jiǎng Jì as Grand Commandant. Winter, Twelfth Moon [243 Jan 8 – Feb 6], Wèi prefecture earthquake.



三年春正月，東平王徽薨。三月，太尉滿寵薨。秋七月甲申，南安郡地震。乙酉，以領軍將軍蔣濟為太尉。冬十二月，魏郡地震。




Fourth Year, Spring, Standard Moon [243 Feb 7 – Mar 7], the Emperor was applied the foremost dress, bestowed on the various ministers each on distinct basis. Summer, Fourth Moon [243 May 6 – Jun 4], Yǐmǎo [243 May 29], enthroned as Imperial Empress Zhēn-shì, Great Amnesty. Fifth Moon [243 Jun 5 – Jul 3], first day of the moon, the sun was eclipsed, completely. Autumn, Seventh Moon [243 Aug 3 – Aug 31], Edict to sacrifice to former Marshals-in-Chief Cáo Zhēn, Cáo Xiū, Campaigning South General-in-Chief Xiàhóu Shàng, Minister of Ceremonies Huán Jiē, Excellency of Works Chén Qún, Grand Tutor Zhōng Yáo, Chariots and Cavalry General Zhāng Hé, Left General Xú Huǎng, Front General Zhāng Liáo, Right General Yuè Jìn, Grand Commandant Huà Xīn, Excellency over the Masses Wáng Lǎng, Agile Cavalry General Cáo Hóng, Campaigning West General Xiàhóu Yuān, Rear Generals Zhū Líng, Wén Pìn, Metal Mace Bearer Zāng Bà, Defeating Caitiffs General Lǐ Diǎn, Setting Righteousness General Páng Dé, Martial Fierceness Colonel Diǎn Wéi in Tàizǔ Temple Hall. Winter, Twelfth Moon [243 Dec 29 – 244 Jan 26], Wō state female king Bǐmíhū sent envoy to proffer tribute.



四年春正月，帝加元服，賜群臣各有差。夏四月乙卯，立皇后甄氏，大赦。五月朔，日有食之，既。秋七月，詔祀故大司馬曹真、曹休、征南大將軍夏侯尚、太常桓階、司空陳群、太傅鍾繇、車騎將軍張郃、左將軍徐晃、前將軍張遼、右將軍樂進、太尉華歆、司徒王朗、驃騎將軍曹洪、征西將軍夏侯淵、後將軍朱靈、文聘、執金吾臧霸、破虜將軍李典、立義將軍龐德、武猛校尉典韋於太祖廟庭。冬十二月，倭國女王俾彌呼遣使奉獻。




Fifth Year, Spring, Second Moon [244 Feb 26 – Mar 25], Edict on General-in-Chief Cáo Shuǎng to lead the multitudes to campaign against Shǔ. Summer, Fourth Moon [244 May 24 – Jun 22], first day of the moon, the sun was eclipsed. Fifth Moon [244 Jun 23 – Jul 21], Guǐsì [244 Jun 30], lectures on the Shàng Shū jīng completed, sent the Minister of Ceremonies with Grand Offering to sacrifice to Kǒng-zǐ at Bìyōng, with Yán Yuān accompanying. Bestowals on the Grand Tutor, General-in-Chief, and the attendant lecturers each on distinct basis. Bǐngwǔ [244 Jul 13], General-in-Chief Cáo Shuǎng withdrew the army and returned. Autumn, Eighth Moon [244 Sep 19 – Oct 18], the King of Qín [Cáo] Xún died. Ninth Moon [244 Oct 19 – Nov 16], the Xiānbēi inwardly submitted, installed Liáodōng Dependent State and established Chānglí county to house them. Winter, Eleventh Moon [244 Dec 17 – 245 Jan 14], Guǐmǎo [245 Jan 6], Edict to sacrifice to former Secretariat Writers Director Xún Yōu in Tàizǔ Temple Hall. [4] Jǐyǒu [245 Jan 12], reverted Qín state to Jīngzhào prefecture. Twelfth Moon [245 Jan 15 – Feb 13], Excellency of Works Cuī Lín died.



五年春二月，詔大將軍曹爽率眾征蜀。夏四月朔，日有蝕之。五月癸巳，講尚書經通，使太常以太牢祀孔子於辟雍，以顏淵配；賜太傳、大將軍及侍講者各有差。丙午，大將軍曹爽引軍還。秋八月，秦王詢薨。九月，鮮卑內附，置遼東屬國，立昌黎縣以居之。冬十一月癸卯，詔祀故尚書令荀攸于太祖廟庭。〔一〕己酉，復秦國為京兆郡。十二月，司空崔林薨。










[4] Your Servant Sōngzhī believes the reason the Wèi clan accompanying sacrifices did not reach Xún Yù probably was as in his final years he dissented, and also because his position was not as a Wèi minister. As for raising Chéng Yù but omitting Guō Jiā, advancing Zhōng Yáo and afterward Xún Yōu, then the reasoning is unclear. Xú Tā plotted rebellion and Xǔ Chǔ’s heart was roused, the utmost far-reaching loyalty and sincerity the same as [Jīn] Mìdī, and moreover at the danger of Tóng Pass, if not for [Xǔ] Chǔ there would have been no rescue. The achievements and exploits of [Xǔ] Chǔ surpassed those of Diǎn Wéi, now sacrificing to [Diǎn] Wéi but not [Xǔ] Chǔ also is not understandable.



〔一〕　臣松之以為故魏氏配饗不及荀彧，蓋以其末年異議，又位非魏臣故也。至于升程昱而遺郭嘉，先鍾繇而後荀攸，則未詳厥趣也。（徐佗）〔徐他〕謀逆而許褚心動，忠誠之至遠同于日磾，且潼關之危，非褚不濟，褚之功烈有過典韋，今祀韋而不及褚，又所未達也。







Sixth Year, Spring, Second Moon [245 Mar 15 – Apr 13], Dīngmǎo [245 Mar 31], Nán’ān prefecture earthquake. Bǐngzǐ [245 Apr 9], appointed Agile Cavalry General Zhào Yǎn as Excellency of Works. Summer, Sixth Moon [245 Jul 12 – Aug 9], [Zhào] Yǎn died. Eighth Moon [256 Sep 9 – Oct 7] Dīngmǎo [245 Sep 27], appointed Minister of Ceremonies Gāo Róu as Excellency of Works. Guǐsì, appointed Left Radiant Grandee Liú Fàng as Agile Cavalry General, Right Radiant Grandee Sūn Zī became Guard General. Winter, Eleventh Moon [245 Dec 6 – Jan 4], Xiá sacrifices in Tàizǔ Temple, first sacrificing to the previously discussed ministers assisting the mandate of twenty-one men. Twelfth Moon [246 Jan 5 – Feb 2], Xīnhài [246 Jan 9], Edict that former Excellency over the Masses Wáng Lǎng’s composed Yì Zhuàn was to be used by scholars for classes and exams. Yǐhài [246 Feb 2], Edict said: “Tomorrow there will be a great assembly of the various ministers, thus order the Grand Tutor to ride carriage up to the Hall.”



六年春二月丁卯，南安郡地震。丙子，以驃騎將軍趙儼為司空；夏六月，儼薨。八月丁卯，以太常高柔為司空。癸巳，以左光祿大夫劉放為驃騎將軍，右光祿大夫孫資為衛將軍。冬十一月，祫祭太祖廟，始祀前所論佐命臣二十一人。十二月辛亥，詔故司徒王朗所作易傳，令學者得以課試。乙亥，詔曰：「明日大會群臣，其令太傅乘輿上殿。」




Seventh Year, Spring, Second Moon [246 Mar 5 – Apr 2], Yōu Province Inspector Guànqiū Jiǎn suppressed Gāogōulí. Summer, Fifth Moon [246 Jun 1 – Jun 30], suppressed Huìmò. Defeated them all. Hán, Nuóxī, and others of several tens of states each led their tribes to surrender. Autumn, Eighth Moon [246 Aug 29 – Sep 27], Wùshēn [246 Sep 3], Edict said: “Recently arriving in the markets and observing the selling of expelled government slaves, their years are all seventy, some weak and ill, what is called the most destitute of all people. Moreover for the government to have exhausted their strength and then again sell them, in advancing or withdrawing it is without meaning, thus entirely release them as free persons. If there are any that cannot support themselves, the prefectures and counties are to provide for them.” [5]



七年春二月，幽州刺史毌丘儉討高句驪，夏五月，討濊貊，皆破之。韓那奚等數十國各率種落降。秋八月戊申，詔曰：「屬到巿觀見所斥賣官奴婢，年皆七十，或癃疾殘病，所謂天民之窮者也。且官以其力竭而復鬻之，進退無謂，其悉遣為良民。若有不能自存者，郡縣振給之。」〔一〕










[5] Your Servant Sōngzhī notes: When the Emperor first ascended the throne, there was an Edict “government slaves sixty and above are dismissed to be free persons.” If there was this edict, then it should therefore be a perpetual system. Within seven to eight years yet again there is selling of those aged seventy. Moreover slaves of seventy that are weak and ill are not things that would sell, and yet to sell them in the markets, these are all matters difficult to resolve.



〔一〕　臣松之案：帝初即位，有詔「官奴婢六十以上免為良人」。既有此詔，則宜遂為永制。七八年間，而復貨年七十者，且七十奴婢及癃疾殘病，並非可售之物，而鬻之於巿，此皆事之難解。







Jǐyǒu [246 Sep 4], Edict said: “I will on the nineteenth day [246 Sep 16] personally sacrifice, but yesterday when going out I personally saw road repairs, if it rains it will have to again be rebuilt, in vain expending labor efforts. I always remember that the Hundred Surnames have little strength but much conscription, morning and night keeping it in heart. The roads should only seek to be advantageous for transportation, hearing that there is beating of the old and small to work on making lofty decorations, causing fatigue and destitution, it brings grieving sighs; how can I calmly ride on this and travel to deliver fragrant virtue to the Ancestral Temple? From now on afterward, clearly extend these orders.” Winter, Twelfth Moon [246 Dec 25 – 247 Jan 23], lectures on the Lǐjì completed, sent the Minister of Ceremonies with Grand Offering to sacrifice to Kǒng-zǐ at Bìyōng, with Yán Yuān accompanying. [6]



己酉，詔曰：「吾乃當以十九日親祠，而昨出已見治道，得雨當復更治，徒棄功夫。每念百姓力少役多，夙夜存心。道路但當期于通利，聞乃撾捶老小，務崇脩飾，疲困流離，以至哀歎，吾豈安乘此而行，致馨德于宗廟邪？自今已後，明申敕之。」冬十二月，講禮記通，使太常以太牢祀孔子於辟雍，以顏淵配。〔一〕










[6] Xí Zuòchǐ’s Hàn Jìn Chūnqiū states: That year, Wú officer Zhū Rán entered Zhāzhōng, killing and capturing several thousand. Zhāzhōng civilians and officials of over ten thousand families crossed the Miǎn. Sīmǎ [Yì] Xuān-wáng spoke to Cáo Shuǎng saying: “If they are again allowed to return, they will certainly again attract invasion. It is appropriate to temporarily detain them.” [Cáo] Shuǎng said: “Now to not repair the defenses of the Miǎn’s south and detain the people to the Miǎn’s north is not a long-term strategy.” [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng said: “Not so. Generally things placed on secure ground then is secure, on endangered ground then is endangered, therefore military books say success or failure is by form, security or danger is by momentum. Form and momentum are critical to controlling the masses, and cannot be not examined. Supposing if rebels of twenty thousand men cut off the Miǎn river, thirty thousand men lock together with the various armies of the Miǎn’s south, ten thousand men on land plunder Zhāzhōng, how will you rescue them?” [Cáo] Shuǎng did not listen, in the end ordering them to return. [Zhū] Rán later attacked and defeated them. Yuán Huái spoke to [Cáo] Shuǎng saying: “The people of Wú and Chǔ are frail and weak with few abilities, outstanding talents and great worthies do not appear in their lands. In comparing skills and measuring strength, they are not enough to compete with the central states. However that from high antiquity onward they have always been a concern for the central states, overall is because they have the Jiāng and Hàn as moats, boats and oars to use, when having the advantage then they plunder on land, when not having the advantage then they enter the waters, in attacking them the roads are far, the superior skills of the central states have no way to be used against them. Sūn Quán from since ten and several years onward has greatly cultivated the Jiāng’s north, mending and repairing armor and weapons, focusing his defenses. Repeatedly setting out to rob and plunder, daring to go far away from his waters, on land stationing on flat ground: this is what the central states should hope to hear. In the use of soldiers, value is in using the fed to wait for the hungry, using the rested to strike the fatigued, brigades do not wish for long times, marches do not wish to go far, defenses when fewer then are hardened, power when concentrated then is strong. Right now it is appropriate to abandon the Huái and Hàn on south, retreating back to avoid them. If the rebels are able to enter and occupy the center, coming to encroach the borders, then it will accord with their shortcomings and the superior skills will be able to be used. If they do not dare come, then the borders will obtain calm and be without the worry of plunder and theft. If our state is wealthy and soldiers strong, government cultivated and people unified, the subduing of their state is not enough to be considered far off. Now Xiāngyáng is isolated to the Hàn’s south, if the rebels follow the Hàn and go upstream, then it will be cut off and not connected, [if the rebels] in one battle are victorious, then without being attacked it will on its own submit, and therefore maintaining it is of no benefit to the state, losing it is not enough to be a disgrace. From Jiāngxià on east, the Huái’s south’s various prefectures from the three lords onward, that there have been so many deserters, is because they are near to the rebel borders and easy to plunder and rob. If they are relocated to the Huái’s north, long distances cutting off between them, then the people will be secure and pleased, and how where there be alarms of cries and barks?” They were not relocated.



〔一〕　習鑿齒漢晉春秋曰：是年，吳將朱然入柤中，斬獲數千；柤中民吏萬餘家渡沔。司馬宣王謂曹爽曰：「若便令還，必復致寇，宜權留之。」爽曰：「今不脩守沔南，留民沔北，非長策也。」宣王曰：「不然。凡物置之安地則安，危地則危，故兵書曰，成敗，形也，安危，勢也，形勢御眾之要，不可不審。設令賊二萬人斷沔水，三萬人與沔南諸軍相持，萬人陸鈔柤中，君將何以救之？」爽不聽，卒令還。然後襲破之。袁淮言于爽曰：「吳楚之民脃弱寡能，英才大賢不出其土，比技量力，不足與中國相抗，然自上世以來常為中國患者，蓋以江漢為池，舟楫為用，利則陸鈔，不利則入水，攻之道遠，中國之長技無所用之也。孫權自十數年以來，大畋江北，繕治甲兵，精其守禦，數出盜竊，敢遠其水，陸次平土，此中國所願聞也。夫用兵者，貴以飽待飢，以逸擊勞，師不欲久，行不欲遠，守少則固，力專則彊。當今宜捐淮、漢以南，退卻避之。若賊能入居中央，來侵邊境，則隨其所短，中國之長技得用矣。若不敢來，則邊境得安，無鈔盜之憂矣。使我國富兵彊，政脩民一，陵其國不足為遠矣。今襄陽孤在漢南，賊循漢而上，則斷而不通，一戰而勝，則不攻而自服，故置之無益于國，亡之不足為辱。自江夏已東，淮南諸郡，三后已來，其所亡幾何，以近賊疆界易鈔掠之故哉！若徙之淮北，遠絕其間，則民人安樂，何鳴吠之驚乎？」遂不徙。







Eighth Year, Spring, Second Moon [247 Mar 24 – Apr 21], first day of the moon, the sun was eclipsed. Summer, Fifth Moon [247 Jun 20 – Jul 19], divided Hédōng’s ten counties north of the Fén to form Píngyáng prefecture.



八年春二月朔，日有蝕之。夏五月，分河東之汾北十縣為平陽郡。




Autumn, Seventh Moon [247 Aug 18 – Sep 16], Secretariat Writer Hé Yàn’s memorial said: “Those who excel in acting for the state certainly first govern the self, those who govern the self are cautious of habits. When habits are correct then the self is correct, when the self is correct then without even commanding it yet it is enacted. When habits are not correct then the self is not correct, when the self is not correct then although it is commanded it is not obeyed. Therefore, for a lord of men, those they travel with certainly must be selected correct men, what they view certainly must be examined as correct images, discard Zhèng sounds and do not listen to it, distance from flatterers and be not close with them, only afterward do nefarious hearts not appear and correct ways can expand. A final end’s ignorant ruler does not understand what is harmful or beneficial, rejects and distances from noble men, attracts and is close with petty men, the loyal and good are estranged and distanced, the fawning and flattering are close and intimate, chaos appears in the close and familiar, described as altar rats. Examining their ignorance or enlightenment, it was accumulation that made it so, therefore the sagely and worthy are tirelessly devoted in taking it as the utmost consideration. Shùn warned Yǔ stating: ‘Neighbors ah! Neighbors ah!’ saying to be cautious on who is close by. Zhōu-gōng warned Chéng-wáng stating: ‘The friends! The friends!’ saying to be cautious on who to interact with. The Shū says: ‘One man has goodness; millions of people rely on it.’ Possibly from now on afterward, when the carriage visits Shìgàn Hall and tours for recreation in the Rear Garden, all the chief ministers should attend and follow, taking advantage of when at ease in plays and feasts to simultaneously review written documents, inquire on and plan government affairs, discuss and debate the meanings of the classics, to be a law for myriad ages.” Winter, Twelfth Moon [248 Jan 13 – Feb 11], Cavalier Regular Attendant Remonstration Grandee Kǒng Yì’s memorial said: “By Ritual, the Palace of Heaven’s Son has systems of carving and polishing, no decorations of vermilion and cinnabar. It is appropriate to adhere to ritual and restore the ancient ways. Now Heaven’s Under is already pacified, lord and servant clearly distinguished in status, Your Majesty should only be unremitting in position, maintain fair and correct heart, careful in reward and punishment to employ them. You can end the Rear Garden practice of riding horses, in going out you must drive carriage or ride chariot. This is a fortune for Heaven’s Under and what Your Servants desire.” [Hé] Yàn and [Kǒng] Yì both took advantage of deficiencies to advance to remonstrate.



秋七月，尚書何晏奏曰：「善為國者必先治其身，治其身者慎其所習。所習正則其身正，其身正則不令而行；所習不正則其身不正，其身不正則雖令不從。是故為人君者，所與游必擇正人，所觀覽必察正象，放鄭聲而弗聽，遠佞人而弗近，然後邪心不生而正道可弘也。季末闇主，不知損益，斥遠君子，引近小人，忠良疏遠，便辟褻狎，亂生近暱，譬之社鼠；考其昏明，所積以然，故聖賢諄諄以為至慮。舜戒禹曰『鄰哉鄰哉』，言慎所近也，周公戒成王曰『其朋其朋』，言慎所與也。（詩）〔書〕云：『一人有慶，兆民賴之。』可自今以後，御幸式乾殿及游豫後園，皆大臣侍從，因從容戲宴，兼省文書，詢謀政事，講論經義，為萬世法。」冬十二月，散騎常侍諫議大夫孔乂奏曰：「禮，天子之宮，有斲礱之制，無朱丹之飾，宜循禮復古。今天下已平，君臣之分明，陛下但當不懈于位，平公正之心，審賞罰以使之。可絕後園習騎乘馬，出必御輦乘車，天下之福，臣子之願也。」晏、乂咸因闕以進規諫。




Ninth Year, Spring, Second Moon [248 Mar 12 – Apr 10], Guard General Central Writers Director Sūn Zī, Guǐzǐ [248 Apr 10], Agile Cavalry General Central Writers Supervisor Liú Fàng, Third Moon [248 Apr 11 – May 9], Jiǎwǔ [248 Apr 11], Excellency over the Masses Wèi Zhēn, each resigned their positions, as Marquesses returned to their mansions, ranked Specially Advanced. Fourth Moon [248 May 10 – Jun 8], appointed Excellency of Works Gāo Róu as Excellency over the Masses, Radiant Grandee Xú Miǎo as Excellency of Works, he firmly declined and would not accept. Autumn, Ninth Moon [248 Oct 5 – Nov 2], appointed Chariots and Cavalry General Wáng Líng as Excellency of Works. Winter, Tenth Moon [248 Nov 3 – Dec 2], heavy winds blew off roofs and broke trees.



九年春二月，衛將軍中書令孫資，癸巳，驃騎將軍中書監劉放，三月甲午，司徒衛臻，各遜位，以侯就第，位特進。四月，以司空高柔為司徒；光祿大夫徐邈為司空，固辭不受。秋九月，以車騎將軍王淩為司空。冬十月，大風發屋折樹。
crumbs: 4  Annals of Three Young Emperors

title: 4  Annals of Three Young Emperors
text:
Jiāpíng (249 - 253)


Jiāpíng Inaugural Year, Spring, Standard Moon [249 Jan 31 – Feb 28], Jiǎwǔ [249 Feb 5], the Chariot Carriage visited Gāopínglíng. [7] Grand Tutor Sīmǎ [Yì] Xuān-wáng memorialized to dismiss General-in-Chief Cáo Shuǎng and [Cáo] Shuǎng’s younger brothers Central Manager of the Army [Cáo] Xī, Martial Guard General [Cáo] Xùn, Cavalier Regular Attendant [Cáo] Yàn from office, to as Marquesses return to their mansions. Wúxū [249 Feb 9], relevant managers memorialized to arrest Yellow Gate Zhāng Dāng to send to the Minister of Justice, to investigate and verify his testimony that he and [Cáo] Shuǎng had plotted treason. Also Secretariat Writers Dīng Mì, Dèng Yáng, Hé Yàn, Director of Retainers Colonel Bì Guǐ, Jīng Province Inspector Lǐ Shèng, Minister of Agriculture Huán Fàn all had with [Cáo] Shuǎng communicated treacherous plans, exterminated three clans. 〔二〕　孔衍漢魏春秋曰：詔使太常王肅冊命太傅為丞相，增邑萬戶，群臣奏事不得稱名，如漢霍光故事。太傅上書辭讓曰：「臣親受顧命，憂深責重，憑賴天威，摧弊姦凶，贖罪為幸，功不足論。又三公之官，聖王所制，著之典禮。至于丞相，始自秦政。漢氏因之，無復變改。今三公之官皆備，橫復寵臣，違越先典，革聖明之經，襲秦漢之路，雖在異人，臣所宜正，況當臣身而不固爭，四方議者將謂臣何！」書十餘上，詔乃許之，復加九錫之禮。太傅又言：「太祖有大功大德，漢氏崇重，故加九錫，此乃歷代異事，非後代之君臣所得議也。」又辭不受。
