This boy heard of this, himself knew his crimes were heavy, plotted to murder his parent and to rebel, bribed my Left and Right personnel, ordered them to take advantage of when I took medicine, to secretly take advantage to poison me, and he repeatedly had such plans. The situation was already discovered, he directly wished to take advantage of an opportunity to lead soldiers to enter the West Palace to kill me, set out to capture the General-in-Chief, calling on Attendant Central Wáng Chén, Cavalier Regular Attendant Wáng Yè, [27] Secretariat Writer Wáng Jīng, producing from his chest a yellow silk Edict to show them, saying that today he would put it into effect. My grave danger surpassed that of a pile of eggs. I am an old widow; how can I overly begrudge my remaining life? It is only that I would be aggrieved by the Former Emperor’s remaining wishes not being fulfilled, that the State Altars being overturned would be too painful and that is all. Relying on the spirits of the Ancestral Temple, [Wáng] Chén and [Wáng] Yè at once hurried to tell the General-in-Chief, so we were able to be forewarned and alert, but this boy still commanded his Left and Right to set out Yúnlóng Gate, thundering war drums, personally wielding blade, with his Left and Right mixed with the guard together entering into the battle lines, and on the front lines came to harm. This boy in conduct was rebellious and without principles, and also brought on himself great disaster, doubling my grief in heart that cannot be spoken of. In the past Hàn’s King of Chāngyì for his crimes was deposed to a commoner, this boy also should be buried by a civilian’s Rituals. Now inside and outside are all to know of this boy’s conduct. Also Secretariat Writer Wáng Jīng was a vicious traitor of insolence, thus arrest [Wáng] Jīng with his family and dependents to all be sent to the Minister of Justice.”



五月己丑，高貴鄉公卒，年二十。〔一〕皇太后令曰：「吾以不德，遭家不造，昔援立東海王子髦，以為明帝嗣，見其好書疏文章，冀可成濟，而情性暴戾，日月滋甚。吾數呵責，遂更忿恚，造作醜逆不道之言以誣謗吾，遂隔絕兩宮。其所言道，不可忍聽，非天地所覆載。吾即密有令語大將軍，不可以奉宗廟，恐顛覆社稷，死無面目以見先帝。大將軍以其尚幼，謂當改心為善，殷勤執據。而此兒忿戾，所行益甚，舉弩遙射吾宮，祝當令中吾項，箭親墮吾前。吾語大將軍，不可不廢之，前後數十。此兒具聞，自知罪重，便圖為弒逆，賂遺吾左右人，令因吾服藥，密因酖毒，重相設計。事已覺露，直欲因際會舉兵入西宮殺吾，出取大將軍，呼侍中王沈、散騎常侍王業、〔二〕尚書王經，出懷中黃素詔示之，言今日便當施行。吾之危殆，過于累卵。吾老寡，豈復多惜餘命邪？但傷先帝遺意不遂，社稷顛覆為痛耳。賴宗廟之靈，沈、業即馳語大將軍，得先嚴警，而此兒便將左右出雲龍門，雷戰鼓，躬自拔刃，與左右雜衛共入兵陳間，為前鋒所害。此兒既行悖逆不道，而又自陷大禍，重令吾悼心不可言。昔漢昌邑王以罪廢為庶人，此兒亦宜以民禮葬之，當令內外咸知此兒所行。又尚書王經，凶逆無狀，其收經及家屬皆詣廷尉。」










[26] Hàn Jìn Chūnqiū states: The Emperor observed that his authority was daily leaving him, and could not contain his anger. Thus he summoned Attendant Central Wáng Chén, Secretariat Writer Wáng Jīng, Cavalier Regular Attendant Wáng Yè, and said: “Sīmǎ Zhāo’s heart, the people on the roads all know. I cannot sit by and receive the disgrace of being deposed. Today I will with you sirs personally set out to suppress him.” Wáng Jīng said: “In the past Lǔ Duke Zhāo could not tolerate the Jì clan, was defeated and fled and lost his state, laughed at by Heaven’s Under. Now power is with their gates, and has been for many days. The Court and Four Quarters all will serve them to the death, with no regard to the logic of rebellion or obedience, and it has not been so only for one day. Moreover the Residential Guard is empty and deficient, weapons and armor few and weak, what resources does Your Majesty have to use, to yet in one morning be like this, it is nothing more than to wish to remove an illness but instead make it more extreme! The disaster and danger are immeasurable, it is appropriate to be reconsidered in detail.” The Emperor thus produced from his chest the written order and threw it to the ground, saying: “Enacting it is decided. Even if I die, what is there to fear? All the more when death is not certain.” Thereupon he entered to inform the Dowager Empress. [Wáng] Chén and [Wáng] Yè fled to inform [Sīmǎ Zhāo] Wén-wáng, [Sīmǎ Zhāo] Wén-wáng made preparations for this. The Emperor therefore commanded boy servants of several hundred, drumming and trumpeting and setting out. [Sīmǎ Zhāo] Wén-wáng’s younger brother Garrison Cavalry Colonel [Sīmǎ] Zhòu entered, encountered the Emperor at the East Stopping Carriages Gate, [the Emperor’s] Left and Right rebuked them, [Sīmǎ] Zhòu’s multitudes fled. Central Protector of the Army Jiǎ Chōng also opposed the Emperor in battle below the South Watchtower. The Emperor personally used sword. The multitudes wished to retreat, Heir-Apparent’s Resident Chéng Jì asked [Jiǎ] Chōng: “The situation is critical, what do you say?” [Jiǎ] Chōng said: “The raising of you all was precisely speaking of today. In today’s affairs, there is nothing to ask about.” [Chéng] Jì at once advanced and stabbed the Emperor, the blade piercing out the back. [Sīmǎ Zhāo] Wén-wáng heard, was greatly alarmed, threw himself on the ground and said: “What will Heaven’s Under say of me?” Grand Tutor [Sīmǎ] Fú ran to go, pillowed the Emperor on his thighs and wept, his sorrow extreme, saying: “Your Majesty’s murder is Your Servant’s crime.”
Your Servant Sōngzhī believes Xí Zuòchǐ’s book, though it was the last produced, however its narration of this event distinctly has structured sequence. Therefore I first record Xí’s report, and have the minor differences in other reports placed after it.
Shìyǔ states: Wáng Chén and Wáng Yè hurried to inform [Sīmǎ Zhāo] Wén-wáng, Secretariat Writer Wáng Jīng to be upright would not go out, having [Wáng] Chén and [Wáng] Yè explain his intentions.
Jìn Zhūgōng zàn states: [Wáng] Chén and [Wáng] Yè were about to go out and called on Wáng Jīng. [Wáng] Jīng would not follow and said: “You my good sirs go.”
Gān Bǎo’s Jìn jì states: Chéng Jì asked Jiǎ Chōng saying: “The situation is critical, what do we do?” [Jiǎ] Chōng said: “The Duke’s raising of you all was for today’s affair. Why hesitate?” [Chéng] Jì said: “Right.” Then he thrust his spear and violated the Emperor’s path.
Wèishì Chūnqiū states: Wùzǐ [260 Jun 1], night, the Emperor personally led Surplus Followers Deputy Director Lǐ Zhāo and Yellow Gate Following Official Jiāo Bó and others to below Língyún Terrace, giving armor and weapons to the soldiers, wishing to take advantage of an opportunity to personally set out to suppress [Sīmǎ Zhāo] Wén-wáng. It happened to rain, the relevant managers memorialized to delay the date. Therefore he met Wáng Jīng and the rest and produced a yellow silk Edict from his chest and said: “If this can be tolerated, what cannot be tolerated? Today I will decisively enact this affair.” He entered to inform the Dowager Empress, and therefore drew sword and mounted carriage, commanding the Residential Guard in the Hall, ash-haired officials and servant boys, to beat the war drums, setting out Yúnlóng Gate. Jiǎ Chōng from the outside entered [the Palace], the Emperor’s brigade was routed and dispersed, but he declared himself Heaven’s Son, hand wielding saber to exert and strike, of the multitudes none dared draw near. [Jiǎ] Chōng commanded and urged the officers and soldiers, Cavalry Commander Chéng Cuì’s younger brother Chéng Jì with a pike advanced, the Emperor passed away in the brigade. At the time there was torrential rain and thunder and lightning, dark as night.
Wèi Mò zhuàn states: Jiǎ Chōng shouted at bannermen commander Chéng Jì saying: “If the Sīmǎ family’s affairs fail, how will you all have any descendants? Why not go out to strike!” [Chéng] Cuì and his brother two men thus lead the bannermen out, turned back and said: “Do we kill? Do we capture?” [Jiǎ] Chōng said: “Kill him!” The soldiers engaged, the Emperor said: “Drop your weapons!” The General-in-Chief’s soldiers all dropped their weapons. [Chéng] Jì and his brothers took advantage to advance and stabbed the Emperor, the Emperor fell below the chariot.



〔一〕　漢晉春秋曰：帝見威權日去，不勝其忿。乃召侍中王沈、尚書王經、散騎常侍王業，謂曰：「司馬昭之心，路人所知也。吾不能坐受廢辱，今日當與卿〔等〕自出討之。」王經曰：「昔魯昭公不忍季氏，敗走失國，為天下笑。今權在其門，為日久矣，朝廷四方皆為之致死，不顧逆順之理，非一日也。且宿衛空闕，兵甲寡弱，陛下何所資用，而一旦如此，無乃欲除疾而更深之邪！禍殆不測，宜見重詳。」帝乃出懷中版令投地，曰：「行之決矣。正使死，何所懼？況不必死邪！」於是入白太后，沈、業奔走告文王，文王為之備。帝遂帥僮僕數百，鼓譟而出。文王弟屯騎校尉伷入，遇帝於東止車門，左右呵之，伷眾奔走。中護軍賈充又逆帝戰於南闕下，帝自用劍。眾欲退，太子舍人成濟問充曰：「事急矣。當云何？」充曰：「畜養汝等，正謂今日。今日之事，無所問也。」濟即前刺帝，刃出於背。文王聞，大驚，自投于地曰：「天下其謂我何！」太傅孚奔往，枕帝股而哭，哀甚，曰：「殺陛下者，臣之罪也。」臣松之以為習鑿齒書，雖最後出，然述此事差有次第。故先載習語，以其餘所言微異者次其後。世語曰：王沈、王業馳告文王，尚書王經以正直不出，因沈、業申意。晉諸公贊曰：沈、業將出，呼王經。經不從，曰：「吾子行矣！」干寶晉紀曰：成濟問賈充曰：「事急矣。若之何？」充曰：「公畜養汝等，為今日之事也。夫何疑！」濟曰：「然。」乃抽戈犯蹕。魏氏春秋曰：戊子夜，帝自將宂從僕射李昭、黃門從官焦伯等下陵雲臺，鎧仗授兵，欲因際會，自出討文王。會雨，有司奏卻日，遂見王經等出黃素詔於懷曰：「是可忍也，孰不可忍也！今日便當決行此事。」入白太后，遂拔劍升輦，帥殿中宿衛蒼頭官僮擊戰鼓，出雲龍門。賈充自外而入，帝師潰散，猶稱天子，手劍奮擊，眾莫敢逼。充帥厲將士，騎督成倅弟成濟以矛進，帝崩于師。時暴雨雷霆，晦冥。魏末傳曰：賈充呼帳下督成濟謂曰：「司馬家事若敗，汝等豈復有種乎？何不出擊！」倅兄弟二人乃帥帳下人出，顧曰：「當殺邪？執邪？」充曰：「殺之。」兵交，帝曰：「放仗！」大將軍士皆放仗。濟兄弟因前刺帝，帝倒車下。













[27] Shìyǔ states: [Wáng] Yè was a Wǔlíng man, later became Jìn’s Central Protector of the Army.



〔二〕　世語曰：業，武陵人，後為晉中護軍。







Gēngyín [260 Jun 3], Grand Tutor [Sīmǎ] Fú, General-in-Chief [Sīmǎ Zhāo] Wén-wáng, Grand Commandant [Gāo] Róu, Excellency over the Masses [Zhèng] Chōng bowed head and said: “In prostration seeing the Central Order, that the former Duke of Gāoguì village was rebellious and without principles, brought on himself great disaster, and following the precedent of Hàn’s King of Chāngyì being deposed for his crimes, he is to be buried by a civilian’s Rituals. We Your Servants merely filled seats, could not rectify and rescue the disaster and chaos, restrain the treacherous rebellion, and receive the Order with trembling fear, liver and heart lamenting and cold. By the principles of the Chūnqiū, the ruler has no exterior, and so it writes: ‘King Xiāng went out to reside at Zhèng.’ He could not serve his mother; therefore he was cut off from the throne. Now the Duke of Gāoguì village acted recklessly without course, almost endangered the State Altars, upon himself brought downfall, cut off from Man and Divinity, burial by a civilian’s Rituals truly accords to the ancient canons. However, We Your Servants in prostration consider that Your Highness has benevolence and mercy surpassing all, and even though you maintain great righteousness, yet you bequeath sorrow and pity. We Your Servants in our hearts truly cannot bear it, and believe you can apply your grace to use a King’s Rituals to bury him.” The Dowager Empress followed this. [28]



庚寅，太傅孚、大將軍文王、太尉柔、司徒沖稽首言：「伏見中令，故高貴鄉公悖逆不道，自陷大禍，依漢昌邑王罪廢故事，以民禮葬。臣等備位，不能匡救禍亂，式遏姦逆，奉令震悚，肝心悼慄。春秋之義，王者無外，而書『襄王出居于鄭』，不能事母，故絕之于位也。今高貴鄉公肆行不軌，幾危社稷，自取傾覆，人神所絕，葬以民禮，誠當舊典。然臣等伏惟殿下仁慈過隆，雖存大義，猶垂哀矜，臣等之心實有不忍，以為可加恩以王禮葬之。」太后從之。〔一〕










[28] Hàn Jìn Chūnqiū states: Dīngmǎo [Xīnmǎo, 260 Jun 4], buried the Duke of Gāoguì village to Luòyáng’s northwest by thirty lǐ at the shore of Chán stream. Inferior chariots of a few carts, not setting banners or flags. The Hundred Surnames gathered together and watched it, saying: “That is Heaven’s Son who was killed the day before yesterday.” Some covered their faces and sobbed, unable to control their grief.
Your Servant Sōngzhī believes if it was inferior chariots of few carts and did no setting of banners or flags, how was it a burial by a King’s rituals? This probably was excessive words from disgust, what is called ‘not as extreme in fact.’



〔一〕　漢晉春秋曰：丁卯，葬高貴鄉公于洛陽西北三十里瀍澗之濱。下車數乘，不設旌旐，百姓相聚而觀之，曰：「是前日所殺天子也。」或掩面而泣，悲不自勝。臣松之以為若但下車數乘，不設旌旐，何以為王禮葬乎？斯蓋惡之過言，所謂不如是之甚者。







Sent Envoy Holding Stave the Acting Central Protector of the Army and Central Ramparts General Sīmǎ Yán north to welcome the Duke of Chángdào village [Cáo] Huáng to succeed as Emperor Míng’s posterity. Xīnmǎo [260 Jun 4], the various Excellencies memorialized the Dowager Empress stating: “Your Highness’s sagely virtue radiates and swells, calming and relieving the Six Directions, yet you only make ‘Orders,’ the same as a vassal state. We request that from now on Your Highness’s written Orders all be called Edicts and Regulations, following the precedent of the previous dynasty.”



使使持節行中護軍中壘將軍司馬炎北迎常道鄉公璜嗣明帝後。帝卯，群公奏太后曰：「殿下聖德光隆，寧濟六合，而猶稱令，與藩國同。請自今殿下令書，皆稱詔制，如先代故事。」




Guǐmǎo [260 Jun 16], the General-in-Chief firmly declined the honors of Chancellor of State, Duke of Jìn, and Nine Bestowments. The Dowager Empress’s Edict said: “To have achievements and not conceal it is a great principle of the Zhōu Yì, to complete a man’s beauty is what the ancient worthies esteemed. Now listen to the request, and send it out to show to the outside, to make clear the glory of Your Excellency’s modesty.”



癸卯，大將車固讓相國、晉公、九錫之寵。太后詔曰：「夫有功不隱，周易大義，成人之美，古賢所尚，今聽所執，出表示外，以章公之謙光焉。」




Wùshēn [260 Jun 21], General-in-Chief [Sīmǎ Zhāo] Wén-wáng sent up word: “The Duke of Gāoguì village led his following carriage men and soldiers, drawing blade and beating metal drums to head toward where Your Servant was located. Fearing that weapon blades would join together, at once I ordered the officers and soldiers to not do injury or harm, and violations of orders would be dealt with by Military Law. Cavalry Commander Chéng Cuì’s younger brother Heir-Apparent’s Resident [Chéng] Jì unexpectedly entered the battle lines and injured the Duke to the point that he lost his life. At once I arrested [Chéng] Jì and enacted Military Law. Your Servant has heard that the integrity of a servant of men is to accept death without second thought, the righteousness of serving superiors is to not dare to flee from troubles. Formerly the disaster suddenly arrived, the calamity like shooting a trigger, truly I wished to devote myself to accept death, by what command had decided. However considering that the original plan then was to above endanger the Imperial Dowager Empress, overturning the Ancestral Temple, Your Servant is shamed to bear my great appointment, righteousness is in securing the state, and I fear that even if I die, the crime would only be all the more serious. I wished to comply with the power of Yī and Zhōu, to calm the troubles of the State Altars, at once with relay stations I extended orders to not approach the [Emperor’s] carriage, but [Chéng] Jì hurriedly entered into the battle lines, so delivering a great change. Grief and distress and pain and regret, my five internal organs broken and torn apart, not knowing on what land I can fall upon. By the law for Grand Treason Without Principles, father and mother and wives and children and those of the same womb are all beheaded. [Chéng] Jì was vicious and cruel in rebellion, violating the state and disordering coherence, the punishment cannot merely be execution. At once order the Attendant Censor to arrest [Chéng] Jì’s family and dependents to send to the Minister of Justice, to bind and correct the crimes.” [29] The Dowager Empress’s Edict said: “Of the crimes that receive the Five Punishments, none are greater than to not be filial. If someone has a son that is not filial, one should report and punish him. How can this boy again be considered a ruler of men? I am a woman and do not understand Great Principles, and so said that [Chéng] Jì should not be considered Grand Treason. However the General-in-Chief’s intentions are sincere, speaking words sorrowful and mournful, therefore listen to what has been memorialized. Send it down to far and near, to have all know the beginning to end.” [30]



戊申，大將軍文王上言：「高貴鄉公率將從駕人兵，拔刃鳴金鼓向臣所止；懼兵刃相接，即敕將士不得有所傷害，違令以軍法從事。騎督成倅弟太子舍人濟，橫入兵陳傷公，遂至隕命；輒收濟行軍法。臣聞人臣之節，有死無二，事上之義，不敢逃難。前者變故卒至，禍同發機，誠欲委身守死，唯命所裁。然惟本謀乃欲上危皇太后，傾覆宗廟。臣忝當大任，義在安國，懼雖身死，罪責彌重。欲遵伊、周之權，以安社稷之難，即駱驛申敕，不得迫近輦輿，而濟遽入陳間，以致大變。哀怛痛恨，五內摧裂，不知何地可以隕墜？科律大逆無道，父母妻子同產皆斬。濟凶戾悖逆，干國亂紀，罪不容誅。輒敕侍御史收濟家屬，付廷尉，結正其罪。」〔一〕太后詔曰：「夫五刑之罪，莫大於不孝。夫人有子不孝，尚告治之，此兒豈復成人主邪？吾婦人不達大義，以謂濟不得便為大逆也。然大將軍志意懇切，發言惻愴，故聽如所奏。當班下遠近，使知本末也。」〔二〕










[29] Wèishì Chūnqiū states: Chéng Jì and his brother did not accept the punishment, climbed up to the roof naked, shamefully shouting obscenities. From below they were shot, and so died.



〔一〕　魏氏春秋曰：成濟兄弟不即伏罪，袒而升屋，醜言悖慢；自下射之，乃殪。













[30] Shìyǔ states: Previously during Qīnglóng [233 – 237], Shí Bāo sold iron in Cháng’ān, was able to meet Sīmǎ [Yì] Xuān-wáng, [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng became aware of him. Later he was selected out to be a Secretariat Writers Cadet, served as Qīng Province Inspector and Defending East General. During Gānlù [256 – 260] he entered Court, was about to return, took leave of the Duke of Gāoguì village, and stayed inside all day. [Sīmǎ Zhāo] Wén-wáng sent someone to intercept him and have him pass by. [Sīmǎ Zhāo] Wén-wáng asked [Shí] Bāo: “Why did you stay so long?” [Shí] Bāo said: “He is no ordinary man.” The next day he set out and reached Xíngyáng. A few days later the disaster occurred.



〔二〕　世語曰：初，青龍中，石苞鬻鐵於長安，得見司馬宣王，宣王知焉。後擢為尚書郎，歷青州刺史、鎮東將軍。甘露中入朝，當還，辭高貴鄉公，留中盡日。文王遣人要令過。文王問苞：「何淹留也？」苞曰：「非常人也。」明日發至滎陽，數日而難作。







Sixth Moon [260 Jun 26 – Jul 24], Guǐchǒu [260 Jun 26], Edict said: “In antiquity the names and appellations of the lords of men were difficult to violate and easy to avoid. Now the Duke of Chángdào village’s forbidden name and appellation are extremely difficult to avoid, thus the Court ministers are to widely discuss changing it and present memorials.”



六月癸丑，詔曰：「古者人君之為名字，難犯而易諱。今常道鄉公諱字甚難避，其朝臣博議改易，列奏。」
crumbs: 4  Annals of Three Young Emperors

title: 4  Annals of Three Young Emperors
text:
Jǐngyuán (260 - 263)


The King of Chénliú forbidden name Huàn appellation Jǐngmíng was Emperor Wǔ’s grandson, King of Yān [Cáo] Yǔ’s son. Gānlù Third Year, enfeoffed as Āncì county’s Chángdào village’s Duke. The Duke of Gāoguì village died, the Excellencies and Ministers discussed and welcomed to enthrone the Duke. Sixth Moon [260 Jun 26 – Jul 24], Jiǎyín [Jun 27], entered Luòyáng, met the Imperial Dowager Empress, that day ascended the Imperial Emperor’s throne in Tàijí Front Hall, Great Amnesty, changed the Year, bestowed on the people noble titles and grain and silk each on distinct basis.



陳留王諱奐，字景明，武帝孫，燕王宇子也。甘露三年，封安次縣常道鄉公。高貴鄉公卒，公卿議迎立公。六月甲寅，入于洛陽，見皇太后，是日即皇帝位于太極前殿，大赦，改年，賜民爵及穀帛各有差。




Jǐngyuán Inaugural Year, Summer, Sixth Moon [260 Jun 26 – Jul 24], Bǐngchén [260 Jun 29], advanced General-in-Chief Sīmǎ [Zhāo] Wén-wáng’s rank to Chancellor of State, enfeoffed Duke of Jìn, increased fief by two prefectures, adding to the previous to total ten, applied the gifts of the Nine Bestowments, entirely as in the previous Edict; all his various junior relatives that were not yet Marquesses all were enfeoffed as Marquesses of precincts, bestowed cash of ten million, silk of ten thousand pǐ, [Sīmǎ Zhāo] Wén-wáng firmly declined and so it stopped. Jǐwèi [260 Jul 2], former Hàn Emperor Xiàn’s consort [Cáo] Jié died, the Emperor oversaw [mourning] in Huálín Garden, sending Envoy Holding Stave to posthumously title the consort as Xiàn-Mù Huánghòu. The burial, chariots and dress regulation systems all followed the Hàn clan precedents. Guǐhài [260 Jul 6], appointed Secretariat Writers Right Deputy Director Wáng Guàn as Excellency of Works. Winter, Tenth Moon, [Wáng] Guàn died.



景元元年夏六月丙辰，進大將軍司馬文王位為相國，封晉公，增封二郡，并前滿十，加九錫之禮，一如前（奏）〔詔〕；諸群從子弟，其未有侯者皆封亭侯，賜錢千萬，帛萬匹，文王固讓乃止。己未，故漢獻帝夫人節薨，帝臨于華林園，使使持節追諡夫人為獻穆皇后。及葬，車服制度皆如漢氏故事。癸亥，以尚書右僕射王觀為司空，冬十月，觀薨。




Eleventh Moon [260 Dec 20 – 261 Jan 17], the King of Yān sent up a memorial of congratulations for the Winter Solstice, calling himself a Servant. Edict said: “The rulers of antiquity sometimes had those that were not Servants; the King should follow this principle. Can he in memorials not call himself Servant? Also what should be the reply? One who becomes the posterity for the main clan reduces his treatment of his personal parents; all the more when succeeding one of importance. But if then you are the same as the Servants, also my feelings will not be at ease. Thus all consult the ritual canons standards, to attend to thoroughly finding what is appropriate.” Relevant managers memorialized, believing: “In Rituals none are as esteemed as honoring ancestors, in regulations none are greater than the standard canon. Your Majesty examines virtue by allotted fate, succoring and overseeing the myriad states, succeeding to the importance of the main clan, expanding the foundations of the Three Zǔ. In prostration we consider that the King of Yān in body is honored as a relation, his correct rank as a vassal subject, he personally maintained reverent respect, compliantly walked in deferential virtue to be an example to the myriad states, his compliance to standard canon, expressing and conveying great obedience, and could not be restrained. The Sagely Court truly should honor him with exceptional regulations, treated with the rituals of not being a Servant. We Your Servants have settled discussions and believe that the King of Yān in Response Memorials can follow the old style. Of the Central Edicts applied, if they are inquiries on wellness, set them by the category of meaning as ‘respect for addressing Yān,’ it can slightly express your sagely respect, increase the lofty ceremonial forms of address, showing that you do not dare presume, and should say: ‘The Imperial Emperor respectfully inquires on the Great King’s attendant managers.’ As for Regulation letters, the state’s standard canon is how the Court distinguishes and displays public systems, announcing and spreading the courses of ceremonies to Heaven’s Under. It is appropriate to adhere to the law, and therefore say: ‘Regulation Edict on the King of Yān.’ Altogether the Edict mandates, Regulation letters, memorializing of affairs, sending up letters in addressing the King of Yān can all use High Level [format]. The affairs not of the Ancestral Temple and assisting sacrifices, all will not call the King by personal name, the memorializing of affairs, sent up letters, written documents, and officials and people are all to not touch on the King’s forbidden name, to make clear his exceptional rituals, above the various lords. Above it complies with the regulations of the ruler’s canon and honoring ancestors, below it follows your sagely respectful and expansive heart. The two are not transgressed, the ritual truly should be as this, and it can be widely announced and put into effect.”



十一月，燕王上表賀冬至，稱臣。詔曰：「古之王者，或有所不臣，王將宜依此義。表不稱臣乎！又當為報。夫後大宗者，降其私親，況所繼者重邪！若便同之臣妾，亦情所未安。其皆依禮典處，當務盡其宜。」有司奏，以為「禮莫崇于尊祖，制莫大于正典。陛下稽德期運，撫臨萬國，紹大宗之重，隆三祖之基。伏惟燕王體尊戚屬，正位藩服，躬秉虔肅，率蹈恭德以先萬國；其于正典，闡濟大順，所不得制。聖朝誠宜崇以非常之制，奉以不臣之禮。臣等平議以為燕王章表，可聽如舊式。中詔所施，或存好問，準之義類，則『（宴）〔燕〕覿之（族）〔敬〕』也，可少順聖敬，加崇儀稱，示不敢斥，宜曰『皇帝敬問大王侍御』。至于制書，國之正典，朝廷所以辨章公制，宣昭軌儀于天下者也，宜循法，故曰『制詔燕王』。凡詔命、制書、奏事、上書諸稱燕王者，可皆上平。其非宗廟助祭之事，皆不得稱王名，奏事、上書、文書及吏民皆不得觸王諱，以彰殊禮，加于群后。上遵王典尊祖之制，俯順聖敬烝烝之心，二者不愆，禮實宜之，可普告施行。」




Twelfth Moon [261 Jan 18 – Feb 16], Jiǎshēn [261 Jan 23], yellow dragon sighted at Huáyīn county inside a well. Jiǎwǔ [261 Feb 2], appointed Director of Retainers Colonel Wáng Xiáng as Excellency of Works.



十二月甲申，黃龍見華陰縣井中。甲午，以司隸校尉王祥為司空。




Second Year, Summer, Fifth Moon [261 Jun 15 – Jul 14], first day of the moon, the sun was eclipsed. Autumn, Seventh Moon [261 Aug 13 – Sep 11], Lèláng’s outer Yí, Hán and Huìmò, each led their subordinates to come to Court with tribute. Eighth Moon [261 Sep 12 – Oct 10], Wùyín [261 Sep 14], the King of Zhào [Cáo] Gàn died. Jiǎyín, again mandated General-in-Chief be advanced in noble title to Duke of Jìn, added rank as Chancellor of State, prepared the gifts of the honored bestowments, all like in previous Edicts. Again he firmly declined and so it stopped.



二年夏五月朔，日有食之。秋七月，樂浪外夷韓、濊貊各率其屬來朝貢。八月戊寅，趙王幹薨。甲寅，復命大將軍進爵晉公，加位相國，備禮崇錫，一如前詔；又固辭乃止。




Third Year, Spring, Second Moon [262 Mar 8 – Apr 5], green dragon sighted at Zhǐ county inside a well. Summer, Fourth Moon [262 May 6 – Jun 3], Liáodōng prefecture reported that the Sùshèn state had sent envoy with relay translators to enter with tribute, proffering their state’s bows of thirty sets, length three chǐ five cùn, wooden arrows length one chǐ eight cùn, stone crossbows of three hundred sets, leather and bone and iron miscellaneous armor of twenty sets, mink furs of four hundred sets. Winter, Tenth Moon [262 Oct 30 – Nov 28], Shǔ’s chief officer Jiāng Wéi invaded Táoyáng, Defending West General Dèng Ài resisted him, defeated [Jiāng] Wéi at Hóuhé. [Jiāng] Wéi escaped and fled. That year, Edict to sacrifice to former Army Libationer Guō Jiā in Tàizǔ Temple Hall.



三年春二月，青龍見于軹縣井中。夏四月，遼東郡言肅慎國遣使重譯入貢，獻其國弓三十張，長三尺五寸，楛矢長一尺八寸，石弩三百枚，皮骨鐵雜鎧二十領，貂皮四百枚。冬十月，蜀大將姜維寇洮陽，鎮西將軍鄧艾拒之，破維于侯和，維遁走。是歲，詔祀故軍祭酒郭嘉於太祖廟庭。




Fourth Year, Spring, Second Moon [263 Feb 25 – Mar 26], again mandated General-in-Chief [Sīmǎ Zhāo] be advanced in rank and noble title and bestowed all like in previous Edicts, again he firmly declined and so it stopped.



四年春二月，復命大將軍進位爵賜一如前詔，又固辭乃止。




Summer, Fifth Moon [263 Jun 23 – Jul 22], Edict said: “Shǔ is a petty and small state, its lands narrow and people few, but Jiāng Wéi oppressively uses his multitudes, never once abandoning his ambitions, after years of being defeated, yet he again plows and plants in Tàzhōng, exploiting the multitudes of Qiāng, conscripting and toiling without end, the people cannot bear his commands. Conquering the weak and attacking the ignorant is an excellent principle of warfare, delivering men but not being delivered to men is the highest strategy of the military schools. What Shǔ relies and depends on is only [Jiāng] Wéi and nothing more, taking advantage of his going far from his nests and caves, employing our strength is easy. Now send Campaigning West General Dèng Ài to command his various armies toward Gānsōng and Tázhōng to trap and capture [Jiāng] Wéi. Yōng Province Inspector Zhūgě Xù to command his various armies toward Wǔdū and Gāolóu, head and tail of the suppression. If [Jiāng] Wéi is captured, then east and west together advance, to sweep away and exterminate Bā-Shǔ.” Also mandated Defending West General Zhōng Huì to through Luògǔ attack Shǔ.



夏五月，詔曰：「蜀，蕞爾小國，土狹民寡，而姜維虐用其眾，曾無廢志；往歲破敗之後，猶復耕種沓中，刻剝眾羌，勞役無已，民不堪命。夫兼弱攻昧，武之善經，致人而不致於人，兵家之上略。蜀所恃賴，唯維而已，因其遠離巢窟，用力為易。今使征西將軍鄧艾督帥諸軍，趣甘松、沓中以羅取維，雍州刺史諸葛緒督諸軍趣武都、高樓，首尾蹵討。若擒維，便當東西並進，掃滅巴蜀也。」又命鎮西將軍鍾會由駱谷伐蜀。




Autumn, Ninth Moon [263 Oct 20 – Nov 17], Grand Commandant Gāo Róu died. Winter, Tenth Moon [263 Nov 18 – Dec 17], Jiǎyín [263 Dec 9], again mandated General-in-Chief [Sīmǎ Zhāo] to be advanced in rank and noble title and bestowals all as in previous Edicts. Guǐmǎo [263 Nov 28], enthroned as Imperial Empress Biàn-shì. Eleventh Moon [263 Dec 18 – 264 Jan 15], Great Amnesty.



秋九月，太尉高柔薨。冬十月甲寅，復命大將軍進位爵賜一如前詔。癸卯，立皇后卞氏，十一月，大赦。




From since Dèng Ài and Zhōng Huì led the multitudes to attack Shǔ, wherever they reached was at once conquered. That moon, Shǔ ruler Liú Shàn visited [Dèng] Ài to surrender. Bā-Shǔ was all pacified. Twelfth Moon [264 Jan 16 – Feb 14], Gēngxū [264 Feb 3], appointed Excellency over the Masses Zhèng Chōng as Grand Protector. Rénzǐ [264 Feb 5], divided Yì Province to form Liáng Province. Guǐchǒu [264 Feb 6], specially pardoned Yì Province’s servicemen and civilians, further exempted taxes by half for five years.



自鄧艾、鍾會率眾伐蜀，所至輒克。是月，蜀主劉禪詣艾降，巴蜀皆平。十二月庚戌，以司徒鄭沖為太保。壬子，分益州為梁州。癸丑，特赦益州士民，復除租賦之半五年。




Yǐmǎo [264 Feb 8], appointed Campaigning West General Dèng Ài as Grand Commandant, Defending West General Zhōng Huì as Excellency over the Masses. The Imperial Dowager Empress passed away.



乙卯，以征西將軍鄧艾為太尉，鎮西將軍鍾會為司徒。皇太后崩。
crumbs: 4  Annals of Three Young Emperors

title: 4  Annals of Three Young Emperors
text:
Xiánxī (264 - 265)


Xiánxī Inaugural Year, Spring, Standard Moon [264 Feb 15 – Mar 14], Rénxū [264 Feb 15], caged cart summoned Dèng Ài. Jiǎzǐ [264 Feb 17], [the Emperor] traveled to visit Cháng’ān. Rénshēn [264 Feb 25], sent envoys with jade rings and silk to sacrifice to Huà mountain. That moon, Zhōng Huì rebelled in Shǔ, was by the multitudes suppressed, Dèng Ài also was killed. Second Moon [264 Mar 15 – Apr 13], Xīnmǎo [264 Mar 15], specially pardoned all that were in Yì territory. Gēngshēn [264 Apr 13], buried Míng-Yuán Empress Guō. Third Moon [264 Apr 14 – May 12], Dīngchǒu [264 Apr 30], appointed Excellency of Works Wáng Xiáng as Grand Commandant, Campaigning North General Hé Zēng as Excellency over the Masses, Secretariat Writer Left Deputy Director Xún Yǐ as Excellency of Works. Jǐmǎo [264 May 2], advanced the Duke of Jìn’s [Sīmǎ Zhāo’s] noble title to King, enfeoffed ten prefectures, adding to the previous to twenty. [31] Dīnghài [264 May 10], enfeoffed Liú Shàn as Duke of Ānlè. Summer, Fifth Moon [264 Jun 12 – Jul 10], Gēngshēn [264 Jun 12], the Chancellor of State and King of Jìn [Sīmǎ Zhāo] memorialized to restore the Five Ranks of Nobility. Jiǎxū [264 Jun 26], changed the Year. Guǐwèi [264 Jul 5], posthumously mandated that Wǔyáng Marquess Xuān-Wén [Sīmǎ Yì] be Jìn King Xuān, Wǔyāng Marquess Zhōng-Wǔ [Sīmǎ Shī] be Jìn King Jǐng. Sixth Moon [264 Jul 11 – Aug 9], Defending West General Wèi Guàn sent up a jade ring and seal found by a Yōng Province soldier in Chéngdū county, one of each, the seal’s inscription resembling the characters “Chéng Xìn.” In accordance with the meaning of Zhōu Chéng-wáng giving over grain, announced and showed them to the hundred officials and stored them in the Chancellor of State’s office. [32]



咸熙元年春正月壬戌，檻車徵鄧艾。甲子，行幸長安。壬申，使使者以璧幣祀華山。是月，鍾會反于蜀，為眾所討；鄧艾亦見殺。二月辛卯，特赦諸在益土者。庚申，葬明元郭后。三月丁丑，以司空王祥為太尉，征北將軍何曾為司徒，尚書左僕射荀顗為司空。己卯，進晉公爵為王，封十郡，并前二十。〔一〕丁亥，封劉禪為安樂公。夏五月庚申，相國晉王奏復五等爵。甲戌，改年。癸未，追命舞陽宣文侯為晉宣王，舞陽忠武侯為晉景王。六月，鎮西將軍衛瓘上雍州兵于成都縣獲璧玉印各一，印文似「成信」字，依周成王歸禾之義，宣示百官，藏于相國府。〔二〕










[31] Hàn Jìn Chūnqiū states: The Duke of Jìn had been advanced in noble title to King, Grand Commandant Wáng Xiáng, Excellency over the Masses Hé Zēng, Excellency of Works Xún Yǐ together visited the King. [Xún] Yǐ said: “The Chancellor and King is esteemed and valued, Marquess Hé [Zēng] and the ministers of the entire Court already are all exhaustively respectful. Today then when we face him together we should bow. Have no doubts.” [Wáng] Xiáng said: “The Chancellor of State’s rank is powerful, truly honored and respected; however he is Wèi’s prime minister, and we are Wèi’s Three Excellencies. Excellency and King are separated by one step and nothing more. In the ranking and organization of all society, how can it be that Heaven’s Son’s Three Excellencies can bow to someone? It will decrease the prestige of the Wèi Court and damage the virtue of the King of Jìn. A noble man cares for men through ritual. I will not do it.” When they entered, [Xún] Yǐ therefore bowed, but [Wáng] Xiáng alone only saluted. The King spoke to [Wáng] Xiáng saying: “From today afterward I understand the heaviness of how you consider me.”



〔一〕　漢晉春秋曰：晉公既進爵為王，太尉王祥、司徒何曾、司空荀顗並詣王。顗曰：「相王尊重，何侯與一朝之臣皆已盡敬，今日便當相率而拜，無所疑也。」祥曰：「相國位勢，誠為尊貴，然要是魏之宰相，吾等魏之三公；公、王相去，一階而已，班列大同，安有天子三公可輒拜人者！損魏朝之望，虧晉王之德，君子愛人以禮，吾不為也。」及入，顗遂拜，而祥獨長揖。王謂祥曰：「今日然後知君見顧之重！」













[32] Sūn Shèng states: In the past Gōngsūn Shù because he rose in Chéngdū declared Chéng. The inscriptions of the two jades probably was made by [Gōngsūn] Shù.



〔二〕　孫盛曰：昔公孫述自以起成都，號曰成。二玉之文，殆述所作也。







Previously, from since after the pacification of Shǔ, Wú invaders garrisoned and pressured Yǒng’ān. Sent the various armies of Jīng and Yù [provinces] to drag and horn as rescue. Seventh Moon [264 Aug 10 – Sep 7], the rebels all escaped and retreated. Eighth Moon [264 Sep 8 – Oct 7], Gēngyín [264 Sep 10], mandated that Central Succorer of the Army Sīmǎ Yán assist as aide to Chancellor of State affairs, to agree with the meaning of the Duke of Lǔ being appointed afterward.



初，自平蜀之後，吳寇屯逼永安，遣荊、豫諸軍掎角赴救。七月，賊皆遁退。八月庚寅，命中撫軍司馬炎副貳相國事，以同魯公拜後之義。




Guǐsì [264 Sep 13], Edict said: “Formerly the traitor minister Zhōng Huì created rebellion and chaos, assembling the campaign officers and soldiers, forcing them with military power, beginning to spit out villainous plots, speaking out cruel treachery, pressuring and coercing the multitudes, having them all send down discussions, in the sudden hurried interval, none were not frightened and intimidated. The Chancellor of State’s Left Major Xiàhóu Hé, Cavalry Soldiers Department Associate Zhū Fǔ at the time were sent to Chéngdū, Central Manager of the Army’s Major Jiǎ Fǔ and Cadet Central Yáng Xiù each were participating in military affairs. [Xiàhóu] Hé, [Yáng] Xiù, [Zhū] Fǔ all resisted in integrity and would not yield, refusing [Zhōng] Huì’s vicious words, faced danger with no concerns, statement and direction upright and stern. [Jiǎ] Fǔ spoke to surplus officer Wáng Qǐ saying: ‘[Zhōng] Huì is treacherous and brutal, wishing to completely kill the officers and soldiers.’ He also said: ‘The Chancellor of State has already led multitudes of three hundred thousand to travel west to suppress [Zhōng] Huì,’ wishing to by this exaggerate the situation to encourage the hearts of the masses. [Wáng] Qǐ went out, and had [Jiǎ] Fǔ’s words announced and told to the various armies, and therefore had the officers and soldiers increased in their thoughts of exertion and encouragement. It is appropriate to apply prominent favor, to make clear the loyalty and righteousness. Thus advance [Xiàhóu] Hé and [Jiǎ] Fǔ in noble title to Marquesses of villages, [Yáng] Xiù and [Zhū] Fǔ in noble title to Marquesses Within the Passes. [Wáng] Qǐ spread and passed [Jiǎ] Fǔ’s words, informing the officers and soldiers, and should have exceptional rewards. Thus appoint [Wáng] Qǐ as Division Retainer Officer.”



癸巳，詔曰：「前逆臣鍾會構造反亂，聚集征行將士，劫以兵威，始吐姦謀，發言桀逆，逼脅眾人，皆使下議，倉卒之際，莫不驚懾。相國左司馬夏侯和、騎士曹屬朱撫時使在成都，中領軍司馬賈輔、郎中羊琇各參會軍事；和、琇、撫皆抗節不撓，拒會凶言，臨危不顧，詞指正烈。輔語散將王起，說『會姦逆凶暴，欲盡殺將士』，又云『相國已率三十萬眾西行討會』，欲以稱張形勢，感激眾心。起出，以輔言宣語諸軍，遂使將士益懷奮勵。宜加顯寵，以彰忠義。其進和、輔爵為鄉侯，琇、撫爵關內侯。起宣傳輔言，告令將士，所宜賞異。其以起為部曲將。」




Guǐmǎo [264 Sep 23], appointed Guard General Sīmǎ Wàng as Agile Cavalry General. Ninth Moon [264 Oct 8 – Nov 5], Wùwǔ [264 Oct 8], appointed Central Succorer of the Army Sīmǎ Yán as Succoring Army General-in-Chief.



癸卯，以衛將軍司馬望為驃騎將軍。九月戊午，以中撫軍司馬炎為撫軍大將軍。




Xīnwèi [264 Oct 21], Edict said: “The Wú rebels’ government and punishments are oppressive and cruel, taxation and exploitation without limit. Sūn Xiū sent envoy Dèng Gōu to order the Jiāozhǐ Administrator to use chains to send its people, to mobilize into soldiers. Wú officer Lǚ Xīng because the hearts of the people were enraged, and also as the ruler’s brigades had pacified and settled Bā-Shǔ, at once joined together towering heroes, executing and eliminating [Dèng] Gōu and the rest, expelling the Administrator and chief clerks, succoring and harmonizing the officials and people, to wait for the state’s commands. Jiǔzhēn and Rìnán prefectures heard that [Lǚ] Xīng had left rebellion to join obedience, and also joined hearts in answer, with [Lǚ] Xīng uniting together. [Lǚ] Xīng sent letters to Rìnán provinces and prefectures, spreading and showing great plans, soldiers overlooking Hépǔ, informing them of disasters and fortunes, sent Commandant Táng Pǔ and others to visit Jìnchéng county, and therefore Nánzhōng Overall Commander and Protector of the Army Huò Yì sent up the memorial explaining himself. Also Jiāozhǐ officers and officials each sent up memorials, saying: ‘[Lǚ] Xīng began the enterprise, large and small follow his commands. The prefecture has mountain bandits entering to join the various prefectures, fear that their intentions differ, each having doubts of betrayal. For the time being it is appropriate to appoint [Lǚ] Xīng as Commander of Jiāozhǐ’s various military affairs, Upper General-in-Chief, Marquess of Dìng’ān county. We beg for bestowal of commendations and rewards, to reassure the desolate borders.’ The heartfelt sincerity took form in these statements. In the past Yífù attended Court in Lǔ and the Chūnqiū deemed it beautiful, Dòu Róng submitted to Hàn and was treated with exceptional courtesy. Now the state’s authority shakes the distant, succoring and embracing the Six Directions, about to roll up the frontiers, unite as one the four borders. [Lǚ] Xīng turns his head toward the ruler’s influence, leading multitudes to bow and submit, across ten thousand lǐ hurrying to righteousness, requesting official and serving duties, and should be applied favorable treatment, esteemed with noble title and rank. This will allow [Lǚ] Xīng and the rest to embrace loyalty and feel joy, distant men to hear of it, and certainly all will be encouraged. Thus appoint [Lǚ] Xīng as Envoy Holding Stave, Overall Commander of Jiāo Province’s various military affairs, Nánzhōng General-in-Chief, enfeoffed Marquess of Dìng’ān county, able to by the suitability of affairs first act and only afterward send up report.” The conferment mandate had not yet arrived, [Lǚ] Xīng was killed by his subordinates.



辛未，詔曰：「吳賊政刑暴虐，賦斂無極。孫休遣使鄧句，敕交阯太守鎖送其民，發以為兵。吳將呂興因民心憤怒，又承王師平定巴蜀，即糾合豪傑，誅除句等，驅逐太守長吏，撫和吏民，以待國命。九真、日南郡聞興去逆即順，亦齊心響應，與興協同。興移書日南州郡，開示大計，兵臨合浦，告以禍福；遣都尉唐譜等詣進乘縣，因南中都督護軍霍弋上表自陳。又交阯將吏各上表，言『興創造事業，大小承命。郡有山寇，入連諸郡，懼其計異，各有攜貳。權時之宜，以興為督交阯諸軍事、上大將軍、定安縣侯，乞賜褒獎，以慰邊荒』。乃心款誠，形于辭旨。昔儀父朝魯，春秋所美；竇融歸漢，待以殊禮。今國威遠震，撫懷六合，方包舉殊裔，混一四表。興首向王化，舉眾稽服，萬里馳義，請吏帥職，宜加寵遇，崇其爵位。既使興等懷忠感悅，遠人聞之，必皆競勸。其以興為使持節、都督交州諸軍事、南中大將軍，封定安縣侯，得以便宜從事，先行後上。」策命未至，興為下人所殺。




Winter, Tenth Moon [264 Nov 6 – Dec 5], Dīnghài [264 Nov 6], Edict said: “In the past the sagely emperors and enlightened kings pacified chaos and relieved the world, protected the important and settled achievement. The civil and the military are different in application, but the merits and exploits are the same. Therefore some danced with shield and ax to admonish those that would not submit, some lined up brigades and regiments to awe the cruel and arrogant. As for loving the people and preserving the state, giving kindness to all sorts, certainly one must first cultivate culture and instruction, show them the proper course, when one has no other alternative and only then using troops, this is the same for all flourishing virtue. Formerly the end of Hàn was divided and collapsed, the nine lands overturned, Liú Bèi and Sūn Quán took advantage of the openings to create calamities. The Three Zǔ pacified the central Xià, but were not given enough days, and therefore allowed the remnant bandits to usurp and rebel for successive generations. By good fortune relying on the authoritative spirits of the Ancestral Temple, the governing assistant’s [Sīmǎ Zhāo’s] loyalty and martial power then spreading to the Four Quarters, opening and subduing Yōng and Shǔ, the campaign did not take a season, one expedition and then success. Since shortly ago the Jiāng’s exterior is declined and weakened, government and punishment desolate and ignorant, with Bā and Hàn pacified and settled, isolated and endangered without support, Jiāo, Jīng, Yáng, Yuè are thus turning to our influence. Now Jiāozhǐ false officer Lǚ Xīng already commanded three prefectures, across ten thousand lǐ submitted to the mandate, Wǔlíng’s fief Marquess’s Chancellor Yán and others joined together five counties, requesting to be servant and subject. Yùzhāng’s and Lúlíng’s mountain peoples led multitudes to rebel against Wú, taking Assisting North General as title. Also Sūn Xiū of illness died, the ruler and commanders changed, the state’s interior disordered and rebellious, each person having their own intentions. False officer Shī Jì, the rebel’s famed minister, is suspicious and doubtful of himself, deeply meeting with fear and hatred. The multitudes are rebelling and the close are deserting, none have firm wills, from antiquity to the present, there has never been signs of destruction as extreme as this. If the Six Armies shake and dazzle, to the south overlooking the Jiāng and Hàn, the region of Wú and Kuài certainly would support their old and carry their young to welcome the ruler’s brigades, an inevitable result. However raising and mobilizing great multitudes yet has labors and costs, it is appropriate to announce and explain power and virtue, openly demonstrate benevolence and faith, to allow them to understand the advantages of obedience and unification. Chancellor of State’s Advisor to Army affairs Xú Shào and River Department Official Sūn Yù in the past were at Shòuchūn, both met with capture. [Xú] Shào originally was false Nánlíng Commander, talent and character open and strong. [Sūn] Yù is Sūn Quán’s branch relation, loyal and good and discerning in affairs. Thus send [Xú] Shào south to return, with [Sūn] Yù as his aide, to spread and declare the state’s commands, inform and explain to the Wú men, all that is to be revealed and spoken of is all to be by the facts. If they are informed and aware, it will not damage the planning for campaigns; overall the temple victory’s far-reaching calculation is the way since antiquity. Thus appoint [Xú] Shào as concurrent Cavalier Regular Attendant, added Serving Chariots Commandant, enfeoffed a city precinct Marquess, [Sūn] Yù as concurrent Dispensing Affairs Yellow Gate Attendant Cadet, bestowed noble title as Marquess Within the Passes. The concubines bestowed on [Xú] Shào and the rest, with the male and female family servants that are here, are to all be permitted to accompany them, to make clear the state’s grace, and they are not required to return, to widely spread great faith.”



冬十月丁亥，詔曰：「昔聖帝明王，靜亂濟世，保大定功，文武殊塗，勳烈同歸。是故或舞干戚以訓不庭，或陳師旅以威暴慢。至于愛民全國，康惠庶類，必先脩文教，示之軌儀，不得已然後用兵，此盛德之所同也。往者季漢分崩，九土顛覆，劉備、孫權乘間作禍。三祖綏寧中夏，日不暇給，遂使遺寇僭逆歷世。幸賴宗廟威靈，宰輔忠武，爰發四方，拓定庸、蜀，役不浹時，一征而克。自頃江表衰弊，政刑荒闇，巴、漢平定，孤危無援，交、荊、揚、越，靡然向風。今交阯偽將呂興已帥三郡，萬里歸命；武陵邑侯相嚴等糾合五縣，請為臣妾；豫章廬陵山民舉眾叛吳，以助北將軍為號。又孫休病死，主帥改易，國內乖違，人各有心。偽將施績，賊之名臣，懷疑自猜，深見忌惡。眾叛親離，莫有固志，自古及今，未有亡徵若此之甚。若六軍震曜，南臨江、漢，吳會之域必扶老攜幼以迎王師，必然之理也。然興動大眾，猶有勞費，宜告喻威德，開示仁信，使知順附和同之利。相國參軍事徐紹、水曹掾孫彧，昔在壽春，並見虜獲。紹本偽南陵督，才質開壯；彧，孫權支屬，忠良見事。其遣紹南還，以彧為副，宣揚國命，告喻吳人，諸所示語，皆以事實，若其覺悟，不損征伐之計，蓋廟勝長算，自古之道也。其以紹兼散騎常侍，加奉車都尉，封都亭侯；彧兼給事黃門侍郎，賜爵關內侯。紹等所賜妾及男女家人在此者，悉聽自隨，以明國恩，不必使還，以開廣大信。」




Bǐngwǔ [264 Nov 25], mandated Succoring Army General-in-Chief and Marquess of Xīnchāng village [Sīmǎ] Yán be Jìn’s Heir Presumptive. That year, abolished Garrison Farm offices to standardize government and conscription, all the Managers of Agriculture all became Administrators, Commandants all became Magistrates and Chiefs. Encouraged and recruited Shǔ men that were able to move inward to be given government grain for two years, further exempted twenty years. Ānmí, Fúlù counties each reported Auspicious Grain growing.



丙午，命撫軍大將軍新昌鄉侯炎為晉世子。是歲，罷屯田官以均政役，諸典農皆為太守，都尉皆為令長；勸募蜀人能內移者，給廩二年，復除二十歲。安彌、福祿縣各言嘉禾生。




Second Year, Spring, Second Moon [265 Mar 5 – Apr 2], Jiǎchén [265 Mar 23], Qúrěn county caught a Spirit Turtle to proffer, submitted it to the Chancellor of State’s office. Gēngxū [265 Mar 29], as Tiger Elite Zhāng Xiū had in the past at Chéngdū rode quick horse to the various camps to warn of Zhōng Huì’s rebellion, and in the end lost his life, bestowed on [Zhāng] Xiū’s younger brother Zhāng Yǐ noble title as Marquess Within the Passes. Summer, Fourth Moon [265 May 3 – May 31] Nánshēnzé county reported Sweet Dew falling. Wú sent envoys Jǐ Zhì and Hóng Qiú to ask for peace.



二年春二月甲辰，朐〈月忍〉縣獲靈龜以獻，歸之于相國府。庚戌，以虎賁張脩昔於成都馳馬至諸營言鍾會反逆，以至沒身，賜脩弟倚爵關內侯。夏四月，南深澤縣言甘露降。吳遣使紀陟、弘璆請和。




Fifth Moon [265 Jun 1 – Jun 30], Edict said: “The Chancellor of State and King of Jìn [Sīmǎ Zhāo] widely spreads divine considerations, radiance covering the Four Seas, in shaking and dazzling martial achievements, then his power covers separate desolations, in flowing and striding influence, then he contacts with no exterior. Grieving and sympathizing with the Jiāng’s exterior, he attends to giving relief and nurturing, restraining warfare to esteem benevolence, demonstrating it with power and virtue. Where his written declaration was applied, receiving the influence they turned to admiration, sending envoy to offer tribute, to make clear their submission to obedience, regional gems and exquisite treasures, joyfully demonstrating their intentions. But the King is of utmost modesty, it was all entirely registered and sent. This is not how to reassure and support the newly attached and follow their earnest wishes. All that Sūn Hào has proffered and delivered is all to be returned and sent back to the King, to accord with ancient principles.” The King firmly declined and so it stopped. Also mandated that the King of Jìn use cap of ten and two tassels, establish the banners and flags of Heaven’s Son, announce to clear the way when exiting and entering, ride Gold Root chariot of Six Horses, equipped with Five Seasons escort chariots, install banner leaders and streamer followers, music and dancers of Eight Rows, establish Bells and Stands hanging at his Palace. Advanced the King’s consort to Royal Queen, Heir Presumptive to Heir-Apparent, the King’s sons, King’s daughters, King’s grandsons were mandated noble titles following the old ceremonies. Guǐwèi [265 Jun 30], Great Amnesty. Autumn, Eighth Moon [265 Aug 29 – Sep 26], Xīnmǎo [265 Sep 6], Chancellor of State and King of Jìn [Sīmǎ Zhāo] died. Rénchén [265 Sep 7], Jìn Heir-Apparent [Sīmǎ] Yán succeeded the fief and inherited the rank, taking command over all the officials, over all materials and conferment, all entirely as before. That Moon, Xiāngwǔ county reported a giant man sighting, over three zhàng in height, footprints three chǐ two cùn, white haired, wearing yellow single robe, yellow headscarf, leaning on a staff, who called to civilian Wáng Shǐ saying: “Now there will be Grand Peace.” Ninth Moon [265 Sep 27 – Oct 26], Yǐwèi, Great Amnesty. Wùwǔ [265 Oct 3], Excellency over the Masses Hé Zēng became Jìn’s Assistant Chancellor. Guǐhài [265 Oct 8], appointed Agile Cavalry General Sīmǎ Wàng as Excellency over the Masses, Campaigning East General-in-Chief Shí Bāo as Agile Cavalry General, Campaigning South General-in-Chief Chén Qiān as Chariots and Cavalry General. Yǐhài [265 Oct 20], buried Jìn King Wén [Sīmǎ Zhāo]. Intercalary Moon [265 Dec 25 – 266 Jan 22], Gēngchén [265 Dec 24], the Kāngjū and Dàyuān presented tribute of famed horses, submitted to the Chancellor of State’s Office, to make clear the merit of embracing myriad states and attracting the distant.



五月，詔曰：「相國晉王誕敷神慮，光被四海；震燿武功，則威蓋殊荒，流風邁化，則旁洽無外。愍卹江表，務存濟育，戢武崇仁，示以威德。文告所加，承風嚮慕，遣使納獻，以明委順，方寶纖珍，歡以效意。而王謙讓之至，一皆簿送，非所以慰副初附，從其款願也。孫皓諸所獻致，其皆還送，歸之于王，以協古義。」王固辭乃止。又命晉王冕十有二旒，建天子旌旗，出警入蹕，乘金根車、六馬，備五時副車，置旄頭雲罕，樂舞八佾，設鐘虡宮縣。進王妃為王后，世子為太子，王子、王女、王孫，爵命之號如舊儀。癸未，大赦。秋八月辛卯，相國晉王薨。壬辰，晉太子炎紹封襲位，總攝百揆，備物典冊，一皆如前。是月，襄武縣言有大人見，〔長〕三丈餘，跡長三尺二寸，白髮，著黃單衣，黃巾，柱杖，呼民王始語云：「今當太平。」九月乙未，大赦。戊午，司徒何曾為晉丞相。癸亥，以驃騎將軍司馬望為司徒，征東大將軍石苞為驃騎將軍，征南大將軍陳騫為車騎將軍。乙亥，葬晉文王。閏月庚辰，康居、大宛獻名馬，歸于相國府，以顯懷萬國致遠之勳。




Twelfth Moon [266 Jan 23 – Feb 21], Rénxū [266 Feb 4], Heaven’s blessings forever ended, the calendar calculations were on Jìn. Edict on the various Excellencies and Ministers and servicemen to prepare the ceremonies and establish a stage in the South Suburbs, sending envoy to present the Imperial Emperor Ruler’s Seal and Ribbon and conferment, abdicating the throne to the Jìn successor King [Sīmǎ Yán], following the Hàn-Wèi precedent. Jiǎzǐ [266 Feb 6], sent envoy to present the conferment. Therefore changed residence to Jīnyōng city, and in the end housed at Yè, at the time his years twenty. [33]



十二月壬戌，天祿永終，曆數在晉。詔群公卿士具儀設壇于南郊，使使者奉皇帝璽綬冊，禪位于晉嗣王，如漢魏故事。甲子，使使者奉策。遂改次于金墉城，而終館于鄴，時年二十。〔一〕










[33] Wèi Shìpǔ states: Enfeoffed the Emperor as King of Chénliú. His years fifty-eight, Dà’ān Inaugural Year [302] passed away, posthumous name Yuán Huángdì.



〔一〕　魏世譜曰：封帝為陳留王。年五十八，大安元年崩，諡曰元皇帝。







Appraisal states: In antiquity as Heaven’s Under is public, only by virtue was it shared. Later eras inherited ranks, enthroning sons as heirs. If the hereditary succession was not continued, then it is appropriate to select a close relative of enlightenment and virtue, like Hàn’s Wén and Xuān. This is an unchanging constant standard. Emperor Míng [Cáo Ruì] did not do this, his feelings clung to personal affection, adopting and raising an infant, passing on the great vessels, the entrustment was not focused, insisted on including the branch clans, and in the end Cáo Shuǎng was executed and exterminated, the King of Qí [Cáo Fāng] replaced on the throne. The Duke of Gāoguì village [Cáo Máo] was talented and intelligent and early to mature, enjoyed inquiry and valued literature, overall also having Emperor Wén’s [Cáo Pī’s] manner and legacy, however he was reckless and impatient, angered and unrestrained, and brought on himself great disaster. The King of Chénliú [Cáo Huàn] was himself deferential in facing south, the governing assistant [Sīmǎ Zhāo] controlled the government, looking up to comply with previous forms, he saluted and yielded and so abdicated, therefore enjoying fief of a large state, becoming the Guest to Jìn. Compared to Shānyáng, the treatment and favor was greater.



評曰：古者以天下為公，唯賢是與。後代世位，立子以適；若適嗣不繼，則宜取旁親明德，若漢之文、宣者，斯不易之常準也。明帝既不能然，情繫私愛，撫養嬰孩，傳以大器，託付不專，必參枝族，終于曹爽誅夷，齊王替位。高貴公才慧夙成，好問尚辭，蓋亦文帝之風流也；然輕躁忿肆，自蹈大禍。陳留王恭己南面，宰輔統政，仰遵前式，揖讓而禪，遂饗封大國，作賓于晉，比之山陽，班寵有加焉。

title: 5  Biographies of Empresses and Consorts
text:
The Yì1 states: “The Male correct position is the exterior, the Female correct position is the interior. Male and Female correct, is the Great Principle of Heaven and Earth.” Of the ancient former wise kings, none did not understand the regulation of Empresses and Consorts, follow the virtues of Heaven and Earth, therefore when the Two Consorts married to Guī, the Way of Yú completed prosperity, when Rén and Sì matched to Jī, the Zhōu House then flourished. Fall and Rise, Survival and Destruction, constantly are by this. The Chūnqiū explanations say Heaven’s Son has twelve women, vassal lords nine women, examining this by sense and reason, it is an unchanging standard. But the last generations [of a dynasty] are extravagant and indulgant, unrestrained in their excessive desires, reaching to causing male and female to be resentful and unmarried, emotionally disturbing harmonious aura, only attractiveness is esteemed, not rooted in beautiful virtue, therefore moral teachings decline and the great [social] network is ruined and destroyed. Is it not lamentable? Alas, for those with state and with family, this can be an eternal reflection!



易稱「男正位乎外，女正位乎內；男女正，天地之大義也」。古先哲王，莫不明后妃之制，順天地之德，故二妃嬪媯，虞道克隆，任、姒配姬，周室用熙，廢興存亡，恆此之由。春秋說云天子十二女，諸侯九女，考之情理，不易之典也。而末世奢縱，肆其侈欲，至使男女怨曠，感動和氣，惟色是崇，不本淑懿，故風教陵遲而大綱毀泯，豈不惜哉！嗚呼，有國有家者，其可以永鑒矣！




In the Hàn system, the Emperor’s paternal grandmother is called Grand Imperial Dowager Empress, the Emperor’s mother called Imperial Dowager Empress, the Emperor’s consort called Imperial Empress, the other inner offices [the harem] ten and four ranks. Wèi followed the Hàn laws, the titles of the mothers and Empresses, all were as the old system. From the Lady (fūrén) on down, the generations had additions and reductions. Tàizǔ established the state, first mandating the Royal Queen, those below were five ranks: having Lady (fūrén), having Zhāoyí, having Jiéyú, having Rónghuá, having Měirén. Emperor Wén added Guìpín, Shūyuán, Xiūróng, Shùnchéng, Liángrén. Emperor Míng added Shūfēi, Zhāohuá, Xiūyí; abolished the Shùnchéng office. During Tàihé [227 - 232] first restored the Mìng Fūrén, raised its position to above Shūfēi. From Fūrén on down the nobility was altogether twelve ranks: Guìpín and Fūrén positions were after the Imperial Empress, nobility without a match. Shūfēi position matched the Chancellor of State, nobility comparable to the vassal lords and kings. Shūyuán position matched the Censorate Grandee, nobility comparable to county Duke. Zhāoyí comparable to county Marquess. Zhāohuá comparable to village Marquess. Xiūróng comparable to precinct Marquess. Xiūyí comparable to Within the Passes Marquess. Jiéyú matched to Central Two Thousand Dàn. Rónghuá matched to True Two Thousand Dàn. Měirén matched to Comparable Two Thousand Dàn. Liángrén matched to Thousand Dàn.



漢制，帝祖母曰太皇太后，帝母曰皇太后，帝妃曰皇后，其餘內官十有四等。魏因漢法，母后之號，皆如舊制，自夫人以下，世有增損。太祖建國，始命王后，其下五等：有夫人，有昭儀，有婕妤，有容華，有美人。文帝增貴嬪、淑媛、脩容、順成、良人。明帝增淑妃、昭華、脩儀；除順成官。太和中始復命夫人，登其位於淑妃之上。自夫人以下爵凡十二等：貴嬪、夫人，位次皇后，爵無所視；淑妃位視相國，爵比諸侯王；淑媛位視御史大夫，爵比縣公；昭儀比縣侯；昭華比鄉侯；脩容比亭侯；脩儀比關內侯；婕妤視中二千石；容華視真二千石；美人視比二千石；良人視千石。
